notes.title: Get Ready for the Mighty Carp Tour 2025
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fde8626c826b278d2c5c64dae39fad6033f31355.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p]The legendary Carp is calling, and it’s time to gear up for the challenge in the Mighty Carp Tour 2025![/p][p]If you’re passionate about carp fishing, this is your chance to prove your mastery in one of the toughest freshwater competitions of the year. You’ll face diverse venues, each with its own challenges, from the historic Tiber River in Italy to the vast waterways of San Joaquin Delta in the USA, the renowned Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany, and the legendary Weeping Willow Fishery in Great Britain.[/p][p]Beginner players who may not want to participate can still register to receive passes to all tournament locations, so you can explore new places in the game that you haven’t unlocked yet. You can also get a whole bundle of goodies including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need to enjoy your Carp fishing experience with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000715/Fishing_Planet_Mighty_Carp_Tournament_Pack/"]The Mighty Carp Tournament Pack,[/url] regardless of whether or not you’ll choose to take on the Tournament challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000715/Fishing_Planet_Mighty_Carp_Tournament_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]Tournament Dates:[/h3][p][/p][p]September 8 – Registration opens (24 hours before the First Qualifier)[/p][p]September 9 – Qualifier 1: Tiber River, Italy[/p][p]September 10 – Qualifier 2: San Joaquin Delta, USA[/p][p]September 11 – Qualifier 3: Sander Baggersee Lake, Germany[/p][p]September 13 – Semifinal: Sander Baggersee Lake, Germany[/p][p]September 14 – Grand Finale: Weeping Willow Lakes, Great Britain[/p][p][/p][h3]Important! Check all tournament details in the Sports → Tournament tab within the game.[/h3][p]* Only Carp Rods are permitted. Rod stands and keepnets are allowed.[/p][p]* Boats and stringers are not allowed.[/p][p]* Review the [url="https://fishingplanet.com/TournamentRules.htm"]Competitive Activities rules[/url] before registering.[/p][p]* Only one Fishing Planet account is allowed per device for tournaments. If you’re playing with family, each member will need their own device to participate.[/p][p][/p][p]Sharpen your rigs, study the waters, and bring your A-game. See you bankside—tight lines and good luck![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b04fae6ecdd9808b3dba93535a777135dc3b6e79.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Customize Your Fishing Journey with Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95a1e5bbde914dc231e1b96c4186dd1dcfcf0b00.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers, 
[/p][p]We’re excited to introduce Fishing Planet Steam Trading Cards - collectible cards users earn by playing on Steam. By collecting the entire set of cards you can earn items that help you customize your profile. You can collect cards inspired by legendary fish species, get unique badges and backgrounds for your Steam profile and emotes to use in Steam chat. All of this lets you personalize your Steam profile and make it feel like a showcase of your fishing journey.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Trading Cards[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our cards bring to life some of the most iconic species on the Planet. Collect them simply by playing Fishing Planet, and the more time you spend on the water, the more chances you’ll have to reel in a random free card. Typically, you’ll get about half of the set just from playing, while the rest comes as you trade with friends or visit the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/market/"][u]Steam Marketplace[/u][/url] to swap with anglers from all over the world. Collecting cards lets you craft badges that add to your Steam Level and is a fun way to show your expertise in Fishing Planet! [/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Let’s take a closer look![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Perch Bully [/b][/p][p]A vicious perch with a massive jaw and nasty bite.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a256fdafd1cb702e494f9333bc20d17b4408cbb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Fighter Shark [/b][/p][p]Scarred and one-eyed, this shark became a nightmare even for caimans.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c68842fc713e43e1ea67b4320e8a9c795cd8577.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Elusive Arapaima [/b][/p][p]The legendary spirit of Lake Maku-Maku, feared and revered by generations of anglers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3b2f1d0d91e3f9bb0b79713846d518f57c68f60c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Wailing Catfish [/b][/p][p]A fearsome catfish from the Marron River, known for its growling cries that echo through the jungle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b242a88e38844c46e82f9927640b7960cc3a1754.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Carp Colossus [/b][/p][p]A massive, terrifying carp haunting the waters of Weeping Willow.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eed877954c6369697234cdedbe86f5443fb70e74.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Taimen-Khan [/b][/p][p]The unstoppable ruler of the Selenge – massive, ruthless, and always hungry.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/66b4627e13d251da5f5193d4bad7732b52caa460.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Northern Snakehead [/b][/p][p]A land-crawling predator with an appetite for everything, even birds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7fa82301521a014f077fdccc1a157115a685762d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Badges & Emotes[/b][/h3][p]Once you’ve gathered all 7 Fishing Planet Trading Cards, you can craft a unique Steam badge. Each full set you complete will raise your badge to the next tier — starting with Fishing Novice and climbing through Experienced Angler, Master of Fishing, and Mythic Catcher, until you reach the final honor: King of the Ocean! You can also collect a unique badge crafted from Foil Trading Cards. Unlike the regular one, it can only be crafted once per game and does not level up.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="center"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcgGjpZe7AHx3ZBBDYZ_06G8kgMIWq3h_91R4hnFeOE93IxUvLw5bnSDf71icNI7Va3OLnDMUuuuralIon4JhmC-3nV6j7D7TJNqrxP3AOfsBKnnQhhrmisTYb2jy8_PwS-qpYJ1A?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXecCDJJrVXfGnnZDAAoPRJsE2_cb6njs7sU_HPOeuri-kH1oL5rHEOQ81_daeephBokX0GF2q0GB63nNt5xCpHi1aiUnaWHtgLaF-4qd5ROMhs6C9yBHi60HdQ1O1cibZyiP3yIuQ?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc88YJJnLFf8jalWTJmoiVGIxOMRenGz_D0bQxXsKMcNsi6LupjwKVTc4jiVg1RgJjq-6QAltSqOaNKOD7hB6m4wY1cT33oDwMGA0gj9Dmu3a04huZ2OR3814j3a4fgRZbeT7Hm-A?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcxSx51PiTHF8hseSfOH86iYBy4CrLtLCmLeIelnusB5fhrpamTsNrJ8YRTPX8EBr-zZ555cDIFw65QU5A0R0dRzuAAi_wT92xu8BqFactU07Erxc6M5NeM5hQWiH46MXaRj738fA?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe-VYbsF34cf4x9zYIibKl1_fvu8ezKY0nIe7_jXgP--NtEYPDy1wo2oAP-uggIT8RGZXwc9RJFMCl57kTVj2xZkaR1NUoUIoqzB8onrfWVAXm_KK8vXbeV41WW1PLRQa75A7kg2A?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVulUJLjxiGGPkSw9QmGkOoRmUhnMkCoU1yICSXO_SsJ_ecByS83u_EKTmhZUiTZzmmx6p9wjutDeavUEeQORcoK2VFWi-jVbmI9z8k63VQBgOZUxCvXQi3j6sLSllg0DE0wk?key=jnbE-cB2rshobKqhE5O83g"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Along with boosting your Steam profile level, you’ll unlock new backgrounds and a pack of fishing-themed emotes. Drop them into your chats to bring a bit of Fishing Planet flavor into every conversation. notes.title: Celebrating Fishing Planet's 10 Years Anniversary
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/061aa8d846f3adac8a9a211771fe17d8d1be0a0e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p]Today marks a very special day for us. Exactly 10 years ago, Fishing Planet was introduced to the world on Steam. What started as a small project by a tight-knit team, more like a family, has grown into something we never imagined. And now, our beloved creation is celebrating its very first jubilee![/p][p][/p][p]Anniversaries are the perfect time to reflect on the journey: to look back at milestones, draw some conclusions, and set bold intentions for the future. So let’s rewind to the very beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]Some of you have been with us from the very start and remember just how small the game once was, and how much it has grown. And for those who joined more recently, it might come as a surprise that the very first location wasn’t Lone Star Lake. Back in August 2015, the original launch included Emerald Lake, along with Rocky Lake, Mudwater River, Neherrin River, Falcon Lake, Everglades, and the San Joaquin Delta. Later that year, Saint-Croix Lake arrived in October, followed by White Moose Lake in December.[/p][p]Lone Star Lake didn’t appear until April 2016, with Kamiq Creek joining in August the same year. Quanchkin Lake opened its waters to players in January 2017.[/p][p][/p][p]2018 was a landmark year for European destinations. In December, we introduced Lesni Vila, Ghent-Terneuzen Canal, Tiber River, and Sander Baggersee Lake, followed by Weeping Willow Fisheries in March 2019. The adventure continued in 2020 with Blue Crab Island, Maku-Maku Lake, and the Marron River. Then, in 2021, came the stunning Amazonian Maze along with the ever-popular Congo River. The Selenge River in Mongolia arrived in June 2022, and just two years later, the long-awaited Ocean at Kaiji No Ri launched in June 2024, adding to the game a whole new level of challenge with saltwater fishing and Fishing Together with your buddies on the same boat.[/p][p][/p][p]In December 2024, we added something deeply meaningful, our home location in Ukraine, a small Christmas gift both to our players and ourselves. And just this summer, the breathtaking and luxurious Maldives made their debut on Steam and Epic Games, with other platforms soon to follow.[/p][p][/p][p]And speaking of platforms, there are already eight! Fishing Planet launched on PlayStation in 2017, followed by Xbox and UWP in 2019, iOS and Android in 2023, Epic Games in 2024, and Nintendo Switch in 2025 - making the game available on nearly every widely used platform around the world, just a download away![/p][p][/p][p]From dozens of fishing techniques and mechanics to competitions, seasonal events, and hundreds of unique fishing items - sometimes it’s hard to believe all of this was created by a small, passionate team of fewer than 50 people.[/p][p][/p][p]And thinking about all of this, we can’t forget that it’s you - our incredible community - who make it all possible. All of you who love the game (and sometimes hate it too), who invest hundreds of hours mastering your skills and precision, who support us through feedback, bug reports, in-game purchases, and by being active in the community on social media - you’re the reason the world of Fishing Planet exists. Without you, none of it would have any meaning.[/p][p][/p][p]To give you a sense of how massive our shared Planet has become, we’ve gathered some statistics, and some fun facts for you. There are now over 35 million players across all platforms, and together you spent a total of 80,925,684 hours in the game last year. That’s 3,371,070 days, or 9,231 years. Yes, nine thousand two hundred and thirty-one years of fishing! For context, that’s more time than has passed since the very first human civilizations emerged on Earth as it was only 6000 years ago.[/p][p][/p][p]And just last year alone, players across all platforms caught 845,546,903 fish, that’s 845 million, weighing a total of 5,756,176,873 kilograms, or almost 13 billion pounds. To put that into perspective, that’s enough fish to fill 2,300 Olympic-sized swimming pools, it weighs as much as 960,000 adult elephants, or, if laid end-to-end (assuming an average of 40 cm per fish), it would form a line over 2.3 million kilometers long, enough to reach the Moon and back three times, with fish to spare.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the launch of Fishing Together, players have hosted 384,826 Fishing Together sessions across all platforms. We hope that sharing boats with friends made plenty of real friendships stronger too.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past year, players across all platforms earned an incredible 565,461,512 Baitcoins collected through Daily Bonuses, the Reel of Fortune, Events, Competitions and Tournaments, Achievements, Leveling Up, Gaining Ranks, Twitch Drop rewards, and other in-game activities.[/p][p][/p][p]We also tried calculating how many Credits our hardworking anglers earned by catching and selling fish, but the numbers were simply astronomical, reaching into the quadrillions, which is a number with 15 zeros![/p][p][/p][p]To help grasp just how massive that is: if you spent $1 million every minute, non-stop, you’d burn through $1.44 billion per day. And even then, it would take you over 1,900 years to spend $1 quadrillion. And if you stacked $1 quadrillion in $100 bills, the pile would reach over 1 billion kilometers high, which is enough to stretch from Earth to Saturn.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope these wild numbers bring a smile to your face and to keep the celebration going, we’ve prepared a little surprise many of you have asked for. We know some of you love the music tracks that played in the game menu over the years, so we’ve created a special YouTube video with all those tracks and gameplay in the background, so you can enjoy them anytime you feel nostalgic. Head over to our YouTube channel and give it a listen! And everyone who leaves a comment under that video on YouTube will have a chance to win one of the three Japan Ocean Packs![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LXtkgqnz8o0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]But that’s not all. As some of you already know, an epic [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/528728489311862987"]Twitch Drops campaign[/url] is live right now! You can earn 108,000 Credits, 25 Baitcoins, tons of exclusive fishing items, and access to 10 of the most-loved locations in the game![/p][p][/p][p][b]And don’t forget about the Anniversary Premium Deals with 1, 6, and 12-month Premium bundles that include extra in-game currency, plus up to 60% OFF on Unlimited Licenses and Travel Cost in-game.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned to our social media and keep celebrating with us, there’s more to come, including giveaways and anniversary activities on our[url="https://discord.gg/fMxN9af2"] Discord server[/url] and [url="https://www.facebook.com/groups/fishingplanetofficial"]Facebook group.[/url] Follow us, stay with us, fish with us and continue shaping the future of Fishing Planet together with us.[/p][p][/p][p]With all our hearts and warmest wishes for what’s ahead. [/p][p][/p][p]Tight lines and see you on the water![/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch Note - Version 5.0.18
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e84901a9e4c2cb0fbf3f47b4222fa7a830db70ad.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p]It’s been a busy couple of weeks for our team, and we want to thank all of you for patiently waiting for the next Bug Fix Patch.[/p][p]In this update, we’ve tackled a number of issues reported by players and spotted by our QA team, and one of the most important issues where massive fish (500+ kg) would get stuck in the final few meters and couldn’t be landed for a while. This should now be resolved![/p][p]We also heard your feedback about the challenge of landing the largest fish in the game, like Unique Black Marlin and Unique Swordfish over 500 kg, taking too long to bring in. To understand this better, we analyzed all catches of these giants within the last month, looking at the time from hook to landing.[/p][p]Here’s what we found:[/p][list][*][p]Around 50% of these catches take players [b]13–14 minutes[/b] on average.[/p][/*][*][p]The majority (50–99%) take [b]15–25 minutes[/b] on average.[/p][/*][*][p]Only about [b]1% of catches[/b] go up to 50 minutes on average and sometimes even longer  — rare cases, but they do happen.
[/p][/*][/list][p]If you find yourself struggling to land these giants within 15–25 minutes, consider working on your technique, seeking tips from experienced anglers, and making sure you’re using the best gear available. Please, also keep in mind that at the highest levels, even more powerful rods and reels become available to help you bring in these beasts faster. It’s very important , these are ocean monsters — some up to 600 kg, there must be that [i]true[/i] big game fishing challenge![/p][h3]Now, let’s dive into the rest of the fixes and improvements included in this patch:[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed a bug where exiting the settings triggered an “unsaved changes” message, and the ESC button became unresponsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Sunglasses once again reduce sun brightness as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue when big fish would hang in the last 2-3 meters for some time before it could be landed on the catamaran.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect detection when using Vertical Jigging.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish radars on the catamaran’s onboard monitors and the captain’s bridge now display consistent results.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue allowing players to pass through certain objects on the largest island in the Maldives location.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the volume of the Bar Music in Maldives to match the music volume set in the game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Bar music from the resort no longer plays far out at sea in Maldives.[/p][/*][*][p]The player profile now opens correctly from the local chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where synchronous relocation via the captain’s pin during Fishing Together sessions caused the game to break for one of the players.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where purchasing a license would sometimes result in the wrong license being bought.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing players to fall underwater when fast-forwarding time to the next day and declining boat rental.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed disconnects occurring after fish were taken into hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were teleported back to the beach when moving through bushes on the main Atoll at Maldives.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the overly bright, acidic color of plankton at 4a.m at Maldives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the cooldown was not removed correctly when skipped using a Baitcoin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where changing a boat’s PIN caused a blinking effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where boats and kayaks appeared upside down after being returned to their start position.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character appeared elevated above the wooden bridge on Falcon Lake.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where received Marker Buoys displayed stubs and empty buttons in the “Receive a Buoy from Friend” window.[/p][/*][*][p]Added email notifications for automatically approved Sponsored Competitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where no hint was shown about boat relocation to the start position after a player changed their PIN.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jonin 20000 SE reel thumbnails were mixed up in the shop and inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Rod Holder’s height adjuster on Chamaeleon Catamaran stopped working after teleporting with a Navigation Buoy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the competition details window automatically opened when hovering over the first competition in the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where feeder and sinker items were missing from templates.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved various graphical issues, including water reflections in pools and visual artifacts in sand at Maldives.[/p][/*][*][p]Other improvements and optimizations to enhance overall game performance.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to share your feedback and bug reports — they help us make the game better with every update. We’ll keep working to improve your experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Tight lines and good luck on the water![/p][p][/p][p]_______________________________________________________________[/p][p][b]Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:[/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2Ffpofficial"]Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fgroups%2Ffishingplanetofficial"]Facebook Group[/url] [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f95dc6bb2da1e4b7acd2c0ba3121c6ec7994d69b.png"][/img][/p][h1]Recent Fixes[/h1][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p]As you may know, we've rolled out a series of hotfixes over the past few days. We’ve made good progress and expect to have those resolved soon.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Compensations[/h1][p]We truly appreciate your patience and support during this time. Now that the system has stabilized, we want to offer a token of thanks to our amazing community with the following compensations:
[/p][olist][*][p]Players who purchased Chamaeleon Cruiser Pack or Atoll Scout Pack in the period from the release on June 18th until the crashes were fixed on June 24, will receive additional 7 days of pond pass to Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives, Advanced License and Premium.[/p][/*][*][p]Players, who had any other packs with Premium or Premium account itself during this period, will receive additional 3 days of Premium. They will be added automatically when you log in from Friday, June 27 at 00:00 AM UTC until Monday, June 30 at 00:00 AM UTC.[/p][/*][*][p]All the other players, including those from the second group will receive 24 hours of pond pass to Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives, Advanced License and 44 000 credits for their trip to the location, - available to claim by logging in between Friday, June 27 at 00:00 AM UTC and Monday, June 30 at 00:00 AM UTC.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]Please, be aware that you need to log into the game during this weekend period to receive your access to Maldives![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful for your continued support, especially to those who purchase DLC packs right after major releases — even knowing there might be early issues. Your trust means the world to us, and none of this would be possible without you.[/p][p]Wishing you a fantastic weekend — and don’t forget, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/528724684296946002?l=english"]the Ocean Drops Campaign[/url] is still live! Be sure to grab those extra lures, baits, credits, and Baitcoins for your next fishing adventure in the Maldives.[/p][p]See you on the crystal-clear waters of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu.[/p][p][/p][p]Tight lines![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/123dd2a93ff5a3d07ace5795083adb47985e93a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]_______________________________________________________________[/p][p][b]Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:[/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2Ffpofficial"]Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fgroups%2Ffishingplanetofficial"]Facebook Group[/url]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/131aed3352d2423cf218cf1d847cdfdef50d65a8.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers, [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve released a new Hotfix Patch to address crashes and freezes some of you experienced after the Maldives Update. More fixes are on the way in the coming days, but here’s what’s included in this patch: [/p][olist][*][p]Fixed a temporary freeze on the loading screen when an “app not responding” error appeared,[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the game would become unresponsive when switching categories in the Menu or Inventory,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash/freeze when Global Chat was open while on a waterway,[/p][/*][*][p]Additional improvements to overall game stability and performance,[/p][/*][/olist][p]We hope this patch helps improve your gameplay experience. Please try playing and let us know if these fixes work for you—we really look forward to your feedback. We're also actively investigating a critical issue with black screens appearing when entering Photo Mode. [/p][p]If this happens to you, here’s how you can help: [/p][olist][*][p]After the issue occurs, close the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]Go to the Fishing Planet folder that can be found here: [b]log%USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Fishing Planet LLC\\FishingPlanet[/b] and find the two Player log files.[/p][/*][*][p]Send both files to [b][url="https://support@fishingplanet.com"]support@fishingplanet.com[/url][/b] with a short note mentioning it was the black screen bug and the fish you had just caught before it happened.,[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you all for your continued support and patience. [/p][p]Tight Lines![/p][p][/p][p]_______________________________________________________________  [/p][p][b]Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:[/b]  [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/fpofficial"]Discord[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/groups/fishingplanetofficial"]Facebook Group[/url][/p]

notes.title: Post-Release Fixes and Compensation
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f95dc6bb2da1e4b7acd2c0ba3121c6ec7994d69b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p]Here’s a quick update on the post-release fixes.[/p][p]We’re aware of some crash and freezing issues and are actively working on fixes. A new update is rolling out at this very moment to improve game stability. To avoid interruptions in your game play, we’re updating servers one by one, as many players are online. A few more updates will follow in the coming days, and we’ll keep you posted.[/p][p]While it might seem like everyone is reporting issues, our data shows that most players are playing smoothly. Still, every affected player matters to us. The crashes vary in cause, and limited diagnostic info from users makes it harder to resolve quickly—but we’re on it.[/p][p]We’re also considering compensation options for those who made in-game purchases during this period. First, we want to make sure the game is fully stable—then we’ll take care of compensation. Rest assured that your experience and satisfaction are our top priority. We’ll share details about compensation after the fixes are in place.[/p][p]Regarding another reported issue—reeling in big fish (500+ kg) on the new map—some of you noticed that they get stuck in the last few meters. Our investigation showed that this isn’t a bug but a physics-based interaction. To land the fish, use a wider pull & reel motion, lifting the rod higher—just like you would in real life when pulling a very big fish onto the boat. That triggers the gaff animation and gets the fish onboard.[/p][p]Thanks again for your patience and support. We’re working hard to make sure you can enjoy the game without disruptions—and we truly appreciate the trust you place in us. [/p][p]Tight lines![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch Note - Version 5.014
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d8a7c8626e7ef974aed0bca19a7c312545145f2.png"][/img][/p][h3]Dear Anglers,[/h3][p]Last night we urgently released a hot fix patch to address some of the most common issues that occurred after the Maldives Update. [/p][h3]Here is what’s new:[/h3][olist][*][p]Resolved an issue of players not being able to take out their rod or rod stands on the waterways[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when players didn’t get strikes when trying to complete the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue of balancing the amount of environmental objects appearing at the location depending on the player’s video settings[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug when some words on the buttons appeared in other languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Chamaeleon Cruiser Pack appearing incorrectly in the Store in Polish localization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when some players couldn’t enter the game[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Known Issues[/h3][p]We also received reports about other issues that some of you experienced and we want to keep you in the loop about them:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]We know many of you experience freezes when entering the menu or trying to move items in the Inventory. The root cause of the issue was found - and it appears to be quite complex and needs a few technical updates on our side. We already started doing them, but it will still require a few days to complete this process. We are doing everything possible (and some impossible things) to fasten it.[/p][/*][*][p]The issue with the black screen when entering photo mode unfortunately returned - and it has another cause than it had before - it’s being actively investigated and we hope it will be fixed within the next few days.[/p][/*][*][p]We also know that some players had issues when catching big fish (over 500kg) and on the last 2-3 meters the gaff animation doesn’t get triggered. This is being addressed as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Some of you are getting an error when trying to enter the game. We found that it helped some players to update their OS to the latest version and re-install the game. If you are experiencing something similar, please try these steps and if it doesn’t resolve the issue, contact [url="https://support@fishingplanet.com"]support@fishingplanet.com[/url].[/p][/*][*][p]We are also investigating the nature of other crashes or freezes not related to entering the menu and inventory, thanks to everyone who reported the issues and helped our investigation.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]If you are experiencing any of the issues listed above, please just wait for the fix that is on its way. No need to report them again, we already have enough information to prepare the fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]We also get many-many questions about when the Maldives map will be released on consoles and mobile platforms. Believe us, there is nothing in the world that we want more right now than to release it for all the platforms as soon as possible. But first, we need to stabilize the Steam and Epic Games versions with a few more hotfixes. Once that’s done, we’ll focus on getting the update to all other platforms. Thanks so much for your patience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Server Reboot[/h3][p]Last, but not least, we want to inform you that tomorrow, June 20 at 5:05 AM UTC there will be a server reboot with an estimated downtime of 10 minutes. This is one of the things we need to do to stabilize the system after the release.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible patience, understanding, and all the fast bug reports. We truly hope you’re still enjoying your time in the Maldives — more improvements are on the way![/p][p][/p][p]Tight lines![/p]

notes.title: Release Note: Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b4ee9b74095f1b3c7855c6d679fb47cc541ca2d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey Anglers,[/p][p][/p][p]The hot season is here, and it’s the perfect time for a tropical fishing getaway! Welcome to [b]Noomaa Kuda Atholhu[/b] — one of the most stunning and luxurious fishing destinations on the planet, now officially available in-game.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this launch with our amazing community, we’re giving every player [b]a special gift: the crazy-bazy Crabby Cap[/b]! Claiming it is easy—just open the game and head to the Personal Offers tab. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]Let’s get down to what’s new![/p][p][/p][h2]Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives[/h2][p]Get ready to explore a brand-new tropical destination spanning [b]400 square kilometers[/b] (nearly 100,000 acres) of open ocean! This massive area features [b]55 fully explorable atolls[/b], islands, and ocean spits—perfect for discovery and fishing from the shore. You’ll find 28 fish species swimming these waters, including [b]14 completely new additions[/b] to the game: [b]Swordfish, Black Marlin, Sailfish, Great Barracuda, Blacktip Reef Shark, Two-Spot Red Snapper, Wahoo[/b] and many more. Fish at this location generally grow bigger and stronger, bringing a whole new layer of challenge to the fish fighting experience into the game.[/p][p]Players can unlock this destination at [b]level 94[/b], or dive right into the adventure with one of the DLC packs, each including [b]30- or 60-day access,[/b] plus an [b]Advanced License and Premium account[/b] for the same time period. The maximum level cap in the game has been increased from 90 to 100.[/p][p][/p][h2]A brand new fishing yacht with color customization feature[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/123dd2a93ff5a3d07ace5795083adb47985e93a7.png"][/img][/p][p]The all-new [b]Chameleon Catamaran[/b] is your ultimate ride for big game fishing parties with room for [b]5 players onboard.[/b] Packing a massive [b]3,000 kg fish storage[/b] and a [b]650 kg max fish capacity[/b], it’s ready to keep even the most Unique beasts this destination has to offer. Every angler onboard gets their own fishing spot with [b]two adjustable rod holders[/b] and [b]a personal display[/b] loaded with [b]Fish Finder 360, Echo Sounder, and a GPS Map[/b] while having their rods in sight.[/p][p][/p][p]But what makes this yacht special is that it comes with an exclusive color customization feature. Only the bravest anglers can earn it by taking on a series of challenging missions that lead to the ultimate showdown with [b]the biggest monster in the game…[/b] 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd1T05KuGn4HfdNLZjmF_bXDQkSvCKQZNjHK0YEiZ6TZ6Be16EOGJiqKVaw21tgqSI_dCpd_XA8k9HibFXOc-sDjdJgKDSioQT6Fv7wqdcr-rgXTm_uK_31ARi_xQQvGVpbMrSG?key=N3866dwmsuEKyYszKXxZ7g"][/img][/p][p][b]Chamaeleon Catamaran[/b] can be obtained with two heavy-duty trolling setups from high-technology Tsurihito™ fishing brand, a generous supply of lures and baits for your big game fishing, and a spacious Tackle Wagon accommodating over 300 items, you'll have all essential fishing gear at your fingertips in [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743490/Fishing_Planet_Chamaeleon_Cruiser_Pack/"]Chamaeleon Cruiser Pack[/url][/b]. With 60-days of access, Advanced License and Premium account, additional Marker and Navigation Buoys we got you covered for an unforgettable escape from the mundane.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743490/Fishing_Planet_Chamaeleon_Cruiser_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]New Bottom Spinning Gear[/h2][p]Another exciting addition to the game is [b]Saltwater Bottom Spinning[/b] fishing. You get new specialized rods designed for targeting fish that dwell near the ocean floor. These rods blend the sensitivity and versatility of traditional spinning setups with the strength and durability required for deep-sea conditions. They are perfect for catching bottom-dwelling predators such as Groupers, Snappers, Amberjacks, and various reef species. These rods have a strong backbone and a sensitive tip to detect subtle bites and handle the weight of heavy fish. Paired with saltwater spinning reels offering high drag capacity and corrosion resistance, they’re built to meet the demands of bottom fishing in saltwater environments.[/p][p][/p][p]An ultra-powerful bottom spin setup from Tsurihito™ and an extra-long spinning set from Fletch and Bradford™ go in the [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743500/Fishing_Planet_Atoll_Scout_Pack/"]Atoll Scout Pack[/url][/b]. All kinds of baits and lures specially designed to chase exotic ocean species, and a super spacious [b]400+ items Tackle Wagon Vault™[/b] to have everything you need, will make your ocean fishing smooth and easy. [b]A tropical Angler’s outfit[/b] with [b]polarized glasses[/b] and the [b]AquaRay™ headlamp[/b] will fill your [b]30-day journey[/b] through the Maldives atolls with extra comfort.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743500/Fishing_Planet_Atoll_Scout_Pack/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h2]Vertical Jigging Retrieval[/h2][p]Try out a new fishing technique in the game — [b]Vertical Jigging[/b] — where lures like pilkers, spoons, jigs, and more are dropped straight down into the depths and retrieved with sharp, jerking motions to mimic injured prey. This method draws in predatory fish from all depths — from the bottom to the midwater layers — provoking strikes through sudden lure movements.[/p][p][/p][p]Vertical jigging is a precise and effective way to fish, offering anglers the chance to engage fish directly below the boat in deep or open waters. To help you master the technique, the game tracks your retrievals in real-time, so you’ll know exactly when you’re doing it right.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2885023b41e2f441a9642cee6bf8d090441deee8.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Saltwater Items[/h2][p]Experiment with the new saltwater gear that is now available in the In-game Store. You’ll find massive [b]Saltwater Poppers and Spoons, brand-new Triple-Hook Pilkers[/b]—perfect for targeting aggressive ocean predators. For trolling fans, there’s a full set of new gear, including [b]Luminous Trolling Octopuses[/b] and the versatile [b]Trolling Skirt Rig,[/b] which consists of a Trolling Skirt, Head and Hook.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Livebait Trolling Rig[/h2][p]A specialized fishing setup made for trolling live baitfish behind a moving boat. To support this method, we’ve introduced a range of new baits, including various sizes of Flying Fish, Indian Ocean Squid, and Split Tail Mullet to tempt predators like Swordfish, Tuna, Marlin, Barracuda, and more.[/p][p][/p][h2]Missions, Competitions, Achievements, Monsters[/h2][p]Take on a chain of new engaging monster missions and come face-to-fin with two formidable ocean predators. This time, the Brave Angler must confront the fast and legendary [b]Night[/b] [b]Windrazor[/b] — a true hunter of the dark — and the terrifying [b]Hordecuda[/b], a one-of-a-kind monster unlike anything you've faced in the game before. 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeahf0K5lCOUHy0NmoJp2uPUXc67Sa2SrOqI1999iC84hoAaoSRl7DA14SCRjOqIYqN-uXrE5kE_CvuDpgrLSM_bv-3qOzXrcDopZlWsJLf-A0ADshLH_tNG8-AAk5y-TJusG4U?key=N3866dwmsuEKyYszKXxZ7g"][/img][/p][p]Dive into a challenge of [b]6 all-new thrilling competitions[/b] and get up close with vibrant marine life of the Maldives. Unlock [b]11 fresh achievements[/b] as you explore every stretch of these tropical waters — and only the most curious and relentless adventurers will earn the [b]hidden achievement.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Sounds Improvements[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p]We’ve introduced a range of sound improvements to enhance your experience. These include new drag and reeling sounds for both saltwater and freshwater reels, updated casting sounds that now vary based on distance and reel type, and refined reel opening/closing sounds. Additionally, some splashing sounds for floats, lures, and fish have been updated. New background music has also been added to the main menu.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ol2zhJpD2LU;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]
Bug Fix for Multiple Issues [/h2][p]Here are the most important things that have been fixed:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed incorrect display of inventory item thumbnails in the Inventory tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed marker buoys accepted in club chat not showing up in 3D until the game was restarted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Club-Series Glowing Pear-Shaped Float not glowing properly[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the description text for a rod stand in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved incorrect appearance of navigation buoys in photo mode[/p][/*][*][p]With the introduction of the new Live Baits category, the Japanese Squid has been reassigned to it. As a result, it can no longer be used with bottom rods. If you had setups where bottom rods were equipped with this bait, the Japanese Squid will now be unequipped and automatically moved to your Backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit where trolling bonus was granted while the boat engine was running and anchored[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an error occurring when attempting to teleport using navigation buoys[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn’t place a rod on a rod stand after competition scoring time ended[/p][/*][*][p]Updated achievement tracking: Nile Perch now counts toward the Perch Captain achievement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text overflow on the MAKE CAPTAIN (PREMIUM) button in French[/p][/*][*][p]The level for some Saltwater Braid Lines was changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue with shared buoys not appearing in the accept list[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted overly bright lighting on some objects during morning sun[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed competition ending unexpectedly when trying to change spot[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tab focus behavior when changing days or switching between tabs[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected rod name display in the 3D view[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue where players on boats could pass through other boats due to collision settings[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary close button (X) for controller users in the Stats window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character model misalignment when rotating camera on kayak in photo mode[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out slingshot animation in both first-person and third-person views[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved overflow issue in the Friends > Options menu with more than 6 options[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed heavy collision between fishing gear and grass on the San Joaquin pier[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tournament description text to display properly across multiple languages[/p][/*][*][p]Closed an exploit spot behind the rock with water access on the Selenge River[/p][/*][*][p]The in-game shop price for Squid Chains was changed to balance the game economics system.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved mouse freeze issue in Epic Games Store after entering via controller from the BUY button[/p][/*][*][p]Improved image loading stability across all platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Restored missing 'SE' label on the SpellLauncher™ 320 SE rod in 3D view[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where player briefly appeared on shore before spawning on yacht after Fishing Together session[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved graphical glitch where gray squares appeared after deleting a template[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fish couldn’t be reeled in after forwarding time under specific conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected translation in Spanish localization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed license appearing in UI but missing in 3D view[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved error message "Selected Room has not been found..." when joining Fishing Together session from another pond[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed connection issue when joining friend’s room after being in a Private/Club Room and traveling from the Globe[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed UI rendering issues on macOS[/p][/*][*][p]This one is just a small token of appreciation for those dedicated players who read the release notes — and every single bug fix — from start to finish. Tell us in the comments you are the one who did it![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ocean water not displaying properly on M1 Mac processors[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue preventing completion of the Congo Chercheur achievement[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c666f1a015da342662376947ed69f18c38e26c1.png"][/img][/p][p]We want to thank our incredible community for all the excitement and support you've shown from the very first announcement of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives to its official release. It is you who make it all possible and inspire us at every step as we continue to build fishing locations all around the globe in Fishing Planet! Let’s celebrate this release together and create some unforgettable moments under the Maldivian sun. [/p][p][b]And don’t forget to grab your little gift to carry that island vibe with you wherever your fishing adventures take you.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Tight lines and see you on the water![/p][p][/p][p]_______________________________________________________________[/p][p][/p][h3]Check out the DevDiaries about the location:[/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/512958375408959645"]DevDiary: Hooked in the Maldives[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/528721513576136833" buttoncolor="#0084ff"]DevDiary: Ocean Life of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/528722773603778677"]DevDiary: Gearing Up for the Maldives[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/fpofficial"]Discord[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/groups/fishingplanetofficial"]Facebook Group[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You are always welcome to ask for help in our support: [url="https://support@fishingplanet.com"]support@fishingplanet.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DevDiary: Gearing Up for the Maldives
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/61c19f3f5be1f85968acf981c85c45e4d7ba5af2.png"][/img]
Hey Anglers,

We've seen incredible interest in the first two DevDiaries covering [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/512958375408959645"]the upcoming Maldives location[/url][/b] and the vibrant [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380600/view/528721513576136833"]ocean life of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu[/url][/b]. But we also know that it’s the new gear that really hooks your attention! In this DevDiary, we're excited to reveal the latest additions and the shiny new treasures you'll soon get your hands on.

The new Maldivian update introduces a full set of gear tailored for saltwater fishing — dozens of items built to handle the ocean’s harshest conditions. New tackle materials and technologies offer improved resistance to saltwater corrosion, ensuring lasting performance out at sea. And when it comes to landing true ocean giants only the most powerful rods and reels will do. Time to get ready for the big fight!


[/p][h2]Saltwater Bottom Spinning Rods[/h2][p]
The first thing we want to introduce is saltwater bottom spinning rods. This specialized gear is designed for targeting fish species that live close to the ocean floor. It combines the sensitivity and versatility of spinning setups with the strength and durability needed for deep-sea conditions. Anglers use this method to catch bottom-dwelling predators like Groupers, Snappers, Amberjacks, and reef fish species that typically hide around reefs, rocks, and underwater structures.

These rods have a strong backbone and a sensitive tip, allowing anglers to detect subtle bites and apply the power needed to lift heavy fish from the depths. They're paired with saltwater spinning reels that offer high drag capacity and corrosion resistance, making them ideal for the challenges of bottom fishing in saltwater environments.

[/p][h3]KarasuTōha™[/h3][p]
Designed for challenging offshore conditions, this short yet incredibly strong rod provides maximum control over heavy fish while maintaining sensitivity for precise bait presentation. Featuring HikariFlex™ infused construction, this rod remains lightweight without compromising durability, allowing anglers to detect even the slightest movements. TensaiCore™ multi-directional carbon reinforcement ensures superior strength, handling extreme loads with ease. The ergonomic TatsukoGrip™ EVA handle provides a secure and comfortable grip, reducing fatigue during intense fights.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d9232ee69352ee6ca7de13f994c949a820c416ab.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]Commander™[/h3][p]
It is designed for long-distance casting and versatility. This rod excels in both boat and shore fishing. Its durable yet lightweight construction provides the perfect balance of power and sensitivity, making it ideal for targeting medium to large fish. FaVortex™ technology enhances casting accuracy by optimizing the rod's aerodynamics, ensuring smooth, controlled long-range casts. Meanwhile, FaLineFlow™ minimizes friction with precision-placed guides, improving line release and maximizing casting distance. Reinforced with corrosion-resistant components, this rod is built to withstand the toughest saltwater conditions while delivering reliable performance.

The new location features approximately 55 atolls, small islands, and ocean spits you can step onto from your boat, making onshore fishing a big part of the experience. That’s why we’ve prepared specialized gear for long-distance casting — this lineup features the longest Bottom Spinning Rod in the game. It’s perfect for targeting massive bottom-dwelling fish like Grouper from the shores of the lagoons.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/839c35ee655ffacbc302a0214bae1fd29426ac24.png"][/img]

[/p][h2]Saltwater Casting and Spinning Rods[/h2][p]
Saltwater casting and spinning rods aren’t new to you, but we’re expanding the lineup with even more powerful gear built to handle massive ocean predators—this time with a focus on trolling. 

[/p][h3]Kōdo Kage™[/h3][p]
Designed for high-power offshore trolling, this saltwater casting rod delivers strength and precision for battling extra-large fish. The curved butt section provides better leverage, reducing strain during prolonged fights. Its medium length balances power and control. Built with TensaiCore™, the multi-directional carbon fiber core ensures high durability under heavy loads. The RyuKen™-reinforced tip adds strength while maintaining flexibility for precise hook sets. TatsukoGrip™ high-density EVA handle offers a secure hold, even in wet conditions. Made for deep-sea trolling, this rod is built to handle the ocean's toughest predators.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/89cf9ad9f8cc525fa19c246039370bb21c6aa00c.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]MizuJigu™[/h3][p]
It is a set of short yet powerful saltwater spinning rods designed for handling medium to large fish. Built for balance and sensitivity, they combine cutting-edge materials with advanced engineering to maximize casting efficiency and durability. Featuring HikariFlex™, these rods utilize ultra-thin graphene layers for strength, allowing anglers to detect the lightest bites while maintaining full control. TensaiCore™ reinforces the blank with multidirectional carbon fiber and nanoceramic layers, ensuring durability under extreme pressure. The TatsukoGrip™ ergonomic handle offers a secure, fatigue-free grip, making long fishing sessions more comfortable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1c52e9b616bbee760f58eb545416b8dad071f2a0.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]BreakwaterX™[/h3][p]
Engineered for long-distance casting, these rods excel both from shore and boat, providing effortless control and sensitivity. Featuring DynamicCore™, the blank is constructed with advanced lightweight composites, offering excellent flexibility to absorb sudden movements without sacrificing strength. FaVector™ reinforces the rod with high-tensile polymer layers, ensuring a perfect balance between power and sensitivity—allowing anglers to detect subtle bites while maintaining complete control over their catch. With an ergonomic, non-slip EVA handle and a perfectly balanced design, this rod delivers comfort, precision, and reliability in every cast.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4189d30102e0553a384a5611536c52ec88b63956.png"][/img]

[/p][h2]Saltwater Casting and Spinning Reels[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]Jōnin™[/h3][p]
Our favorite item in this update is the asymmetrical Jōnin™, a saltwater casting reel engineered with cutting-edge Rinkaku® technology. Its frame, inspired by the natural flow of ocean currents, enhances ergonomics and torque distribution for smooth, efficient retrievals under heavy pressure. The KaijutsuShield™ triple-layer corrosion protection defends against salt, sand, and wear, while Shinobi™ precision gear alignment minimizes noise and vibration, ensuring ultra-smooth performance in the toughest conditions.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/RobCzUb.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]Tengu Kai™[/h3][p]
It is a saltwater spin reel designed for smooth, effortless retrievals under extreme strains. Its full metal body ensures strength and stability under heavy loads. The KaijutsuShield™ corrosion-resistant sealing protects internal components from saltwater and debris, guaranteeing long-term reliability. Additionally, Shinobi™ silent gear alignment minimizes noise and vibration for an ultra-smooth experience. Whether battling big fish offshore or enduring rough waters, this reel is built to perform.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/BhEbXdU.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]JigokuTen™[/h3][p]
This saltwater spin reel combines durability and precision. Its lightweight construction ensures easy handling, making it ideal for long fishing sessions. Designed for small to medium-sized fish, it features RyuGear™ multi-layered steel gears for smooth power transfer and KaijutsuShield™ triple-layer corrosion protection to withstand tough marine environments. JigokuTen™ is a perfect mix of durability and sensitivity for jigging.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/O9U4pzd.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]BossCast™[/h3][p]
Designed for versatility, these durable saltwater spin reels are perfect for long-distance casting and handling medium to large fish. The combination of TorqueFlow™ technology for smooth torque under heavy loads and HydroLock™ sealing for unmatched water resistance ensures flawless performance in all conditions. With a lightweight construction and advanced balance provided by FaBalancePro™, these reels offer reliability, comfort, and precision for extended fishing sessions.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/FxfZ8rt.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3]XCurrent™[/h3][p]
It is a saltwater spin reel that delivers consistent power and smooth performance under extreme conditions. FaLight™ aerospace-grade aluminum construction keeps it lightweight yet durable, reducing fatigue on long trips. TorqueFlow™ precision-machined gears provide consistent torque, ensuring seamless power transfer when fighting fish. For ultimate protection, HydroLock™ triple-layer sealing safeguards internal components from salt, water, and debris, extending the reel’s lifespan.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/dOIxoTd.gif"][/img]

[/p][h2]Terminal Tackle[/h2][p]
Lines are getting stronger to handle bigger fish, and a brand-new series is making its debut—[b]Saltwater Fluoro Lines[/b]. These fluorocarbon lines offer superior clarity in the water, making them less visible for fish and as a result scaring them off less. While fluoro lines are less powerful than mono lines in general, they outperform mono of the same diameter when it comes to strength—making them a top choice for stealthy, heavy-duty saltwater fishing.

Saltwater Fluoro lines will go in two colors—clear and transparent pink that blends seamlessly underwater making it even harder for fish to detect.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/04b4082110072e97570766e3d71a63a65bcffe9a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/249a716a673eb6ee35a1efda62a4d3253ce6254c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5f3d258ccf8b372f7f650d0851daece13c981368.png"][/img]
A new [b]Color Series of Saltwater Mono Lines[/b] is also on the way—thinner yet stronger than the current options in the game. These lines feature fresh, eye-catching colors that stand out above the water for better visibility, while remaining subtle below the surface to avoid spooking fish — making them a perfect addition to your vibrant gear collection. Available in muted blue and striking purple options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46ad4d03163234464cc0d55c5711c60c38105fa7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/df4ec8e8a8bf277c55ac42403c2b39f59d212337.png"][/img]
[b]Saltwater Titanium Leaders[/b] are now being added to the game—and we know you’ve been waiting for them! While titanium is known for its strength and resistance to bite-offs, it’s also quite visible in clear ocean water. That’s why the saltwater version comes with a silicone coating—making them less noticeable and more flexible. These leaders will help you handle toothy predators with greater confidence. Just keep in mind—saltwater fish are clever, and some may still get suspicious when they spot a leader! 😄

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/63092fcddac90618f71547db02b4b9d2f1862e97.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6dd37cfa5b35468fad24ee76e9e737237b7ffa3f.png"][/img]
Another cool addition in this update will be extra strong and sharp [b]Saltwater Hooks[/b] with a specialized geometry for better hooking efficiency. Since the Maldives will be home to a variety of relatively small coral reef dwellers, you'll also get smaller-sized saltwater hooks designed specifically for targeting these fish. Overall, the range of saltwater hook sizes is expanding.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c9e5a1966d4f8d639add84f41d4d0765ac278ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/88a4065e2830e009750d1598b63bc532e09af01f.png"][/img]
You’ll also get new Saltwater Sinkers with a unique design—featuring an elongated body and a ball-shaped end to enhance stability and sinking performance. Ideal for rough waters and strong currents.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bd28f9b4832dc67def778def4d135ba9a3337ee5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d940e9b7c78e2f891228ce97516a18efe3e566da.png"][/img]

[/p][h2]Saltwater Lures[/h2][p]
For those chasing topwater predators, there’s something new to try — [b]Saltwater Poppers[/b]. These new lures ensure maximum splash and attraction, while the reinforced body construction provides long-lasting performance. Equipped with strong single hooks for improved catch efficiency. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c96ac6094eb4c919a8301c69fe3a44685a3656fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0294d1fbcb074d9728bbd85fdaa37e8bb12d826b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3289267ab29308579ce560d02ea701b2080b7012.png"][/img]
Another shiny addition that true anglers will fancy are [b]Saltwater Stealth Poppers[/b] designed for surface hunters. Equipped with two treble hooks for a secure hold, ensuring your catch has no chance to escape.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f2b6f8251d7e1463277e3c2efbee77b97089dc34.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f1963ab371cd7552a0fea476e1b1e61bc158f8ab.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5743ae1f808208bc0787fd969af2dd32b66c35d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3433dad3076a09603387982860e2c38dc5afecda.png"][/img]
[b]Saltwater Spoons[/b] share the classic design of their freshwater counterparts but are built to withstand the harsh conditions of saltwater fishing. A must-have for coastal fishing and slow speed trolling, designed to attract a variety of ocean predators. Their simple design makes them a reliable choice for targeting predators in open water or near structures. A timeless tool with solid performance.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a6b663f7969063a9dc8de49700d0398df662a1bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/479b779b64b71e39929bebabf508dc5778fe39e0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5b5bd84d847319bc22fba5d5e4e937dc233d5e2.png"][/img]
[b]Luminous Trolling Octopuses[/b] feature a glow-in-the-dark design, making it highly effective for deep-water and night fishing — a popular choice in the Maldives, where a wide variety of fish are actively feeding after dark. With lifelike tentacles and durable silicone construction, it provides realistic movement that attracts predators like Swordfish even in low-light conditions. Perfect for trolling at all speeds.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/250ab541c1b7020129e1ff308903c3104e94b5ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cf41f5361f4996dee732ed66b57c4662c5ee8852.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/81c0f7d1a2e67b14f76b2c57609862acfc0d9c2a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e9f7923f218b6d1726033182d207b9678da3b391.png"][/img]
There’s also something new coming for trolling fans — [b]Trolling Skirt Rig[/b] — a highly popular large silicone trolling lure designed to be rigged on a jig head and consists of three elements - Trolling Skirts, Heads and Hooks. This type of lure is now available in several unique variations. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2f40083e1cf735da9f8b45dfcb4df6ac40bdbe43.png"][/img]
[b]Trolling Skirt[/b] is specifically crafted for Billfish and Tuna fishing. It features a flexible and durable build that ensures lifelike movement in the water, attracting attention with its vibrant colors and natural flow.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/14428f7ddcf93f7b8d27b14e34bfb775fe33cd6b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/191e8e8d38d4c95e6b90df5671f28798b1503170.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9cf6fc2e404dca2886bd326d2ecf74b8c4894c5e.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/406c7995158d447ff25a53dd3fd3f5c6197dac15.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37595b4545e68e348c841b42b13b6dff0764df30.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/268ed5ba23a8d9de1225b01ab99e6879ba654c13.png"][/img]
[b]Trolling Skirt Head[/b] is a streamlined, slanted-cylinder trolling skirt head designed for offshore big game fishing. Its hydrodynamic shape creates an enticing bubble trail. Perfect for rigging with skirts and targeting large pelagic species.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/67d8a7ef577bbf5aa45ffc7208abe42704621800.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/efb0ed5f9bdff16e19b60a064eeadd32c5827227.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5821443ac3e93f4a7060e3bbdffcc7701b546579.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/704b04b039e387f1079b4e585776de00ac271bf2.png"][/img]
[b]Trolling Skirt Hook[/b] is a high-quality stainless steel trolling hook rigged with a durable 49-strand cable for maximum strength and flexibility. Designed for use with trolling skirts, this hook provides a reliable and secure connection to handle powerful offshore species.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/50c7c970ed1138afea81bbac7b1e6e30c8efebaf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/baf3e9a889ea5420bf92420ec412ac900b7b6e49.png"][/img]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/LjKdbLF.gif"][/img]
[/p][h2]Saltwater Baits and Live Bait Trolling Rig[/h2][p]
A variety of new unique baits are coming your way— Fish Head and Black Tiger Shrimp, Flying Fish of different caliber, Split Tail Mullet, Indian Ocean Squid, Indo-Pacific Swimming Crab, Natal Rock Oyster Meat, and Filamentous Red Algae. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/79f5d39e82e879292876ba80ceae3a42016afef5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/faea54dfeedcc277805de8eddcdb06692b544fab.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a23a80117540a1dddeee2fb1af5569b44a0d69ce.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9ee1236d4fa4e2fe2001b95aa43239aa46ec864c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d3e2779ee0ebf4068f60cc2c281928e5533341bd.png"][/img]

Some of these new baits, along with several already available in the game, are perfect for the [b]Livebait Trolling Rig[/b], a special fishing setup used to troll a live baitfish behind a moving boat to attract large predatory fish. It's a highly effective method for targeting species like Swordfish, Tuna, Marlin, Barracuda, and many more. Saltwater baits in the game are growing more impressive in size — making them irresistible offerings for even the most massive ocean predators. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6ccf23619537374fdb9f642203ba1a4807cc60a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/85660a431ed6df02635cc9a6ee9e639383a7805e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e915c23adac12078b740e7119169f4b931f8c403.png"][/img]

The main feature of this rig is that the bait must be alive during setup, even though it usually becomes non-living in the process of rigging. The Livebait Trolling Rig is a highly popular and effective method for saltwater fishing, known for significantly increasing the chances of landing large predatory fish.

When setting up a Live Bait Trolling Rig, start by adding one of the essential components — either a Live Bait Trolling Hook or a Head Starter Sinker. Then, attach the second piece and finish the setup with a Live Bait. If you're targeting toothy predators, don’t forget to add a leader — and you’re all set for an exciting trolling adventure!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f1effeb28414e6ae3f7b6b13cfe60b4c9a5d5489.png"][/img]

[/p][h2]Vertical Jigging Retrieval[/h2][p]
Vertical jigging is now part of the game — opening up new possibilities for fishing and bringing fresh variety to spinning fishing. It is a dynamic and highly effective technique for catching predatory fish. Whether they’re lurking midwater or hugging the bottom, you can lure them to the surface by teasing them with pilkers, spoons, jigs and other vertical-friendly lures to provoke a strike.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/u3dXRWS.gif"][/img]
Drop your metal jig or pilker straight down and let it sink, close the spool and then work it back up with sharp, rhythmic jerks to mimic an injured fish or squid - lift your rod upward, and slowly reel in as it drops - and get ready for some serious strikes. You will now be able to see the game track this retrieval in the special HUD and understand whether you are doing it right.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/qzaQDEW.gif"][/img]
[/p][h2]Catamaran Fishing Spots[/h2][p]
As you may remember from our previous DevDiaries, the new Chameleon Catamaran is special not only for its unique design, but also for the color customization missions. But that’s not all.
To make your time on the water more convenient, each of the five fishing spots on the yacht now features its own display and two adjustable rod holders.

You can still use your Tablet on board to place Marker or Navigation Buoys, but now you’ll also be able to track what’s happening on the water and manage your rods simultaneously. Easily switch between GPS map, Echo Sounder, and FishFinder360 with a single button press.

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/T9OJmmA.gif"][/img]
The rod holders are fully adjustable, allowing you to change both the angle and direction for maximum comfort and flexibility, depending on your preferred fishing style. It’s all intuitively controlled using your mouse buttons and scroll wheel.

We know some players enjoy fishing solo, while others prefer teaming up with just one or two friends in Fishing Together sessions. But don’t forget — there’s an XP bonus for fishing with friends and club mates, and the more players you have, the bigger the boost for everyone. If you fill all five fishing spots, you’ll get a significant XP bonus, making teamwork more rewarding than ever!

[/p][h2]And last, but not least[/h2][p]
As we get closer to the release of this exciting new location, we want to thank our amazing community of anglers for the incredible interest and support you’ve shown with every DevDiary we share.

Since we know many of you are actively leveling up to be fully ready for the big launch, we’ve prepared something just for you — the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54831/Ultimate_Japan_Bundle/"]Ultimate Japan Bundle[/url], which includes all three Japan Ocean Packs at 20% off available exclusively on Steam. Please note that if you already own any of the Japan Ocean Packs, the price of that pack will be automatically deducted from the bundle total — so you can grab the other two at a discount.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33de9f1d08710bb90ca877243dc071a5f5a38b6c.png"][/img]
And here’s a little something to look forward to for everyone on all the platforms: every single player will receive a special gift from our team — a unique Crabby Cap to celebrate the launch of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives! Stay tuned so you don’t miss the release and can claim your gift right on time!

[b]We can't wait to see you out on the water — tight lines and happy fishing![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54831/Ultimate_Japan_Bundle/


_______________________________________________________________

[b]Follow us on social media to stay tuned and be in touch with our lovely community:[/b]

[url="https://discord.com/invite/fpofficial"]Discord[/url]
[url="https://www.facebook.com/groups/fishingplanetofficial"]Facebook Group[/url]

You are always welcome to ask for help in our support: support@fishingplanet.com











[i]*All visual content in this DevDiary is crafted to showcase the upcoming features; however, there may be slight differences upon the actual release of the update[/i][/p]
