notes.title: DevDiary: Ocean Life of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c428e2d6974c6c3ed7b510248e7ed889e49ee713.png[/img]

Hey Anglers, 

Welcome to the next stop in our journey — the Maldives, a true gem of the Indian Ocean and a paradise for sportfishing enthusiasts. We've already introduced this breathtaking location in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/512958375408959646?snr=2___][b]previous DevDiary[/b][/url] — now it's time to dive deeper and explore the incredible fish species that call these waters home.

Swaying palms under a blazing sun, crystal-clear waters brimming with life, shimmering fish darting just beneath the surface — we are creating the Maldives at their finest. The dry season has settled in, bringing perfect conditions for ocean fishing. A tropical paradise where [b]Yellowfin Tuna, Wahoo, Mahi-Mahi, Sailfish,[/b] and [b]Marlin[/b] are entering their peak feeding frenzy.

The geography of the Maldives plays a key role in shaping the habitats where different fish species thrive. Spanning the Indian Ocean, the islands are arranged in two parallel chains of atolls that rise from a deep oceanic plateau. Between them lies the Inner Sea — a calmer, more sheltered area rich with diverse fishing grounds. Venture west, however, and you’ll encounter the true open ocean: expansive, untamed, and brimming with big-game potential.

This location will feature 28 fish species, including 14 completely new additions to the game. We will cover the new arrivals in this DevDiary, but you’ll also recognize some familiar faces from other regions. Species like [b]Yellowfin Tuna, Bigeye Tuna, Albacore, Skipjack Tuna,[/b] and [b]Dogtooth Tuna[/b] will feel right at home in these tropical waters. 

Other well-known species such as [b]Greater Amberjack, Giant Trevally, Narrow-Barred Mackerel,[/b] and [b]Striped Marlin[/b] will also make an appearance here, taking advantage of the deep reefs and fast-moving currents. Even reef dwellers like [b]Giant Grouper, Ruby Snapper, Mahi-Mahi, Striped Bonito,[/b] and [b]Green Jobfish[/b] will continue their usual routines, now within the vibrant underwater landscape of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu. All of these species are already familiar to anglers from Kaiji No Ri — but here, in the Indian Ocean, the warmer waters and open space allow some of them to grow even larger here, offering the thrilling opportunity to encounter their powerful Unique forms.

And of course, we can’t leave out the [b]Fish Monsters.[/b] You’ll have to defeat two new monster fish:[b] The Night Windrazor[/b] and [b]The Hordecuda[/b]. You might be able to guess the real-life inspiration behind the first one — and maybe even take a shot at what the second could be — but we’re confident the Hordecuda will surprise you. As the Brave Angler, you’ll need to save the world first to uncover what these terrifying creatures truly look like, and we can’t wait for you to discover it.

[h2]Let’s start with the ocean’s most legendary hunters — the Billfish.[/h2]

[h3]Swordfish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff045a55f6c81bb79f6d177c61e0d999f6cfae3c.png[/img]

The Swordfish (Xiphias gladius) is a powerful pelagic predator that can reach up to 1322 lb (600 kg). Found in tropical and temperate waters worldwide, though it may also roam into colder regions. It rarely approaches the shore, preferring the open ocean, where it moves between surface layers at night and depths of up to 1804 ft (550 m) during the day. A solitary hunter, the Swordfish feeds on squid, pelagic fish like mackerel and herring, and sometimes even tuna or small sharks. While most active at night, it also feeds in daylight. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fWM7BrD.gif[/img]


[h3]Sailfish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d1703dcb7f37637c49d2900baf8b2f16dc5c21c.png[/img]

The Sailfish (Istiophorus) is known as the fastest fish in the ocean. It lives in warm waters around the world and usually hunts near the surface, though it can dive as deep as 1968 ft (600 m) when needed. While Sailfish prefer the open sea, they often roam closer to shorelines, reefs, and islands, especially where the water stays deep and clear. 

Active both during the day and at night, they usually hunt in groups, feeding on sardines, anchovies, mackerel, squid, and sometimes even crustaceans. Sailfish are also known to travel alongside tuna, which makes them a familiar catch in tuna fishing grounds. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KVRJuWn.gif[/img]


[h3]Black Marlin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/97e9cafebb74ba3f5f2f952e3455b188ff495101.png[/img]

The Black Marlin (Istiompax indica) is a massive pelagic predator, found throughout the Indian and Pacific Oceans. Weighing up to 1653 lb (750 kg), it’s one of the most sought-after catches in both commercial and sport fishing. These fish prefer surface waters near coasts, islands, and coral reefs. While usually solitary, Black Marlins may appear in numbers when baitfish gather near the surface. Their diet includes small tuna, anchovies, mackerel, flying fish, squid, and crustaceans like shrimp and crabs.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2xZ4OMC.gif[/img]

As you can see, some of the Billfish you'll encounter are absolute giants, with weights reaching up to 1650 lb (750 kg). But don’t worry — you’ll have a chance to get fully equipped to take them on, with powerful gear and plenty of storage space aboard the new Chamaeleon catamaran.

[h2]Discover the Exotic Reef Species of Noomaa Kuda[/h2]

Alongside the formidable Billfish, a wide variety of other species contribute to the vibrant underwater life of Noomaa Kuda Atholhu. While many of them aren’t giants, their coral reef habitats make them beautiful and exotic — a true delight for anglers seeking something unique.


[h3]Great Barracuda[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9041c4cf31205f9dc3360dc4fc4fb32f58ebb050.png[/img]

When something flashes past like a silver bolt and vanishes just as fast — chances are, it’s a barracuda. The Great Barracuda (Sphyraena barracuda) is a medium-sized but formidable predator, found in warm waters across the globe. Weighing up to 110 lb (50 kg), it hunts in a wide range of habitats, from mangroves to outer reefs, always alert and ready to strike. This aggressive species bites in any weather, day or night. Young barracudas often move in groups, while adults prefer to go solo. Their main targets are small fish, with the occasional squid — and shrimp only when they’re feeling generous.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EFCrhG5.gif[/img]


[h3]Wahoo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/50d101e6d1bfd2112697ecefefd55bc98490ade2.png[/img]

Wahoo (Acanthocybium solandri) is a large predatory fish from the mackerel family, reaching up to 176 lb (80 kg). They live in open ocean waters but often stay close to coasts, reefs, and continental shelves. They hunt fish and squid, either alone or in small groups, and are known for striking from below with sudden bursts of speed about 50 mph (80 km/h). They're often spotted near tuna schools and are most active around sunrise and sunset, though they’ll still bite at night — just a little more slowly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LPBtdTv.gif[/img]


[h3]Indo-Pacific King Mackerel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1886b04c3e59190ec7cc47559ae660c2a985f4a8.png[/img]

The Indo-Pacific King Mackerel (Scomberomorus guttatus) is a medium-sized fish from the mackerel family, found in the warm waters of the Indian and western Pacific Oceans. Reaching up to 11 lb (5 kg) and beyond, this pelagic fish prefers coastal waters at depths of 49 to 262 ft (15 to 80 m). It’s a prized catch for commercial fishers and a worthy challenge for anglers. King Mackerel travels in small schools , dining on sardines, anchovies, squid, and the occasional crustacean. They are active both day and night, so there’s no bad time to go fishing for them. But beware - once hooked, these fish love to leap and thrash.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JKTDVii.gif[/img]


[h3]Two-Spot Red Snapper [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/135307d9a5e7ec50ff8cc5c4acdb7f768af31231.png[/img]

The Two-Spot Red Snapper (Lutjanus bohar) is a long-lived Indo-Pacific species that can reach up to 33 lb (15 kg) and live over five decades. Found near reef slopes and sandy seabeds, it prefers oceanic islands to continental shores. Usually solitary, but it forms schools during spawning season. It feeds on fish, shrimp, crabs, snails, and mollusks — and tends to bite best at dawn, dusk, or under a full moon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lsv9tGY.gif[/img]


[h3]Yellowstripe Scad[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/453f6332ba7bef897d3ed7fb5c7b6c7814fc1a0e.png[/img]

The Yellowstripe Scad (Selaroides leptolepis) is a small schooling fish found in the warm, coastal waters of the Indo-West Pacific. These agile swimmers thrive at depths of up to 229 ft (70 m), often gathering in large groups near the seabed over soft, sandy bottoms. Despite their size, Yellowstripe Scad are efficient predators with surprisingly large mouths. Their diet ranges from tiny zooplankton and invertebrates, like crustaceans and mollusks, to fish larvae — and even smaller scad. While they’re mostly active during the day, they’ve been known to feed at night too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KW8cxpb.gif[/img]


[h3]Gorgeous Swallowtail[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5e5c2d2d15413b365347296385c9055b5736308e.png[/img]

The Gorgeous Swallowtail (Meganthias natalensis) is a jewel of the deep. Reaching up to 4 lb (2 kg), it prefers rocky slopes and deep reefs between 262 and 721 ft (80 and 220 m). These vivid reef-dwellers feed on small fish, mollusks, and crustaceans. They often share habitats with Ruby Snappers and Groupers, and remain active around the clock.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H7cAfAz.gif[/img]


[h3]Sleek Unicornfish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fbec8192d7ac822476d4eadb2ff43c523c72c66.png[/img]

The Sleek Unicornfish (Naso hexacanthus) is a graceful reef dweller, found from 39 to 114 ft (12 to 35 m) deep in lagoons and along coral slopes. This species tends to stay in large schools, making it a striking sight in its natural habitat. Omnivorous by nature, they feed on various zooplankton and algae. It’s active in all weather conditions, both day and night, though it often ventures closer to shore after sunset.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ogvMPk5.gif[/img]


[h3]Giant Sweetlips[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/16702695651178c22e31e177364b55025ce75761.png[/img]

The Giant Sweetlips (Plectorhinchus albovittatus) is a nocturnal bottom-feeder that prefers living alone near lagoons and barrier reefs. Found at depths up to 164 ft (50 m), it snacks on crustaceans, mollusks, and small fish. During the day, it retreats into deeper reef zones, emerging at night to feed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0X3i8px.gif[/img]


[h3]Spotfin Flyingfish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f9eece3049e99d5bb072135b09056d4c1dc7bd85.png[/img]

The Spotfin Flyingfish (Cheilopogon furcatus) is one of the larger flying fish species, growing up to 13,8 in (35 cm) and weighing around 1lb (0.5 kg). Found in warm waters worldwide, it lives near the surface, whether in coastal areas or the open ocean. These fish stick together in small schools and follow currents that bring zooplankton to the surface. Their diet includes tiny crustaceans, mollusk larvae, fish eggs, and small fish. Active both day and night but especially drawn to light after sunset. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bAGBXwM.gif[/img]


[h3]Sickle Pomfret[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e2ecca91417604e932278de8571dce8e80670105.png[/img]

The Sickle Pomfret (Taractichthys steindachneri) is a medium-sized fish that lives in deep waters, usually between 164 and 2296 ft (50 and 700 m), often near underwater mountains or along continental shelf slopes. This fish is a group-hunting omnivore, feeding on small fish, squid, crustaceans, and tunicates. It’s also a favorite meal for Bigeye Tuna, Swordfish, and Sharks. Since it lives in dark, deep waters, the Sickle Pomfret isn’t tied to specific feeding times and bites both day and night.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gugU29B.gif[/img]


[h3]Blacktip Reef Shark[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9f776375aa1aa2be8e9a88589f756e7bf6af05aa.png[/img]

The Blacktip Reef Shark (Carcharhinus melanopterus) is a sleek coastal predator that prowls warm Indo-Pacific waters. Weighing up to 44 lb (20 kg), it glides effortlessly across coral shallows and sandy flats. Adults stick to reef slopes and platforms, while younger sharks prefer calmer lagoons. Often seen in small schools, they’re quick, alert, and always on the hunt for reef fish, squid, crabs — and occasionally even small rays or sea snakes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OWHzHMy.gif[/img]


We saved the Blacktip Reef Shark for dessert — and for good reason. We know many players have been looking forward to more sharks in the game, and this one is a standout addition. While not the largest predator, the Blacktip is one of the most common and iconic sharks in the Maldives, making it a must-have for this location. 

There’s also a special surprise waiting for those who take on the catamaran color customization missions. We won’t spoil it for you, but let’s just say — if you’re a fan of really big sharks, you’re going to love what we’ve prepared for you. 

We know many of our players are hungry for bigger sharks, and they’re definitely on the horizon. This is just the beginning of an epic shark chapter in the game.

To top it off, we’re also preparing another DevDiary that will dive into the gear, lures, and baits specially crafted for Noomaa Kuda Atholhu. We’ll also introduce a new retrieval technique and showcase the unique features of the Chamaeleon catamaran. From new setups to tropical tactics, there’s plenty more coming to get your hands on. Stay tuned — your next fishing adventure is about to get even better.

Until then — tight lines and see you on the water!

notes.title: DevDiary: Hooked in The Maldives
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d9bf2e5ce63ba141eff8439c2b6564c81c1fed23.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,

A new destination in Fishing Planet is on the horizon, and it's time to give you a glimpse of what’s coming your way. When we launched our first ocean location—Kaiji No Ri in Japan—we introduced you to the vastness of the open ocean. Even then, we knew it was just the beginning of true big game fishing. Now, we’re taking things to the next level with Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, Maldives. This island paradise will be perfect for Anglers who dare to think beyond the shoreline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b6b7a14e867707dc85410b95afd0441f89775cb4.png[/img]

[h2]Shaped by the Sea[/h2]

The geography of the Maldives is defined by two long, parallel chains of atolls, known as ridges, stretching north to south across the Indian Ocean. Noomaa Kuda Atholhu lies south of the eastern ridges, surrounded by scattered smaller atolls. Deeper open ocean waters lie to the west of the atoll, while the calmer, so-called Inner Sea is to the east.

Atolls are ring-shaped coral reefs that form around lagoons, built over time as volcanic islands sink and coral grows upward. Over millions of years, marine life and waves break down this coral into the iconic soft white sands that give the Maldives their clear, turquoise waters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fa709d52992ebcf1e8314c004b358d8600258e24.png[/img]

[h2]A Living Paradise[/h2]

This location will be just as vast as our Japan map, spanning 20x20 km—an impressive 400 square kilometers. It features over 55 atolls, small islands and ocean spits, with all of them fully explorable except for one, and why this one is so special you will be able to find out later when the map is released. You’ll be able to step off your boat, walk across the islands, and cast your line from the shore for a truly immersive experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b3e95f0cb8e75df60a8071964e7b53eb63a3065.png[/img]

When creating this map, we put extra care into crafting the water to capture the true essence of the Maldivian seas. It’s crystal clear and teeming with life—you can see colorful reef fish, rays and small sharks swimming close to shore, and even spot sea turtles. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6hUWxBs.gif[/img]

On the beach, cheeky little crabs lounge in the sun and dash off in a hurry the moment you get too close, adding a bit of lively mischief to the scene. The Maldivian islands are truly alive with vibrant marine life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e0a9ea58a26e302332dbadad15d3257b468517cc.png[/img]

[h2]Ocean Clouds[/h2]

We also introduced something new—special ocean clouds. Unlike those over freshwater, ocean clouds are often larger, taller, and more dramatic, fueled by constant heat and moisture. We’ve also added sunny, cloudless weather and a subtle heat haze effect to enhance the sensation of hot, shimmering air. To bring this to life, we developed custom technology that makes ocean skies in the game feel more real and immersive than ever before. Here’s a small preview of how the sun moves across the sky, changing the lighting and the appearance of clouds throughout the day. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1FvYivC.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o2AotkB.gif[/img]

[h2]Maahuraa Lagoon[/h2]

The location will feature two starting points for your fishing adventure - Maahuraa Lagoon and Kuda Veli. The main one is the atoll with Maahuraa Lagoon, where anglers can stay at a comfortable resort to unwind after a day on the water. It also serves as the hub where all yachts and boats arrive from the ocean.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/02Ypz4ND/Main-Pin.png[/img]

We’ve received questions from players about ocean boats and whether they’ll be usable in the new location. Rest assured — your Scutum and Volans fishing yachts are built for the ocean and will be fully compatible. For your convenience, a rental boat will also be available at the location for those who haven’t added an ocean yacht to their collection yet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kX8KneU.gif[/img]

If you're looking to upgrade and go high-tech, there’s also something special coming your way: the brand-new Chamaeleon Catamaran. This sleek vessel can accommodate up to 5 players, offers significantly more fish storage, and is built to handle the truly massive ocean giants you’ll encounter — because the fish at this location are going to be bigger than ever. Stay tuned — we’ll reveal more about the fish in the next DevDiary, which is already in the works!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z0tIWCA.gif[/img]

All players aboard the catamaran will have their own adjustable rod holders and top-tier displays, so everyone can stay fully tuned in to the action on the water at all times. The yacht’s name is no coincidence — it hints at one of its coolest features: the ability to change the boat’s color! You’ll get a full chain of engaging missions to unlock custom color options and ride the waves in your own unique style.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DIqptoz.gif[/img]

[h2]Kuda Veli[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Kzp8vw4P/Kuda-Veli.png[/img]

Another starting point on the map, Kuda Veli, is a small distant atoll, home to a fishing settlement nestled a few kilometers southwest of the main atoll. The locals here have a strong connection to the ocean and stick to their fishing craft, passing it down through generations. While most fishermen head for the open ocean the lagoon at the center of the atoll is worth a cast.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ob3TsWG.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZZo1ChC.gif[/img]

The Maldives, scattered like gems across the Indian Ocean, offers some of the most thrilling fishing adventures on the planet. With crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life, it’s a dream destination for anglers seeking both stunning beauty and serious challenges. What you’ve seen in this DevDiary is just a glimpse of what’s to come. Get ready to explore a variety of islands and atolls—some with their own unique feel, hidden easter eggs, and surprises waiting to be uncovered. Stay tuned for the next DevDiaries—new fish, fresh gear, and unforgettable adventures are just over the horizon!

Tight lines, and see you in the next DevDiaries!

Hey Anglers,

Let’s get the Location Reveal Party started! This summer, we’re taking you to Noomaa Kuda Atholhu, a brand-new fishing destination set in the heart of the Maldives, deep in the turquoise embrace of the Indian Ocean.

This island paradise offers more than just breathtaking views—beneath the surface lies a world teeming with legendary fish. You'll go head-to-head with Swordfish, Sailfish, Black Marlin, and Sharks—the long-awaited apex predators of our fishing universe. Noomaa Kuda Atholhu is all about the full tropical experience: sun-soaked atolls, lush palms, and iconic white, powder-soft sand—formed from crushed coral, cool even in the hottest sun.
A full DevDiary is on the way, where we’ll dive into all the exciting new systems, gear, and gameplay this location will bring. notes.title: St. Patrick’s Day 2025: Kick The Snake!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a80dad1d01f50a15af11e3dea9c7ff1a9acfa7e3.png[/img]

When the waters turn a festive shade of green, the notorious Snakeheads make their grand return, stirring up trouble again. But fear not, Brave Angler! It’s up to you to clear the waters and restore order — because if there’s one thing St. Patrick teaches us, it’s that persistence and a bit of luck can handle even the trickiest of pests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/204ebccfe09ad51d3929d5188bbe7d29cd307b07.png[/img]

[h2]Get ready, Brave Angler, it's time to get rich and famous![/h2]

The leprechauns are feeling extra generous this year, and they’ve left [b]some surprises just for you — including Twitch Drops and special St. Patrick gifts in the Personal Offer section.[/b] Be sure to check in regularly – you never know what kind of lucky treasure might be waiting for you!

What’s a celebration without the right outfit? New anglers who haven’t completed all the event missions can earn the Leprechaun Frock Coat, Paddy’s Top Hat, and Green Shamrock Glasses — plus the St. Patrick’s Song motorboat to ride in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d06469e3894035ae5156a771f3fede496b0aebd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/80f50d1b5cfa010f1736472c741b0f0d763b51a8.png[/img]

And if you’re a seasoned angler who has already accomplished the event missions, this is the perfect time to stock up on Baitcoins. [b]Don't forget that every event fish gives you a Baitcoin[/b], and you know better than anyone how to make the most of them in the game!

[h2]In search of the Lucky Horseshoe: Rainbow Chase[/h2]

The Gold Horseshoe Stringer is the key to keeping those pesky Snakeheads safely in check, with no chance of escape. To get it, head to Emerald, Tiber, Saint-Croix, San Joaquin, Sander Baggersee, or Blue Crab Island. Win boat races, collect Stringer parts, and don’t forget to gather Clover Coins to pay the Leprechauns for repairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9ebfd0b682387dcaf753c5188912e89fc58f8377.png[/img]

[h2]The Magic Cauldrons[/h2]

They say treasure lies at the end of the rainbow, and in this case, it’s true! Keep an eye out for Silver and Golden Pots — these magical cauldrons are packed with event baits, credits, Clover Coins, and even Baitcoins. But remember, leprechauns have their own sense of humor, and sometimes they might just leave you guessing what happened to the treasure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bc4763c96395019b81b8079568a4bd91925696a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fc23e25cb1fb1c45d3e9e062c3cf04df0a1227c6.png[/img]

[h2]The Lucky Horseshoes[/h2]

Lucky Horseshoes are scattered all around — find them to unlock a trove of special items! You could get Lucky Charm Catapult, Leprechaun's Chest, Triskele Rod Stand, Kayak Irish Rover, and even the illustrious St. Patrick's Song Motor Boat. Most Pots and Lucky Horseshoes are available to all players, even if you’ve completed past event missions. So keep your eyes open and grab as many as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4d9012e0db10dc5a648b33cb55e378ca4c166755.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/77dbdbbd202d2bc5d281818d3bb1321c5911734a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5bb6644263c17ef1f8d85b24e0300994870be5f8.png[/img]

[h2]Let’s get down to our event fish[/h2]

To take down the Snakeheads, you’ll need event lures and the Gold Horseshoe Stringer. Completing Leprechaun’s Favor missions earns you 1 Clover Coin, but even if you’ve finished them all, you can still catch event fish and earn golden Baitcoins for every single catch!

notes.title: [Steam, EpicGames] Release Note v.5.0.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d8a7c8626e7ef974aed0bca19a7c312545145f2.png[/img]

We have just released a new bug fix patch, now available on Steam. We are currently working on releasing the same patch for the Epic Games Store, and it should be available within the next few hours. Please, make sure to check for the latest version and download the update to get these changes in the game as this release will not get downloaded automatically. 

This update primarily focuses on optimizing and enhancing the performance of the Dnipro River Map, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all players. Additionally, we’ve addressed a variety of bugs and issues to further improve gameplay. Here’s what’s been fixed:

[olist]
[h3]Competitions:[/h3]
[*] Resolved an issue where the competition end signal played on the loading screen after a competition had ended.
[*] Tooltip "A Search" no longer gets stuck after changing tabs when the cursor is in the search field in competitions.
[*] New Fish "European Weatherfish" is now correctly scored in the "Catch 'Em All" competition.
[*] D-pad functionality restored in the Entry Fee window for Custom competitions.
[*] Fixed the button for opening the "My Sports Events" list when multiple events are present on the list.
[*] Fixed an Issue when Players couldn’t change the Entry Fee amount for Custom Competitions.

[h3]Gameplay & Visuals:[/h3]
[*] Fixed an issue where the rod could be cast into the rock mountain on the Selenge River.
[*] Resolved a fog issue when the flashlight was turned on at night.
[*] Corrected the fins animation in photomode and third person view when the fish is hanging on lip grip or hook.
[*] Fixed a visual defect at the connection between the leader and the main fishing line while holding a fish caught by trolling.
[*] Fixed endless spool unwinding when casting beyond terrain boundaries.
[*] Resolved issues with Warmouth and Bluegill fish having fins raised too high.
[*] Fixed the Splake fish missing textures issue.
[*] Seagulls now properly display at lower video quality settings.
[*] Fixed camera view issues when catching a fish.
[*] Changed the thumbnail of the golden Thorn Jig Head to display it correctly without a barb.
[*] Resolved image loading issues.
[*] Players now pick up the correct rod from the stand based on the indicator light.
[*] Resolved an issue where spod rods could not be placed on the rod stand.
[*] Fixed the photo mode issue for Mad-Eye Buffalo Monster fish.
[*] Fixed an issue with flashlights that weren’t visible on the waterways.
[*] Decreased volume for Ukrainian folk songs playing on the Dnipro River map as a response to players’ requests.
[/olist]

[b]Known Issues:[/b] We are aware of an issue with setup templates, where grey squares appear in place of missing items. Rest assured, we are actively working on a fix and will resolve this as soon as possible. In the meantime, these squares typically disappear after some interaction with the Templates list. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

This update will soon be available on consoles, and we are actively working on resolving the remaining issues to bring the new Dnipro River map to mobile platforms. It will still take at least several weeks before we will be able to release it.

Thank you for your patience, valuable feedback and support as we continue to refine and enhance Fishing Planet!

Tight lines and happy fishing!

notes.title: Merry Fishmas 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f21c0192ead41f1f552c03bf0fa8f53e58c753a2.png[/img]

Dear Anglers,
This year has been an extraordinary one for us, as we turned two of our long-standing dreams into reality. The Ocean Update, an idea we envisioned from the very beginning, introduced the vast open seas and the Fishing Together feature, allowing friends to fish side by side on the same boat. Additionally, we finally brought the Dnipro River—our home location—to life, a cherished project that had been long overdue.

Over the past year, so much has happened in Fishing Planet:
🎣 The Club Leagues Season, which, despite its challenges, still brought many players together.
🏆 11 thrilling tournaments and thousands of competitions.
🎃 A brand-new Halloween Event that was both challenging and exciting.
🛠️ 10 major bug-fix patches across 7 platforms, improving the game experience.
🌊 Saltwater and freshwater trolling were introduced to the game.
🛥️ Hundreds of new items, from saltwater yachts to a variety of new tackle, outfits, event items and rewards.

Someone joked that "Fishing Planet was cooking this year," and they weren’t wrong—but what we want you to know is that this was just the appetizer! There’s so much more in store for next year, and we can’t wait to share it with you.

We are deeply grateful for your support and feedback, which drives us to keep improving and growing. While some features take longer to implement and not everything may be possible immediately, we want you to know that we are always listening and doing our best to enhance the game for you.

As we wrap up this year, we wish you and your loved ones a joyful and peaceful holiday season. May your Christmas be filled with warmth and happiness, and may the New Year bring you success, good health, and, of course, plenty of unique catches!

Thank you for being part of our amazing community. Here’s to an even more exciting 2025, together!

Tight lines and yours faithfully,
The Fishing Planet Team

notes.title: Christmas Giant’s Tour!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d02fa5fe75a1264fa9d5637039a9b0d522e21b8.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,
We’re here to announce that the Christmas Giant’s Tour is coming next week, with registration starting on December 23rd and the Final on December 29th!

First, we want to address the timing. We know Christmas week is family time, and holding a tournament then isn’t ideal. Unfortunately, due to the release of the new map, there was no other option. Canceling the tournament wasn’t something we wanted, as we know how important it is to many of you. We truly appreciate your understanding.

Now, let’s talk about the recent changes to competitions and tournaments.
Over the past few months, we’ve introduced updates to the weather mechanics, significantly impacting how competitions work. In the past, knowing all the best fishing spots in a competition would almost guarantee success. However, with these updates, weather patterns and fish migration now play a much larger role. This means that familiar spots might perform differently depending on the conditions.

When these changes were implemented, we didn’t immediately communicate them to the community. Competitions have always been designed as an aspect of the game where players discover and refine strategies through personal exploration. However, we’ve since realized that many players perceive these updates as a malfunction or unintended issue. To clear up any confusion: these adjustments were intentional and aimed at introducing diversity and keeping the experience fresh.

The good news is that you can still learn and adapt! Understanding how fish migrate under different weather conditions adds an exciting new layer of strategy to the game. We believe this adjustment creates an opportunity for players who’ve mastered the game to engage with new challenges, fostering continuous exploration and rewarding effort in novel ways.

We hope this evolution in gameplay keeps your fishing adventures intriguing and offers new milestones to achieve. Keep honing your skills and embracing the thrill of discovery—it’s all part of the journey.
Tight lines!

notes.title: All-Times Christmas Holiday
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/639492286add6c854a4fb1460b687450449e3764.png[/img]


Ho Ho Ho Anglers, 
Cast your cheer—may the fish be biting all through the year!

For everyone who’s been asking, “When?”—the wait is over! Christmas has officially landed on our Planet, and it’s here to stay for almost three festive weeks. This year, you can dive into the Christmas Holiday and the Krampus Hunt missions, or double down and take on both!

[b]The Christmas event starts on December 19th 3 PM UTC and will last until January 6th 10 AM UTC.
[/b]

[h3]Christmas Holiday Event[/h3]

Oh man! Santa’s sleigh’s in trouble again! A snowstorm wrecked his ride somewhere over Canada—luckily, Santa’s fine, but his reindeer are MIA and presents are scattered all over the globe!

Join in to save Christmas—find the lost presents, track down the mythical Crystal Burbot, and complete holiday challenges! Don’t forget to search for those Present boxes on every waterway and grab some Fireworks for the holidays! 

Head over to White Moose Lake, recover Santa’s gift bag, and get those presents back in time for Christmas! Santa’s counting on you, and he’s running out of time! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b3f74d54837f625288d565cf581300b68c4bada.png[/img]

[h3]To help Santa you need to complete Fishmas missions[/h3]
Catch a required amount of Antlered Salmon to harness them in Santa’s sleigh instead of his runaway reindeer. Keep in mind that Antlered Salmon bite best when someone launches fireworks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b96fe1a9a3a4d45b325fb231d0ec0262885391f0.png[/img]

Explore the waterways by boat and help Santa fill his bag with lost gifts! Once you arrive at waterways, find Santa's bag on the pier to get started with the task of collecting boxes with presents.

You’ll find Green boxes on Emerald Lake, Blue boxes on Falcon Lake, White boxes on Tiber River, and Red boxes on White Moose Lake.

And don’t forget to interact with the Gift Boxes to get some Holiday treats for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/624862397a6b4ae2feff201a310a1e046e993e4c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2d794c20b4acae05b0160f9cab41b5d42263ed5f.png[/img]

Catch Decorator Fish to find lost decorations and deck the tree! The more fireworks you set off, the higher your chance of catching these festive fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f9c7f18e84c15697e9c1c4a878b01a3cb0160eef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b98adc1a372e16abecb3928730d3ab53a73ef4ff.png[/img]

And don't forget about the snow fights! 
Hit a certain number of players with Snowballs to earn a special achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7f1f608fcf72a83da69ee90f8c7915bf776e88d8.png[/img]

 Interact with the Snow Piles to get some snow or use the Snow Grounbait mix to make snowballs for the fights. Ready, set, aim—and dive into the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7bddb31af8917a835f6a8ee54f9ac77bb9600f25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18040f9b1874fca47d15298645b644c28d220cc5.png[/img]
Complete Christmas Achievements and Missions and get an exclusive Snowman rod stand and delightful Santa-themed Tackle Box. That Snowman is a perfect fishing buddy for an introvert – you will never feel lonely when fishing with this guy, but no one will keep talking when you just want to fish in silence 😂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1cb105ba4bafac4be47bf82d81a9ef0450e51210.png[/img]

[h3]Summon Crystal Burbot![/h3]
Complete all missions and discover what’s lurking in the waters of White Moose! Join the festive adventure and reel in the legendary Crystal Burbot, the majestic Antlered Salmon, and the playful Furry Trout, all while enjoying fireworks and holiday cheer.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6da68a7d4b49711c8456c787660551f2c02d0492.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/09ad0b1275e7a4823fa659bf08096bae1361f582.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f13033ce6a1788ab6ce05c1740729a59f43479.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5224a02da9732061af67671551efe708720f6926.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5acc07155e9ebc8bf2fcfe044868da744cf991a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e72a8505a9d268e86702c35b42131a50cb057f96.png[/img][/url]


Have fun catching these magical Christmas fish, while the fireworks are blasting, and complete the Myth Buster and Deer Hunter challenges to get unique holiday rewards.

notes.title: Release Note: Dnipro River, Ukraine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6548db24c4ccd7074bbf533a46ee6424fda0570.png[/img]

Welcome to the Dnipro River, Ukraine, a new Level 46 location on Fishing Planet, and a place near and dear to the hearts of the game's developers!

32 fish species,  including well-known favorites such as Carp, Northern Pike, European Perch, Zander, Wels Catfish, Grass Carp, Silver Carp, and the iconic Beluga. And new to the game, White-Eye Bream, Common Nase, Sterlet, European Weatherfish, Chinese Sleeper, rare and valuable Black Sea Roach and locals’ favorite Azov Shad.

Freshwater trolling is finally here and it is available at all the locations in the game! Set out on the brand-new Dnipro motorboat, or give trolling a try with the rental boat available right at Dnipro River. 

Troll for Wels Catfish, Northern Pike and Zander and see how these mighty predators love the brand new Twerky Runner lures! An interesting fact about how Ukrainian anglers fish for Wels Catfish is that it is caught in these areas by trolling at night, while in other countries it is usually caught from the shore. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351850/Fishing_Planet_Dnipro_Delta_Pack/]Grab the Dnipro Delta Pack[/url] and set off in the Dnipro Motorboat, complete with two rod holders for trolling. Get two durable casting and spinning setups, a full range of tackles and lures, and a stylish outfit adorned with traditional designs. Enjoy a 30-day fishing trip on the Dnipro River, surrounded by serene water lilies and willows, with license and Premium account covered!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351850/Fishing_Planet_Dnipro_Delta_Pack/

Discover new baits that are favorites among Ukrainian anglers, including Salo, Mamaliga, and Corn Sticks. And don’t miss the irresistible new groundbaits—featuring flavors like gingerbread and baked milk—that will have the fish biting and, who knows, maybe even make your mouth water too!

New lures, like Twerky Runners, Cicadas, Freaky Walkers, Bionic Slugs and Thorn Jig Heads, including a barbless one will be a pleasure to use for the local predators.

As in every new location, you get plenty of new missions and achievements, 4 new competitions and even two Monster missions! The Sturgeon Leviathan returns, alongside a brand-new threat, the Thorn-Ripper, waiting to be defeated.

Please, note some updates on other locations: European Weatherfish was also added to Lesni Villa, Czech Republic, and another addition to this update, driven by player requests, will be the ability to take Beluga at the Dnipro River. Similarly, we’ve made this option available for European Eel at the Tiber River, Ghent-Terneuzen Canal, and Sander Baggersee Lake. Since these species are endangered in real life, we’ve made them available to take in the game, ensuring no harm to the planet while still offering players the chance to experience the thrill of keeping them virtually. Be aware that this option is available for anglers with Advanced Licenses. 

https://youtu.be/T2jQpi02r5s 

Go ahead and start exploring the new map, or bear with us for the second part, which is equally important for players. We've resolved a number of issues, including the much-anticipated fix for the bass boat shaking bug, when the screen was shaking after hitting an object when driving a bass boat. Additionally, in response to feedback from players with special hearing needs, we've adjusted the Hell Bell sound, lowering its frequency to ensure that everyone can hear it clearly and comfortably.

Another exciting new feature is the redesigned UI for the Competitions rules section. Players will now be able to easily see the equipment, lures, or baits required for each competition, and if they are already equipped in the inventory, a green check will appear next to them. This feature is just the first iteration and will be refined in future updates, but we hope this small change will enhance the player experience by reducing confusion and making it easier to prepare for competitions.

One particularly amusing issue that has now been addressed involved extending the field for the credits balance. This adjustment became necessary because one of our players achieved the maximum possible amount of in-game currency! What an incredible milestone—congratulations on this remarkable achievement! The field has now been expanded to accommodate even higher balances. Way to go!

Here is what else has been included into the bug fix patch:

[b]Tournaments[/b]
1. Fixed graphical artifacts appearing on tournament banners swaying in the wind.
2. Improved localization support for the Tournament Details Popup.
3. Corrected the boat type identification during tournaments.
4. Fixed issues with tournament joining mechanisms becoming unavailable after the tournament started.
5. The "Apply" button no longer appears after the tournament has started.
6. Addressed an issue blocking player interaction after reopening the game client during a tournament.
7. Resolved the problem where the player's previous competition results window returned them to the shore.

[b]UI and Graphics Improvements[/b]
8. Redesigned the Template Received and Cooldown windows.
9. Fixed the wrong color of buttons on Repair and Wear & Tear modal windows.
10. Enhanced the Buy/Sell windows with better clarity and usability.
11. Adjusted the incorrect item quantities displayed in the Mission tab.
12. Corrected blurred user avatar images on the profile tab.
13. Fixed UI alignment issues, such as misplaced "check" icons during boat purchases.
14. Updated Reel of Fortune UI to ensure compatibility with gamepad inputs.
15. Improved club management with the ability to change short names in club descriptions.

[b]Physics and Gameplay Fixes[/b]
16. Adjusted lure behavior consistency when holding the rod in hands.
17. Reduced excessive foam around fish when reeling them in closer.
18. Resolved the "flying fish" bug on Rocky Lake.
19. Corrected the glowing shader for Tench and Golden Tench fish.

[b]Sound Adjustments[/b]
20. Lowered the volume of splashes and other ambient fish activity sounds.
21. Fixed sound inconsistencies with tournament flags.
22. Resolved an issue where tournament flags emitted wind-flapping sounds despite being static.

[b]Game Stability and Functionality[/b]
23. Resolved crashes in photo mode caused by pressing "P".
24. Fixed crashes occurring when hosts forwarded time during FT sessions.
25. Prevented the endless processing window when users tried to leave regular competitions during registration.
26. Addressed crashes when trying to interact with rods after minimizing and reopening the game.

[b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b]
27. Adjusted the shader for Golden Tench and Tench fish to fix translucency issues.
28. Resolved problems with boat movement and captain status interactions.
29. Fixed issues with inventory mechanics, such as transferring items from Home Storage.
30. Fixed a bug when the Fish Species window for Saint-Croix Lake was appearing empty after opening another waterway.
31. Resolved the appearance of a large white figure opposite Sander Baggersee Lake.
32. Other minor fixes and adjustments.

We hope you enjoy exploring the Dnipro River and the enhancements included in this update. From the new map to bug fixes and UI improvements, these changes aim to make your experience smoother and more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to your feedback.

notes.title: Dnipro River, Ukraine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/71021e33f59da9f16d6958c6f169bca3ff076b1e.png[/img]

Amidst the wide steppe and the boundless Ukrainian horizons, where the world’s most fertile black soil nurtures life, the tributaries of the Dnipro River flow like veins of vitality, weaving intricate patterns through the landscape. The sunlit fields stretch endlessly, a patchwork of earthy tones is rich with vegetation and teeming with wildlife. These waters, abundant with fish, are a gift of nature—a sacred haven that whispers the timeless stories of generations past. We invite you to cast your line among water lilies and graceful willows in the serene beauty of this cherished waterway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/673b7e6338320f03b78537aad2fe3189b788d700.png[/img]

Dnipro River, Level 46 offers four unique locations to explore: The Delta Fishing Lodge, The Wild Beach, The Reed Cat, and The Poachers’ Side. Yet, the adventure doesn’t end there—feel free to go ashore and discover other hidden gems scattered across the area. With plenty of space to wander, you can take your time exploring the landscapes, uncovering details along the way that we’re sure will capture your attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b93d775e82f40204b75e76dd3d53439958811b0.png[/img]

This lively place is teeming with motion, from yachts and barges gliding across the water to ducks swimming and horses wandering nearby,  sheep graze peacefully on the slopes, birds soar above, and insects hum in the air. Don't forget to turn on the sound to fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EYkdWTk.gif[/img]

Let’s take a closer look at The Delta Fishing Lodge, a small cozy angler’s base located on the edge of the picturesque Dnipro delta. It offers comfortable hotel rooms to relax after a busy day of fishing. Piers jut out into the water and provide easy access to fishing spots. For guests' convenience, the base offers motorboat and kayak rentals, making it easy to explore the river and find the best fishing spots.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3OFaU8f.gif[/img]

[h2]Boats and Freshwater Trolling
[/h2]
Speaking of boats, experienced anglers were quick to spot a key detail in the first teaser of the new location: the rod holders. Many of you guessed correctly—these holders are designed for freshwater trolling - this update introduces an exciting new fishing method!
On the Dnipro River, the rental boat comes equipped with two rod holders created specifically for trolling with spinning and casting rods. This means that every angler visiting the location can experience freshwater trolling simply by renting this boat.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zu4bMs5.gif[/img] 

For those looking to troll across various freshwater locations in the game, the Dnipro Motor Boat is your go-to companion. This locally produced classic boasts an authentic Ukrainian design, embodying the style and craftsmanship of its heritage. Equipped with two rod holders and powered by a 75-horsepower Neptune motor, it delivers stable and efficient performance. The durable construction makes it a reliable choice for anglers who appreciate both functionality and legacy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dBPJIGj.gif[/img] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y5dD8VN.gif[/img]

[h2]Dnipro River Fish Species[/h2]

When exploring a new location, the variety of fish species is always a key interest for anglers. The Dnipro River map features 32 fish species, including well-known favorites such as Carp, Northern Pike, European Perch, Zander, Wels Catfish, Grass Carp, Silver Carp, and the iconic Beluga Sturgeon.
In addition to these familiar species, the map introduces 7 new ones, expanding the diversity of catches available.  Let’s take a closer look at these species and the opportunities they present.

[h3]White-Eye Bream[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WYvUJUf.gif[/img] 

White-Eye Bream is a ray-finned fish species of the Carp family, widespread in many large rivers of Europe and Asia and in drainages of the Black, Caspian, and White seas. These fish prefer to inhabit large, fast-flowing rivers and estuaries.

White-Eye Breams have silvery-gray elongated bodies flat on the sides and dark gray fins. These fish usually grow to a mass of 1-2.2 lb, with the maximum weight of a unique specimen rarely exceeding 3.3 lb. It is a ray-finned fish species of the Carp family, widespread in many large rivers of Europe and Asia and in drainages of the Black, Caspian, and White seas. These fish prefer to inhabit large, fast-flowing rivers and estuaries.

White-Eye Bream feeds on small crustaceans, mollusks, insects, and insect larvae.

[h3]Common Nase[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QjZiuty.gif[/img]

Common Nase is a European freshwater fish of the Carp family. Its natural habitat is the drainages of the Black, Baltic, and North Sea, but this migratory fish has also been introduced to other parts of Europe. Common Nase prefer deep, fast-moving waters, where they usually stay in shoals.

Common Nase has a blue-gray or silvery elongated body with an orange tail. Generally, these fish grow to 9-15 inches in length and weigh from 0.6-2.2 lb. However, unique specimens are known to reach up to 3.5 lb in weight.

These bottom-dwelling fish mainly feed on algae and other aquatic plants.

[h3]Sterlet[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hhs78zf.gif[/img]

Sterlet is a relatively small species of Sturgeon found in large rivers in Eurasia, particularly the ones flowing into the Black and Azov seas. This valuable commercial fish prefers to inhabit clean rivers with strong currents and cool water, where it likes to hide in deeper areas with sandy bottoms.

The Sterlet has a long, narrow nose with barbels and an elongated triangular-shaped body that is yellowish-gray and covered with bony plates instead of scales. Distinguished from other Sturgeons by their small size, the Sterlet usually weighs between 2 and 13 lb, with unique specimens sometimes weighing up to about 19 lb.

[h3]European Weatherfish[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kpNmjxq.gif[/img] 

European Weatherfish is a species of Loach widespread in Europe and Asia. It gets its name for coming to the surface and acting excitedly whenever the air pressure changes before a thunderstorm. These fish inhabit still waters of muddy rivers and are resilient to low-oxygen environments.

These small fish are yellowish in coloration, with brown bands stretching along their entire body. 

European Weatherfish usually grow to a length of about 12 in and a maximum weight of 0.5 lb.


[h3]Chinese Sleeper[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ooueE3c.gif[/img] 

Chinese Sleeper is a species of freshwater fish widely introduced throughout Northern Eurasia and many European countries. The only known member of its genus, Chinese Sleeper, prefers to inhabit still waterways with plentiful aquatic vegetation and can easily survive even in polluted environments.

Chinese Sleepers resemble Gobies by their shape and overall appearance. These fish have somewhat chubby short bodies with varying coloration that ranges from greyish-green to brown tones with a grey belly and is covered with small spots. During mating season, however, they turn black. The maximum weight of a Chinese sleeper is 1 lb, with most specimens weighing around 0.2-0.7 lb and ranging in body length from 6 to 10 in.

These fish are carnivorous and feed predominantly on invertebrates, larvae, and other small fish, including those of their kind.

[h3]Black Sea Roach[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TMjU7U3.gif[/img] 

The Black Sea Roach is a predatory freshwater fish. It prefers areas of rivers with a fast current, eddies, with clean spring water rich in oxygen. It usually occurs in small groups, sometimes on its own. The silvery gray body of this fish has blue reflections along its sides. They feed on insects, small fish and fry.

The Black Sea Roach is considered a rare and valuable fish.

[h3]Azov Shad[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qEmbPgp.gif[/img]

Azov shad is a freshwater fish of the herring family that adapts to various conditions, including brackish water and sudden temperature changes. From early May, when the water warms up to 59°F, until early June, Azov shad spawns in the Dnipro, seeking the rapid current. Historically, Azov shad has been of significant economic importance for the Kherson region and an essential source of income. People of Kherson simply love this fish!

[h2]Monsters[/h2]

Yes, you read that right—Monsters, plural! Because two monsters are better than one, aren’t they? Fans of the legendary Sturgeon Leviathan Monster will be thrilled to know it’s staying in the game. Even if you’ve already completed this mission before, you’ll have another chance to catch it.

But the monster tale doesn’t stop there—a brand-new beast is making its debut: the formidable Thorn-Ripper.

This aggressive creature prowls the depths of the Dnipro River, a true survivor hardened by centuries of evolution. Its spikes, razor-sharp and menacing, developed as both a defense mechanism and a weapon to dominate its territory. According to legend, the Thorn-Ripper harbors a grudge against fishermen, its rage fueled by the loss of its family to human nets. Stories tell of this monster ramming boats with its needle-like spikes, leaving behind nothing but shattered hulls and terrified anglers.

Catching the Thorn-Ripper won’t be easy. Cautious and elusive, it can only be lured by something truly extraordinary—like the Wasp Walker, a one-of-a-kind bait designed to tempt even the wariest predator.
We won’t spoil the surprise by showing you what this monster looks like. You’ll just have to discover it for yourself when the battle begins. Good luck, Brave Anglers!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VuEyQq1.gif[/img] 

[h2]Lures, Baits and flavors of Ukraine[/h2]

In addition to the baits, lures, and groundbaits already available in the game, new options are on the horizon for anglers to discover. Let’s take a closer look at what’s in store.

[h3]Salo and Salo Generalske[/h3]

Salo, the traditional cured pork fat, is a beloved staple of Ukrainian cuisine. If you know what prosciutto is for Italians and jamon for Spaniards, then you understand what salo means for Ukrainians. Typically salted and sometimes infused with garlic or spices, it can be enjoyed raw, smoked, or cooked. But salo isn’t just a culinary treasure—it’s also an excellent bait for carp fishing. Its dense, fatty texture holds securely on the hook, releasing a tantalizing aroma that Common and Grass Carps find irresistible. This bait shines in warm weather, as the heat helps the fat release its enticing scent.

Salo Generalske, on the other hand, is a more refined, premium version. Enhanced through marinating, smoking, or unique seasonings, this "fancier" salo offers an even richer flavor profile. And just as it would impress diners, it’s sure to drive fish wild with its delectable allure.

And as a small taste of Ukrainian hospitality, take a moment to explore the location—you might stumble upon some free pieces of salo to use as bait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0bafbe941f8b627c8ea9ed8c5bab5afd84383090.png[/img]

[h3]Mole Crickets[/h3]

While not as appetizing to people as salo, the mole cricket is a true delicacy for fish. This insect, with its hard exoskeleton and juicy body, is a natural treat straight from the Ukrainian landscape. Its earthy, organic aroma works wonders in attracting predatory fish. Widely regarded as one of the best baits for Catfish and other large species, the mole cricket is a trusted choice for local Ukrainian anglers, blending tradition with the wisdom of nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea9b30ef5d445129e2ea9cfeb9d34d9e3b17eb7c.png[/img]

[h3]Crawling Worms[/h3]

Thanks to its high flexibility and considerable size, the crawling worm makes an ideal bait for catching large fish. It is effectively used together with different types of hooks, which significantly raises the chances of a successful catch. This bait performs especially well in muddy and overgrown waters, where Catfish dwell and feed. Yummy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfefc8da995b4cd9085730269898a3c58597ac98.png[/img]

[h3]Cicada Spoons[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/418c58cdaf121eb31fb191a2d4f77e10749a9236.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95a4436c5f12df1f9d99057ca73210522e95cabb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/181005bf70c74ba3f1059538e1aa79f2aea2ac1d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b5cc9eb6e8ad2a0d01e7a5cec76d5f6d8fc4067.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5be727a9f850b696ebbd7ea9521a2db24fff396f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d1dd83ea4ceafb94d8106f970e97065188d35408.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5562a1319c126a721ce53bcc12f89d46770543a2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b4b9dc44bdb7d35391e12517e90440cf7ebb8d46.png[/img][/url]

The Cicada is an effective lure designed for fishing at different water depths. Its compact body with front lead weight ensures an accurate and far cast, even in strong winds. The Cicada works great for catching a variety of predatory fish including Bass, Pike, Zander, and Trout thanks to its ability to adapt its vibration to the situation.

[h3]Twerky Runners[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ede31c6f51fa3a36e9de47d6ce67667a926b9f84.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8a8cd01657e34fc7dc0a374ddeede27f940eca98.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cb51a0dd8de977e6959d3875230a0a3e543d05e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/234fac7eabae0cdb74df532b877bb753effa1b71.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d68d8bd5b319e46d484271e78000e1e45472f49c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2718adb1afc8435519a8aebc6ad77a68066a01e7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/40aad6d97f72e2fe0120f1f6e362b71a1921e285.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5c227f1539e824b604ad0071e86e43e8b37c5085.png[/img][/url]

The Twerky Runners are new effective crankbaits that have a special hunchbacked shape to ensure a fast, high-frequency wobble. The lure has a special aroma that attracts catfish. Rigged with razor-sharp highest quality hooks, the Twerky Runner is great for trolling and particularly suited for using with more powerful fishing rods. Choose your Twerky Runner from a selection of sizes and colors depending on the fishing conditions and how deep you want to go.

[h3]Freaky Walkers[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ccccabe7c8f325e1219c77abc6ceb5e98bd677a4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9ac5d2b31ffd2c710d935249e8a7b6626211e614.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb3e7795e741d5750545d3932a41b0b461dd1a53.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7176d1bcc7e0207fd5d8238fac787be33ad9bb6f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c598aedd72073401a24b984ce3e3bab44a2e3d3e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/08e6c71b4975943f8360b9b7522d05dc374f197e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0c9c9688a2f029a3c5ae4a0922074b294f44bde0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d980cb553bd43161ea387b76427b9eee6c811c9d.png[/img][/url]

Walkers are surface lures that imitate the movement of a wounded fish, frog, or insect on the water surface. Thanks to their ability to produce a variety of movements, Walkers effectively provoke Perch, Chub, Asp, and other surface predators into attacking.

[h3]Bionic Slugs[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/087a4d89018f3142a5f6b9599144b0672da1b776.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7c62bdab4d040490426f5d8ce89676db7d828cdc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/471a11f718cfd50128c305f4d1d4dc3e1d05fac9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/531a0909546adf3b8f63217e14e2b92448e950ef.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/58cd0d7675c7986412e7a8665592533312122bdc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0127d14238580f0e456c595ef32fc7fe44a941e5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5f4ed8a1e03e732135447966826666f980e80db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/de8ba71db1bd7f89ca87f32d482a9cdfbc2cdc07.png[/img][/url]

Bionic Slugs are innovative lures that imitate a fast-moving fish and are made of high-quality silicone. With its realistic shiny scales and a forked tail, this lure mimics a wounded fish to attract predators. Its soft tail moves attractively in the water. The slug is easy to use: just put the hook through its mouth and tighten the line through the metal ring. Suitable for catching various types of fish in both fresh and salt water.

[h3]Thorn Jig Heads[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7274931eb5d75dc13a85b590e2ed483a8044a41b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/130429cbe05cf584581c7b10159c447366059afa.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b46b41caab7ba18d53007a7979ca82b9c0e00d8b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/29fe95bb720ee2b408785793fc60b2e8898ec639.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/402a58ea382b1e30cab203b19741c66b0f55f841.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/234d384e48e8c140738c5349640c28b355b32e42.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a5399678785675a457df4d8527d0211dd10318a4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/49b832b939cb8c9a13a2234cc1566c5caa4ade62.png[/img][/url]

Developed by the world’s top anglers, the Thorn Jig Head proves that the devil is in the details. Small changes lead to significant improvements. The beveled weight provides a louder and clearer impact even on soft ground, while a special plastic spike holds the silicone in place, allowing you to make the retrieve in difficult conditions. The weights are painted in colors visible to fish even at great depths, significantly increasing your chances for a successful catch!

[h3]Groundbaits[/h3]

We’re also  introducing a variety of new groundbaits, particles, and aromas, but we’d like to highlight a few personal favorites that hold a special place in our hearts. These selections carry a nostalgic charm for our team, reminding us of cherished memories from childhood.

Gingerbread Classic Groundbait has a characteristic sweet aroma and is made with spices, which means it can effectively attract fish even in cold weather. Low cost and high efficiency make this groundbait unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/84e4e2b5a957bc7ec49eade3de3968185729af54.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91cf34d0bb87d537b596d63c2b5f05e860d60bcb.png[/img]

Mamalyha, a traditional Ukrainian-style corn porridge similar to Italian polenta, brings a rich, hearty flavor to the table—and to the water. When transformed into feeder bait with added aromas, it becomes an irresistible treat for all kinds of peaceful fish, including Bream and Carp. This time-honored recipe blends tradition with effectiveness, making it a go-to choice for anglers seeking success.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7abfce3e36dc65e1d4bd1cc660228194133ca628.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f348e1eba3105c788f24693d59e4cdc3dac53cae.png[/img]

Corn sticks are not only a delicious snack popular in Ukraine, but also a feeder groundbait ideal to use for peaceful fish! It has an attractive texture and smell that ensures fish are active near your fishing spot for a long time.

Baked milk is a classic Ukrainian drink made by slowly baking milk overnight in a cooling traditional stove. This gentle process caramelizes the natural sugars in the milk, giving it a rich, caramel-like aroma. A geyser groundbait infused with baked milk aroma is designed to quickly release its enticing scent into the water, creating a powerful "geyser" effect that draws fish from afar. Especially effective in deep fishing, this chum's sweet fragrance guarantees to capture the attention of nearby fish, ensuring a successful catch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s9JoS1Y.gif[/img]

This location is deeply cherished by the Fishing Planet team, and we've poured all our passion into creating it. The Dnipro River has inspired countless generations, serving as a symbol of Ukraine’s natural beauty and cultural legacy.  The esteemed poet Taras Shevchenko captured the river’s essence in his powerful words:
[i]
"The mighty Dnipro roars and bellows,
The wind in anger howls and raves,
Down to the ground it bends the willows,
And mountain-high lifts up the waves."[/i]

These vivid lines not only highlight the river's grandeur but also convey its wild, untamed energy, which contrasts beautifully with the calm and peaceful experience that awaits you. As you explore this iconic waterway, you’ll follow the path of generations who’ve found inspiration, sustenance, and a deep connection to nature along its banks. Welcome to our home and enjoy your stay!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/10b319b233e2e34296edfb1caf930822e3dd391d.png[/img]

notes.title: Akhtuba River: Important Update for Anglers
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

We would like to inform the community that in approximately three weeks, the Akhtuba River location will be removed from the game. To ensure a smooth transition, we have prepared a comprehensive compensation plan for all players affected by this change:

[b]Relocation and Refunds[/b]
[list]
[*] All players present at the Akhtuba River location at the time of its removal will be transferred to the Global Map.
[*] Any travel expenses, unused paid stay costs, and boat rental fees for this location will be refunded in full.
[/list]
[b]Keepnet Fish[/b]
[list]
[*] If you have fish in your keepnets at the time of removal, they will be automatically sold, and the credits will be added to your account.
[/list]
[b]License Refunds[/b]
[list]
[*] Players with active licenses for the Akhtuba River location will be compensated for any unused days.
[*] For players with unlimited licenses, the full cost of the license will be refunded.
[/list]
[b]Marker Buoy Reimbursement[/b]
[list]
[*] Any Marker Buoys used at this location will be returned to you and made available for use at other locations
[/list]
[b]Achievement and Mission Completion[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements in progress at the Akhtuba River location will be marked as completed.
[*] Players in the middle of completing the exploration mission for this location will also have the mission marked as completed.
[/list]

All compensations will be processed automatically, and your in-game balance will be updated to reflect the adjustments outlined above. If you have any questions, feel free to contact [b]support@fishingplanet.com[/b], we will be happy to help.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we work to make this transition as seamless as possible. Our team remains committed to delivering the best possible experience for all anglers.

Tight lines and don’t forget [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/7142240538544046104?snr=2___]the Thanksgiving Event is live now[/url], so don’t miss out!

notes.title: Thanksgiving Day 2024: Golden Turkey Rush
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/04d5f472393aa8f62fb05b288bf589620cf11edf.png[/img]

Dear Fishing Planet Community,

Thanksgiving is just around the corner, and we’re inviting you to celebrate with us by preparing a festive feast that captures the spirit of gathering, gratitude, and tradition. This special meal reflects the togetherness and sense of community that Thanksgiving represents.

Join us for the Thanksgiving Day event and embark on a thrilling series of missions designed to help you craft delicious dishes for our holiday feast! Those who show the most determination will be rewarded with the exclusive Indian Canoe, along with in-game currency and unique fishing items. Our special Thanksgiving Cauldrons will be simmering delightful fish dishes for our festive dinner. Catch fish of all sizes using delicious Golden Corn. From Lone Star to San Joaquin, whether it’s Sunfish or Trout, no underwater dweller can resist its allure. 

Harvest Golden Corn at event locations to enhance your chances of landing that perfect catch. Earn the exclusive Pilgrim Hat reward by completing the Catcher in the Corn achievement. 

Featuring mid-level waterways as the primary event locations, this celebration is designed for players of all skill levels to enjoy and complete. Thanksgiving Day embodies the spirit of harvest, unity, and, of course, Fishing Planet! 

[b]Mark your calendars—the event will run from November 21st, 10:00 AM UTC to December 2nd, 10:00 AM UTC.
[/b]
[h2]The search for the Cornucopia

[/h2]Our journey begins at Lone Star Lake, where your first task is to discover the Horn of Plenty, or Cornucopia. Once you find it, you'll unlock a series of missions that will guide you in preparing all the delicious holiday dinner dishes and setting up the perfect Thanksgiving feast at Lone Star Lake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4e9a4b736cc7a7bc21b43d298eb437331f881f7b.png[/img]

[h2]Thanksgiving Dinner
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/92275192173df131f693edde6168c5eb89445835.png[/img]

To start cooking every dish, you’ll first need to find the magical Cauldron at each event location. Once you do, you will receive tasks that will guide you in gathering all the ingredients necessary to create a variety of delicious fish-inspired dishes.

Start your journey at Lone Star with the delectable Assorted Fish Platter, then venture to Lesnivila for the savory Stuffed Carp. Don’t miss out on the delightful Fish Pie waiting for you at Mudwater!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51b4dd48346f7c7276bef37a59d7bfad3ed2accf.png[/img]

As you explore, treat your taste buds to the rich flavors of Trout Sashimi at Rocky Lake, prepare the perfectly Grilled Carp at Neherrin, and warm up with a bowl of Festive Fish Soup at Ghent Terneuzen.
Continue your gastronomic exploration by uncovering the tempting Smoked Trophies at Tiber, indulging in Gefilte Fish at Quanchkin, savoring the flavorful Trout Tacos at Saint Croix, and experiencing the exotic Chinese-style Carp at San Joaquin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b4ae476690aa0933c56df97d8bd0efcae577010.png[/img]

[h2]Table decorations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f0a4f2bf6618654731a9561ded3378bb8f22915d.png[/img]

Every festive dinner table deserves the perfect decorations, and you can find them at Emerald! Once you've completed cooking  any of the holiday dishes, be sure to stop by Emerald to collect decorations that will complete your holiday table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2c6c659f2489a21794c5890ef812a1e8a2bc12a6.png[/img]

[h2]Corn Harvest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/017280433402a85d71b60f34c5af89a234e9ef68.png[/img]

And don’t forget to explore the Corn Fields—where you can find thriving corn stalks ready for harvest! Gather some delicious Golden Corn to use as bait for your fishing adventures. You can also discover corn stalks beyond the event locations, including the Selenge River, the Amazonian Maze, and the Congo River. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7998433cb05dd3b5aa5668769297c491c60e24e4.png[/img]

[h2]Secret Missions[/h2]

There are also two secret missions waiting to be uncovered! The thrill lies in the surprise—you’ll only discover them after you accidentally complete it and receive your reward. So, keep your eyes peeled and be adventurous; try different approaches and see what surprises await you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/068c15b7ef1dfb1a082b58fadc00ac86aaeacf7a.png[/img]

[h2]Thanksgiving Cornucopia Pack[/h2]

Celebrate the holiday fishing tradition with the Thanksgiving Cornucopia Pack! This is your chance to snag the exclusive Thanksgiving edition True Pilgrim’s Doublet. This comprehensive package is fully loaded, featuring three high-quality telescopiс setups and all kinds of tackles, a spacious keepnet, and an abundance of bait to ensure a bountiful Thanksgiving catch. And the special Pilgrim Jacket will elevate your look and complement the Pilgrim Hat you'll receive upon completing the Catcher in the Corn achievement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654610/Fishing_Planet_Thanksgiving_Cornucopia_Pack/

As we prepare for this Thanksgiving event, we want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you in the Fishing Planet community. Your passion and support make our journey together truly special. Thank you for being such an important part of our community, and we look forward to celebrating this season of gratitude with you. Happy fishing and happy Thanksgiving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0ebf812ad2d0b199c202a0ffa5a5a9308c744399.png[/img]

[b]Be sure to check out our social media channels—there will be some treats waiting for you, just like always!

notes.title: Dnipro River near Kherson, Ukraine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/df591d3ad83f303decb84c7ce769700baccbcc3a.png[/img]

Dear Fishing Planet Community,

Today is a deeply meaningful day for us as a Ukrainian team, and we’re excited to share a special announcement close to our hearts. We want to pull back the curtain on our upcoming location—the mighty Dnipro River near Kherson, Ukraine, a place of incredible natural beauty and resilience.

Many of you know about the ongoing war in Ukraine. In February 2022, russia launched a full-scale invasion, occupying parts of the East and South of Ukraine. Kherson, a southern city close to the vast Dnipro River, was seized in the early days of the invasion. For nine long months, the people of Kherson lived under oppression, yet they never gave up. They resisted, they protested, and on November 11, 2022, the city was liberated by the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Even today, though, Kherson remains under constant missile threat.

The Dnipro River, a symbol of Ukraine’s strength, flows through Kherson, and we’ve long dreamed of creating a Ukrainian location inspired by the landscapes and spirit of our home. We wanted to preserve and share its beauty as it was in times of peace. Sadly, the war has scarred this place; in their retreat, russian forces destroyed a major dam, flooding vast areas and triggering an ecological disaster.

In the face of this, we’re determined to honor the spirit of Ukraine and the enduring beauty of the Dnipro. Our upcoming location captures the river’s serenity and vibrancy before all the destruction, offering you a chance to experience a place that means the world to us. It’s a place our team has known and loved since childhood, filled with memories and a connection to the natural wonders that we grew up with.

This is only a first look—we’re preparing a detailed DevDiary to show you everything that’s coming. New fish species, a new fishing mechanic, and a piece of Ukraine’s landscape are all on the way, crafted with love and dedication. We aim to release this location by the end of the year as a special Christmas gift to our players.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. This project is dedicated to the brave defenders of our Homeland and to the memory of those who have given their lives for Ukraine. It is because of their courage and sacrifice that we are able to continue our work today.

Stay tuned for a more detailed announcement coming soon—we can’t wait to share more about this special location with you!

notes.title: Welcome to Topwater Kayak Cup!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca1cfa3b0201468cb229f2de8491e0f79840da39.png[/img]


Hey there lovely Anglers,
Welcome to the Topwater Kayak Cup tournament! Get ready to take on the challenge of catching a range of fish with topwater lures under special rules. Show off your skills by landing big fish and reaching the Finish Point before time runs out!

Travel to top fishing spots around the world, from Lake Falcon in Oregon and the Selenge River in Mongolia to California’s San Joaquin Delta. Reach the semifinals at Michigan's Saint-Croix Lake, and compete in the final showdown at Lake Maku-Maku in Peru!

The Topwater Kayak Cup 2024 will be held from November 12th until November 17th, with the Registration starting on November 11th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 11th of November - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 12th of November - Qualifier 1 in Oregon, FALCON LAKE.
[*] 13th of November - Qualifier 2 in Mongolia, SELENGE RIVER.
[*] 14th of November - Qualifier 3 in California, SAN JOAQUIN DELTA
[*] 16th of November - Semifinal Round in Michigan, SAINT-CROIX LAKE.
[*] 17th of November - the Grand Finale in Peru, MAKU-MAKU LAKE.
[/list]

[b]Important:[/b]
Be sure to check out all the Tournament details in the Tournament Tab within the game. A key aspect of this tournament is that only Spinning and Casting rods with top water lures are permitted. You cannot use rod stands and stringers, only keepnets are allowed. Please, note that boats are prohibited, players must use only kayaks during the tournament.

Also, don’t forget to review the[url=https://fishingplanet.com/TournamentRules.htm] Competitive activities rules[/url] before registering. Remember, only one Fishing Planet account is allowed per device for tournaments. If you're playing with family, each member will need their own device to participate.

Enjoy your chance to get a whole bundle of goods including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804846/Fishing_Planet_Topwater_Kayak_Pack/ 

Fight for the championship title and a prize pool packed with Credits, BaitCoins, and unique fishing gear. Good luck and have fun!
