notes.title: Chronicles of The Haunted Fleet
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1bec0dec31d6f25e10b5fdf6fd5c6acae7ed6ede.png[/img]

As Halloween draws near, the air turns crisp, the days grow shorter, and a thick, low fog rolls in at dusk, blanketing everything in a misty veil. The wind whispers through the trees, carrying with it the scent of damp earth and fallen leaves, rustling softly as if nature itself is preparing for something ominous. There’s a sense of anticipation, the world is holding its breath, waiting for the mysterious wonder of Halloween night, and the Fishing Planet community is eagerly awaiting for one of their favorite events in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51146ae50cc82fc086970c8b7a702e7b65f06e18.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5a945cacea4c915d3e18e368446658d3fcaa1db2.png[/img]

Our journey begins on the Mudwater River, where the remnants of a long-sunken ship lie. Among the wreckage, we uncover an old chest, weathered by both water and time. As we pry it open, a layer of algae and sand gives way to reveal [b]the Diary of the Supernatural Explorer[/b] inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/986146a096f7aca6332ef0b6f721c0e2a6b96dcf.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bc2a87d2510e48992baa837eb88f33f228f7fe67.png[/img]

The whereabouts of the explorer and the fate that befell him remain shrouded in mystery. Many pages of the diary have not survived, and some are heavily damaged. Within its worn covers lie a collection of gripping tales and intricate sketches. Were these terrifying monsters mere figments of his imagination, or did they truly exist? It’s up to our Brave Angler to unravel this mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7521b1b7b79bb90757d6980b39484b023c891c1f.png[/img]

As you explore the pages of the [b]Supernatural Explorer’s Diary[/b], the ancient legends within come to life. You’ll face mythical creatures such as the [b]Slide Rock Bolter, Armored Bighead, Double-Headed Eel, Dingonek, Akkorokamui, and Vampire Fish[/b], among others—monsters that emerge from the misty mountains of Colorado to the distant Japanese islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2352023a8224518079f769a25a804dfb988fecc4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d8efd5915a8254073bd6579e40edc32899fc95e6.png[/img]

Guided by the Diary, your journey will take you across the globe, uncovering mysteries tied to haunted sunken ships and cursed waters. Every page reveals a new tale and each mission is rooted in the local legends and traditions of the region where it takes place, drawing you into the rich folklore and eerie tales that have haunted these lands for centuries. You will face terrifying creatures straight from the myths of each location. These missions will test your courage, skill, and preparation as you battle supernatural forces using powerful lures crafted from traditional items and mystical artifacts tied to the region's history. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/53eead90e6aff76c1f1f5d4a1d73ae55a2f36468.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bc5e9c5e3011daed36c3d422cfba6f0eaf03e527.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/073120c7a566859ff484e62712cbff19a2a8e4fd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fcabbef29334f5eac697a5ccd9136e5d6e1928b1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/85c312d2ada443e3c4da7f19b413cbddb1849a5f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b0b710caf104b480679f9881e93fe2e6a2671164.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc52519b79051b89be3269c3184288ba42113906.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cd7f24b18d77e387bbabf5735e20e88ceeb4904e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ec910cd32cafb962a5feeb7ca29a21258a7ef77.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/60ce7df66aaead492d565320f31a80ff9a90dbf2.png[/img][/url]

You’ll need to craft those lures from ingredients like [b]grave soil, stale wine, fireflies, and enchanted relics[/b] to face these terrifying beasts. Each challenge brings you closer to uncovering the dark secrets behind these ancient legends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6fcdd8d9fe7ebb090a58d8280a626629eb2947af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/748a68823ae7c7cb4f90e14fb285664e8b833887.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9841dec41019ae7a41b3b12618ac6549554425de.png[/img]

The event lures—such as the[b] Labradorite Spoon, Silicone Finger Tube, Piranha Duo Swimbait, Silver Bullet, Pearl Squid Jig, and Skull Jig[/b]—along with unique baits like [b]Dried Fish Head, Rotten Liver, Suttung’s Mead, Pig's Heart, Bloody Flies, Blood Dough Balls, Cursed Aracu Minnow, Boiled Crawfish,[/b] and [b]Poisonous Maggots[/b]—will aid you in overcoming the challenges and missions that await, enhancing your chances of success as you delve deeper into the mysteries of the event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/05d6d279dfe9ac9ded37109a282fbf9adae1ad05.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/16999adc02c4bcdc100eed552505a85e30f85e88.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f2313c282deadb936b63ba4431b6efbd873c8ad4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/44154828b4260e90adb9e9687e7b1d60fc0f4b35.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d78d0f006fb3a9f4e41f242bcdb12a18e97058d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2c6a1464a9458320d59ecfc20eb021989c96f89c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5f5d24860379e09abb268de153731732d98376d6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/175830e527ec1a0acade358c167504301d9427e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4bfd14506cfebd2addada398f2b181463bbacffd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7c82bb136822b2fc66cee9420f8c39a24c847889.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f7f044d9249379f9373206367c192f428348d19f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/41ae0c87b701b822a7c58bd3f8215e63c8d66adb.png[/img]

After overcoming numerous challenges and missions across all continents, just when you think the adventure is over and you've earned your reward for completing the event—a beautifully crafted spinning setup featuring the [b]Katana Soul 220 rod[/b] and the [b]Samurai Shadow 15000 reel[/b], [b]Sou'wester  Hat[/b] and a[b] pond pass for distant island of Kaiji No Ri in Japan[/b]—a new challenge emerges, pushing you to face yet another fearsome monster! And trust us, it’s a finale worthy of the bravest anglers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/97a6f196420671469db1fe71668e9ae81b9f5824.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2855ecbdbfb7eddcf261ed22262f228ac502176e.png[/img]

For those bold enough to complete the last mission, the ultimate reward awaits: [b]the Japanese Squid Kabuto[/b]. This beautifully crafted helmet, symbolizing the mystical strength of the ocean, merges the warrior’s protection with the elegance of a true masterpiece. It represents power, resilience, and readiness to face any challenge that comes your way.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j7hSDQD.gif[/img]

Don’t overlook the additional challenges that accompany the main storyline! In [b]Bolivia[/b], you’ll encounter the [b]Skull Challenges[/b], where you must pay homage to the ancestors of the local people by completing their tasks. These challenges are not only a test of skill but also a way to connect with the rich cultural heritage of the region.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/be015372b81ba535562801db1a3a1bc7cdac519b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/61b01a92c180e5f5dd8c51d11f16f31fa2cc22c8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fb9e783d9efbd40f44e9f8fa1d6e14e43b8414ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8a1ac2b9cbf36afcd86ab2369fdc8706a9f66338.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c2640badadb3110093ebd8dc54a7db4ec684c887.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c20f2aec45ca430634383163ac8d75055d1b863b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/476a92208a9e50bd0117fd98bc8eca9f4da32ed9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1813fa29f1ad6971e31009134beae37f2517369.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/50383742fb2016face0a87ba5bd5fc6021a5e27d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f332bd02680ffe8ce988484db28d1f963a19a428.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0411d41ddbe041903b695e7f66da748a05595775.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ccc00c6e2d14b850a045a25fcfdb676a0a7a3c0.png[/img]

Another exciting challenge is the [b]Ringing Ghost Bells[/b], where you’ll need to showcase your dexterity and agility. Your goal is to ring all the ghost bells of the [b]St. Sebastian Church[/b] within the allotted time. If you succeed, the ancient gods will lend their support, helping you overcome any malevolent spirits that may stand in your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/faffc9c2a222ae09fe0afc76fc9132e18f638208.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6780b05350eada90d1dc6343ca2f9e662efb495f.png[/img]

You will also encounter something that you already know from the previous years. [b]Pumpkin Candy Bait[/b] will be there for you to catch [b]Bluegill skeleton[/b] event fish on all the freshwater locations, and accomplish Sweet Tooth achievement. These Halloween pumpkin jellies are just the perfect bait to liven up that holiday spirit and awaken your inner child as you go on a night hunt after monstrous bony anomalies that find pumpkin Candy simply irresistible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d5fb311e47c35f22c6cef80923f225c779cd9b1.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f6b3f8d98a4fe4b491b9b558ffe7a76acfa55c.png[/img]

And don’t forget to hunt for the [b]wheels from Phantom Ships[/b], scattered across the waterways involved in the event! Collecting them will reward you with special event baits and exclusive items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a66d0ada21fa72e53d74aca683aa66d3c9033495.png[/img]

Each waterway holds its own secrets, so keep your eyes open as you explore. Be sure to interact with every object you come across—every location has its own surprises waiting for you. Don’t miss a thing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/81ae1cfcffb8ca3e37dd2e43c295b8f4e5fa9a50.png[/img]

There's something else to boost your Halloween spirit! Throughout the entire event, the regular rental kayak will be replaced with the [b]Coffin Kayak from previous Halloween events[/b]. To take it for a spin, simply leave your own kayak at home and head to any boat pin at any location to rent this spooky ride. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e346397404a682b39844b130a0df1332a97cbc.jpg[/img]

And for those who love testing their luck on the[b] Reel of Fortune[/b], we’ve got something special for you too! We've added some event baits to the Golden Reel, so don't hesitate—give it a spin and see what you win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a689043ac7ac06ad11c2fc59c844dd825efbf344.png[/img]

Gear up with [b]The Supernatural Explorer Pack[/b] and get three skillfully crafted powerful setups to battle supernatural creatures. While a sturdy oilskin coat will shield you from storms and bad weather, you'll have all the essential mission lures, the coolest-ever coffin rod case, exclusive stringer to keep the monsters, extra storage slots, and access to all key locations with licenses and premium account to ensure you're equipped for every possible challenge – wasting no time as you explore the [b]Chronicles of the[ Haunted Fleet[/b] and save the world from the forces of darkness!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255720/Fishing_Planet_Supernatural_Explorer_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d58a2c0bb58f715c43cad70a84f23584d4b9f557.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255720/Fishing_Planet_Supernatural_Explorer_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/978615536782d13ab13ce2cf6a789024fe1c787e.jpg[/img]
[/url]
Dive into the spine-chilling adventure this Halloween season! From facing off against legendary monsters to unraveling ancient, forgotten mysteries, this event is filled with intense challenges and supernatural discoveries. Make sure to use your speakers or headphones to make your experience even more immersive, follow the pages of the [b]Supernatural Explorer’s Diary[/b], and plunge into the unknown. This is one event that will leave its mark—don’t miss it!

notes.title: Release Note Patch 9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a219ce21e0c03a7e4dba3b0f8245f49c61e6c3fd.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,
We’re here to bring you the latest update with improvements, fixes, and enhancements to make your Fishing Planet experience smoother and more enjoyable. This patch addresses key gameplay issues such as crashes, freezes, and loading problems, while also delivering various UI enhancements, animation and sound tweaks, and updates to Fishing Together sessions. We've also fine-tuned features like Photo Mode and made several other important improvements based on your feedback.
In addition, we’re thrilled to announce the release of our brand-new Halloween event, which will start within a few days! Stay tuned for a detailed announcement with all the missions and challenges coming your way. Dive into the patch details below to see what's been fixed and improved in this update.

[olist]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements [/h3]

[*] Resolved the running screen issue after catching a fish.
[*] Fixed an issue where the incorrect line was equipped when applying a template.
[*] Resolved the issue of characters freezing in the third-person view.
[*] Fixed the game freezing issue when casting the Mokonzi bottom rod and putting it in the boat rod holder.
[*] Fixed the time freezing issue in the Grouperzilla mission.
[*] Fixed the issue where the rod stand failed to disappear after the player boarded a boat multiple times in a single session.
[*] Fixed line distortion and stretching on telescopic rods when reeling in a fish.
[*] Resolved line overstretching on float setups.
[*] Fixed freezing after viewing tournament results in the Hall of Fame.
[*] Fixed game freezing when fast-forwarding time; the mouse cursor would not disappear, blocking subsequent actions.
[*] Fixed the bug where Head Starter Sinker remained in the setup when adding lures.
[*] Resolved an issue where the stay prolonging dialog window could be skipped on the next day if time was forwarded from 24 to 24 hours.
[*] Fixed the issue where items in the Backpack would move to Homestorage.
[*] Fixed movement lock after sending a gift to a friend through game chat when using gamepad.
[*] Corrected the appearance of X-Series and Club-Series Hunched and Deep Runners.

[h3] User Interface [/h3]

[*] Updated the achievement received window.
[*] Updated the Repair, Wear, and Tear window.
[*] Improved the look of modal windows.
[*] Added the user's nickname on the HUD to make issue investigations faster.
[*] Fixed an issue of Trolling XP Multiplier displaying in the XP Modifiers pop-up when the fish was caught without trolling.
[*] Fixed duplicate filters in the waterway items window in the local shop.
[*] Resolved search issues in themed tabs in the local shop after the first search attempt.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong mission group opened after switching tabs.
[*] Fixed incorrect window sequences when inviting lower-level players to clubs.
[*] Fixed the "TimeIsUp" window showing no credits in competitions.
[*] Fixed navigation issues in Fish Storage and Fishkeeper using the gamepad.
[*] Fixed player nicknames being cut off in sharing windows.
[*] Added a close button in the Pack's info window.
[*] Fixed an issue where licenses and fish descriptions couldn’t be opened using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed the gamepad hint issues after switching to the mission list in the new mission window.
[*] Fixed an issue where missions from the last opened tab displayed instead of the group with the tracked mission.
[*] Fixed search character limit messages displaying incorrectly.
[*] Fixed misaligned titles in the Friends window with multiple fields.
[*] Moved the mode-switching button lower on the screen of the Tablet for the Fish Finder.
[*] Fixed header misalignment in the Friends menu.
[*] Fixed templates not displaying in custom competition tabs.
[*] Fixed the scroll jumping issue  in the Create Club window.

[h3]Animations and Sound Fixes[/h3]

[*] Improved the animation of Tournament flags in the wind.
[*] Fixed the issue where tournament flags made flapping sounds despite being static.
[*] Lowered the volume of the spool open and close sound in first-person view.
[*] Adjusted the first-person hand animation in motorboats.
[*] Fixed tackle jittering when a fish is caught.
[*] Fixed animations for some fish species.

[h3]Fishing Together[/h3]

[*] Fixed the bug where the rod was drawn twice after entering a new FT session.
[*] Fixed the time window not appearing after a day change during FT sessions.
[*] Fixed a disconnect issue where the host appeared randomly at the fishing point instead of captain bridge.
[*] Resolved an issue where FT session invites broke after finishing another session.
[*] Fixed the issue with an invitation window artifact that appeared when receiving a new invitation after finishing another session.
[*] Fixed issue where players couldn’t move to a map pin using a tablet during an FT session.

[h3]Photo Mode[/h3]

[*] Fixed photo mode breaking after resetting feeder filling and switching rods.
[*] Fixed the Sailor Collection Pack waistcoat not displaying in photo mode..
[*] Fixed Garry Scott Bandicoot NE waistcoat not displaying in photo mode.
[/olist]

Thank you for your continued support! We hope these updates enhance your experience, and we look forward to your feedback. Stay tuned for more improvements in future releases.
Tight lines and happy fishing!

notes.title: Get Ready for the Mighty Carp Tour 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fde8626c826b278d2c5c64dae39fad6033f31355.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,
The legendary Carp is calling, and it's time to gear up for the challenge in the Mighty Carp Tour 2024!
Although Carp might not be the crown jewel of North American waters, it remains an all-time European favorite and a true test of skill for anglers around the world. Now's your chance to prove your carp-catching mastery in one of the most challenging freshwater competitions of the year!

Throughout this exciting journey, you'll be facing diverse fishing environments, each with its own unique set of challenges. From the historic Tiber River in Italy to the vast waterways of San Joaquin Delta in the USA, and the renowned Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany, these spots are sure to test your skills at every stage. The Semifinals will push you further at Sander Baggersee, before the Top 20 finalists face off in the Grand Finale at the legendary Weeping Willow Lakes in Great Britain.

[b]Tournament Dates:[/b]
[list]
[*] September 16th – Registration opens, 24 hours before the First Qualifier.
[*] September 17th – Qualifier 1: Tiber River, Italy.
[*] September 18th – Qualifier 2: San Joaquin Delta, USA.
[*] September 19th – Qualifier 3: Sander Baggersee Lake, Germany.
[*] September 21st – Semifinal: Sander Baggersee Lake, Germany.
[*] September 22nd – Grand Finale: Weeping Willow Lakes, UK.
[/list]

[b]Important:[/b]
Be sure to check out all the Tournament details in the Tournament Tab within the game. We’ve made a slight adjustment to the conditions recently. A key aspect of this tournament is that only Carp Rods are permitted. You can also use rod stands and keepnets. Please, note that boats and stringers are not allowed. Also, don’t forget to review the [url=https://fishingplanet.com/TournamentRules.htm]Competitive activities rules[/url] before registering. Remember, only one Fishing Planet account is allowed per device for tournaments. If you're playing with family, each member will need their own device to participate.

[b]Enjoy your chance to get a whole bundle of goods including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000715/Fishing_Planet_Mighty_Carp_Tournament_Pack/

notes.title: Release Note - 5.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/992886ec68ab20954a69df9a3c4daebe9e1a7194.jpg[/img]
Hey Anglers,

A new bug fix patch has been released. This update addresses a wide range of issues and brings improvements based on your valuable feedback.

One of the key issues we’ve addressed in this patch is the bug where the 'Keep/Release' buttons were missing after catching a fish. In our testing, we were unable to reproduce this bug after the fix. However, since such issues can depend on various factors specific to different devices, we kindly ask that if you encounter this problem again, please don’t hesitate to report it to us at support@fishingplanet.com.

[b]Here’s an overview of the improvements and bug fixes included in this patch:
[/b]
[b]Visual and Sound Enhancements:
[/b]
1. Fixed an issue with grass textures not displaying on Maron River.
2. Addressed the issue where character footsteps on the wooden pier were inaudible.
3. Fixed silicone lures hanging parallel to the ground after catching a fish on the gaff.
4. Resolved an issue where the game’s start screen music would override in-game music settings.
5. Adjusted the excessively bright map on the tablet.
6. Fixed an issue with the boat engine sound persisting after a saltwater competition.

[b]UI and Navigation:
[/b]
7. Updated the "Buy Receive" and "Product Details" windows in the UI.
8. Fixed the scroll bar disappearing on the license purchase tab.
9. Addressed an issue with the map zoom functionality in Volans and Scutum.
10. Resolved issues with the scrolling function in the Fish Storage description.
11. Reworked pop-ups for item selling and repairing.
12. Improved map interaction on tablets by adding an input lock for better navigation.

[b]Gameplay Improvements:
[/b]
13. Resolved an exploit that allowed players to instantly reel in fish by maneuvering the boat in small circles while trolling.
14. Fixed various issues where input controls were blocked when using specific setups with a PS controller.
15. Added a feature where the last bait of a kind is now highlighted with a red circle.
16. Resolved the issue where players could slide on boats from water onto land.
17. Addressed a bug where the player could not exit the bait selection if Game Chat was opened via keyboard and RB/LB was pressed on a gamepad.
18. Fixed issues with fish schools moving too fast on Blue Crab Island.
19. Corrected the varying depths of lures during trolling when held or on a stand.
20. Resolved a bug where the camera movement was restricted when retrieving fish from the water.

[b]Tournament and Competition Fixes:
[/b]
21. Resolved broken flag displays in some tournament locations, also fixed the issue where flags appeared to be floating in some areas.
22. Addressed an issue with the player not receiving their score in qualifiers after disconnection.
23. Fixed an issue where fish caught from the boat after being disconnected did not count towards tournament scoring.
24. Resolved issues with the boat’s position resetting in boat competitions after a disconnect.
25. Corrected an issue with the Apply button

[b]Fishing Together (FT):
[/b]
26. Resolved input blocking issues when using stands with PS controllers in FT sessions.
27. Fixed an issue where the boat was moved to the center of the map after the host disconnected in FT sessions.
28. Corrected a bug where FT guests could receive the "Extend Stay" window before the host.
29. Fixed synchronization issues in FT sessions when spawning on a boat.
30. Resolved issues with the FT Finish screen when moving from FT room into a random room.
31. Fixed several issues related to the Fishing Together sessions, including syncing player positions and controlling the yacht after disconnects.

[b]Photo Mode and Visual Glitches:
[/b]
32. Fixed the camera clipping through Motor Boats and Bass Boats textures in Photo Mode.
33. Resolved character positioning issues when using Photo Mode on the bass boat.
34. Addressed the issue where the character was displayed under the pier after being ashore from the fishing yacht at Green Harbor.
35. Corrected the fishing line color discrepancy between Photo Mode and first-person view.
36. Corrected an issue where rods could be cast into the walls in the marina at Kaiji No Ri.
37. Fixed a bug where fish would detach from the gaff when the player rotated their character side to side.
38. Fixed incorrect fishing rod animations during compost pile interactions.

[b]Inventory and Item Management:
[/b]
39. Corrected template issues where incorrect fishing lines were equipped.
40. Addressed the problem of setup slots shifting to empty slots after a game restart.

[b]Various Improvements and Bug Fixes:
[/b]
41. Resolved an issue with the "Reel of Fortune."
42. Corrected issues with rod shaking in the character’s right hand while putting on glasses.
43. Addressed a bug where the Fish Finder's depth did not match the scale depth on older devices.
44. Resolved problems with mouse cursor visibility after joining private UGC competitions.
45. Added translation for Trolling XP Multiplier in all languages in the game.

We deeply appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to enhance your gaming experience. Your feedback and bug reports have been instrumental in helping us identify and address issues. Thank you for being a part of our community and for your continued understanding as we strive to make the game better for everyone.

notes.title: Happy Fishing Planet Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5ed9d52c2d4180ff332e8c19545b57746ae64ee.png[/img]

Dear Anglers,

Fishing Planet’s Anniversary falls on Sunday this year, so we are announcing a whole weekend of celebrations!

Nine years ago, we launched the game on Steam. Since then, we've expanded to PlayStation, Xbox, Apple, and Android. Over the past year, we've launched on the Epic Games Store, and we’re not stopping there—stay tuned for news about another platform release coming soon!

Our community has grown significantly, now boasting nearly 29 million players across all platforms. We've become closer to you with the launch of our official Facebook group, which has been growing rapidly. In just eight months, we've reached 15,000 members, coinciding with hitting 15,000 members in our official Discord server. It’s a great pleasure for us to see our community expand and look forward to more exciting moments together!

In the past year, we've introduced Clubs and Club Leagues, new fishing mechanics, and our biggest update yet: the Ocean. Saltwater fishing, Fishing Together with friends on the same boat, new fishing yachts, navigation buoys, trolling, a 3D start screen, and even kitty cats added into the game! Behind the scenes, we've also made significant strides, releasing hotfix patches for all platforms simultaneously twice, which means 16 patches in one day!

This nine-year journey feels like a full circle for us. When we first created Fishing Planet, we dreamed of offering both freshwater and saltwater fishing experiences in breathtaking locations around the globe. With 25 maps worldwide and now ocean fishing in the game, we've turned that dream into reality. Seeing our vision come to life is incredibly rewarding, and we couldn't have done it without the support and passion of our amazing community!

The end of one circle means the beginning of a new one. We are already working on new saltwater and freshwater locations, new events, and many other features that you will soon discover in our DevDiaries.

And of course, we have prepared something special for the celebration!

First, we are excited to launch the Sailor Collection Pack. It includes a sleek and stylish ocean outfit with the coolest purple glasses, a powerful spinning setup, and saltwater casting gear as fierce as a beast! You'll also get tons of terminal tackle, along with a high-tech six-slot rod case. Enjoy seven days of access to Kaiji No Ri with Premium and the advanced license. Whether you're looking to extend your saltwater fishing adventure or explore the ocean for the first time, this pack is a fantastic deal!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922520/Fishing_Planet_Sailor_Collection_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3892ef40eec50e09ea01800e9ccfbbbf132f05f4.jpg[/img][/url]

Another highly anticipated event for our players is the Fishing Planet Anniversary License and Travel/Stay Discount. From today until August 14th, enjoy up to 60% off all unlimited licenses and travel and stay costs at all locations! Plus, there are discounts on 12 and 6-month Premium available on Steam and Epic Games platforms. This is the perfect time of year to make some long-term investments—enjoy!

Plus, if you haven’t yet, come join our community on Discord and our official Facebook Group. Stay tuned for updates and participate in the Fishing Planet Anniversary giveaways for a chance to earn exclusive rewards. We have prepared several activities for this weekend, which will be announced soon. We love treating our community not just during big celebrations like this one, but also on random weekends throughout the year, so stay with us!

Thank you for being a vital part of this incredible journey and inspiring us to continually grow and improve. Your enthusiasm and support mean the world to us. We’re excited to celebrate with you this weekend and to keep crafting unforgettable fishing experiences together.

Tight lines and happy fishing!

notes.title: Release Note, Patch 5.0.5
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have prepared a huge bug fix patch for you today. 
We’ve taken your feedback into account regarding XP and credits for fish in Kaiji No Ri and have made some adjustments. The prices for fish have increased, and you'll now earn more XP when trolling with saltwater gear. XP in Fishing Together sessions has also been boosted - the more players on the boat, the more XP each of you will receive. Additionally, don’t forget that you get an XP bonus when fishing with your club mates, so fishing with them on the same boat is always a win-win.

We’ve also modified the fish fights, making it easier to reel in big catches faster, and as a result allowing you to gain more XP in less time.

After receiving feedback about the Fishing Together Mastering Missions being too difficult, we've made some adjustments to make them more achievable. The amounts of fish needed to catch in all three missions have been reduced. The name of the mission "Fishing Together Hunt: Plugs" was changed to "Fishing Together Hunt: Trolling", and plugs are no longer required lures for completing the mission, now you can use any trolling lures of your choice.

[b]Here’s a detailed list of what’s been fixed and improved:
[/b]
1. Fixed the character appearing in the water after reconnecting the Fishing Together session host in the game. Yes, the drowning guy has been finally rescued! 😁
2.Fixed the issue of disappearing reel sounds in Japan.
3. Addressed the issue of birds' sounds playing incorrectly.
4. Corrected the issue of no drag sound when the rod is on the stand.
5. Adjusted the sound effects for whales and dolphins in Japan.
6. Fixed the sounds for the character’s footsteps in Japan.
7. Fixed a bug in the tutorial mission when interacting with the worm pile.
8. Resolved an issue where a player would be teleported to the boat dock after disembarking from a boat in Mongolia.
9. Fixed FPS drops in Mongolia when looking at the Nomadic camp from various locations.
10. Fixed kayak exploit when reeling in big fish.
11. Corrected the overly bright appearance of the White Sturgeon fish.
12. Fixed a bug of a character sliding over the ground in a boat.
13. In rod selection mode, the bait icon was incorrectly displayed with the rod stand icon and labeled as EMPTY HANDS.
14. Fixed the issue where the twitching indicator was lagging.
15. Fixed the credits for caught fish not displayed in the "Time is up" window when the competition ended while the player was offline.
16. Fixed a freeze that occurred during the purchase of a license if the waterway was unlocked early.
17. Corrected the slingshot shooting animation in third-person view.
18. Fixed water waves appearing in the middle of a sand island in Japan.
19. Fixed the issue where the button to collapse/expand the tournament/competition participants table was missing.
20. Resolved the pop-up "Selected room has not been found..." appearing every time when entering the waterway after a competition ended.
21. Fixed the issue where the windscreen of the rental yacht was half-displayed upon spawning.
22. Fixed the right part of the rental yacht’s windscreen incorrectly lit blue.
23. Corrected continuous splashing sounds nearby even at a significant distance from the fish jumping out of the water.
24. Fixed an issue where the fish would spin around when hooked on a gaff.
25. Added information about broken items in the "Stay ended" window.
26. Fixed fish appearing outside the radar range on the Fish Finder 360.
27. Addressed the issue of the boat map failing to zoom for some time after teleporting using a navigation buoy.
28. Corrected the yacht tipping over after returning to the start position.
29. Fixed desynchronization of weather between host and guest after time rewinding.
30. Addressed the issue where the character's hand was seen through the sleeve while reeling with big reels.
31. Made optimizations of the ocean water for better performance on different devices.
32. Added an icon for different rod stands that could hold a different number of rods. Now the icon indicates the correct number of rods on the rod stand..
33. Changed the braid color to a lighter shade, so it is more visible on the ocean water.
34. Fixed ocean waves passing through the yacht sides.
35. Resolved character freezing from a 3rd person view on the fishing pin on the boat during the Fishing Together session.
36. Corrected the issue where the swivel was hanging in the air in the bottom setup during photomode.
37. Fixed incorrect display of the character’s hand holding the gaff from a 3rd person view.
38. Addressed desynchronization of floating objects on the water for all the Fishing Together session participants.
39. Fixed global ratings displaying outside the main window at 3840 x 1620 resolution.
40. Fixed hands shaking animation when retrieving a rod from the DuoHolder.
41. Fixed the gaff displaying incorrectly from the side of the fish in 3rd person view.
42. Addressed the issue where players could not search for clubs with two hieroglyphs, requiring three hieroglyphs.
43. Fixed club room chat displaying activities of friends who are not in the club.
44. Fixed the issue when in Fishing Together sessions the active captain sees water splashes from the yacht engine.
45. Fixed marker buoys not bobbing with the waves.

50. Fixed the issue where the screen remains dark after removing glasses in Japan.
51. Fixed a freeze in the Fish Verification window after moving via buoy while holding a fish without a license.
52. Resolved issue where the keepnet would not equip when double-clicked if another keepnet was already equipped.
53. Fixed issue where moving on the boat with the R key did not work after a Fishing Together session ended due to timeout in the fishing day extension window.
54. Corrected rod movement animation after catching fish during the tutorial.
55. Fixed score not being credited in the qualifier after a disconnect.
56. Fixed private chat messages not being received when sent to an offline player if the sender closed the game.
57. Corrected the incorrect display of total weight of caught fish in the "Timed Fishing Derby" mission.
58. Fixed exit button not displaying on the Fishing Together menu window, when invitation is sent from a different waterway
59. Player returns to the starting position from the boat after changing the Room on a waterway
60. Fixed an issue in Kaiji No Ri when cats on the pier were floating in the air
61. Fixed the ocean boats capacity HUD, so it shows correct number of players on the yacht and free spots
62. The scroll bar disappears on the license purchase tab.
63. Fixed a bug that allowed reeling in big fish on the ocean much faster
64. Fixed a bug that allowed creating competitions in Japan with boats that were not allowed on the location
65. Resolved a bug with music on the start screen and the game music playing simultaneously
66. Fixed the weather of the host and the guest not synchronized if the guest's gear was cast in the water when rewinding time by two days
67. Fixed a bug when a guest is shown the boat rental window after rewinding time for a day in the Fishing Together session
68. Fixed the transparent time forwarding window bug while a player is trying to forward time on the ocean boats 
69. Fixed the Tablet maps displaying land, or some parts of it, in black color for all bodies of water
70. Fixed a freezing issue when opening the Tablet map when moving from the back of the ocean yacht to the captain’s bridge
71. Fixed some players rank displaying incorrectly after the last release
72. Resolved the issue in the "Timed Fishing Derby" mission where the duration of the license reward was not displayed in any of the windows
73. Fixed notifications about created sponsored competitions not being received via mail
74. Fixed a bug when Pond stay prolonged window was freezing and credits were withdrawn from the player’s balance multiple times 
75. Fixed Tablet map zoom being too sensitive in Japan.
76. Fixed a bug of the Tablet button activating by putting on/taking off the glasses when the gear is cast in the water.
77. Fixed the fish spinning in different directions on the gaff.
78. Fixed the issue of the lure and leader not appearing in setups when adding a leader in the combination lure+tail.
79. Spinnerbaits/Buzzbaits lures disappearing from the setup when adding a leader in combinations lure+soft bait bug fixed.
80. Fixed the sound of the yacht's engine on the Kaiji No Ri map after the end of the competitions + sound of the engine shutdown when entering the competitions from the boat while fishing.
81. Adjusted the excessively loud environmental sounds in the Congo River.
82. Fixed the rod retrieval animation looping at the start of a competition on a bass boat.
83. Fixed a bug when the Scutum boat was tipping over after changing a room from the moving boat position.
84. Fixed the rain sound disappearing on Emerald Lake after changing the player’s pin
85. Fixed a bug in Amazon Maze where fish would escape under the fallen tree and move out of the map, making them impossible to reel in.
86. Fixed Trophy/Unique Kamba Catfish being displayed incorrectly in the photo mod
87. Fixed a bug of Impetuous Kayak displaying as a rental kayak on the waterway
88. Fixed the chat window being blurred not enough, so as the messages weren’t readable
89. Improved casting reel line locator animation
90. Resolved an issue on the tablet when the text information was very hard to see.
91. Fixed the issue when the start screen was displayed without water
92. Fixed the bug when Fish Storage was still being used instead of using a Fishkeeper after the saltwater yacht was unequipped.
93. Adjusted the brightness of the Tablet Map as it was too bright
94. If you've read this far, let us know in the comments! We love knowing that our detailed (and sometimes long-winded) patch notes are read at least by someone till the end.
95. Other minor bug fixes, adjustments and improvements.

We hope these fixes and improvements make your gameplay more enjoyable. We're continuing to work on other issues and will address them in upcoming patches. Thank you for your support and for sharing your feedback with us. Please, do not hesitate to contact support@fishingplanet.com if you experience any technical issues.

Known issue: We wanted to inform you that after the release, we discovered an issue with the leaderboards where the fish weight data has disappeared. The hot fix for this issue will be released today. Thank you for your understanding.

Tight lines everyone!

Dear Players,
We have some important information for those participating in the Independence Trout Open 2024. We received a few questions and want to clarify things for everyone.

Firstly, some players couldn't join the Tournament today because they couldn't find the Join button. Recent UI changes have altered its appearance. Please see the attached screenshot for a demonstration of the new layout. You can still participate in Q2 and Q3, and we hope this resolves any difficulties.

Secondly, there have been changes to some Tournament conditions compared to last year. This time, only spinning and casting rod setups can be used in the Tournament. In the Tackle Types section, we listed Barbless Jig Heads, Barbless Hooks, Barbless Spoons, and Barbless Spinners. Some players pointed out that Barbless Hooks can't be used with Spinning and Casting Rods. You are correct, and we apologize for this mistake. We will correct it in the next tournament. Unfortunately, we can't change it now, as any adjustments would require extensive testing by our QA team. Thank you for your understanding.

Additionally, with the Ocean Update, saltwater rods were added to the game. Please ensure you distinguish between casting rods and saltwater casting rods, and spinning rods and saltwater spinning rods, to meet the competition or tournament requirements and choose the correct setup.

We hope this clarifies your questions, but if you still have concerns, please contact us at support@fishingplanet.com or in our official social media channels.

notes.title: Welcome to The 4th of July Event: Independence Treasure Hunt 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/391e6b17d19210724a5daa91b607a09013c4552c.png[/img]

Hey Anglers!
American Independence Day is coming, it’s time to go on a treasure hunt! This year we also have a surprise for our Canadian anglers. It is Canada Day on July 1st, and you will have some treats from us to celebrate it with Fishing Planet!

[h3]The event kicked off today, on June 27th at 10:00 UTC and will be live until July 8th 10:00 UTC and will be held on all the American locations from Lone Star Lake, Texas to Kaniq Creek , Alaska.[/h3]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/59bf082027ea8b60ed3f38dac5ca17fd5e04ee8d.png[/img]

Join the Independence Day celebration missions and contribute to the restoration of the George Washington Monument! Embark on an exciting adventure to find fragments of Washington's battle saber, lost over a century ago. Set out to locate ancient canoes sunk in various North American waterways, guided by coordinates found on historical fish tags. Each sunken canoe holds a chest with relics and a piece of the saber. Restore the saber and receive an ancient map that will lead you to real treasures!

notes.title: [Steam/EGS] Patch Note 5.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Anglers,

Here is another hotfix patch for Steam and Epic Games. First of all, we want to let you know that the problem causing incorrect rank displays for some players has been fixed. However, rank corrections are being processed individually, so it may take some time before the changes reflect on your account. If your rank hasn't been updated yet, please be patient—it will be corrected for all players soon. Thank you for your understanding and patience!

[b]Here’s the list of other bug fixes and improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a notification when PondPass expires.
[*] Added information about broken items in the "Stay ended" window.
[*] Fixed issue where the "Stay ended" window did not appear after time was fast-forwarded.
[*] Fixed sound effects (splash sounds) and missing music in the starter scene after reconnecting.
[*] Fixed the issue where only clubs from the player's region were displayed when filtering by "All" countries.
[*] Resolved issue where the player's purchased premium account was disappearing.
[*] Fixed issue where previous messages in the chat were not displayed if the player left and re-entered the room.
[*] Minor bug fixes for the 4th of July event.
[*] Corrected mistakes in translations in different languages.
[*] Fixed issue where shadows from objects in the Kaiji No Ri marina were not displayed.
[*] Resolved issue with incorrect flow where the "Stay ended" window did not appear after time was fast-forwarded during an Fishing Together session.
[/list]

We appreciate your reports and patience while we work on resolving the issues. Tight lines and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

We have just released another patch addressing bug fixes and improvements reported over the past few days. While there are still a few issues we're actively working on, rest assured these will be resolved in the next hotfix patch. We appreciate your patience and continued support as we work diligently to enhance your gaming experience.

In addition, we'd like to address an important matter: we've conducted another ban wave based on our anti-cheating reports. Currently, these bans are temporary, but this is for the last time, and they will become permanent if those players attempt to use cheating software again. We want to stress that using any third-party software to alter gameplay in Fishing Planet is strictly forbidden and will result in a permanent ban.

Responding to some concerns about us joining the list of games that use Denuvo anti-cheat, we want to assure you that Denuvo operates with minimal impact on performance, ensuring a smooth gaming experience, and prioritizes user privacy, collecting only necessary data to prevent cheating. This improvement was primarily made to fulfill our community's request, and we firmly believe it will ensure a safe and fair gaming environment for all.

Lastly, we’ve been receiving many questions about the release of the Ocean Update for consoles and mobile platforms. We know you’re eagerly awaiting this update and appreciate your enthusiasm. The ocean update has turned out so huge that we needed to take some more time to optimize it better for smooth performance on all the devices. We will announce the release date within a few days, so stay tuned and thank you for your patience.

[b]Here is the list of resolved issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the twitching animation issue on the 3D retrieve indicator.
[*] Addressed the system lag accompanied by a characteristic sound.
[*] Fixed the issue where pressing the "A" button did not open the first mission group list after switching mission group tabs.
[*] Adjusted the speed at which fish drag boats and kayaks. Now, the speed better correlates with the fish's weight and strength and the weight of the boat.We've made it slightly faster based on players' feedback while keeping the mechanic realistic.
[*] Bottom/Feeder Setup: Correctly displays the sinker when viewing the setup in templates.
[*] Fixed the issue where the rented yacht would sink after the player came ashore on the Kaiji No Ri island.
[*] Fixed game logic initialization for placing rods on stands in the settings.
[*] The yacht no longer tips over after being returned to its start position.
[*] Improved server performance for the Ocean Update
[*] Fixed the issue where the background in photo mode did not change for the guest after teleporting to a navigation buoy in Fishing Together sessions.
[*] Addressed the occasional weather desynchronization between the host and guest after time rewinds in Fishing Together sessions.
[*] The boat rental window no longer appears twice if the session time ends while the host is offline.
[*] Fixed the issue where players would spawn directly in the boat during the Fishing Planet Boat Series Tournament.
[*] Club List now correctly displays clubs from all regions when filtering by country with "All" selected.
[*] Resolved the intermittent inability to navigate with a gamepad in Kaiji Ni Ri location.
[*] Fixed the issue where the guest saw the host's cast rod detach from the boat and move away after joining a Fishing Together session.
[*] Bait is now correctly consumed on the Livebait Trolling Rig.
[*] The "Tight Lines!" achievement is now properly credited on Steam.
[/list]
Tight lines and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Note 5.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Anglers,

Yesterday marked a historic day for Fishing Planet with the release of the Ocean Update, and we're thrilled to see your excitement! We've received tons of feedback from you, and while many of you are loving the new ocean features, we know there are a few things you didn't like as much. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so we wanted to address some of the most talked-about issues before we share the list of bug fixes and improvements.

We've heard your concerns about the Denuvo Anti-Cheat software. We want to assure you that Denuvo is designed to prioritize user privacy, collecting only the necessary data to prevent cheating. In the first 24 hours, we identified and dealt with many cheating players, helping to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone.

Some of you have mentioned that reels wear out quickly when using max drag. We understand this makes the gameplay more challenging, but max drag wasn't intended to be used the way it has been. This change is meant to make the game feel more realistic. To keep your reels in good shape, try to avoid using max drag continuously.

Last but not least, regarding the time-forward cooldown during nighttime: we initially enabled it because many fish species are active at night. However, after hearing your feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

[b]Here is the list of other bug fixes and improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Corrected boat antenna rotation in Fish Radar.
[*] Fixed a bug where the guest would experience a freeze and black screen when the host finishes a Fishing Together session.
[*] Corrected the message displayed upon event mission completion.
[*] Applied minor fixes to the XP Modifiers window.
[*] Implemented minor fixes for Ocean Missions.
[*] Resolved an issue where players would be placed in a different room after returning to a Fishing Together session.
[*] Fixed texture issues on the Scutum Boat.
[*] Addressed an overlap of multiple tags on the same spot on the Tablet in Fishing Together sessions.
[*] Applied various physics fixes.
[*] Relocated navigation buttons for switching tablet modes.
[*] Fixed UI bugs in different tablet modes.
[*] Resolved an issue where the boat wouldn't move if the player at the helm was changed while in reverse.
[*] Corrected the message about the end of the map displayed on the local map.
[*] Fixed animation issues for big reels where the hand texture was seen through the sleeve while reeling.
[*] Prevented the Extended Fishing Together session window from appearing in the guest's window after accessing the local map.
[*] Fixed performance degradation during long play sessions.
[*] Fixed a minor bug with Club invites.
[*] Implemented anti-cheat improvements.
[*] Resolved a photo mode bug for the Monster Fish Striped Marlin and other minor issues in photo mode
[*] Fixed an issue where the yacht would tip over and fly up high after being anchored.
[*] Corrected the pale appearance of boat and kayak slots compared to other slots.
[*] Fixed the issue where saltwater sinkers were not working in carp setups.
[*] Resolved the problem where it was impossible to buy items from the Lures and Baits category tabs in the Global Shop.
[*] Applied various fixes to the Shop interface.
[*] Fixed the preview for empty templates.
[*] Optimized server workload for better performance.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy the improvements!
The Fishing Planet Team
[/b]

notes.title: Release Note 5.0.0: Ocean Update
notes.content:
​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/016e1857e5eb32e7d67798031e4c3674fc461fbb.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,

The most expected release note in the Fishing Planet’s history has arrived. Let’s go!
[h2]Here is what’s new:[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3] Kaiji No Ri, Japan[/h3] New map with an enormous 400 sq km (almost 100,000 acres) of ocean, home to 18 dynamically moving fish species, including Bluefin Tuna, Striped Marlin, Mahi Mahi, plus Bigfin Reef Squid, among others. Accessible to players at level 83, with a new maximum level cap raised to 90, this expansive location offers a wealth of new challenges and opportunities. As customary in Fishing Planet, players of lower levels can unlock access to the map by purchasing a DLC pack with a pond pass for 30 and even 60 days. This time, we're offering two DLC packs, providing you with greater flexibility and convenience in choosing their preferred option!

[*] [h3]Ocean water simulation[/h3] As a standout feature that deserves extra attention, incredibly lifelike ocean water simulation, complete with various types of waves, including intense storms. The ocean's appearance will dynamically change based on weather conditions and wind patterns, offering a truly captivating experience. Immerse yourself further with realistic sounds of birds, wind, and water splashes, enhancing the authenticity of your ocean adventure.

[*] [h3]Sea Life Simulation System[/h3] Featuring dynamic zones that highlight schools of predatory fish near the water's surface, birds actively hunting for bait fish, and pods of dolphins and majestic blue whales gracefully navigating the ocean depths. Immerse yourself further with additional elements such as cruise liners, regattas, and trawler boats, creating a vibrant and lifelike maritime environment that dynamically changes depending on the time of the day and weather.

[*] [h3]Fishing Together[/h3] Now, you can enjoy fishing with 2, 3, or 4 players on the same boat, depending on your chosen vessel. Invite your fellow anglers for a fishing party, and even let them take the wheel if you fancy. Plus, you'll earn an additional XP bonus for Fishing Together! The more anglers you have onboard, the higher the bonus for each of you. And if you're all clubmates, you'll also receive the club room XP bonus. Fishing Together also implies that the players share common fishing conditions: common bite rate, weather, and time for all participants. Rest assured it doesn’t mean that your fellow anglers can catch all of the fish and leave not Dive into an exclusive series of group missions and achievements, tailored specifically for Fishing Together, a first in Fishing Planet!

[*] [h3]Brand new fishing yachts for ocean fishing[/h3] All the new boats are compatible for Fishing Together sessions. Rent a boat for two players using in-game credits, or opt for the Scutum™ and Volans™ Fishing Yachts accommodating 3 and 4 players respectively, available in DLC packs. All boats feature two rod holders for each player, allowing one more additional rod in hands. There’s no longer a need for a keepnet when fishing on a boat, as all boats are now equipped with ample built-in fish storage. Equipped with state-of-the-art FishFinders 360™, these vessels detect fish across surface, mid, and bottom water layers. Navigate with precision using the new Detailed Navigation Map, Echo Sounder, Compass, and Speedometer panel.

[*] [h3]In addition to the boat control panel equipment[/h3] Players get new Tablet software that will have not only usual tools such as already familiar to players marker buoys, but also new Navigation buoys, and additional Tabs with Echo Sounder and Fish Finder 360™, which will become available after players complete special Maintenance Adventures missions.  

[*] [h3]Navigation buoys[/h3] New special buoys, available on the new location, used to mark your favorite fishing spots and teleport among them for fast and easy exploration of such a vast location.
 
[*] [h3]Over 500 new saltwater items[/h3] Over 500 new saltwater items are now available in local and global shops! These additions include delicious fresh baits like spiny lobsters, flying squid, gutted fish, and innovative saltwater lures such as pilkers, plugs, squid jigs, bucktails, trolling octopuses, and teasers like squid chains. Equip yourself with the latest super powerful saltwater gear, designed to reel in massive ocean fish weighing over 270 kg (almost 600 lb)! There is a new addition to the Global shop: the Saltwater Tackle section, featuring all the saltwater items. For your convenience, these items are included in all the shop's dropdown menus. Special high-performance saltwater equipment was added to the Premium Shop as well.

[*] [h3]As mentioned above, two Ocean DLC packs are now available for purchase[/h3] Players can choose between two fishing yachts that hold 3 or 4 players for Fishing Together. Both packs include powerful gear, multiple baits and lures, additional storage slots, and tackle wagons for up to 300 tackles. [/list]

 The [b]Japan Odyssey Pack[/b] offers a larger four-seater boat, a 60-day pond pass with an advanced license, and more marker and navigation buoys.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922540/Fishing_Planet_Japan_Odyssey_Pack/

 The [b]Ocean Voyager Pack[/b] provides a smaller boat for three players, a 30-day pond pass with an advanced license, and marker and navigation buoys. Both packs allow players to bring friends and have all the necessary items for saltwater fishing. Choose the one that best suits your needs.   

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922530/Fishing_Planet_Ocean_Voyager_Pack/

[list]
[*] [h3]Saltwater trolling [/h3] Fishing technique used in the ocean where one or more fishing lines, baited with lures or baitfish, are drawn through the water behind a moving boat. This method targets various saltwater species, including larger pelagic fish like tuna, marlin, etc. which are known to chase moving prey. Saltwater trolling is a dynamic and exciting way to fish, offering anglers the opportunity to cover large areas of water and target a variety of species in different oceanic conditions.

[*][h3] Free spool mechanics[/h3] Which will enhance your fishing experience, especially for bottom fishing at great depths. This feature is available on all reels in the game, whether for saltwater or freshwater fishing. It allows for precise control of your line, enabling free immersion of lures or sinkers to significant depths with an open spool and securing the line at the desired depth with a closed spool. This added functionality offers greater accuracy, especially when the bottom topography is unknown and considering the fact that the depth of the ocean will be more than 100 meters at many spots, making it easier to target specific depths and fish species.

[*] [h3]Completely revamped the Pull-and-Reel mechanics system[/h3] Provide a more immersive and realistic fishing experience, mirroring the dynamics of ocean fishing. Expect fish fights to be more challenging but also more rewarding, as they replicate the true struggle of reeling in massive ocean catches. 

[*] [h3]Gaff[/h3]
Gaff animation for the retrieval and retention of large ocean fish.

[*] [h3]New Competitive Activities and Rewards[/h3] 4 new Kaiji No Ri competitions, 11 achievements, 20 new exclusive saltwater X-series items
 
[*] [h3]Dozens of new missions[/h3] Including exclusive Fishing Together missions that can be accomplished only with other anglers on the same boats, and Maintenance Adventures to improve the equipment you use on your Tablet as s reward.

[*] [h3]New anti-cheating solution[/h3] We are dedicated to providing a fair and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. To combat cheating and ensure a level playing field, we integrated the Denuvo Anti-Cheat system for Steam and Epic Games Store players. This decision highlights our commitment to maintaining the integrity of our game and protecting our community from unfair practices. You can find out more about it[b][url=https://fishingplanet.com/pc/Denuvo.htm] here[/url][/b].
 
[*] [h3]A small but nice new addition: meet the very first NPC in the game! [/h3] The marina administrator, who works tirelessly from early morning until late night, ensures the port runs smoothly and loves cats. He might need your assistance with calibrating new navigation tools. When you spot him, don't hesitate to approach and ask if he requires any help. You will also have a chance to deliver some treats to the kitty-cats on the pier.

[*] [h3]Reel of Fortune[/h3] After many player requests, The Reel of Fortune is finally available on Steam.

[*] [h3]Time forwarding cooldown has been added during nighttime [/h3] The day cooldown was originally implemented when night fishing wasn't part of the game, the night cooldown became necessary later on. Considering the numerous fish species in the ocean actively biting during both day and night, adding the night cooldown was essential with this update. An important thing to note is that there won’t be any cooldown for forwarding time to the next morning when selling fish.
[h3]UPD:[/h3] After hearing players' feedback, we’ve decided to revert this change. There will no longer be a nighttime cooldown, so you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.[/list]
[list]
[*][h3] Changes in deterministic user-generated competitions [/h3] As requested by players, there will be less randomness. The weather and bite rates now match real conditions on the waterways, meaning dedicated training will give you a better chance to win, making the process more fair and rewarding.

[*][h3] New start screen[/h3] While the game loads, you'll now see a stunning 3D ocean scene featuring boats, birds, dolphins, and a whale breaching the water.
 
[*] [h3]New settings options [/h3] Players can now adjust the volume of boat sounds and regulate water quality with more precision.

[*][h3] Numerous bug fixes and enhancements[/h3] Have been implemented, including updates to the reel damage system and drag behavior to eliminate exploits related to the "unbreakable setup”. We’ve also implemented a new wear system for tackles: freshwater items will wear out faster in ocean water, just as they do in real life. As the bugfix list is very long, we suggest reading it in a different article [b][url=https://forum.fishingplanet.com/index.php?/topic/38330-steam-egs-release-note-500-bugfix/]HERE[/url][/b].
[/list]

We're thrilled to announce the completion of this monumental update and extend our gratitude to all of you for your patience during its development. We eagerly await your feedback and wish you an incredible experience out on the ocean!
