notes.title: Christmas Event 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6d3d76c2b65ff223e4f805bd6b37fdd63077b354.png[/img]
[b]Hey Anglers,[/b]
This year we have an unprecedented combination of Christmas festivities. 
This year we bring you complete freedom to choose the adventures you like. You will be able to play Christmas Holiday Event and Krampus Hunt Event, or dare your luck to complete them all. You can choose missions you prefer or do all of them, and enjoy the Holidays as much as you want in a way you want. 
[b]The Christmas event starts on December 14th and will be available through January 5th.
Have yourself a great Christmas and join us on the Christmas adventures on Fishing Planet![/b] 

[h2]Christmas Holiday missions [/h2]
Welcome to Christmas Holiday adventures!
With Christmas back in town, there’s plenty of magic and festive excitement waiting for you!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff62671e62dc11cab4824fe36533f198608a725d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff62671e62dc11cab4824fe36533f198608a725d.png[/img][/url]

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! Santa’s sled was wrecked in a terrible snowstorm somewhere in Canada. Luckily, Santa is doing fine...but his reindeer went missing and all of the 

Christmas presents are now scattered around the world! 
Help Santa save Christmas by finding all of the lost Christmas presents and tree ornaments, Catch the mythical Crystal Burbot, complete challenges and, obviously, look for Present boxes on all waterways and get Fireworks for Christmas and New Year!

[b]Travel to White Moose lake and find Santa's sleigh. Take Santa's gift bag. Hurry up, Santa really needs your help! Christmas is coming and there's not much time left! [/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5083f19bf8833add76d6a7d74c51f91dcefe29a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5083f19bf8833add76d6a7d74c51f91dcefe29a7.png[/img][/url]

Catch a required amount of[b] Antlered Salmons[/b] to harness them in Santa’s sleigh instead of his runaway reindeer.
Keep in mind that Antlered Salmon bite best when someone launches fireworks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f13033ce6a1788ab6ce05c1740729a59f43479.png[/img]

[b]Fill Santa's Bag as you explore the waterways by boat in search of lost gifts.[/b] You can find Green boxes on Emerald Lake, Blue boxes on Falcon Lake, White boxes on Tiber River, and Red boxes on White Moose Lake. Once you arrive at waterways, find Santa's bag on the pier to get started with the task of collecting boxes with presents!.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9bc70acae5f324949c0f0dc020bac959cf0d3050.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9bc70acae5f324949c0f0dc020bac959cf0d3050.png[/img][/url]

[b]What a Holiday without a Christmas Tree, so do not waste time, find lost decorations and decorate the Tree. [/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37d55a80af5d7a9e39e089a7bcfc4413226395f4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37d55a80af5d7a9e39e089a7bcfc4413226395f4.png[/img][/url]

*Fireworks increase the chance to catch decorated fish.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8103cb9da84684bbc95bb4484c513f84f8ac136c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8680eb100fdd629810d46f0758729cd8ec9392fb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c495bb100d0855b20cc367a8355ec8558015309d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1497b4ee5da1699fdcaba983ca105e54749bfb7b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/07faa1d857125f1a550b5d749b260b03518c0a74.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e3bbb9e3884896407f743e297c4fa1abd3b6169f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03521ff07c2c515aed7974905d6785443ccc2b81.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f3b4535ce9b656c438ff7a6da1e4b999b8c50eca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c95b120a97bd3d812aad7490155d5224ed6c3b61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/facb6722f65f57c41493d7000679165846de7d22.png[/img][/url]

[b]Winter is all about snow, so spend some time on snow fighting with other players! [/b] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98d571270b131e1c76a337fad0bbd904b58f32fa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98d571270b131e1c76a337fad0bbd904b58f32fa.png[/img][/url]
*Hit certain number of players with Snowballs

[b]Complete Christmas Achievements and Missions and get festive rewards![/b]
Get an exclusive Christmas rod stand in the form of a jolly snowman and delightful Santa-themed lure box!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/caa3d5735d061cdef51d89baef17a17eb111f3fb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a3e6e39a204ff3576e7b5f2cf306769c4a464446.png[/img]

[b]Check Gift Boxes that you can find at every event location.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7498cf15017e0126feb6b446aabf7e2835485482.png[/img]

[b]Summon Crystal Burbot![/b]
Complete all missions and get your chance to find out what is waiting for you in the water of White Moose. Make sure to join our fairytale fishing adventure with the good old Crystal Burbot, fantastic Antlered Salmon, and Furry Trout, fireworks and festive excitement!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6da68a7d4b49711c8456c787660551f2c02d0492.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/09ad0b1275e7a4823fa659bf08096bae1361f582.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f13033ce6a1788ab6ce05c1740729a59f43479.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5224a02da9732061af67671551efe708720f6926.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5acc07155e9ebc8bf2fcfe044868da744cf991a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e72a8505a9d268e86702c35b42131a50cb057f96.png[/img][/url]

Have fun catching these magical Christmas fish, while the fireworks are blasting, and complete the [b]Myth Buster and Deer Hunter challenges[/b] to get unique holiday rewards.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2ab4132ff614c9901d819e5f41a4e3a6f0518cd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2ab4132ff614c9901d819e5f41a4e3a6f0518cd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc645d1648c9e626dd31f78469d586167fc71d06.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc645d1648c9e626dd31f78469d586167fc71d06.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/138b957428bdb65fb1367ed95edcf20b16f1be24.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/138b957428bdb65fb1367ed95edcf20b16f1be24.png[/img][/url]

[b]You can also try to complete the Fishy Racing challenge and get Elven Kayak as a prize![/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e69056c1275314d5c0e6f1823f25e5622d77e471.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a6e0f29ea90f2dced3ad120df57ea83206b30b17.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Embrace the spirit of Christmas fishing adventures with this fun and magical Holiday Pack![/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200340/Fishing_Planet_Holiday_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/13dfcba54bd7815844c7f7d116bf1a91b9193b80.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Are you ready to join the Krampus Hunt adventure?[/h2]

The holiday is lost without your help, since the Krampus troublemakers have stolen Santa’s glasses, Beard and Hat. Find the villains and return the stolen things!

[b]Look for special treats, Christmas Tokens and Fireworks in Stockings.[/b]

[h3]Christmas festivities are under threat! only YOU can save Christmas:[/h3]

You need to locate the old troublemakers, capture them and return the things they've stolen.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8735977fc6a2703ce6dee98fb976b83b617b21e9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8735977fc6a2703ce6dee98fb976b83b617b21e9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fbf4e1cff2a9675a0eb8d645041522b9ae38204.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fbf4e1cff2a9675a0eb8d645041522b9ae38204.png[/img][/url]

You can find them by questioning their accomplices, who have decided to follow them and make mischief around. Because of their innate ability to lie, you'll have to catch a score of them.
[b]Get your rods ready![/b]

[h3]Amazing Christmas baits will help you to attract the fairy villains and their minions.[/h3]

[b]Mega Cookie Bait[/b]
If you take a couple of Ginger Cookies and fill them with magic, the special power of Christmas pastry will create an ideal bait.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/20d9da14224bf38a114533e9bca069c1dcf82e64.png[/img]

[b]Use Christmas baits for better catch:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70f501748005e7e895f4677646e9cefb04181981.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/018b37aa37260d0f39cea8353061d7b3dfe73335.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/90d1647128eff3a4a34d4500f15a45fec4bf21c3.png[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6e4a23fbd994032c1c900cf26eb17e949b7a5d4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6e4a23fbd994032c1c900cf26eb17e949b7a5d4.png[/img][/url]

And, of course, enjoy  traditional Christmas treats - [b]Ginger Cookies[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6ca8555a74543e61c06309ddae0068cf5c035bda.png[/img]

These amazing Christmas baits will help you to catch [b]Krampus Fish[/b]: Unlucky Krampus Tarpon, Clumsy Krampus Eel, Crumbling Krampus Payara.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/298b9a9a9825e0e57cff31f0144739f841b86d68.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a65519c82bc56168c597b2d7fb4c43fb64477481.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1890bdeda6cb9edee34cc64bc6edb12f2b1e320f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb193d0d715876ec0bf57695b8433510f5c84a45.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8dfbff9bcfaa47c618493877ea3e7ea26f41698b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c115ec13b6c6f8a413cc75b3b35748d6938688c1.png[/img][/url]

You can locate the thieves by following their [b]minions[/b], who can be lured out with bait treats, sweet pastry groundbait and magical jukeboxes.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ddba829996b58794533b610b481d0d1f5c4eacbf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/76eefac133af00dd479536344df2b9c258b8a8e3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/97df93ff300d549bb679a90fc97df1cb5314c35b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8aa21514306cbadbb34bade4dbfff17e6bd3c31e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/191e26ed62bed5126f41b63f61afc9652ff37d6d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1d85164152ea1dadec5f445fac636acca29f0252.png[/img][/url]

[b]Magical Jukeboxes also are a useful way to attract the minions.[/b]
Activate Jukeboxes by using Christmas tokens**.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6a43274acda33ab5f365d766845a4ca8de467955.png[/img]

[b]Your efforts will be generously rewarded with Christmas gifts![/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d024085f815643ae560006d9fd31a9c4a3fde57.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d024085f815643ae560006d9fd31a9c4a3fde57.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3350d3ede3560dd0a1fd5e657dc9c04255c055d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3350d3ede3560dd0a1fd5e657dc9c04255c055d8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9878056058a05a0b35b296cbfaf19c9a0db57ecc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9878056058a05a0b35b296cbfaf19c9a0db57ecc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Welcome League Season 1: Icebreaking Angler Rivals
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/63218cec7610906df06c97389cd472f095833983.png[/img]

Hello, fellow Anglers!

First day of winter brings a long anticipated start of our first ever League Season on Fishing Planet!

The first Season of leagues will take place this winter and starts today. We cannot wait to welcome everyone to become a part of this historical event. Symbolically we decided to name the first League season [b]Icebreaking Angler Rivals[/b]. 

As we had a chance to introduce you to Leagues in one of our [b]DevDiaries[/b], you may already know what to anticipate and today you will learn all the details about the upcoming adventure. 


[h1]Overview [/h1]

[b]Club Leagues[/b] is a brand new game mode and your opportunity to start from scratch in a race to bring your Club into the spotlight. Clubs will compete with each other in weekly [b]Championships[/b] that are held during the [b]Season[/b] by earning [b]Club Points[/b] for their activity.

[b]A Season[/b] is a long term competition between Clubs that typically lasts between 60 and 90 days. In the beginning and by the end of each Season all the Clubs will receive an applicable notification. 

The results will be presented in the [b]Season Leaderboard[/b]. The most successful Clubs in each League will be working their way up, from the Beginner League to the highest Legendary League. The ranking system will bring bonuses, new opportunities and [b]unique limited-edition trophies[/b] to the top listed Clubs and all their members. 

The activity of each member throughout the Season adds Club Points to the Club count. You’ll have to use all your skill, knowledge, and determination to build a workable strategy along with your clubmates – before someone else snatches the victory from you.

The Club participation in Leagues Season will bring lots of benefits to each member. Such as:
[list]
[*] You’ll get a platform to benefit not only from using your skills but also from your overall time and every in-game activity with your clubmates
[*] Moving up the leaderboard will bring you more and more XP and credits for catching fish
[*] Weekly rewards for winning the Championships to step up your fishing game
[*] Get acknowledged by your clubmates for your contribution and activity 
[*] And last but not least, this is your chance to bring your Club to the victory and become a part of the Club known by the whole community of Fishing Planet
[/list]

We anticipate Leagues to create an engaging and competitive experience for Clubs by giving them goals to strive for and a sense of progression as the clubmates improve their skills.

[h1]First League Season: Icebreaking Angler Rivals[/h1]

First League Season: Icebreaking Angler Rivals starts today, on December 1st at 12:00 UTC and will be active [b]until February 21st, 2024 10:00 UTC[/b].

The first season will hold 10 Championships. The first Championship will begin in a week after the start of the season, on December 8. The First season duration is 3 months. 

Each club that has accumulated [b]300 or more Club points[/b] by the start of the first Championship (Dec 8) will automatically participate in the Season. 

The participating Clubs will be divided into Divisions and start competing inside of their Division. Each division will have the winners who will move further and those with lower performance will move down to the lower League. The only exception is the Beginner League, where all remaining clubs will compete again and again for further evaluation. 

At the start of the Season, all participating clubs will be assigned to the Beginner League.

If your club hasn't accumulated 300 or more Club Points by the start of the first Championship, you still have the opportunity to earn this required amount before the beginning of one of the following weekly Championships, enter the race in the Beginner League and compete for the main rewards.

[h1]League Levels and progress[/h1] 

There will be seven Leagues, categorized by the Clubs’ levels: 
[list]
[*] The Beginner League
[*] The Rookie League
[*] The Professional League
[*] The Expert League
[*] The Master League
[*] The Elite League
[*] The Legendary League
[/list]

The higher the League, the more bonuses and rewards the Clubs and all their members will receive. 

Your Club’s journey will depend on your skills and activity. The positioning between the Leagues will depend on the total amount of Club Points earned during the weekly Championships. 

All participating Clubs in each League will be divided into Divisions and start competing inside of their Division. 

Each Division will consist of approximately 7 to 10 Clubs. Clubs in the same division will compete against each other for[b] the top-4 positions in the Beginner League[/b] and [b]top 3 in the next levels Leagues[/b]. Securing one of the top positions in the League allows a club to move to the next level League.

Some clubs that do not qualify for promotion to the next League will either remain in the current League or be dropped down to the previous League. The fate of these Clubs will depend on the club points earned and the ranking of clubs that jumped Up from the previous league.

Exceptions:
[list]
[*] For the first Beginner League, the category "To Drop Down" is absent; there is no possibility of moving below the first League.
[*] For the last Legendary League, the category "To Jump Up" is absent; there is no opportunity to move higher than the seventh league.
[/list]

If there is no possibility to form at least one Division in one particular League for the weekly Championship, the League will not be established. All clubs will be transferred to a lower League and continue competition there.

Best Clubs of each Championship get unique rewards. While moving up from the Beginner League, your club and each member will get more valuable bonuses and benefits, including additional XP and in-game money. 

[h1]Gaining Club Points[/h1]

Club Points of a Club is a total count of Club Points gained by all the Club members.

Club members earn [b]Club Points[/b] by catching fish in the club room, and points will be awarded based on the type of fish and the number of players in the Club Room. 

You will see the amount of Club Points with the start of the Season. Club Points are not being transferred to the next Season, it means every new Season starts from scratch. If a member leaves their Club in the middle of the Season, the Club Points earned by this member will be removed from the Club Points count of the Club.


[h1]The Legendary League[/h1]

Legendary League will be different from the others. First of all this is the plaсe where the strongest Clubs of the Season compete with each other and an absolute goal for all the Clubs to get to but there is more.

All lucky ones who get to the Legendary League will need to compete against each other. Unlike the previous Leagues, in the Legendary League the Clubs [b]will not be divided into divisions[/b]. All clubs that advanced to it will compete for their place on the Leaderboard.

Only a half of Clubs will be able to remain in the Legendary League after the weak Championship results, the other half will move to the Elite League.

[h1]Seasonal Rewards[/h1]

After the Season concludes, the process of season review will take approximately two days. You can see the Season rewards in the game in the Season Reward window.

Top-10 Clubs with the highest number of Club Points will receive the Season rewards and of course the [b]Season Trophy[/b]. All the Club members of the winning Club will receive the reward, meaning it doesn’t depend on their individual contribution, but if a member leaves the Club before the season review is done, the reward will not be sent to this member.

[h1]The new in-game currency - Club Token[/h1] 

With the start of the Leagues we introduce a new currency - [b]Club Tokens[/b]. This special currency can be earned and spent in Club activities.

Club Tokens can be earned by winning weekly Championships and in the League Seasons.

The Club currency also could be obtained from the new [b]Club Enthusiasts Pack[/b] with a huge amount of Club tokens. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804849/Fishing_Planet_Club_Enthusiast_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c6acd3875e967d1f2f5d7e1a8e65a0ee0b95e931.jpg[/img][/url] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804849/Fishing_Planet_Club_Enthusiast_Pack/

Additionally, all club members are able to donate their Club Tokens for common Club goals and needs. For example, as a club you can spend your Club Tokens on new logo elements. In the future with the next iteration of Leagues you will be able to buy new Club Series items in the Global Store. 

[h1]Review and Disqualification [/h1]

And last but not least, we will be paying all our attention to the fairness of the competitions. Every weekly Championship will be reviewed in order to detect and penalize abuse. 

If a player is disqualified, their points will be revoked and deducted from the total Club Points. However, the Club continues to participate in the Championship and the Season. 

If a club is disqualified, all its members lose the opportunity to compete for prizes in championships and the main season prize. They could join another club or create a new one. But please note, that the Club Points will be revoked and you will need to start from scratch. 

[h1]Definitions[/h1]
In the end, let’s do a little summary of all the important points related to Leagues.

[h3]Season:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A period of time when competitions are held.
[*] Clubs compete for the main rewards and the top place during this time.
[/list]

[h3]Championships:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The main component of a season that divides the season time into smaller segments.
[*] Clubs gain club points and receive evaluations during the championship.
[/list]

[h3]Division:[/h3]
[list]
[*] An organizational element during a championship.
[*] As there could be around 300 clubs during the championship, dividing by divisions helps rank clubs and provides more chances for evaluation and potential advancement to the next league.
[*] Similar to dividing by groups.
[/list]

[h3]League:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A ranking element based on the competitive activities of a club and the amount of club points it earned. Represents evaluation levels, ranging from The Beginner to the most advanced Legendary League.
[/list]

[h3]Club Points:[/h3]
[list]
[*] An evaluation element influencing the club's position in the leaderboard and the final evaluation for determining the winner of the season. Can only be gained through club activities (Fishing in the same club room, winning competitions and tournaments) during an active Season.
[/list]

[h3]Club Tokens:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new in-game currency specific to the club. Obtainable during the season or through the in-game store. Can be spent on Club-Series Items (coming soon) or club-related items. It cannot be exchanged for other in-game currencies.
[/list]



If you made it this far, we hope we've covered everything in a way that makes sense. But if you have still got any questions or uncertainties, we're right here for you. Don't hesitate to drop your questions in the comments below.

Good luck, Anglers, and let the Icebreaking Angler Rivals begin!

Join us for an unforgettable dinner with the entire Fishing Planet family! To whip up some delicious dishes for our Thanksgiving feast, embark on a series of exciting missions.

[*] Our special Thanksgiving Cauldrons will be cooking up delightful fish dishes for our festive dinner
[*] Earn the Pilgrim Hat reward by accomplishing the Catcher in the Corn achievement.
[/list]

With the mid-level waterways as main event locations this event is catered for players of all levels to complete.


Thanksgiving Day brings the spirit of harvest, family, and, of course, Fishing Planet! Gear up for a November filled with exciting new adventures!

[b]The event will be active until 10 a.m. UTC, November 27. [/b]

[h1]Golden Turkey Rush:[/h1]
As part of the event, we will be setting up a Thanksgiving feast at Lone Star Lake. 
To do this, you need to collect a certain number of Holiday Dishes.

You can obtain these Holiday Dishes by completing fish-catching and ingredient-gathering missions for cooking on each event location, which will be marked with the turkey icons on the global map.

notes.title: Welcome November Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5458fda6f911d86295c0807f96bae1e503ea519c.png[/img]
Welcome Anglers,

We are delighted to present you November update that will undoubtedly bring lots of joy and exciting gaming experiences:

[list]
[*] A new set of (exhilarating) Boat Competitions! Register, win and get rewards!
[*] Club Leagues — a new type of competition between clubs with unique prizes. The first, winter Club Leagues Season starts on December 1st. More details will follow, stay tuned!
[*] Updated design for various windows and tabs for a more convenient gaming experience.
[*] A new exciting event for upcoming Thanksgiving — Golden Turkey Rush, starting November 17th!
[/list]

[h2]Leagues[/h2]
Inspired by the feedback from our amazing Community we put a lot of work and love in this feature and now we are incredibly excited to present it to you. 
With the start of the first Season you will be able to prove that your Club is the top of your League by showing your skills and team spirit. 

Season starts on December 1st, will last the entire winter and conclude at the end of February. We will provide you with all the detailed information before the starting date.

Time to get together with your club mates and get ready and strategize your way to victory!

[h2]Boat Competitions[/h2]
Are you ready to face new challenges in Fishing Planet? Many of you love fishing from a boat, which is why we are launching a series of boat and kayak competitions!

The first set will consist of 5 competitions of various difficulty levels and formats. 

You'll be able to compete for the title of the best boat angler on the following locations:

[list]
[*] Tiber
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b2918a0a21209af314956e7f903d36754e2803fe.png[/img]
[*] Saint-Croix Lake
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f03f2936b9ecbdba5d6bbb822e969d0bda1b0640.png[/img]
[*] Blue Crab Island
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0ed3243bc994b83011b89bc9bb9e500663458e2b.png[/img]
[*] Falcon Lake
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0fd31976405a8a2fc85b96723e9865516b398b9d.png[/img]
[*] Maku-Maku Lake
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b7ea6f4b9289012a9752d83165f5fd3b32b95b0.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Each competition has unique rules, fish categories, and tackle specifics, so be sure to carefully follow all the conditions.[/b]

[h2]Updated UI design[/h2]
[h3]Missions[/h3]
We have redesigned the mission screen, making it significantly easier to track your progress and access important information. Clear grouping of missions by categories allows an easier progress tracking and displaying rewards with all the necessary details.

[b]Before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ae2998cd64a20c84d6ecab9694819ccc2f996c26.png[/img]
[b]After:[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7b10939280ed836f2853b094131dea3932060044.png[/img]

[b]Now, it's possible to obtain all the required information about rewards with just one click, without having to navigate to other windows. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e3b16d561edcf37a71ddc02abb0cfe32fbd46943.png[/img]

[h3]Other improvements for Missions UI’s:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the display of task progress in the 'Mission Progress' section of the 'Missions' tabv 
[*] Move all available event missions to a separate Event tab and add scrolling focus to the selected mission in the 'Events' group when switching to the 'Missions' tab;
[*] Implemented automatic activation of the first mission in the mission list when switching between mission groups;
[*] Also,  we've enhanced the Completed Mission window by adding the display of received items within the same window;
[*] And added some corrections to Mission Info, Missions List,  and  Mission Tab Sub Menu.
[/list]

[h2]Other UI Improvements:[/h2]
[b]The gift receiving window [/b]has also been updated - changes layout and added more information about friend 
[b]Before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/849b9969339adcfdc195a4633e7313d980a47511.png[/img]
[b]After:[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c6a5e9e9d7c16ac64b581347fa6bdc811bbc0aed.png[/img]

[b]The product delivery window has been improved[/b] - added product description and list of all items, services and currency 
[b]Before:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/280418adec1bd7e41c6e6e89961eac0be500c436.png[/img]
[b]After:[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/65e69fad75564d19e4ef443697129d0449557dc1.png[/img]

[b]Added possibility to buy multiple identical items at once.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4a83c91e5752d8e0a92e6412cc55720caa35aa5c.png[/img]

[h2]More UI Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have altered the order and execution of in-game events 'EndOfDay' and 'PondStayFinish. Now, the player first receives an income for the catch and then decides whether to leave the water body or stay;
[*] In order to create a more convenient licensing purchase flow, we added the option to purchase a license before receiving a penalty for fishing without one;
[*] Added the ability to save your last activity in the in-game shop and the last visited tab will be reopened. Additionally, a 'Main' tab has been introduced to navigate back to the store's main screen;
[*] The interface for the completed achievement window has been improved, allowing the display of received items within that window as well;
[*] Updated sub-menus in screen “Sport”,  including all chapters;
[*] Additional displaying fixes: added "Keepnet" to "Stringer" in dedicated pop-up in the caught fish window. Also, for better gaming experience we changed displaying order for DayResult and ExtendStay window at the end of the in-game day;
[*] Adjusted the highlighting of sections in the main menu;
[*] For better understanding of the item purchase process in the in-game store, added the 'Item Name' to the 'Not Enough Money' window;
[*] A 'BUY PREMIUM' button has been added to the 'Today's Results' and 'Trip Results' windows.
[/list]

[h2]General Bugfix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with bait mixing. When the recipe is open, checkmarks for baits are now applied only in the backpack or home storage, depending on Global map or location player are;
[*] The tournament bug related to the appearance of the 'Time's Up' window in 3D mode after the tournament's scoring time has ended has been fixed;
[*] [Gamepad] Fixed issue with incorrect tooltips initializing in chat and photo mode after connecting a PS controller;
[*] Fixed issue with the cursor disappearance in the inventory when changing the line after catching fish;
[*] Fixed issue with the tablet incorrect behavior and displaying after using catapult;
[*] Fixed issue with the incorrect displaying of the reel handle from the Golden Pack after pulling the rod using body rotation to the right;
[*] Fixed issue for some currency incorrect display in prem shop;
[*] Added Support for Sony DualShock and DualSense controllers on Steam. 
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome Halloween 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7e507c69bdcca442cc2a7c19c6bde05db4420da5.png[/img]


Hello anglers,

[b]Your favorite autumn event is here, and this time we've decided not to hold back on immersing you in the magical and spooky Halloween atmosphere.[/b] 

This year, we're giving you a double dose of frights, that  will draw you in a dreadful adventure and get ready for a terrific battle with the darkest and incredibly dangerous creatures. Now, you not only have the opportunity to battle monster fish, collect magical seals, and banish the supernatural where it belongs by closing the gates, but you'll also meet the terrifying Frankenfish and its cohorts once again.

We've combined two sets of missions from your favorite Halloween events! You can now choose the missions you prefer or take the risk and do them all at once! But be prepared for horrifying adventures and magical battles. The monsters won't go down easily, and you'll need all your magical powers and gear to defeat them and free Fishing Planet from the unholy.

In addition to the event missions, don't forget to explore the cursed pumpkins and peek into the graves; they might be hiding valuable items. 

[b]So, enjoy Halloween with Fishing Planet, and the bravest among you will receive valuable prizes!

The event will be active until 10 a.m. UTC, November 6. [/b]

[h1]Mission set 1: Ghost Gate and Monster Hunt[/h1]
[i]"When Halloween night coincides with a full moon, the fabric of reality thins, and a gateway between the real and the supernatural world opens. Ghosts on water bodies, mysterious lights in the depths, the dead coming back to life – all of this has awakened in the world of Fishing Planet."[/i]

You can kickstart your Halloween adventure with missions that will introduce you to the event and prepare you for further challenges.

[b]Something Wicked This Way Comes![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3c1959b4cef2fc1d1e90a3e4ab90fced46cd56b0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7efe807274b83a3f15a4e4172622264c0fe771f3.png[/img][/url]

You will need to complete all the missions and collect fragments of the former power of the druids on Lone Star Lake which will help you to get it all sorted out.

[b]Druid Stone	[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6da7003674237c2af014f3f573171377b6e6d74d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fb6a57f1b96d1ed25f513eadce2adc53e0470822.png[/img][/url]
The Druid Stone will help you restore the balance between the worlds. To feed it with power, you need to prove your fishing skills.

Now you're ready to continue your journey, and it's time to complete these terrifying missions, close the gate, and save the world from otherworldly forces!

[h2]Close the GHOST GATE![/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca77ff53c92eaaccb6b2fc5c7a05c7095543df30.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e681e3969afa6d0efcb0e1d7b241d704fdf73d0c.png[/img][/url]

Halloween night and the full moon is a dangerous mix, the dark forces can open the ghost gate from the other world. You can stop them if you find special magic items.

Complete mystical missions and catch a variety of monster fish. Collect all required items and use magic baits, boilies and groundbaits with custom tackles. For every correct step you will get unique prizes!

Event will meet you with the 7 sacred missions to get through and face the real danger further.

[b]Collect all the required magical items for the ritual, they act as gate seals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Witch's Broom
[*] Ancient Fish Pendant
[*] Trout-Golem
[*] Pendant Against the Evil Eye
[*] Ring of the Demon Lord
[*] Jack-o'-Lantern
[/list]
And destroy them in the flames of the druidic fire!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/531730337b2c83ff0af91d286ac69d3607def0df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0e452ea7fdd4771efc39380521da42f0cbb988a7.png[/img][/url]

[b]And Cats, Cats, Cats. Look for them and follow them, they will guide you through the adventure![/b]
But be ready, the main fight awaits for you in the end!

[h2]Monster Hunt[/h2]
Defeat all fish monsters!
The final battle is waiting! Host of abominations broke into our world through the otherworldly gates. You need to stop them from bringing chaos and terror to our world. Get your best magic gears and get ready to defeat them. 

[b]These creatures are among them:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tarpon-Demons
[*] Fiery Muskies
[*] Sturgeon-Demon
[*] Cursed Carps
[/list]
Fog, mysterious lights in the water depths, the dead that came back to life — all this has awakened in the world of Fishing Planet, from Lone Star Lake to Blue Crab Islands.
Be careful, fish monsters go out on a hunt at night!

[u]Check the points of the paranormal fish activities![/u]

[b]Use Druid's Mystic baits and boilies baits that will drive infernal fish creatures crazy![/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8b55dc59e1c32a56ad0459680072ca5d1d2ca4eb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ae792769b6e1b191a700b8fa1ee28be95482dd11.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/68c78d833537b34127c1d97f7ebb7c2b1ae63f12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/16b275f66264e55bb02d295a6f1c0c128a1291b9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/20bcd3e3ad7ddb95495d2c6ed75e3affa8fd0176.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e21775b54302f236a1ea0953047c57a31f89a69.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a9540b0e5794316c9c732994933938184bb69658.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b07e53af90a4c4ee9cf080341746d7fae805e493.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c3a8073b648248058c24e317ca5afdfa26c7463d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a3fbcd375609b332ce68abfce998728277fa7b8.png[/img][/url]
[b]And Unique Event’s Lures[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2b691c97f8887e21d4dcfa4e4c877f63776cac9e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cd7b495061347f8e0ca87729aa266778f3857efe.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6e4a0f6f7dce2f73617a8f637fb0a7234c0b601c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/65b645c39035c95dc5a931a3ace52ac9f6c66406.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a2a80e846228eea359cf44b27971b0824af44205.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a102c464d4672094fe982a7eea46315516839c52.png[/img][/url]

[b]Try event groundbaits to attract more monsters![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/28cac57481bdf367c6d0d86db91153a4d5b069a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1dbdd2eab34af2f7f819e8bca66196f2fd3e9f21.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5364f3d7152a0073b2c9de97208285b863d304c6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/764cd472d689155be2feb0cc7c6d227f0968156e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c4dc7986278a494a1004128342e3ac79b7b27dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5745f4ed74de8c767a2f24a1cc778554ec542e2d.png[/img][/url]

[u]Exchange items from pumpkins and graves for event baits, which are intended to improve the biting.[/u]

[b]Most furious of anglers will get unique Jack-o'-Lantern Hat[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5de500268f2c6665576be6c5ddcef25f25695082.png[/img]

[h1]Mission set 2: CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH[/h1]

Behold the abominable Frankenfish - a scary and gruesome monster-fish boss that came to life as a result of a bizarre prank-gone-wrong! This frightful monster will devour anything alive, even humans! So it’s up to you to go on an epic adventure to summon and defeat the horrid beast:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed74bc701e541af474bb890348d61f72dc92a0b3.png[/img]
This year the Frankenfish is back and you will need to conquer it again! 

[b][list]
[*]Retrieve the Book of Recipes from the Quanchkin Witch to brew the summoning potion!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aa5258702d9a0bb66a0e3205911390f13f3c02cb.png[/img][/url]

[*]Find the magic Witching Cauldron somewhere on the islands of San Joaquin and get all of the ingredients!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1569391312d29723e35f107fcd49578e72392753.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b96d9fb0e1c9e0f69217f51e430815614539935.png[/img][/url]

[*]Brew the Summoning Potion to summon and defeat the Frankenfish!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f5a264713d4f2df08f56ffff5676956fa4630477.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3213e10094e4183fa5b2722b45eda27fc886c321.png[/img][/url]

[*][b]Win the kayak race which will make you thrilled. [/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b6cfa69a140ceab2326dfc47b92d01533dec059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18d1272d6fb6cb3c5aad5851211c06a80210826c.png[/img][/url]
[/list][/b]

[b]The winner will get the unique Vampire Glasses and Pond Passes to event ponds.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ccf16156bca1fd362b825fdacffefcf0041ed2b.png[/img]

This will be spook-tacular!

[b]Only you can put an end to its bloody rule once and for all! Conquer the monster to get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c30c6f0e0d156998cd1fa38f1afba3ce488aacff.png[/img]

and [b]get the main reward of the event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d1f030d0db864594430a84001ea6755a0cb915ae.png[/img]

[b]Rent a well known Koffin Kayak to be on time whenever the monster appears![/b]
 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/42c5d5250a4c8199d8548588d53877deaf872da5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0c3a0c8a6a12f137829cc036357b1fc0c97f5b57.png[/img][/url]
[b]Also do not forget to Set out on a night hunt after the mysterious glowing Ghost Pike, catch terrifying Skeleton Bluegills,[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8a5b2456b81d54f7d2f8a59627aec1a7a26577b4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dca10b2fd8bb63ec2b0bbc0366b190034fbacb5b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ef131bb406926e89a8efcd7b0a3a5bfd05428c8d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b2e06015fc1b9b64a6cd880a0f9b528b87715c23.png[/img][/url]

[b]and fierce Monster Gars:[/b] Albino Yeti Gar, Green Ogre Gar and Black Vampire Gar
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b561a98c571d8d1680e0d3e6677e9ab2773dcec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f2a4be50bee4925a77f9106dea5a848289ca8ac3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfe64b7360ae47c472bee57c0052a18c68aa9d2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d8c6796c463031e89b8e54e7070d8896280d85df.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d309ef7fa6a15791c0480396371efd050126cc19.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2daafca223d65694cb5618a77ab31c15d20ad32.png[/img][/url]

[b]Be careful, because all fish monsters are going out for a hunt at night![/b]

[b]Also do not forget about our cool tackles[/b] like the Ghost Reel™ 4000 spinning reel and the SpookySpin™ 260 spinning rod with a glow-in-the-dark tip, as well as creepy lures like the Bony Shad, Spider Spoon, and Slimy Crank and Halloween pumpkin jellies Candy bait and Veins Leader!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/48e324b7a3b281aae755d6cf14cb18ea5c751a51.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5542a0be5454963e57fa3d9c9c36dd3756bf645f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c0a8ffca9f35826d920d8edf3184e0020fe2a582.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37090a740a682f9c3fbc30c2be9b674be28e0d90.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2aef26e915cd542ac1966ffea7079cad4ba33ded.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/17f0136b97d121619fce638201ecaf1ec6435319.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/177dc7191eaed771f0447e1fde341d4962c0350f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/25a5d4df5849f50c907dead88712c0c8b094f2e8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0a3349eb5ea06173b99a888d4b1e6d861b9ccd62.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cf4aabdf6cac13facf7301ce4d4fe10fdcf626e7.png[/img][/url]

[b]Yep, CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH missions promise to be a real adventure quest that’ll scare you out of your fishing wits![/b]

[b]PS:[/b][i]Look around and explore all your surroundings, dig deep into graves marked with Tombstones and do not miss Vicious Pumpkins to get some spooky and unique angling loot.[/i]

notes.title: DevDiary: Club Leagues
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0aedfad8381f3d85e1cb1398c4125b9c78b5e29d.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,

Welcome to another page of our diary series about the upcoming updates!

[b]Today we're excited to unveil the key component of The Clubs System: The Leagues. [/b]

Every angler has their own path and goals, but we all know that competitive spirit drives most of us to achieve more, and Leagues will keep your club members at the forefront of their fishing prowess!
So, get ready to reel in your excitement and join us as we dive into what's coming your way next!

[h2]Leagues[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1aac753fe39b505629b89de285405a5e5e985e06.png[/img]

The League is a leaderboard of club competitions results in the Championship during the Season and the way to compete with the best anglers while being a part of your unique Club within the whole Fishing Planet Community! 
Leagues will create an engaging and competitive experience for clubs by giving them goals to strive for and a sense of progression as they improve their skills.

[h2]Club Points[/h2]
Club Points will be the points that members of clubs earn individually for various game and club activities. The sum of all earned Club Points by players is the club will make a huge impact on your club and lead it to the win. The club that earns the most Club Points wins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d377110933694acfb9f8170991cdb7f8c7d23319.png[/img]
*But don’t forget that you can earn Club Points only during the active Season.

[h2]Seasons[/h2]
The Fishing Planet League system will be divided into Seasons, usually lasting for a few months. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/909225b63d83d4c2852d893ca6cc7de0f937d6f1.png[/img]

At the end of each season players may receive rewards based on their final score, composed by the sum of Club Points in your Club, and the rankings are often reset to some extent to start a new season from scratch.

All clubs in the game compete to earn Club Points to win. The competition happens automatically, as it involves comparing the Club Points earned throughout the Season.

 At the end of the Season, the winning clubs will receive Season Trophies, and their members will receive rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9e3a74b9c46aec7ec114588742fe710f004afff2.png[/img]

At the beginning and at the end of the season all clubs receive notifications. The season starts and ends automatically.

[h2]Championships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fa94b7313740396db3fbcb85b42b628984a41bd3.jpg[/img]

A Championship is a weekly competition within the Season. The competition is automatic, it counts by comparing earned Club Points during the Championship. Another important part of a competitive activity created within the Championship are Divisions. Division is a group of clubs from the same league that compete exclusively amongst each other in order to earn the Club Points. Divisions are formed anew before each championship. The size of a division ranges from 6 to 11 clubs in a single league.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/01c8fa72467b92e0ddd620a2f0d5cee1d0752475.jpg[/img]

For each Championship you will need to earn Club Points from scratch. After the end of the Championship, the Divisions will be disbanded to start anew with the next Championship. The clubs that were first in their Division move to the next League, and the players of the club receive rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18c28782f2f0988fd5cd6f9fa280053fe49d5923.jpg[/img]


[h2]And now we are coming to the most delicious part: League Bonuses and Rewards[/h2]
When the club is in a certain League the members of the club receive bonuses in experience and credits for fish caught. Every fish caught while the club is in the League counts. Players who are members of the Season Winners Club receive rewards for winning the Season and League. These are the top 10 clubs that scored the most Club Points during the Season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70b6032a2e89e1fb1f84b5320b465b660447c2cf.png[/img]

The reward* is received by every member of the club, regardless of the amount of Club Points collected by them, the main condition is to be in the club at the reward time.

*Please note that all awards on the screenshot are only for visual representation. They will be different after the League release!

[h2]Season Rewards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/66f007005b5ebbcfc1d8a6dea4a41d30bd30d08a.png[/img]

All members of the Season Winner Club receive rewards for their victory. These are the top 3 clubs that scored the most Club Points during the Season.

After the Season review, the winning Club will receive the Season Trophy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ce7ad6caa70eb229e1341ea7d0b01c3700535407.jpg[/img]

The Season Trophy will be displayed in the Club Info window. It displays one of the highest Season Trophies won by the club during its lifetime.
 
[h2]League Rewards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03f2c222edbacff854137f88201d18df308ee468.png[/img]
Rewards are in-game currency, items that Players receive at the end of the Championship and Season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7de4ab6d6042b6cb6bb803262a41248730b131be.png[/img]

Among the main rewards, besides baitcoins, will be special club-series items and Club Tokens. 

[h2]League Trophies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fae1b660976f5277834b77fbe05b24aa103d95fd.png[/img]

League trophies are the special club awards given to Clubs for winning the Championships by scoring in the top 3 clubs in their Division. The club must win in the current League to move to the next one. To receive the Legendary League Trophy, the Club must remain in the League and not be relegated after the Championship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/045a3ec7c7cd224f005f14c38ceb7d39b82213cd.png[/img]

The League Trophy will be sent to the Club after the Championship Review.
Every member of the Club can see the fact of receiving the Trophy in the League Trophy Window.

Visually, League Trophies are the statuettes of a fisherman, made of different materials, metal or precious stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/065eade914d4cec78ee05beca1f1ba9d40f7e68f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/375c8ee6839d9923cc1cf1ec8b38bca0097d5557.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc882689da3b2e473a05ae88db6837c84f458d39.jpg[/img]
The Trophies cannot be bought or sold.

The future of Fishing Planet is looking brighter than ever with the exciting League update! As we embark on this thrilling journey of championship competitions among angler clubs, your fishing adventures are about to reach the new heights. Stay tuned for more updates, cast your lines, and get ready to make a splash in the world of angling like never before! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b2b038283d83a3bd9cf3c55f2d54ba702cf047d.png[/img]

Patch 4.5.1: Fishing Planet Clubs, New Fishing Mechanics and Animation
Welcome Fishing Planet Сlubs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5583b51c1c33cacd6f1a5137cb832023c0aeb30a.png[/img]
We are happy to announce the Clubs are here! 
Inspired by the feedback of our amazing Community we put a lot of work and love in this feature and now we are incredibly excited to present it to you. 
It will be an amazing opportunity for you not only to identify your fellow anglers, but also create a safe place for sharing fishing knowledge and experience. So get your best fishing tackles and get ready!

[b]If Clubs nail it, Leagues will follow, so we are patiently waiting for your feedback.[/b]
The epic community get-together is coming!

[h3]What are Clubs?[/h3]

Clubs are an in-game social feature that will unite you with your friends and make team fishing easier than ever. Clubs can have a large number of members. You will be able to create your own community and hold your own events!

[b]Here are some Clubs features and functionalities you will get[/b]

[b]Membership:[/b] Players can join a club and become members, usually by sending a request or receiving an invitation from an existing member or the club leader.

[b]Communication:[/b] Clubs often have built-in communication tools such as chat and Discord channel. This allows you to coordinate strategies, share tips or simply socialize.

[b]Club Events:[/b] Clubs may organize regular or occasional events where only the club members can participate. In this iteration you could create your club room and fish with your club fellows, but this feature will be extended with the future updates. 

[b]Club Benefits and Additional Experience: [/b]The possibility of receiving additional experience (XP) for catching fish in the same waterway surrounded by your clubmates using the Club Room. The more players in the room the greater the bonus everyone gets! These benefits also  include exclusive in-game items, bonuses, xp, tips and separate space for fishing only with your clubmates.

[b]Sharing tackles and markers: [/b]You will be able to collect ANY BAIT WITHOUT LEVEL LIMITS from your teammates and will receive additional experience (XP) as a reward for donating baits or fish tags.

[b]One of the key perks of joining the clubs are:[/b]
[list]
[*] special chat only for club members where you can share baits and marker buoys
[*] a unique club room for fishing together, which allows you to receive an additional experience bonus for catching fish
[/list]
[h3]How can you create or join a Club?[/h3]
Every player who reached level 5 will be able to join or create a Club and start their own story of success in Fishing Planet. To create one from scratch, select Create Club from the Play menu. From there you will be able to choose a name, create a logo and preferred primary/secondary club specifications.

[b]To create your own club:[/b]
[list]
[*] Сhoose a Club Name and add a Description
[*] Select your Country or chose International flag
[*] Create Club Logo by using in-game club logo editor with all available elements in it
[*] Invite players to join
[/list]
[i]All club members are able to invite new players. Club membership is available for players of level 5 and higher, however level restrictions of the specific Club are determined by the Club President when the club is being created.[/i]

Creating a logo will be possible from the available elements in the game creator and it will cost a certain amount of credits or baitcoins depending on the elements you choose. We are also planning on adding an option of uploading your own custom club logo in the future updates.

As we mentioned above, players can send requests to join clubs or can be invited by already existing club members, but all the requests have to be approved by the Club Leader.

[b]As a Club Leader you can:[/b]
[list]
[*] Invite new members
[*] Set Club information and required level minimum for members
[*] Set a country of club origin
[*] Set Club logo 
[*] Change Club Name
[*] Set Club activities
[*] Disband Club
[/list]

[i]If you do not want to own your Club anymore, you can also transfer ownership to another member.[/i]

[h3]Separate Club Menu[/h3]
You will get a new Club menu tab that will help you better navigate through all necessary information. You will be able to scroll through all available clubs and choose the one you like to join or create your own club. There also will be all the info about clubs you joined and your own if you have one. All the club invites will also be there together with much more useful info.

[i]Previously we made a detailed review of the Clubs with a bunch of screenshots of the gameplay. If you haven’t seen it yet, we encourage you to read more about the Clubs feature in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3683427732714585585]Developer Diaries[/url].[/i]

[b]We are very excited about this feature and are eager to hear what you think about it![/b]

notes.title: Happy Fishing Planet Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/93499cf6bb871a71121044a39c0d56fd3b193286.jpg[/img]

Hey there, fellow anglers!

Guess what? It's that special time of the year again – Fishing Planet's anniversary celebration is here! 🎉 [b]Can you believe it's been 8 amazing years since we cast off into the gaming world with Fishing Planet on Steam?[/b]

From the very beginning, we had a clear mission: to bring the joy of fishing straight to you, no matter where you are. Over the years, we've spread our love for fishing to various platforms – [b]PlayStation, Xbox, iOS and Android. [/b]

We've been working hard behind the scenes, fine-tuning every aspect of the game – the physics, the graphics, and the intricate fishing mechanics. We've put extra care into cultivating our fish, ensuring they're hanging out in all the right spots, just like they would in the real world.

From humble beginnings with only US lakes and rivers, we set our sights on becoming a global fishing haven. [b]Today, you have the incredible choice of 25 stunning destinations across the map – North America, Europe, South America, Africa and Asia. And we're about to make waves in open waters too! [/b]🌊

In recent years we have launched the mobile version for both IOS and Android, so you can now take the Fishing Planet experience with you wherever you go. To top it all off, we've set up our [b]official [url=https://discord.gg/fpofficial]Discord[/url] channel[/b], so you can easily connect with your fellow fishing enthusiasts.

[b]And speaking of celebrations – swing by our Discord for a huge Anniversary Giveaway! There's a chance to snag some cool prizes including 180 days Premium, DLC, baitcoins and more, so don't miss out.[/b]

What’s more, in a few weeks we are launching [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3683427732714585585]Fishing Planet Clubs[/url] and planning to implement Club Leagues to bring our competitive activities to a higher level! Plus, we're making fishing as real as it gets with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3649653272202356920]New Fishing Mechanics[/url] – get ready to feel the thrill of the catch like never before!

Finally, we're about to unveil our very first [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3716076292756072155]Saltwater Location[/url]!

Fishing Together takes a new spin too – embark on oceanic explorations with friends, setting sail for an entirely new horizon of fishing excitement. Get ready to reel in those dream catches while enjoying a slew of new tackles and mechanics! There is no release date yet but we will keep you posted, you will see it in our DevDiaries! 

[b]None of this would have been possible without you – our fantastic community of over 17 million players worldwide. You've made this journey incredible, and we can't thank you enough for sticking with us through these 8 amazing years. And yes, we know we haven’t reached perfection yet as we will never be done growing, but your support, passion, and feedback have fueled our determination to keep pushing the boundaries and making Fishing Planet better.[/b]

[b]So here's to you, our awesome anglers! Tight lines, smooth casts, and endless fishing adventures await. We're beyond excited for what the future holds and here's to more unforgettable moments on our Fishing Planet! 🎣🌍[/b]

P.S. Don’t forget to take part in our giveaway in Discord!

notes.title: DevDiary: New Fishing Mechanic
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8c1f4a8a1c3f18434d9055f3516b949c04584b0f.png[/img]

Hey Anglers,

Welcome to the Third Diary of our diary series about the upcoming updates!

[b]We want to introduce you to Pulling-up[/b], a new fishing mechanic we are very excited to implement.

As our mission is to create a fishing experience that is as close to real life as possible, we constantly improve our in-game fishing techniques and create new fishing opportunities for our players.

An angler can easily reel in the line at maximum speed when fishing for small fish. However, as the size of the fish increases, it becomes more and more difficult to spin the reel. A certain threshold occurs when force is applied to a heavy load, so our point is to reduce side effects and expand your fishing experience by bringing in a new pulling-up mechanic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fbe0d48c7d079562943dcaad043df39915862ec8.png[/img]

Pulling up consists of constant, repeatable actions of sharply pulling the line, losing the line, reeling in the loose line and pulling it sharply again. 
There are a few ways to pull the line sharply:

[list]
[*] Sharply raise the rod up (RMB (PC), LT (XBOX), L2(PS))
[*] Body rotation (mouse movement (PC), right stick of the controller (PS/Xbox)
[*] Character movement (character movement buttons (PC), left controller stick (PS/Xbox))
[/list]
When fishing for a heavyweight fish, it is very important to safely take it out of the water. In such cases, we commonly use a landing net.

[b]Landing Net [/b]

For fish over 5 kg, there will be a net landing system, as it is necessary to make sure big fish is caught safely. The landing net will become an integral part of the inventory and will be available to every player starting from level 1.  It is an important and much-needed update, as with the release of ocean fishing, there will be a lot of big fish!!

[b]Upgrade your skill set with a new pumping technique and catch the biggest fish like a pro![/b]

notes.title: Fishing Planet Boat Series
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4be0410aecc7595f6c021e7e9d61e2260260ae08.png[/img]
We welcome all anglers on this beautiful day and are happy to share some news with you! In June, Fishing Planet locations will host a boat predators tournament – Fishing Planet Boat Series. If a regular fishing trip feels boring to you, if you want to show off your honed skills, if you love the spirit of competition – this is for you! Don’t waste your time: go register for the Tournament. Prove to everyone that you are the best angler and earn not only recognition but also fantastic prizes, including Credits, BaitCoins, and unique items.

[b]And the three best Champions will become proud owners of new X-Series Bass Boats and FPBS FlameChamp™ Cap![/b]

Participants and spectators will have a whole week to enjoy the thrill of the fight. The tournament will take place at picturesque locations in the US and Germany. However, you will hardly have time to enjoy the view, since the clash is likely to turn fierce! You will be fishing for the toughest predators using a spinning or casting rod from your boat. The type of qualifying fish depends on the location.

The Tournament will take place from June 13th through 18th. Over this period we’ll hold Qualifiers, Semi-Finals, and Finals. You need to register 24 hours before Qualifiers start – don’t miss the deadline!

[b]The first registration begins on June 13th.[/b]
Dates of the Tournament:
[list]
[*] 13th - Qualifier 1 at the picturesque Saint-Croix Lake, Michigan;
[*] 14th - Qualifier 2 amid the Bavarian views of Lake Sander Baggersee in Germany;
[*] 15th - Qualifier 3 on the vast expanses of SAN JOAQUIN DELTA, California;
[*] 17th - Semi-Finals at the magical Blue Crab Island, Mississippi;
[*] 18th - Tournament Finals at the same place, Blue Crab Island, Mississippi.
[/list]
Make sure to grab everything you must have - Fishing Planet Boat Series Pack,
with all the tackle and exclusive equipment you need to enhance your skills for the ultimate win!

We are looking forward to greeting our new champions!

notes.title: DevDiary: Clubs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed2dbd279b9b8cf66a993a1d8245a097d6a89a28.png[/img]

Hey, anglers!
Welcome to the second diary of our diary series about the upcoming updates!
Today we introduce the upcoming feature we put lots of energy and passion into. With the positive feedback we have received after briefly announcing it in the previous diary we are very excited to tell you more about Clubs.

In-game friends identification and playing together is certainly very important to all players so we decided to create a new tool and an opportunity for you to manage your own friend’s environment in Fishing Planet.  

So anglers, get ready!  If your rod is cast while reading, don’t forget about the bell, so you don’t miss your fish,  and let’s dive deeper into the Club community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/96c2a27be69b35d633274b45d3eafb7093ebedea.jpg[/img]
[b]Introducing the Clubs![/b]
We had an idea of creating clubs since the beginning of Fishing Planet and it was our must-have feature that we were exploring, developing and polishing. We took our time to make it useful, convenient and fun for every member of the Fishing Planet family. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c52253c12ba9efba8338593b3cfbd40bfe4c2919.jpg[/img]

[b]Now we will explain a bit what you will get with the release of Clubs  [/b]

Clubs will give you the opportunity to be in touch with your fishing friends and like-minded people all around while playing Fishing Planet, while sharing great time and creating your fishing history together. They are built for  players to interact with each other in a virtual environment as if they would go on a fishing trip together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5cb64a1a4bfbea1f765ef3509220b90abb930db1.jpg[/img]

Joining a Club you will have an expanded range of communication features, for example, a special chat where you can exchange baits and marker buoys. You’ll also get a unique club room for fishing together, which allows you to receive an additional experience bonus for catching fish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ef085f1edd109ae672efa5753938d04ae3d356de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3e3148d9a2864612a4a0176f5f8815e50bb59bbd.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned before, the most important benefit will be a chance to start building a friendly community or join the existing one. While browsing the  list of clubs you will learn more about them from the short description including the country of the origin, which will make it easier to choose the most suitable community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2a6d391694a09b0334b142639f762ce42a84efc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ba079df6fb0591f85a59f7222580a42d73df205d.jpg[/img]

When creating a new Club first of all, you will need to select a Club Name and add a Description. Important recognition sign for every Club will be the Club Logo. It will help to visually recognize players and their friends inside Fishing Planet and highlight their unique fishing community.
 [b]The logo can be created by using in-game club logo editor with all available elements in it. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ffea4f2856b42eab45fabe039a68d5ea77ee2e0b.jpg[/img]

After creating your Club, any player can be invited to join. All club members will be able to invite new players. Club membership will be available for all players with no level restriction, but creating a club is only available to players of level 5 and higher.  Also, please be aware that the minimum level of club members is determined by the Club President when the club is being created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c543431acdb97d99660625fba58bffd1dcf7d43d.jpg[/img]

[b]The chat will be another huge advantage of participating in clubs.[/b] It only includes the club members, so that all clubmates are always in touch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e93bab80df6a1d042aa3333e80bc3b9a99826cdc.jpg[/img]

Clubs in Fishing Planet are created for the groups of players who come together to socialize, collaborate and participate in various activities, it is also an ongoing adventure and a place to grow your skills and progress together.  The club you join will become a perfect space to share fishing information and experience between members. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/840443e4acece2a5e4af4c027d09da3a653985e8.jpg[/img]

[i]Clubs are very important to us. This is the project of our dear colleague, who put his heart into this update.Volodymyr Egov, who designed clubs and leagues, was killed defending Bakhmut, Ukraine. We are heartbroken but not stopped because making his ideas happen is one of the ways for us to celebrate his life and continue his legacy.[/i]

[b]We hope it will become a platform for connecting players with different skills, knowledge and level with the main goal to experience fishing on a new level! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/21ae00e2cc39664788bf354b48ac1ae3ad00cc6f.jpg[/img]

[b]The Сlubs are in its final stages of testing and improvement and coming in a few weeks. [/b]

So, these are the first steps in introducing clubs to you guys, but what’s coming after is even more exciting! There will be competitive activities among clubs, which will be rewarded with exciting prizes. In order to run these activities, there must be a lot of clubs. This is why we really count on your active involvement because there is so much more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ba6179d8762e43483b5a01c3e1a151f182d00b3a.jpg[/img]

[b]We hope you like the clubs as much as we do and we’ll be able to launch a Club League Season very soon![/b]

notes.title: Welcome Live Bait Fiesta Cup 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1ef9e30fc1579824a9f7869086125a82cdab14c7.png[/img]

We would like to welcome all fishing experts!

This May, we encourage you to take part in the Live Bait Fiesta Cup!

[b]Prepare your bottom and match gear, as well as your favorite boat. You can leave your rod stand at home — you won't need it. When using a boat, remember that only fish caught from the shore will count.[/b]

The winner will be the one who, at the end of the tournament, will demonstrate a catch with a maximum weight of their ten heaviest fish.

During the tournament, you will travel through three wonderful warm countries of South America and visit reservoirs surrounded by tropical jungles and inhabited by unique fish of impressive size and color.
You will take an exciting fishing trip to the Peruvian Lake Maku-Maku, the waters of the Amazonian Maze in Brazil, and the Marron River, which flows through the Bolivian rainforests.
These places with their amazing flora and fauna attract sport fishing experts from all over the world. This means that in this tournament, you will face real fish-hunting pros! The harder the fight, the more significant the victory, as well as the title of Champion and well-deserved prizes: sizable amounts of Credits, Baitcoins, and unique items of equipment!

[b]Best anglers will get unique tackles as a reward:[/b] X-Series Omega 310, LBFC Fiesta Champion Cap, X-Series TornadoMax 10000
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4a3f81f84d359ae0a545d2caa905d09a64729185.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/261dc3c4e2fb67db3ae91248036154c25f153fb5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/da0d22e5d353e7d51801e232c13b3eeb87d6ef9f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b550c102776108747729465abcad109b2293f9eb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b0ff6b2f8daf8ac42bc5bd910932c8d2cf7532d1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/356c86a059257fdad60d19682c90a0ec44aefc21.png[/img][/url]

Stay tuned and don't miss the registration date for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup! Tight lines!

[b]Registration of tournament participants begins on May 15 at 18:00 and lasts one day, until 18:00 on May 16. The tournament takes place from May 16 through May 21.

Tournament schedule dates:[/b]
[list]
[*] May 16–17 — first qualifier on the deep-water lake Maku-Maku in Peru.
[*] May 17–18 — second qualifier in the Amazonian Maze in Brazil.
[*] May 18–19 — third qualifier on the foggy Marron River, amidst the Bolivian jungle.
[*] May 20 — semi-finals on the Marron River in Bolivia.
[*] May 21 — tournament finals in the Amazonian Maze, Brazil.

Also, we need to remind you that it is strictly forbidden to participate in the tournament with two or more accounts! Violators will be excluded from the list of participants and temporarily restricted from all in-game activities and participation in competitions and tournaments.

notes.title: Patch Note: BugFix
DevDiary: Future Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/38cd726c3e2aaeaae21197a7a416651b2ad3fc04.png[/img]

Hey Anglers!

The whole Fishing Planet team is passionately working on the new features. This season will definitely be exciting for all players. We are delighted to open the curtain slightly and tell you more about what's coming on the air in the following months.

Today we will briefly introduce Clubs, Saltwater Location, New Fishing Mechanics, and Fishing Together. These features are tremendous and highly anticipated, so we decided to make it a series and dedicate one of the upcoming diaries to each segment. So stay tuned; we have lots to share.

But first of all, we want to say thank you to our Community! Your feedback is the basis for the development of The Fishing Planet game. You inspire us to push the boundaries and keep converting the passion for online fishing we all share into our game.

Now let's jump in and review every new feature we prepare for you.

[h3]Saltwater location[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/31be5c5ff5888de43bb8cd84f9a30643d0be7ebe.png[/img]
As you know, we are working non-stop on our first Saltwater location. There is a lot of hype about it, and many of you have tried to guess where it will be on the globe. Let's see whose guess was the closest :)
Our future location is a water area around a small island in the southeastern part East China Sea. Fishing on this island is possible all year round due to the warm climate, but autumn and spring are considered the most favorable times as typhoons might occur in the region in summer, and fish activity decreases in winter.
The East China Sea around the island has a significant water exchange with the Philippine Sea and the Pacific Ocean, so you can expect incredible biodiversity and exciting challenges in catching all the fish.
Saltwater is on its way. We look forward to telling and showing you more about it and will dedicate one of our next DevDiaries.

[h3]New fishing mechanic[/h3]
There is one more thing we are very excited to implement in Fishing Planet, new fishing mechanics - pulling-up.
The angler can easily spin the reel at maximum speed when fishing for small fish. However, as the size of the fish increases, it becomes more and more difficult to spin the reel. A certain threshold occurs when the force is applied at a heavy load. We are doing our best to reduce side effects and expand your fishing experience by bringing in a new pulling-up mechanic. Upgrade your skill set with a new pumping technique and catch the biggest fish like a pro. 


[h3]Fishing together[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9f6c3664cf7da5dfffe174e1d3dc8bc16a59bf30.png[/img]
We create a new type of boat for sea fishing with additional characteristics. Most importantly, new boats must be more significant and faster than the existing models because they must be stable in open water conditions of the ocean and sea.
Having the bigger boat at your disposal means you can take your friends on board and go on the fishing adventure together.

[b]And last but not least, we prepared for your few really useful updates![/b]
[h3]Clubs[/h3]
With this new feature, you will be able to create your own clubs and hold regular events. Undoubtedly, it will help you connect with your friends and fishing enthusiasts to experience the world of online fishery to the fullest. Team up with a name and logo, create the unique identity of your club, and share your knowledge and experience. While fishing together in your club room, you will be gaining experience points but also will be able to help your mates out by exchanging baits and fish markers. Just like in real life, fishing with your friends becomes an event you are looking forward to where you can strategize, exchange your knowledge, and, of course, get lots of fun hanging out with like-minded people.
This massive feature is in its final stages of development, and you will get to it in the upcoming months.

[h3]Anti-cheat improvements[/h3]
The last feature might sound less exciting than the previous ones at first, but it's extremely important to the overall impression. Due to the increase in the number of cheating and exploiting the game mechanics, we have completely revised our anti-cheater policy and improved the anti-cheater system in the game, including crucial technical improvements. Thank you all for your reports and suggestions and for helping us improve Fishing Planet! 

The Fishing Planet Team is here to keep developing the best fishing simulator in the world, and we are incredibly grateful to our Community for sharing this passion! We thank you for bringing your impact to the table by giving us feedback, reporting bugs, being active in the Community, and sharing your knowledge with fellow players.

[b]In the upcoming DevDiaries we will get back to you with more information about new features! 
Stay tuned.[/b]

Three qualifying stages will determine the 60 best anglers who will advance to the Semifinals. The top 20 anglers of the Semifinals will then compete in the final battle to become Bass Champion.
