notes.title: Happy St. Patrick's Day: Kick the Snake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b6abe8204d5c6aab113eac865acc3e5e3bd3145.png[/img]

Hey, anglers!
Happy St. Patrick's Day: It’s time to deal with the snakes!
[b]St. Patrick's Day celebration often lasts for almost 2 weeks. And this year is no exception. We promise that our anglers definitely won’t be bored from March 9th to 20th because we've got a challenge that is worth looking forward to!  [/b]

St. Patrick became famous for many miracles. For example, once he drove out all the snakes from Ireland. This scoundrel spreads a real terror for the local fauna! The best way to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day for a real angler is to drive a Snakehead out of the ponds. 

[b]Drive out the Snakeheads like St. Patrick drove out the Serpents and get a Leprechaun costume and St. Patrick's Song boat.[/b]

[b]Amazing Leprechaun costume of several event items is waiting for you:[/b]
Leprechaun Frock Coat, Paddy's Top Hat, Green Glasses
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e090bcc2bcaf49bfbc88826602697dc72d65e527.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5ac27d05e7e42aa937103392806f13ada5922d92.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9af91a1ff543c8c23d62c1fb50299b5a8c715256.png[/img]

and the [b]main prize of the event - the motorboat St. Patrick's Song[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/196c8aae29699ec11913375fd9e63aa3d21e6469.png[/img]

[h3]Plunge into the unforgettable atmosphere of this spring holiday, and may the shamrock-colored luck always accompany you, wherever you fish![/h3]

[b]Show off your boating skills and take part in the Rainbow Chase[/b], where at the end of each race you will find a Leprechaun pot with gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a071fea839576fe2cade757fccddbe695df66e73.png[/img]
Just keep an eye on the timer and make the most of your boat!
The race starts on Emerald.

[b]Try your luck in missions catching the Rowdy Bass, Leprechaun Fish, and Buzzman Tambaqui[/b], and get Baitcoins for capturing them and Clover Coins for completing the missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/69040703460d246e2970a4eae9f4ab877aaa63ef.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e8268f2676e8f64815d464a66bb563d066443970.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ecfdcfc9be8ea75f48a41e59bd50bc2546395748.png[/img]

[b]Get a Leprechauns’ favor for catches: [/b]be sure, they will pay you back with Clover Coins, the most popular currency of the Emerald Event! With Clover Coins you can buy effective lures and cool green outfits, becoming the most fashionable angler at the Irish party!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c868eddb031335df83dc5be7208d294a60c2d487.png[/img]

These three fish species especially like our [b]delicious Drunken Worm and Bully Grasshopper Pickled Januari Palm Fruit[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2d89e3586b697a3e34272c7a97ac631833063716.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/12496520cbde357ef4d0c445036afd15ce137fd3.png[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff48e4a4e5363b8ab703961cd80971b47970ea1c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8263e6d35280e4a44247c2c9a8135c5f3be15f8e.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Northern Snakehead [/h3]
Slick and agile thing, looking like a real snake! The homeland of Snakehead is the rivers of the Far Eastern region. However today this sly one made its way into many waterways of Europe and America. And this is not good at all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91666ef0034e8e092020c288f8ec4c5c35a16396.png[/img]

We've heard the thieves have sneaked into the event's locations. Check carefully the information in-game. 

[b]Don't forget to use special lures.[/b] Also you can change lures to Clover Coins using Horseshoes.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cd1d58dda4470385a6fdf849a0f0265a35554d19.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70171138f2349e849f9865df51d4f46c29ea2e02.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c24c66ca7dffe3ee40d9f94732badd6ce554d6b1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fc2be07895d284e4058c902cf8cfebe61924618e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4ba3dc582d2ee316076f06948d16bde3f141479a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4b256d6d11f306f2d571c18365c29f4b1bfa15b3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c27108a6387c92f3e6555948a3974ef4e7c373b7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b7e4f4ef906f6926279576adbf974c74f1dba58.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2de62c21d1801451d1d4ea22687b21e13a21ccef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b60f1b33b6040a7b5da4d2902033a85974781b04.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b75fbe4beb9fc95624a1cc31d530bd4fadba24c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eb19ec8588bf6fdc6ecef48b6d0bbcb877add9fb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/49af9b8b7d095cf144eb95e9c2642849c3012c3f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e03922a6ea4f1a99c90a547e147ae3ac5508a8ce.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ffee3f7dd934a86887571e609644a9ff3a4776e0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/494ce725ca5192b5cc85d0aea034dc50df01926f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/367a756774f2ecc86dbf8f1496ffa76cbdcaf7ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7f41ba93065624d0c90b3b9300be0470283c4b09.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/28ade2e2d782063956a0878defeaa01b499bba9b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f94d86859936e41bc0a7985120a13d60c5e9905c.png[/img][/url]

They will help you to catch Snakehead for sure. 
But remember: this is not an easy quest!

[b]Search for Lucky Horseshoes to get special items, such as baits:[/b] Lucky Charm Catapult, Leprechaun's Chest, Triskele Rod Stand, Kayak Irish Rover, and St. Patrick's Song Motor Boat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1fcaa1e85116be6faf1ae0249583d52b3996506d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d31d93d46572440e2efe58a2a62ea5b6a6629dc2.png[/img]

[h3]Don’t miss the possibility to get the unique Green Fortune Pack[/h3]
The Green Fortune Pack contains the "Golden Horseshoe" Stringer, which will allow you to immediately join the fight against the Snakeheads, and the unique Shamrock Headlamp to find additional Leprechaun pots with gold.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804841/Fishing_Planet_Green_Fortune_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6980ae9b51289ba83587c16d48d389962536f0c0.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Also, don't miss the opportunity to get a festive St. Patrick Pack… and may the Irish luck be with you![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/422473/Fishing_Planet_StPatricks_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/851129f99a5d40ce94e627fb41a92516fbc99ca0.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[b]Uncover your fishing rods! Let the magic clover bring you good luck, glory and honor![/b]

notes.title: Welcome World Cats Cup 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c4bf202ca8f35cf1bdea88c93318b6923598aab5.png[/img]
Greetings, our dearest fishing community! This March, you will witness (and some of you even directly participate in) a truly historical event. Fishing Planet will hold its first bottom fishing tournament, World Cats Cup! Remember to register for this unique opportunity and take part in the new competitive event.

Have fun competing with other players and trying to catch the biggest fish! You will go on an exciting journey starting in North America, traveling through Europe, and finally reaching the waters of South America!

Fight for fame, recognition, and a prize pool of many Credits, BaitCoins, and unique fishing tackle, and most importantly — for the title of the first bottom fishing Champion!

[b]The tournament will last from March 7 through 12, with registration starting on March 6, one day before the first qualifying game.[/b]
Here’s the tournament schedule:
[list]
[*] March 7: Qualifier 1 at Saint Croix Lake in Michigan.
[*] March 8: Qualifier 2 on the beautiful Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany.
[*] March 9: Qualifier 3 on the swampy shores of Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[*] March 11: Semifinal on the tropical banks of the Marron River in Bolivia.
[*] March 12: Tournament Final in the winding streams of the Amazonian Maze in Brazil.
[/list]
[b]Rewards will include unique x-series items:[/b]
[list]
[*] X-Series Frogman™ 310
[*] X-Series Ballisto Groundbait Catapult
[*] Rivertex™ WCC Champion’s Cap
[*] X-Series Slider
[*] X-Series Cap'n Hook #12/0
[*] X-Series Sinker 150 g
[/list]
[b]The World Cats Cup Pack will be your reliable support in achieving this goal! This bundle contains everything you need for a bottom fishing tournament![/b]

Hello to all our beloved anglers!

Valentine's Day is coming and to make this holiday less about cheesy romantic nonsense and more about what you truly love, we’re hosting the annual Crappie Valentine Cup fishing tournament! 

This sportfishing event is meant to get everyone in the holiday mood this February 14th! 

Don’t hesitate to register and compete in a fun and challenging environment against the very best, as you test your skills in catching Black and White Crappie in a heated race taking you through five different states, from the picturesque banks of Missouri’s Mudwater River, to Louisiana’s swampy Quanchkin Lake! 

Fame, Glory and a prize pool that includes plenty of Credits, BaitCoins,unique fishing tackle and equipment and most importantly - the title of Crappie Valentine Champion await!

[b]Crappie Valentine Cup will be held February 11th through February 16th, with the Registration starting on February 13th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]

[*] 16th of February - Qualifier 3 on California’s San Joaquin Delta.
[*] 18th of February - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[*] 19th of February - the Grand Finale on Neherrin River in the fine state of North Carolina.

notes.title: Welcome Winter Pike Tour
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5879806e476a10efb5746038ee9f3b0c7f353513.png[/img]

Hey guys! 
The month of January brings you a tournament that’ll make it feel like Christmas all over again! Just make sure to register in time and take part in the annual Winter Pike Tour - a competitive sportfishing event that’s all about landing some big fat Pike! Accept the challenge and set out to explore the specifics of Pike fishing in many amazing destinations, like the mesmerizingly remote and delightfully swampy Quanchkin Lake in the Pelican State of Louisiana, peaceful Mudwater River and breathtaking Lakes White Moose and Emerald as you heroically battle through the 3 Qualifiers, the Semifinal and move on to the Grand Finale on Michigan’s vast Lake Saint-Croix - all to prove yourself as the one and only Pike Fishing Champion, win valuable Prizes and most importantly have fun!
[b]Winter Pike Tour promises to be a thrilling competitive battle full of drive, fun and fishing excitement! 
It will be held on January 17th through 23st, with the Registration starting on January 16th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. [/b]
[b]The full Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 16th of January - Registration for the WPT Tournament begins.
[*] 17th of January - Qualifier 1 on Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake. 
[*] 18th of January - Qualifier 2 on Mudwater River in Missouri
[*] 19th of January - Qualifier 3 on the snowy White Moose Lake in Alberta, Canada.
[*] 21st of January - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizing Emerald Lake in New York. 
[*] 22nd of January - the Grand Finale on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
[/list]

[b]Rewards will include unique x-series items:[/b]
[list]
[*][b] X-Series outfits for the Finalist:[/b] X-Series SuperHero™ Angling Jacket, X-Series StrongShell™ Rod Case, Rivertex ™ PikeGuru Cap;
[*][b]X-Series items for the finalist:[/b]  X-Series Ribbed Shad 15 cm, X-Series Offset Hook #9/0, X-Series Jigging Spoon 71 g, #7/0;
[*][b]X-Series items as Semi-Final and Qualification rewards:[/b] X-Series Spinnerbait 28 g, #4/0 and X-Series Spinner Tail 5 cm.
[/list]

[b]Only for the duration of the tournament you can get special tour pack Winter Pike Pack at 30% OFF!
[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/496438/Fishing_Planet_Winter_Pike_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e0e70c154662f344cb0282a2f74ed4dbb3ac87d3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Merry Fishmas 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/43e24ee9d8d438067b813731f9f12957682350fc.png[/img]

Hey, Anglers!
This year we have an unprecedented combination of Christmas festivities. 
You will be able to play Christmas Holiday Missions and Krampus Hunt Missions, or dare your luck to complete them all. You can choose missions you prefer or do all of them, and enjoy the Holidays as much as you want in a way you want. This year we bring you complete freedom to choose the adventures you like.
[b]The Christmas event starts on December 15th and will be available through January 2nd.[/b]

Have yourself a great Christmas and join us on the Christmas adventures on Fishing Planet! 

[h2]Christmas Holiday missions [/h2]
With Christmas back in town, there’s plenty of magic and festive excitement waiting for you!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff62671e62dc11cab4824fe36533f198608a725d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff62671e62dc11cab4824fe36533f198608a725d.png[/img][/url]
Christmas festivities are under threat! Santa’s sled was wrecked in a terrible snowstorm somewhere in Canada. Luckily, Santa is doing fine...but his reindeer went missing and all of the Christmas presents are now scattered around the world! 

Help Santa save Christmas by finding all of the lost Christmas presents and tree ornaments and catch the mythical Crystal Burbot!

[b]Travel to White Moose lake and find Santa's sleigh. Take Santa's gift bag. Hurry up, Santa really needs your help! Christmas is coming and there's not much time left! [/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5083f19bf8833add76d6a7d74c51f91dcefe29a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5083f19bf8833add76d6a7d74c51f91dcefe29a7.png[/img][/url]

Catch a required amount of Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh Keep in mind that Antlered Salmon bite best when someone launches fireworks.

Fill Santa's Bag with lost gifts. Once you arrive at waterways, find Santa's bag on the pier to get started with the task of collecting boxes with presents!.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9bc70acae5f324949c0f0dc020bac959cf0d3050.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9bc70acae5f324949c0f0dc020bac959cf0d3050.png[/img][/url]
What a Holiday without a Christmas Tree. Find lost decorations and decorate the Tree. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37d55a80af5d7a9e39e089a7bcfc4413226395f4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37d55a80af5d7a9e39e089a7bcfc4413226395f4.png[/img][/url]
[i]*Fireworks increase the chance to catch decorated fish.[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c495bb100d0855b20cc367a8355ec8558015309d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1497b4ee5da1699fdcaba983ca105e54749bfb7b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03521ff07c2c515aed7974905d6785443ccc2b81.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f3b4535ce9b656c438ff7a6da1e4b999b8c50eca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c95b120a97bd3d812aad7490155d5224ed6c3b61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/facb6722f65f57c41493d7000679165846de7d22.png[/img][/url]

[b]Winter is all about snow, so spend some time on snow fighting with other players! [/b] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98d571270b131e1c76a337fad0bbd904b58f32fa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98d571270b131e1c76a337fad0bbd904b58f32fa.png[/img][/url]
[i]*Hit certain number of players with Snowballs[/i]

[h3]Complete Christmas Achievements and Missions and get festive rewards![/h3]
Get an exclusive Christmas rod stand in the form of a jolly snowman and delightful Santa-themed lure box!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/caa3d5735d061cdef51d89baef17a17eb111f3fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/caa3d5735d061cdef51d89baef17a17eb111f3fb.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a3e6e39a204ff3576e7b5f2cf306769c4a464446.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a3e6e39a204ff3576e7b5f2cf306769c4a464446.png[/img][/url]

Check Gift Boxes that you can find at every event location.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5139671e2057867b4e231c2b27dadf96ba4b16a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4af3168e10826877e3a430f37a659d590c7f3909.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Summon Crystal Burbot![/h3]
Complete all missions and get your chance to find out what is waiting for you in the water of White Moose. Make sure to join our fairytale fishing adventure with the good old [b]Crystal Burbot, fantastic Antlered Salmon, and Furry Trout, fireworks and festive excitement![/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6da68a7d4b49711c8456c787660551f2c02d0492.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/09ad0b1275e7a4823fa659bf08096bae1361f582.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f13033ce6a1788ab6ce05c1740729a59f43479.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5224a02da9732061af67671551efe708720f6926.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5acc07155e9ebc8bf2fcfe044868da744cf991a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e72a8505a9d268e86702c35b42131a50cb057f96.png[/img][/url]


Have fun catching these magical Christmas fish, while the fireworks are blasting, and [b]complete the Myth Buster and Deer Hunter challenges[/b] to get unique holiday rewards.
 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc645d1648c9e626dd31f78469d586167fc71d06.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cc645d1648c9e626dd31f78469d586167fc71d06.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2ab4132ff614c9901d819e5f41a4e3a6f0518cd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2ab4132ff614c9901d819e5f41a4e3a6f0518cd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/138b957428bdb65fb1367ed95edcf20b16f1be24.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/138b957428bdb65fb1367ed95edcf20b16f1be24.png[/img][/url]            

You can also try to complete the [b]Fishy Racing challenge[/b] and get [b]Elven Kayak as a prize[/b]!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e69056c1275314d5c0e6f1823f25e5622d77e471.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a6e0f29ea90f2dced3ad120df57ea83206b30b17.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Krampus Hunt Missions[/h2]
The holiday is lost without your help, after the incident with Santa, Krampus troublemakers  stole Santa’s glasses, Beard and Hat. Find the villains and return the stolen things!
Look for special treats, Christmas Tokens and Fireworks in Stockings.

[b]Christmas festivities are under threat! only YOU can save Christmas:[/b]

You need to locate the old troublemakers, capture them and return the things they've stolen.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8735977fc6a2703ce6dee98fb976b83b617b21e9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8735977fc6a2703ce6dee98fb976b83b617b21e9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fbf4e1cff2a9675a0eb8d645041522b9ae38204.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3fbf4e1cff2a9675a0eb8d645041522b9ae38204.png[/img][/url]
You can find them by questioning their accomplices, who have decided to follow them and make mischief around. Because of their innate ability to lie, you'll have to catch a score of them. 
Get your rods ready!

[h3]Amazing Christmas baits will help you to attract the fairy villains and their minions.[/h3]
[b]Mega Cookie Bait[/b]
If you take a couple of Ginger Cookies and fill them with magic, the special power of Christmas pastry will create an ideal bait.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/20d9da14224bf38a114533e9bca069c1dcf82e64.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/20d9da14224bf38a114533e9bca069c1dcf82e64.png[/img][/url]
[b]Use Christmas baits for better catch:[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70f501748005e7e895f4677646e9cefb04181981.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70f501748005e7e895f4677646e9cefb04181981.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/018b37aa37260d0f39cea8353061d7b3dfe73335.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/018b37aa37260d0f39cea8353061d7b3dfe73335.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/90d1647128eff3a4a34d4500f15a45fec4bf21c3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/90d1647128eff3a4a34d4500f15a45fec4bf21c3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6e4a23fbd994032c1c900cf26eb17e949b7a5d4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6e4a23fbd994032c1c900cf26eb17e949b7a5d4.png[/img][/url]

And, of course, enjoy  traditional Christmas treats - [b]Ginger Cookies[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6ca8555a74543e61c06309ddae0068cf5c035bda.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6ca8555a74543e61c06309ddae0068cf5c035bda.png[/img][/url]

These amazing Christmas baits will help you to catch Krampus Fish: [b]Unlucky Krampus Tarpon, Clumsy Krampus Eel, Crumbling Krampus Payara. [/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1890bdeda6cb9edee34cc64bc6edb12f2b1e320f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb193d0d715876ec0bf57695b8433510f5c84a45.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8dfbff9bcfaa47c618493877ea3e7ea26f41698b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c115ec13b6c6f8a413cc75b3b35748d6938688c1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/298b9a9a9825e0e57cff31f0144739f841b86d68.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a65519c82bc56168c597b2d7fb4c43fb64477481.png[/img][/url]

 You can locate the thieves by following their minions, who can be lured out with bait treats, sweet pastry groundbait and magical jukeboxes.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ddba829996b58794533b610b481d0d1f5c4eacbf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/76eefac133af00dd479536344df2b9c258b8a8e3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/97df93ff300d549bb679a90fc97df1cb5314c35b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8aa21514306cbadbb34bade4dbfff17e6bd3c31e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/191e26ed62bed5126f41b63f61afc9652ff37d6d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1d85164152ea1dadec5f445fac636acca29f0252.png[/img][/url]


[b]Magical Jukeboxes also are a useful way to attract the minions.[/b]

Activate Jukeboxes by using Christmas tokens**.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98dd4e0dccdbde0f7730127f83a99922b0c8e06d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/98dd4e0dccdbde0f7730127f83a99922b0c8e06d.png[/img][/url]
*Settled on some event locations.
** Get Christmas tokens by completing the event missions.

[b]Do not forget about Christmas gifts that you can find at event locations. Just check Christmas Stockings.[/b]


Your efforts will be generously rewarded with [b]Christmas gifts[/b]!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d024085f815643ae560006d9fd31a9c4a3fde57.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0d024085f815643ae560006d9fd31a9c4a3fde57.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3350d3ede3560dd0a1fd5e657dc9c04255c055d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3350d3ede3560dd0a1fd5e657dc9c04255c055d8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9878056058a05a0b35b296cbfaf19c9a0db57ecc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9878056058a05a0b35b296cbfaf19c9a0db57ecc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c1e0c8f4ac1819b64b098d58cadc8917d43c5c1d.png[/img][/url]

Hush! Collect Christmas presents, hidden around all waterways!

[h3]Enjoy this year's Christmas with excellent Event Packs![/h3]
These packs  contain  everything you need to fully enjoy the Holiday including special sets of treats and tackle that the whole team of the best elf engineers has worked with their magic tools and homemade goods!

[b]Also, do not miss the opportunity to enjoy discount for the biggest one: [/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200347/Fishing_Planet_Krampus_Catcher_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/710f87b245fbcecfdb37910f46fda5a67f6142e8.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:

Hello guys! This time we’d like to invite you to join the most sizable Tournament of the year - the Christmas Giant’s Tour! This event isn’t about any particular kind of fish, the key rule here - the bigger the better… and not just big… but GIGANTIC! Yep, we’re talking super-huge Trophy-sized monsters: Trout, Pike, Salmon, Burbot, Catfish, Muskies, Bass, Gar, Snook, Dolly Varden… The list can go on and on! It’s not the name, it's the size that matters. 
This is the big league, folks, and we’re getting ready for some heavyweight fishing! Tight lines!

[b]Welcome to the Topwater Kayak Cup tournament, where you’ll try your hand at catching a wide variety of fish with topwater lures following special rules! [/b]
You’ll need to not only demonstrate your skills in catching big fish, but also to reach the Finish Point before the end of the tournament time! Travel to the most lucrative fishing locations of the world, from Lake Falcon in Oregon, through the Selenge River in Mongolia and Delta San Joaquin in California, to the semi-finals at Saint-Croix Lake, Michigan, and the final competition spot: Lake Maku-Maku in Peru! Fight for the title of champion and a prize pool of an impressive amount of Credits, BaitCoins, and unique fishing gear!
[b]Topwater Kayak Cup 2022 will be held November 15th through November 20th, with the Registration starting on November 14th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.[/b]

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 14th of November - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 15th of November - Qualifier 1  in Oregon, FALCON LAKE.
[*] 16th of November - Qualifier 2 in Mongolia, SELENGE RIVER. 
[*] 17th of November - Qualifier 3 in California, SAN JOAQUIN DELTA
[*] 19th of November - Semifinal Round in Michigan, SAINT-CROIX LAKE.
[*] 20th of November - the Grand Finale in Peru, MAKU-MAKU LAKE.
[/list]
Participants should use only spinning or casting rods with topwater lures. Also, players must use only kayak during tournament and please note that rod stand usage is prohibited.

[b]In addition, we have some more good news and updates for your:[/b]

notes.title: Once upon a Halloween
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b30e2b71d07ed807112624a4e9a188de4633c112.png[/img]

Hey, anglers!
Halloween is on its way! Are you ready for a terrific battle with the darkest and incredibly dangerous creatures? 

When Halloween’s night coincides with the full moon, the gates between this world and the other world open to release the evil forces. You will find yourself on a whirlwind of mystical adventures!

[b]This awesome adventure is waiting for you on all platforms![/b]
[list]
[*] Complete mystical missions and catch a variety of new monster fish
[*] Collect all required items.
[*] Use new baits, boilies and groundbaits
[*] Use new custom tackles
[*] Get unique prizes
[*] Look for Tombstones and Vicious Pumpkins to get some spooky and unique angling loot
[*] And follow the cats, they will guide you through the adventure!
[/list]
Look for magical items, they act as gate seals. Destroy them on Halloween Eve in the flames of the Druid Fire.

[b]Now it is time to complete terrifying missions and save the world from otherworldly forces!
The event will be active until 12 a.m. UTC, November 4.[/b]

[h2]Something Evil Comes This Way![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3c1959b4cef2fc1d1e90a3e4ab90fced46cd56b0.png[/img]
When Halloween night coincides with the full moon, the fabric of reality gets thinned and a gate opens between this world and the other. Ghosts on the waterways, mysterious lights in the depths, the dead are coming back to life — all these are happening in the world of Fishing Planet. But a fragment of the former power of the druids on Lone Star Lake will help you to get it all sorted out.

[h2]Druid Stone	[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6da7003674237c2af014f3f573171377b6e6d74d.png[/img]
The Druid Stone will help you to restore the balance between the worlds. To feed it with power, you need to prove your fishing skills.

[h2]Ghost Gate[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca77ff53c92eaaccb6b2fc5c7a05c7095543df30.png[/img]
Halloween night and the full moon is a dangerous mix, the dark forces can open a ghost gate from the other world. You can stop them if you find special magic items — gate seals — and destroy them in the flames of a druidic fire on Halloween. Collect all the required magical items for the ritual and light up the fire.

[b]But be ready, the main fight awaits for you in the end![/b]

[h2]Defeat new fish monsters![/h2]
On Halloween, a host of abominations broke into our world through the otherworldly gates. These creatures are among them:
[b]Fish-Phantoms[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bef8c80819a60481763f36fb83481e93256b4d26.png[/img]
[b]Fish-Demons[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b76e8bdabd0c0dacdfb331548f24f9d9e36ae18.png[/img]
[b]Fish-Skeletons[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e075e0f5a2138d6f3c3c5462dfd59dc13cc589b0.png[/img]
[b]Fish-Ghosts[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e7412e2916d91f7be40353fc368a1849c35b77ef.png[/img]
Fog, mysterious lights in the water depths, the dead that came back to life — all this has awakened in the world of Fishing Planet, from Lone Star Lake to Blue Crab Islands.
Be careful, fish monsters go out on a hunt at night!

[b]Check the points of the paranormal fish activities![/b]

[b]Don’t miss your chance to increase your luck  with our new custom rods with the runes from Hellfish Fighter Pack:[/b]

notes.title: Welcome Mighty Carp Tour!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d28506db45c2154de5f923d1656e3418542a177e.png[/img]

Behold the mighty Carp! And welcome the opening Tournament of the fall season - this September’s bottom fishing excitement of Mighty Carp Tour! Although somewhat undervalued in North America, this all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some of the world's most amazing fishing destinations - from the Italian charm of the Tiber River, the sunny magnificence of San Joaquin Delta in USA and hardcore reality of the Russian Akhtuba River in the first three Qualifiers, to the vast openness of German Sander Baggersee Lake for the Semifinal Round and finally, the enigmatic Weeping Willow Lakes fishery in Great Britain, where the ultimate Top-20 Carp catchers will have the chance to fight in the Grand Finale for the title of Mighty Carp Master! 

[b]We reduced prices for traveling to all tournament locations! Discount valid only during the tournament.[/b]

notes.title: Happy Fishing Planet Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/864f3225d08dc69e512c893ce9e66269f2e5ce63.jpg[/img]
Hey, Anglers!

On this special day Fishing Planet celebrates its anniversary. Exactly 7 years ago today we launched the Fishing Planet game on Steam. We wanted our game to be available to you anywhere and over the years we released it on PlayStation, Xbox, iOS and Android. 

We desired the game to give you the best hardware-can-provide experience and atmosphere for fishing, so we polished and tuned our physics, graphics and simulated complex fishing mechanics. We carefully breed our fish, so you can find it exactly where it should be. 

Released with just US lakes and rivers, we dreamed to become the true planet of fishing and now you can choose between 25 unique destinations from all around the world - in North America, Europe, South America, Africa and Asia. We still have a lot to add and improve, so you can account that our common passion for fishing will lead us much further!

Last year we presented you two new destinations - Congo River in Africa and Selenge River in Mongolia. Besides new fishing locations, you got new trophy collecting missions and a bunch of South America monster missions and Twitch Drops.

Finally, this year we released a mobile version of Fishing Planet on both iOS and Android, which will help you to explore all the hidden fishing places of our fishing world at any time you want and anywhere you want.

During next year we are preparing for you more exciting things, such as new waterways, special events, new tackles and… Saltwater fishing! Yes, it is coming, so stay tuned.

And last but not least we want to say how proud we are of our amazing community of over 17 million players from all the parts of the Globe. We’re humbled that you’ve been part of our Planet for 7 wonderful years. Thank you for inspiring and encouraging us to keep improving our game and implementing more and more of interesting features! 

Thank you for being with us all these years! Tight lines, Anglers! And looking forward to more to come.

This is one hot summer we are having, eh, folks? Well, maybe not so much in terms of the weather, as in fishing tournaments! Of course, August brings you yet another thrilling competitive event that is double special for us! Wanna know why? Well, we’re talking about Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup - a dear-to-our-heart Sportfishing Tournament that we’re hosting to celebrate our yearly anniversary of coming out on Steam! FPAC tournament is all about catching Salmon in various beautiful destinations like White Moose Lake, San Joaquin Delta and Lake Saint-Croix! Making your way from the Qualifiers to the Semifinal, you’ll have to prove your Salmon catching skills to take part in t[b]he unforgettable Grand Finale in Mongolia[/b], [b]on the mesmerizing Selenge River[/b] and become the Salmon fishing Champion!

notes.title: Welcome Selenge River, Mongolia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/19eaf5883c0672c68ad00f17328b96c5aa064c7b.jpg[/img]

Embark on a fishing trip across Mongolia and test your skills in catching the amazing inhabitants of the Selenge River!

  [b]Welcome to the vast expanses of Northern Mongolia! It is here, in the hilly forest-steppe, that one of the biggest rivers that feed Baikal - the Selenge - flows. [/b]

[i] We’ve also prepared a surprise for you! To get to the Selenge River, your character doesn’t have to be at maximum level. [b]Reaching level 48 will be enough![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/67f975150b7eac0e8e1dde2e272e645a7886ba4c.jpg[/img]

[b]More information about the new waterway in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3219522887319933968]Dev's Diaries[/url]![/b]

   In its middle course, the Selenge has a mostly flat appearance with alternating narrowing and hollow-like expansions, where the river divides into channels, forming multiple islands. 

   The shores, occasionally overgrown with sparse forest, are mostly clay-sandy, and only occasionally pebbles are found. In view of this, the water in the river is always muddy, having a dark gray color.

   [b]The current is average, and the depth, on average, is up to 3 meters, but there are also holes up to 7 meters.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8048162ae7797cc3a2510a5736b110bd0e05b1e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]4 stunning locations with an unforgettable atmosphere of ancient Mongolia[/h2]

[b]Tom Gal[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/66a5e7bd3199ea5f786c75c40d05df0fec2c1833.png[/img]
   There is a place on the eastern bank surrounded by two narrow distributaries of the river. The locals call the encampment Tom Gal, which means ‘Big Fire” in Mongolian. Apparently, the local waters teem with fish and have long been a favorite spot of the locals. This small pebbled open space is surrounded by a forest. There is a large fire pit in the center of the clearing. People obviously come here often. This quiet and peaceful place literally invites you to sit down by the fire, warm up, and rest, watching the flow of the river and enjoying the sounds of nature after a good catch.

[b]Nomadic Camp[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/619b1d7001e9ac7d9180e5e87fe918ca432e0419.png[/img]
   On Selenge’s western bank, you can witness the traditional life of local nomadic tribes. Not far away from the river, several frame yurts stand covered with snow-white felt. Around them, life is in full swing: horses neigh and snort, dogs bark, voices ring. Behind a small fence, several two-humped camels are standing calmly, a flock of sheep is grazing freely in the distance, and a steppe eagle is soaring in the sky. This enjoyable glimpse of a traditional lifestyle will be a great addition to your main goal here — fishing!

[b]Ancient Hitching Post[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/952734a536967568abfb8fb995ef66578eef2b90.png[/img]
   At the foot of the hill on the western bank of the Selenge, one can find ritual hitching posts — serge. In ancient times it was possible to cross the river into a ford on horseback.  These three-section carved wooden pillars were once a sign that this land had an owner, and were associated with the cult of the horse. Their upper part was intended for celestial horses, the middle one — for human ones, and the lower one — for the horses of the underworld. Here you will find many thousand-year-old ritual structures. Embrace the magic of these places and who knows, maybe the ancient spirits will grant you good luck in your hunt for the trophy Taimen!

[b]Taimen Island[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eb6608b998e402e8b9299f5a9d22431ff7606648.png[/img]
   This large pebbled island in the middle of the river has been a favorite spot, for locals and visiting anglers alike, to anchor their boats. Here you can launch your favorite kayak and finally fish from the water. The center of the island is overgrown with low dense willows, among which several taller trees grow. The locals know that this place is frequented by the king of all salmon, incredible and huge — His Majesty The Taimen. And the successful catches of many anglers only confirm this knowledge!

[h2]8 unique fish species found only in the Selenge River[/h2]

   You’ll have to take on such rare and feisty opponents as [b]Humpback Whitefish, Lenok, Baikal Omul[/b] and, of course, the Khan of all salmon — [b]Taimen![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51b459775c84097a3981e5c0bbd5ab59abc769aa.png[/img]

[b]Please see the detailed Mongolia fish guide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3327611656263130192]HERE[/url]. [/b]

   Oh and please note that the bite of some fish is affected by the direction of the wind!

[h2]Unique Mongolian fauna:[/h2]

    The river is home to many rare nesting and migratory birds, herds of sheep roam, horses graze, and sometimes you can stumble upon nomadic yurts surrounded by camps with two-humped camels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/526fc0138e304ec8503b98a288cf14983b7958b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4fb74286d821cb8e5d54d859e073307103b14068.jpg[/img]

   Oh, and we've added a new kind of weather to the game - snowfall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b8379e76fb7883db9bf7140a24019d384db5df21.jpg[/img]

This lightweight spinning rod is reinforced with state-of-the-art GLR® graphene fibers, allowing you to tackle even the biggest prey without the risk of breaking the blank.This rod is the perfect combination of strength, weight, and ease of use!

A reel with so many patented technologies is a must in every self-respecting angler’s arsenal!

notes.title: Selenge River Fish: Detailed guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7d526dcf05c1e2d5cda3a361cd370da7b999bdb8.png[/img]

Hi, Anglers!

[b]We are happy to present you with a detailed guide to all the unique fish that you can find on the Selenge River![/b]

The sharply continental climate holds the river in icy embrace for almost half a year, from November to April. Harsh winters and hot summers make early autumn an ​​ideal time for fishing.

[b]You’ll have to take on such rare and feisty opponents as Humpback Whitefish, Lenok, Baikal Omul and, of course, the Khan of all salmon — Taimen[/b]!

[h3]Siberian Taimen[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51b459775c84097a3981e5c0bbd5ab59abc769aa.png[/img]
Siberian Taimen is the largest representative of the salmon family. It can reach over 60 kilograms in weight and up to 2 meters in length. It inhabits the cold rivers of Siberia and Mongolia and never goes to sea. It mainly keeps near deep holes close to the shore. This species is active day and night. In the daytime, the Taimen picks shaded areas, and at night it moves to the nearby shallows with a fast current. 

[b]Preferred baits:[/b] Large Minnows, Common Minnow, Shiners.
[b]Preferred lures:[/b] Medium Spoon, Single Spoon, Bullet Spinner Crankbaits, Minnows, Mouse Lure Poppers, Walkers Soft Baits (Shads).

[h3]Lenok[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ae36e0063df813185ed60883b8d7201bbcc38db0.png[/img]
Lenok is a predatory fish that inhabits fast rivers with cold water. It can reach more than 10 kilograms in weight and a meter in length. It prefers to hide among branches, stones, flooded trees, as well as keep to sections of the river with rifts and rapids.
Lenok hunts at any time of the day, but most actively — in the morning and in the evening.

[b]Preferred baits: [/b]Grasshoppers, Dragonflies Bark Beetle Larva, Night Crawlers Natural Eggs, Spawn Sack, Boiled Red Roe Small Minnows, Common Minnow, Shiners.
[b]Preferred lures:[/b] Narrow Spoon, Single Spoon, Bullet Spinner Mini Crank, Minnows, Mouse Lure* Poppers, Walkers Soft Baits (Shads, Grubs, Nymphes).

[h3]Arctic Grayling[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b3770ce4bbc0de9fff92c2bb37e7472309af1720.png[/img]
Arctic Grayling is a relatively small omnivorous predatory cold-loving fish. It can reach up to 4 kilograms in weight and up to 80 cm in length. It lives in rivers, streams, and lakes of the Arctic Ocean basin. The Arctic Grayling prefers rapids and areas near large boulders, where reverse currents can occur, as well as places where branches of trees and bushes hang over the water.
They are most active during the day, and hunt mainly in the early morning and late evening. 

[b]Preferred baits:[/b] Grasshoppers, Crickets, Dragonflies,  Mayflies, Caddis Larva, Bark Beetle Larva Artificial Salmon Eggs, Natural Eggs Spawn Sack, Boiled Red Roe Small Minnows, Common Minnow 
[b]Preferred lures:[/b] Narrow Spoon, Single Spoon, Nano Spoon Spinners, Nano Spinner Mini Crank, Minnows, Poppers.

[h3]Baikal Omul[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f9f9e8b4405da9880151e28084f90a471541af77.png[/img]
Baikal Omul  is a schooling fish of the whitefish genus of the salmon family. It can reach about 3 kilograms in weight and more than 60 centimeters in length. It prefers deep places with clear cool water.
This fish feeds around the clock, and it usually goes to shallow water to feed. It feeds on crustaceans, bottom invertebrates, and juvenile fish. The Omul bites well in all layers of water, but there’s more chance of catching it near the bottom.

[b]Preferred baits:[/b] Caddis Larva, Bloodworms, Red Worms, Sideswimmers, Night Crawlers,  Small Minnows, Common Minnow.
[b]Preferred lures: [/b]Narrow Spoon, Nano Spoon, Spinners, Nano Spinner, Soft Baits (Craws).

[h3]Humpback Whitefish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ce4c0610328b0cf63791cb62eff0af436011e673.png[/img]
Humpback Whitefish is a schooling fish of the whitefish genus of the salmon family. It can reach more than 4 kilograms in weight and up to 70 centimeters in length. The Whitefish prefers places with a silty-sandy bottom, a weak current, and well-developed aquatic vegetation. Its activity peaks in the evening, but it is also active during daylight hours. In cloudy weather, it is active throughout the day. The Whitefish is an excellent fighter, so get ready for some impressive resistance from it.
Adults feed at the river bottom on small mollusks, crustaceans, insects, their larvae, and eggs of other fish.

[b]Preferred baits[/b]: Caddis Larva, Bloodworms, Red Worms Sideswimmers, Night Crawlers, Natural Eggs, Spawn Sack, Boiled Red Roe Small Minnows, Common Minnow.
[b]Preferred lures:[/b] Narrow Spoon, Nano Spoon Spinners, Nano Spinner Soft Baits (Grubs, Craws).

[h3]Common Dace[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/62e1e6959ee23bf622765334327575b0ef726a10.png[/img]
Common Dace is a medium-sized omnivorous schooling diurnal fish. It can weigh more than one kilogram and reach about 40 centimeters in length. It lives in small rivers with clear water and moderate flow and is sometimes found in lakes or in brackish water at estuaries. Its juveniles often hide in holes and roots in coastal vegetation, and as they mature, they move to areas with faster currents.
 If you’re hunting for the Dace with a spinning rod, using twitch retrieve will help you a lot.

[b]Preferred baits: [/b]Semolina Balls, Oat-flakes Grasshoppers, Crickets Dragonflies, Mayflies, Flies Bark Beetle Larva, Night Crawlers Small Minnows, Common Minnow.
[b]Preferred lures:[/b] Narrow Spoon, Nano Spoon Spinners, Nano Spinner Mini Crank, Minnows Poppers, Walkers Soft Baits (Grubs).

[h3]Common Minnow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e23523a3b5caf4802c4de3201a7b48fab00a2d3e.png[/img]
Common Minnow is a small schooling diurnal fish, reaching the maximum length of 20 centimeters. It can be found in streams and rivers with cold, well-oxygenated water. It prefers to stay at a shallow depth with a sandy-stony or sandy-pebbled bottom. 

[b]Preferred baits:[/b] Caddis Larva, Bloodworms, Red Worms Pinkies, Maggots Natural Eggs.

[h3]Amur Bitterling[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/62dcff34e116e2bda099ab6d6f65168c05be1e3b.png[/img]
Amur Bitterling is a diurnal cold-loving fish that lives in reservoirs with stagnant or slow-flowing water. This elusive fish tends to keep in small flocks at depths up to 2 meters, in secluded and quiet places with a sandy or rocky bottom overgrown with algae.

[b]Preferred baits:[/b] Dough Balls, Semolina Balls Pearl Barley, Oat-flakes Caddis Larva, Bloodworms, Red Worms Pinkies, Maggots.

[b]Oh and please note that the bite of some fish is affected by the direction of the wind![/b]

notes.title: Developer Diaries: the Selenge River, Mongolia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e503abdf76beb52b183a192b1ef31de312e769bc.jpg[/img]

Hello anglers!
We haven't brought you new locations for a while now. But we’ve been working hard and are ready to present a wonderful gift for you!
It’s time for you to witness the results of the long work of the whole team: our new location, [b]the Selenge River in Mongolia.[/b]

[b]The Selenge River will show you the incredible world of fishing in Asia.[/b]
Have you ever dreamed of breathing in the fragrant wind that travels over the sea of ​​steppe grasses? Have you ever wanted to observe the vast expanses of millennial steppes? Have you ever wanted to hunt for amazing, unique inhabitants of faraway rivers? If yes—then very soon we’ll give you an exceptional opportunity to visit the distant and unknown Northern Mongolia!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eb6608b998e402e8b9299f5a9d22431ff7606648.png[/img]

It is here, in the hilly forest-steppe, surrounded by low mountains, that the proud and cold river Selenga is found, one of the high-water rivers that feed Lake Baikal. The Selenge flows across predominantly flat land, and in its course the narrowings alternate with hollow widenings, where the river divides into straits and forms numerous islands. The current is quite fast and the waters are muddy, with a lot of sedimentary rocks. Its depth is small (3–4 meters), although sometimes there are pits up to 7 meters.

[b]The shores are mostly clayey and sandy, although pebbles can sometimes be found. The places for fishing are surprisingly diverse, full of life and unique flair.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/526fc0138e304ec8503b98a288cf14983b7958b3.jpg[/img]

Here, in the interfluve, you can find a fishing camp, popular with locals. A large hearth, prepared seats made of fallen trees, and fish dryers assembled from poles eloquently suggest that this is a good fishing place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1f19fac20d36ca0d1135c4defb652e3cac2a9b4b.jpg[/img]

[b]On the west bank of the Selenge you can find a traditional camp of nomads with typical Mongolian yurts and nomadic flocks of sheep grazing, camels, and horses.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b8379e76fb7883db9bf7140a24019d384db5df21.jpg[/img]

At the foot of a low hill, you can feel the spirit of antiquity and see carved wooden serge poles and millennial deer stones, decorated with solar symbols and ritual signs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/952734a536967568abfb8fb995ef66578eef2b90.png[/img]

On a large pebble island overgrown with grass and bushes, there is a small boat station. Under a cliff in front of the island you can see a whirlpool, about which the locals can tell you several legends.
The harsh continental climate keeps Selenga in ice for almost six months, from November to April. Short but hot summers and cold harsh winters make [b]early autumn an ​​ideal time for fishing[/b]. However, September nights may already see some snow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4fb74286d821cb8e5d54d859e073307103b14068.jpg[/img]

[b]The Selenge teems with fish.[/b] In addition to the usual Pike and Burbot, its waters are home to many unique cold-loving fish, such as Arctic Grayling, Humpback Whitefish, Lenok, and Baikal Omul.
[b]However, the Selenge is also famous for having the largest fish of the salmon family![/b] Of course, we are talking about the king of all salmon — [b]Taimen[/b], whose weight can exceed 60 kilograms!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/51b459775c84097a3981e5c0bbd5ab59abc769aa.png[/img]
[b]Of course, in order to deal with such unique underwater dwellers, you will need new lures and baits.[/b]

Your collection of surface lures can be expanded with [b]mini-cranks[/b], ideal for catching predators who prefer to hunt in surface waters, and an [b]artificial mouse[/b], which will attract Taimen, as well as Lenok and Grayling.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d50779bd690dd38afb7087ebab3042abb8d94515.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3b62d8d07dca1e3660768b35a461ad78bc2916c2.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7677c3e381d30eb6f1037c0a72e5f73a278c2a8a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9eac255a54b068f06a1acfedbc2e61a5c29e2f61.png[/img][/url]
The new baits will include Curd Dough, [b]Oat-flakes[/b], [b]Bark Beetle Larva[/b], [b]Boiled Red Roe,[/b] Eurasian Minnow, and [b]Sideswimmers[/b], which will drive Baikal Omul crazy.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1adbf45bd7c316b7e29f3944bfef5d0d906bb80c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bdff78c9b8ac1db87d4a5d36d0ec4fb7636c45c5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4873f1fe05684d5917aa53ace6920279701e50b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a56eb39e69e451a8f136170e79fb7ea689f2319.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/66aef32f08e9db13bca5b74eb93e3587e72c5ff0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b7043b2c38d9446d40ce55e382f2544f5314aaaf.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/916e88173694fdaeefdb0578cb0da55f96a3f6cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/88dcd7941d210c7c0475a5444f796fee4b2e55a4.png[/img][/url]
In general, Mongolia is a very colorful and unusual place where you can not only enjoy the spirit of an ancient original culture (from Buddhist stupas, deer stones, and ruins of ancient temples to nomadic camps and traditional mouth harp music), but also get unique fishing trophies!

notes.title: Welcome Char Charger’s Open!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2c1c9468cd4a0a0431f23e15b23906b8c903cb53.png[/img]
Spring’s drawing to a close with summer about to take it’s rightful spot. What better way to close the season than with one of the most exciting Tournaments you’re gonna see this year! Char Chargers Open is all about catching the many fish pertaining to the Char genus, which means all your favorite kinds of Trout! Held on the North America’s top Trout fishing destinations - from the cold and beautiful banks of Alaska’s Kaniq Creek, to the breathtaking Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan and the snowy Canadian White Moose Lake, this exciting event will have you competing with fellow anglers in 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Final Round that’ll settle the dispute of who’s the Char Champion once and for all!

notes.title: World Bass Tour!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8bf6d7f2bbf67a1f1dbf94de734bca499c7aede5.png[/img]

Greetings to our beloved fishing community!

This April, get ready for a challenge! Dust off your best gear, hone your fishing skills, and enter the first world bass fishing tournament, the World Bass Tour!

Register for this exciting tournament and prove you can masterfully catch one of the most popular fish among America's sport anglers! And the feisty scaly creatures will make it interesting: this tournament promises to become the epicenter of action.

Three qualifying stages will determine 60 best anglers who will advance to the Semifinals. The top 20 anglers of the Semifinals will then compete in the final battle to become Bass Champion.

[b]Best anglers will get unique tackles as a reward: X-Series Missile™ 220, X-Series LanceCaster™ 6500, Rivertex™ WBT Bass Genius Cap[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4aa44ee0467c8fa135a49889c39dabaafe8d0e06.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33823249e97cde2ef6a6b8d05d2eadc1930b8951.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8cbd17535986eaec3b7e146917a6873384e3ba10.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/38bd26d93d6b4279532214bc0e958a7cedaaddd7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/92244bda8e8a6b0abd09466b10e7b08d48e9a893.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/87a3f18984c4cb5980452064d635fd2eab555e54.png[/img][/url]
Through the water expanses of the Everglades, the swampy shores of Louisiana, the tropical Marron River you’ll find yourselves in the Amazon jungle; and then be ready for the final battle on the Blue Crab Island, Mississippi!

[b]The tournament will last from April 12 through 17, with registration starting on April 11, one day before the first qualifying stage.[/b]

[b]Here’s the tournament schedule:[/b]

[list]
[*] April 12: Qualifier 1 at Everglades, Florida.
[*] April 13: Qualifier 2 on the swampy expanses of Quanchkin Lake, Louisiana.
[*] April 14: Qualifier 3 on the Marron River in northern Bolivia.
[*] April 16: Semifinals in the meandering streams of the Amazonian Maze in Brazil.
[*] April 17: Finals on the magical Blue Crab Island, Mississippi.
[*] Tight lines, anglers! Make sure you catch plenty of Bass!
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome World Cats Cup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c4bf202ca8f35cf1bdea88c93318b6923598aab5.png[/img]
Greetings, our dearest fishing community! This March, you will witness (and some of you even directly participate in) a truly historical event. Fishing Planet will hold its first bottom fishing tournament, World Cats Cup! Remember to register for this unique opportunity and take part in the new competitive event.

Have fun competing with other players and trying to catch the biggest fish! You will go on an exciting journey starting in North America, traveling through Europe, and finally reaching the waters of South America!

Fight for fame, recognition, and a prize pool of many Credits, BaitCoins, and unique fishing tackle, and most importantly — for the title of the first bottom fishing Champion!

[b]The tournament will last from March 15 through 20, with registration starting on March 14, one day before the first qualifying game.

Here’s the tournament schedule:[/b]

[list]
[*] March 15: Qualifier 1 at Saint Croix Lake in Michigan.
[*] March 16: Qualifier 2 on the beautiful Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany.
[*] March 17: Qualifier 3 on the swampy shores of Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[*] March 19: Semifinal on the tropical banks of the Marron River in Bolivia.
[*] March 20: Tournament Final in the winding streams of the Amazonian Maze in Brazil.
[*] Good luck to you! Make sure to catch plenty of Catfish!
[/list]

[b]The World Cats Cup Pack will be your reliable support in achieving this goal! This bundle contains everything you need for a bottom fishing tournament![/b]

notes.title: St.Patrick's Day: Kick the Snake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a1a75a9b4973779f5954291c410cf8915ff3d108.png[/img]
Get ready for a dizzying adventure on St. Patrick's Day, where you will need to show all your skill and luck!

Fight against the Snakeheads that have flooded the reservoirs and catch every single one of these nasty creatures!
[b]Event will be helded 10.03.2022 - 21.03.2022![/b]

Show off your boating skills and take part in the Rainbow Chase, where at the end of each race you will find a Leprechaun pot with gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a071fea839576fe2cade757fccddbe695df66e73.png[/img]

Try your luck in missions catching the Rowdy Bass, Leprechaun Fish, and Buzzman Tambaqui, and get Baitcoins for capturing them and Clover Coins for completing missions.

  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/be46904b4ba795fd08532ae2850a3e146fb71c76.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ecfdcfc9be8ea75f48a41e59bd50bc2546395748.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4bcc470e3f76f9cbbdcc98cd70f06493fc5fc2a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/69040703460d246e2970a4eae9f4ab877aaa63ef.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b44c08e7cb731028154c2c595687780beb50848.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e8268f2676e8f64815d464a66bb563d066443970.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea2dc0b90b52199a6a2b16b2d8c02a4f687da789.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1fcaa1e85116be6faf1ae0249583d52b3996506d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2337e43f1c66b9c943440e9fcdb909a78d540d54.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c868eddb031335df83dc5be7208d294a60c2d487.png[/img][/url]

Drive out the Snakeheads like St. Patrick drove out the Serpents and get a Leprechaun costume and St. Patrick's Song

Leprechaun Frock Coat, Paddy's Top Hat, Green Glasses

notes.title: We are Ukraine!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/29898bf415db995829ff872c89589f654e2400cf.png[/img]
[b]Hello, dear friends.[/b]
As many of you know major part of our team is located in Ukraine. On February 24th our reality has changed dramatically as Russia started full flagged war against Ukraine. Most of our team members woke up from explosions on the street and since then our life will never be the same.

Sorry for not getting in touch earlier, our primarily focus has been to take care of our team and families and get them to safety. We are monitoring the situation closely and adapting to the changes as quickly as possible.Though part of our team still remains in Kyiv, we manage to maintain the necessary viable operation. However the response time from our team might slow down, given the circumstances.

Russian invasion is an outrageous act of violence in the modern world. We are experiencing missile strikes on civil buildings in Kyiv and almos all cities in Ukraine, air raid sirens are going off not stop all over Ukraine. Killing civilians, shooting ambulances and bombing kindergartens and hospitals - these are some of humanitarian crimes Russia has conducted over the last 5 days.

We can’t remain indifferent and will support our nation and army in all ways possible. We believe in our armed forces and the bravery of our men and women. Ukraine will always fight for its freedom and independence!

[b]If you are willing to support Ukraine in our fight here are some ways how you can help:
[/b]
[url=https://bank.gov.ua/en/news/all/natsionalniy-bank-vidkriv-spetsrahunok-dlya-zboru-koshtiv-na-potrebi-armiyi ]NBU Account to raise funds for Ukraine’s Armed Forces[/url]
This account accepts multiple currencies. It has been established and opened to receive transfers from international partners and donors in both foreign currency (U.S. dollars, euros, UK pounds) and hryvnias.

notes.title: Welcome Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/97209adce5a6118f9accbfcb57c7ef1131d2b34f.png[/img]
Hey there, dear angling community!

This February you will witness history in the making, as Fishing Planet will be hosting Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour, the game’s first-ever feeder angling tournament!

Indeed, the competitive excitement of this new sportfishing event will overshadow everything else this month and stir up deeper emotions and feelings than the cheesy attributes of Valentine’s Day!  So don’t miss your chance to become a participant of this truly historic event and make sure to register in time!

You’ll have loads of fun angling in a thrilling competitive atmosphere, as you try to catching the biggest Bream imaginable! The heated fishing race of Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour will take you on an amazing adventure across Europe - from the Netherlands, to Germany and even Russia!

Do it in the name of Fame, Glory and a prize pool that includes plenty of Credits, BaitCoins, unique X-Series fishing tackles and equipment:

[b]First three finalists will get unique tackles: X-Series ChumChest™,  X-Series Whisperer™ 450, Rivertex™ BFFT Champion’s Cap[/b]

The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

[list]
[*] 22th of February - Qualifier 1 on Ghent–Terneuzen Canal in the Netherlands.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/28e687d163f13f1d5f6c03718e9a2fb9c6c3cb40.png[/img]

Hey anglers!
The Christmas and New Year holidays are over, which means it's time to plunge headlong into the exciting world of Fishing Planet tournaments again!

[b]What awaits you in 2022?[/b]

[b]This year, in addition to the tournaments you are already familiar with, we invite you to test your skills in three completely new tournaments:[/b]
[list]
[*] World Cats Cup
[*] World Bass Tour
[*] Topwater Kayak Cup
[/list]

[b]We have increased the size and quantity of prizes for all tournaments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rewards in Credits have been increased by 3 times at all stages;
[*] Adding X-Series items to rewards at all stages:
[*] - Qualifiers - for the first 3 places;
[*] - Semi-Finals and Finals - for the first 10 places;
[*] - The top-3 finalists will receive additional X-Series items;
[*] The size of rewards for the Semi-Final in Baitcoins has been increased up to 3 times.
[/list]

[i]*The cost of participation in tournaments has been increased to 25,000.[/i]

[b]We have also prepared new modes and competitive mechanics! So stay tuned for the tournament announcements![/b]

[h3][b]Tournaments list for 2022: [/b][/h3]
[b]January: January 18  - January 23 [/b]
Winter pike tour

[b]February: February 22 - February 27[/b]
Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour

[b]March: March 15 - March 20[/b] 
World Cats Cup

[b]April: April 12 - April 17[/b]
World bass tour

[b]May: May 18 - May 22[/b]
Char Charger's Open

[b]June: June 14 - June 19[/b]
Fishing Planet Boat Series

[b]July: July 5 - July 10[/b]
Independence Trout Open

[b]August: August 9 - August 14[/b]
Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup

[b]September: September 20 - September 25[/b]
Mighty Carp Tour

[b]October: October 19 - October 23[/b]
Gars & Glory Cup

[b]November: November 15 - November 20[/b]
Topwater Kayak Cup

[b]December: Dec 13 - Dec 18[/b]
Christmas Giant's Tour

You can try out new changes in a week at the first tournament of this year - Winter Pike Tour, where unique equipment awaits for the first three places of the final: [b]X-Series SuperHero ™ Angling Jacket, X-Series StrongShell ™ Rod Case, Rivertex ™ PikeGuru Cap.[/b]

[b]Prepare your best tackle to have a profitable and catchy year!
[/b]

notes.title: Welcome Wild Africa Pack!
notes.content:
Hey, anglers!
The atmosphere of African tropical fishing is bound to excite any avid angler. If you are captivated by the unique landscapes and peculiar wildlife of the Congo waters, then grab our new Wild Africa Pack and set off on a tropical journey! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1804840/Fishing_Planet_Wild_Africa_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/22781585f24ea5488861855a618c7929da7677ab.jpg[/img]
[/url]
The pack includes an extremely powerful and durable Nile Chasseur™ 190 SE spinning rod, a capacious GiantSpin™ 9000 SE reel, a set of high quality lures, and the wonderful Safari Pro vest. We've also thrown in the Advanced License and a 7-day Congo River Pass to make your African experience unforgettable!

notes.title: Merry Fishmas: Krampus Hunt
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/88627b7bb0e9c9479e2303c5330bd2e37b39b9a6.png[/img]

Hey, angling folks! Have yourself a great Christmas and join in on the Merry Fishmas: Krampus Hunt adventures with Fishing Planet! 
 
[b]The Christmas event starts on December 17th and will be available through January 4th.[/b] 

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! To save Christmas from the havoc created by the old Krampuses, you will require a special set of treats and tackle! A whole team of  the best elf engineers has worked with their magic tools and homemade goods to come up with this top-notch kit for your Christmas fishing adventure. The right combination of rods and reels will help you to return the things stolen by the elderly villains back to Santa! 
 
[b]Now, only YOU can save Christmas:[/b]
The elderly Krampus fishes have stolen Santa's attributes — glasses, beard and hat — and set off wreaking havoc in nearby waters. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46e76d0e19a9c35459eb4a90849ae5726313c9bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/802faddabaae76af191c5ec76fbf99bbe9914d33.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca2d8328381c66ed3f09531ed307eb2b5c79a0ac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d6680f2b81f369d46026e9195feb5bba15afce3b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/74d325f22ffb11716bcd6f3da60722357c004847.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46f4e8a111ee089ea04af12a9db7a7341fe5f0db.png[/img][/url]

You need to locate the old troublemakers, capture them and return the things they've stolen. 
You can find them by questioning their accomplices, who have decided to follow them and make mischief around. Because of their innate ability to lie, you'll have to catch a score of them. Get your rods ready!
 
[b]Magical Jukeboxes and new amazing baits will help you to attract the minions. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b178cdf4f8db8be7cbe8f41ecd580020fc2db65a.png[/img]

Activate Jukeboxes by using Christmas tokens**. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/123a2fa6d521514634d80f0d87ed684aa2bd9b5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/da1c404fefeda6cce7e305aeb5429d7b8ac40ce0.png[/img][/url]
*Settled on all event locations.
** Get Christmas tokens by completing the event missions. 
 
[b]What Christmas without snowballs. Collect snow and make snowballs.[/b] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6088174476f0f115df503960d85206fd6e26d4f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5c3bed08c5d159d2aa5240c78f9ed0bfbcb7071f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4a310218fee79d1d662c7ca858bb716d21c05b43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/490a9bab923159eb3fb99d29584a25c7a5f59a4d.png[/img][/url]
 
Do not forget about [b]Christmas gifts[/b], that you can find at every event location. Just check Gift Boxes and Christmas Stockings. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1f59ed87fbca65f1e4665e33422269394ab098cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b3ad9574eea7166b32eb8cc1fcf795863e132e68.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a761d688112f6cd835683361e311ec0875468358.png[/img]

[b]The White Moose will also please you with the good old Crystal Burbot, fantastic Antlered Salmon, and Furry Trout![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ff34580bd87488436ecf6da18dd5e20f56c3851.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome Christmas Giant’s Tour!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d3fc80aa23ffde36752b3d9e6ca445bf3630d8e5.png[/img]

Hello guys! This time we’d like to tell you the most sizable Tournament of the year - the Christmas Giant’s Tour! This event isn’t about any particular kind of fish, the key rule here is: the bigger the better...and not just big...but GIGANTIC! Yep, we’re talking super-huge Trophy-sized monsters: Trout, Pike, Salmon, Burbot, Catfish, Muskies, Bass, Gar, Snook, Dolly Varden...the list can go on and on! It’s not the name, it's the size that matters. Yep, this is the big league, boys and girls and we’re doing some heavyweight fishing! Tight lines!
[b]Christmas Giant’s Tour will be held December 14th through December 19th, with the Registration starting on December 13th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The CGT Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 13th of December - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 14th of December - Qualifier 1 on on the snowy White Moose Lake way out in Canada.
[*] 15th of December - Qualifier 2 on on Michigan’s Saint-Croix Lake. 
[*] 16th of December - Qualifier 3 on Florida’s Everglades.
[*] 18th of December - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizingly beautiful Kaniq Creek in Alaska.
[*] 19th of December - the Grand Finale on California’s San Joaquin Delta.
[/list]

[b]Enjoy your chance to get Christmas Giant's Pack with all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need![/b]

notes.title: Patch Note 4.0.1
Release note 4.0.0: Congo River, Africa!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a989f7aa575c2ee3d4364a6e65663d324bd5dc31.png[/img]

Hey, anglers!
We are happy to present to you the update we have been working on for the last 6 months.

[b]This Patch includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New location: Congo River, Africa.
[*] New level cap
[*] 17 unique African fish
[*] New tackles
[*] New competitions and achievements
[*] Graphics optimization and Graphics improvements
[*] Bugfix.
[/list]
[b]New maximum level increased up to 80.
Congo river access level - 75[/b]

[h3]Welcome Congo River![/h3]

We are happy to announce that now you can enjoy fishing in [b]the heart of Africa - Congo River[/b]! Welcome 7 unique locations with 17 species of unique African fish, which can’t be found anywhere else in the world, a bunch of new tackles and baits, unique African flora, and fauna, that will bring your fishing experience to a new level!
 
[b]More information about the new waterway in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3101284846821379798]Dev's Diaries[/url]![/b]

[b]You can explore the variety of the Congo River on 7 locations[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Cable Ferry[/b][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1bc485732227c518419084d52a7499919cdf2193.png[/img]
The north of the reservoir houses a small boat dock. Local anglers are just about the only people you would meet here, as they use it to secure their distinctive long boats. Although this place might seem unremarkable at first, it’s quiet and calm, and everything allows for a leisurely fishing experience.
[list]
[*][b] Waterfall Roar[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/44febb753d1bf341f3e903ebe1281ca209c22c46.png[/img]
Island Mabanga, situated in the southern central part of the water body, owes its name to the fact that it’s made up of stone slabs and boulders. Local anglers know it as a great place to hunt for Tigerfish, because these predators are attracted by the fast current just before the waterfalls. Make sure your tackle is sturdy enough to hold the feisty fish, and enjoy the exciting fight as you listen to the waterfall’s roar and tropical bird calls.
[list]
[*] [b]Local School[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c4ab2ec0ace1877173d1cdf85a317c4da5fdf4f.png[/img]
Situated among palm trees on the east bank of the river is a small local school, attended by children from nearby villages. A neat stone church is located nearby, where parishioners from the surrounding area come every Sunday to listen to the sermon and discuss the latest news. This well-tended place puts you in the mood for pleasant contemplation of nature and peaceful fishing.
[list]
[*][b] Wild Islands[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/35648099ec6e2f34e9dc23273bfdb3fd45c3b6d4.png[/img]
If you want to leave behind the frantic turmoil of civilization just for a day, welcome to the Wild Islands, located in the western part of the river. Local fish enjoy hiding in thickets of underwater grass and among numerous stumps, snags and tree roots growing right in the waters.
[list]
[*][b] Bomuna Settlement[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8bd6c31bd6b3fb3b2b2f6b06a9954271f71636f8.png[/img]
The village of Bomuna is located on the eastern bank of the Congo. Early in the morning, local anglers leave their ramshackle clay houses, set off from an old wooden dock in their dugout canoes, and fish using methods that haven’t changed since ancient times. 
[list]
[*] [b]Forgotten Village[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ba8f6abaa432b7c6d52ec2a2a070496dbfb40613.png[/img]
This abandoned fishing settlement is situated on the western bank directly opposite the local village. It’s not possible to fish from the shore, since it’s too swampy to land. If you decide to go around the village using the wooden pier, be careful: it regularly suffers from the river pushing against it, and only rare anglers walk on its decaying planks.
[list]
[*] [b]Hanging Bridges[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4093f0a4f6e3ba3e3487949e75778d84e6f960a7.png[/img]
This multi-level intricate network of suspended bridges has transformed a group of islands in the center of the pool into a real labyrinth. Only locals know which bridges lead to which islands. But on the other hand, this amazing place makes it possible to feel like a real discoverer, since each path can take you to a secluded fishing nook that is so exciting to explore.
