notes.title: Congo Fish: Detailed guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7d77b48e14bf6fa56cde33bbed79f99273ada7fc.png[/img]

Hi, Anglers!
We are happy to present you with a detailed guide to all the unique fish that you can find on the Congo River!

Local fishing spots are astonishingly varied. Deep mainstream watercourses are as common as wide swampy shoals, while heavily wooded banks give place to barren and rocky ones. In these generous waters, one can hunt for the enormous Nile Perch, aggressive Tigerfish, large African catfish species, and other fish of the most bizarre shapes and colors.

At this colorful location, you will have a possibility to fish for the record amount of unique fish presented on one waterway!  


[h2][b]Big African Predators[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Lures:[/b]
Jerkbaits, Minnnows, Flat Spoons

[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Small Tilapia, Large Minnows

[h3][b]Goliath Tigerfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f60fa80522474268377c11463d2fe92ea6edd398.png[/img]
The Goliath Tigerfish (Hydrocynus goliath) is the largest of Tigerfish species, all of which are vicious predators boasting prominent dagger-like teeth. It tends to wait in ambush behind underwater boulders in places with reverse flow near rapids and quickwaters. This fish enjoys excellent eyesight and can feel low-frequency vibrations emitted by its prey. It is strong enough to attack a 30-kg (66 lb) catfish and literally cut it in half.
The Goliath Tigerfish is also incredibly large: the largest recorded specimen was almost 2 m (6 feat) long and weighed more than 50 kg (110 lb)! It’s not easy to catch it, but it’s possible if you have reliable equipment, a sharp hook, and the ability to stay alert for a long time.

[h3][b]African Tigerfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/83f748009fd7583be2fcee12dd1b3b53358b7e1f.png[/img]
The African Tigerfish (Hydrocynus vittatus) is a large, greedy, and aggressive predator, sporting razor-sharp teeth, muscular body, and characteristic tiger-stripes. This fish can hunt at all depths, usually in places with a strong current, keeping closer to the surface during the day and staying at the bottom at night. When being reeled in, the Tigerfish (one of the fastest fish species on the planet) is extremely feisty, often jumps out of the water, and can easily cut the leader! It feeds on most small fish species and can weigh over 25 kg (55 lb).

[h3][b]Nile Perch[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f4db88046399a8fb92d44e9ee864e947ff4acaa0.png[/img]
Nile Perch (Lates niloticus) is a powerful predator inhabiting the waters of Africa. These fish can dwell at a wide variety of depths, but adults stay mainly in deep places. It prefers streaming water and is most often found in places with a rocky bottom near waterfalls. It avoids shallow overgrown areas. The Nile Perch feeds both during the day and at night. When being reeled in, it tends to jump out of the water.
It feeds mainly on other fish, while small specimens also eat crustaceans and insects. As one of the largest freshwater fish, it can grow to be almost 2 m (6.5 feats) long and weigh up to 200 kg (441 lb)!


[h2][b]African Predators[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Lures:[/b]
Narrow Spoons, Flat Spoons, Grubs

[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Small Minnows, Shiners

[h3][b]Cornish Jack[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b4e77213f7bb11f7dd4dc371863aa1b8ce47bac5.png[/img]
Cornish Jack (Mormyrops anguilloides) is a nocturnal schooling predator. Adults prefer deep and calm waters and tend to stay near boulders and other underwater barriers. A distinctive feature of this fish is its ability to generate a weak electrical discharge for the purpose of navigation, communication, and searching for prey. Its diet is predominantly fish and sometimes crustaceans. At night, these fish go hunting in small schools near rocky areas of the bottom about 20 m (65 feats) from their daytime dwelling spots. Although this is a nocturnal fish, you can successfully land one at sunrise and sunset. The Cornish Jack grows up to be 150 cm (60 inches) in length and weighs up to 15 kg (33 lb)!

[h3][b]African Pike[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/26d9ce0a087a09562648192740be24c6dc0b5677.png[/img]
African Pike (Hepsetus odoe) is a small predator that feeds mainly on small fish. This nimble hunter prefers clean and well-oxygenated water. These pikes choose shallow, calm places with dense underwater or floating vegetation, from the cover of which they wait patiently and imperceptibly for an opportunity to attack their prey. The African Pike is mostly diurnal. Although the fish rarely weighs more than 1 kg (2 lb), catching it can be quite fun.


[h2][b]Big African Catfish[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Small Tilapia, Large Minnows, Buffalo Kidney, Large Liver, Canned Meat,  African Giant Water Bug

[h3][b]African Sharptooth Catfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fed4967909c88ad0d7ecdd0307122b681d6d31bb.png[/img]
African Sharptooth Catfish (Clarias gariepinus) is one of the largest representatives of its genus inhabiting this latitude. It prefers deep areas with a slow or medium current and a rocky or sandy bottom. Thanks to its large mouth this predator can swallow large prey whole. Its maximum length can reach 170 cm (67 inches), with its weight measuring up to 60 kg (132 lb)! What is particular about the African Sharptooth Catfish is its ability to breathe atmospheric air. It can also sometimes make sounds similar to loud croaking.
The African Sharptooth Catfish is omnivorous and most active at night. It feeds on water beetles, mollusks, fish, vegetation, and even organic waste.

[h3][b]Vundu Catfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/26fb2fb36480fcb54f9db4853409a9ab088f7f90.png[/img]
Vundu Catfish (Heterobranchus longifilis) is a large catfish inhabiting the south of Africa. Its size makes it an impressive catch for sport fishing enthusiasts! Not many other catfish species have such large second dorsal fins or long barbels. This one prefers staying 3 to 9 m deep. Just like the African Sharptooth Catfish, this one is omnivorous and can breathe atmospheric air. Boasting significant strengths and endurance, it can reach up to 150 cm (60 includes) in length and weigh over 50 kg (110 lb), so make sure to use particularly sturdy tackle! The Vundu Catfish enjoys deep waters, but it tends to approach the shore during the night to feed on other fish, small vertebrae, and viscera.

[h3][b]Kamba Catfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/99ee0b345cf9adfd94d41006c8da3df52c9eb276.png[/img]
Kamba Catfish (Chrysichthys cranchii) is the largest African catfish. It has a moderately oblong body and four pairs of barbels, and its dorsal and pectoral fins boast sharp barbs. This fish has a varied diet: it can feast on anything from aquatic vegetation and insects to snails, prawns, crawfish, and fish. To catch an adult Kamba Catfish, we recommend choosing powerful tackle, since its weight can reach about 130 kg (286 lb)!


[h2][b]Small African Catfish[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Freshwater Prawns, Night Crawlers, Bloodworms, Leeches, Caddis Larva

[h3][b]Giraffe Catfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1c60e5666b94144ecaea86479cdb96ca96965daa.png[/img]
Giraffe Catfish (Auchenoglanis occidentalis) is a small catfish species inhabiting most areas in West and Central Africa. It prefers to stay in shallow and calm parts of rivers and lakes. It is active at night as well as during the day. Its body is covered with a characteristic pattern, lending it the name ‘Giraffe Catfish’. It can reach 70 cm (27 inches) in size and weigh up to 10 kg (22 lb). 
These omnivorous catfish feed in small groups, usually on vegetation they find on the bottom, sifting through sand or mud with their large barbels. Their regular diet also includes seeds, larvae, worms, and small fish.

[h3][b]African Big Eye Catfish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/41bd9d248fab0c1097dca216abac229a64211704.png[/img]
African Big Eye Catfish (Chrysichthys longipinnis) is a small representative of its genus that prefers to inhabit shallow stretches with a rocky and sandy bottom. That’s why it can seldom be seen in waters deeper than 4–5 m  (13-16 feats). The African Big Eye Catfish is most active at night, choosing to spend the daytime under the bottom rocks. It mainly feeds on worms and other small invertebrates, while larger 
specimens might also hunt for small fry.


[h2][b]African Panfish[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Bloodworms, Pinkies, Caddis Larva, Sweet Corn, Pea dough, Banana Bread

[h3][b]Rednose Labeo[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5f353676496f2133f8dfd92e6c1c8599c16634af.png[/img]
Rednose Labeo (Labeo altivelis) is a bottom-dwelling omnivorous fish of the carp family. It can be found in shallow areas, but mainly inhabits deep waters. It is active both during the day and at night. This fish feeds in schools across various types of bottom, from muddy to rocky. Rednose Lobeo eats algae, worms, small crustaceans, and mollusks, which it collects from the bottom.

[h3][b]Purple Labeo[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9c242c3f2e6bea98eae81620d302c69ff5c49825.png[/img]
Purple Labeo (Labeo congoro) is a relatively large bottom-dwelling omnivorous African fish of the carp family. It tends to stay in warm rocky areas of large rivers. It can also be found in fairly strong currents.
Purple Labeo can reach 42 cm (16 inches) in length and almost 5 kg (11 lb) in weight. It feeds on algae and other organisms, scrubbing them off boulders and other hard surfaces. A distinctive feature of this fish’s behavior is school feeding off the backs of hippos, where the Labeos pluck algae and peeled skin from the animals.

[h3][b]Banded Tilapia[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1d251c435c8bc8cf2721055499f0fae6f47f85fb.png[/img]
Banded Tilapia (Tilapia sparrmanii) is a small schooling diurnal fish. It can live in a wide variety of conditions, but prefers shallow, overgrown places with relatively cool water. The fish is omnivorous and not picky. It can feed on invertebrates, but the basis of its diet is plant food: algae, leaves and stems that have fallen into the water. It can reach over 20 cm (8 inches) in length and about 500 g (1 lb) in weight.

[h3][b]Nile Tilapia[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/502ae8aa95feb5c4e304e8331b50aa32ddc67b24.png[/img]
Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is a large herbivorous schooling fish that can be found in a variety of conditions and reservoirs. Generally, it prefers shallow places and warm water. This fish can reach 60 cm (24 inches) in length and about 5 kg (11 lb) in weight. Nile Tilapia feeds mainly in the daytime, eating detritus, larvae, mollusks, and fish eggs in all layers of the water.


[h2][b]Weird African Fish[/b][/h2]
[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Wax Worms, Caster Maggots, Bloodworms, Caddis Larva, Centipedes
 
[h3][b]Bulldog Fish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1fb5984019631ff6353a14417659bfa744a7e6df.png[/img]
Bulldog Fish (Marcusenius macrolepidotus) is a small bottom-dwelling schooling fish that inhabits overgrown, muddy areas of waterways. This peculiar fish got its name due to its extended lower jaw, which resembles that of a bulldog. It uses its own electric field generated by its muscles to orient itself in space, search for food, and detect predators. It is active both during the day and at night. It feeds mainly from the bottom, picking up various invertebrates, as well as larvae and pupae of small insects.

[h3][b]Elephant Fish[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d41c444d533eb39f16fb8a5d43b1676a9ca7eb6f.png[/img]
Elephant Fish (Campylomormyrus spp.) is a medium-sized bottom-dwelling schooling fish with a characteristic appearance. It got its name from its elongated mouth that looks like the trunk of an elephant. The fish can perceive movement and weak electric fields with its help, allowing it to detect prey. It can weigh more than 2 kg (4.5 lb). This fish prefers to keep close to rapids and sections of rivers with rocky bottom. This is mostly a nocturnal fish, also active at sunrise and sunset.

[h3][b]Congo Yellowfish[/b][/h3]
[b]Preferred Lures:[/b]
Nano Spinners, Larvae, Worms, Slugs

[b]Preferred Baits:[/b]
Night Crawlers, Dragonflies, Caddis Larva, Sweet Corn

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/61153f0cdb975e706418bdad62d72595e8155130.png[/img]
Congo Yellowfish (Labeobarbus stappersii) is a large omnivorous schooling bottom-dwelling fish. It prefers deep places with a slow current and areas near the water edge bordering on coastal forests.
Apart from its impressive size, this fish is also exceptionally strong and very feisty when being reeled in, which makes it a desirable trophy. It eats everything from plankton to small fish, but the basis of its diet is insect larvae and other small invertebrates, which the Congo Yellowfish often digs out from under rocks. This fish is active both during the day and at night. Under favorable conditions, its weight can reach over 9 kg (2 lb).

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d002af0cdae92aec1c2368bda4a4592de6d65eda.png[/img]

Bass fishing is quite an art of its own! And since Fishing Planet wants to help you become a more versatile bass angler, we decided to host a very special Bass tournament, dedicated entirely to Smallmouth Bass! As any Bass angler knows, Smallies are angrier and much more fierce opponents than their Largemouth relatives, which makes the Tournament even more of a fun challenge! So whether you’re a mastermind Bass angler or just getting started in Smallmouth fishing, don’t hesitate to go on this competitive fishing journey for an exciting trip through some breathtaking fishing destinations - from the deep blue waters of Oregon’s Falcon Lake and the the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California in the two Qualifiers, to for the Semifinal Round on Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and over to the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Smallmouth anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Smallmouth fishing Champion and many valuable prizes! 

[b]Grand Smallie’s Cup will be held November 24st through November 28th, with the Registration starting on November 23th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]

[*] 27th of November - Semifinal Round on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix.

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Congo River, Africa
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d4b40071583399ea0a6592315481085cb6949e1c.png[/img]

[b]Hello anglers![/b]

A lot of time has passed since our last Diary. We wasted no time and can finally tell you about our new big update that we’ve prepared for you — the Congo River!

You will be able to explore the Congo River on Steam late November — early December!

[b]Here, in the heart of Africa, the vast tropical rainforest covers both banks of the great Congo River, the deepest river in the world.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/717f53b051831ed36bf1fd03fe3308f9cd5d6e8a.png[/img]

This unique biome is home to hundreds of unique mammals and thousands of bird and fish species.

This is where the last corners of the wild, unexplored nature are hidden.

[b]So what can our anglers expect from the Congo River?[/b]

In its middle reaches (just below Boyoma Falls), the river flows through the territory of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and consists of a chain of lake-like pools with a huge number of islands overgrown with tropical forests and impassable swampy stretches of land.

[b]The pond is located on the equator, that’s why the weather is hot all year round. Frequent fogs and strong intermittent rains give way to heat and high humidity. But then the low water season (or dry season) comes, bringing excellent conditions for fishing![/b]

The pond is practically devoid of emergent vegetation. High coastal grass only grows near the banks, in shallow creeks and channels, resembling a thick wall.

Running muddy water flows north to south, characterized by a weak current in wide areas and a medium current in narrow stretches.

[b]The average depth of the river in these places is about 4–7 meters. And on vast shoals and in narrow channels, the depth ranges from 1.5 to 3 meters.[/b]

The bottom of the central deep-water channels is mainly clay-earthen, with small sandy areas. However, on the shores overgrown with grass, as well as in shallow bays and creeks, it is muddy. The southern part of the pond features a rocky bottom.

[b]At the Congo River, we have prepared as many as seven locations. There are few of them:[/b]

[b] 
Cable Ferry

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed3ab350605e1cdb50d4396026fa9ac5575fb980.jpg[/img]

Wild Islands

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/38aede746010d14b8052f6ec3c295be756375026.jpg[/img]

Bomuna Settlement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7655677bbe1bb6cd244bb01b66fc1dca8a6fd4ac.jpg[/img]

Hanging Bridges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3303bbe12ea6f0baaf84c75f84c5ac0d0d66fa41.jpg[/img]

The Congo is generally not the easiest place to fish, and you’ll have to do your best, but your efforts will be rewarded many times over! After all, we have introduced 17 absolutely new species of fish, including some unique African endemics such as:
 the [b]Nile Perch[/b], which can reach a weight of about 200 kilograms, 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d9e91f1bd58c7e2de040f07eea7f6311989426b1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ff25b8b1b91b7a19af2641c04313b5b28868aab8.png[/img][/url]

as well as the [b]Goliath Tigerfish [/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2a8107beafc99ea0fc5d11083e4c675e1d9483f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a66d90cc8d6410c90ad0c468b96124e4f061cc2d.png[/img][/url]

and the [b]African Tigerfish[/b]! 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4f2a47c85c70a8697432fbf39319f8d5fed2f85d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f19cb512c69dd3030e628c1171b401a5794bb128.png[/img][/url]

[b]And believe us, these are some of the most coveted trophies for anglers from all over the world![/b]

Of course, we couldn't leave you unequipped for battles with such monsters. 
[b]That’s why we’ve prepared some unique baits for you, such as Caddis Larva, African Giant Water Bug, and Banana Bread.[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e43f23e286d425445b5571d258ba409c2411638.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b5dbe83ea08370567368f4895fe18297187d14ea.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/711ca6aad4b6cbfd7b7d75c23ed6f15af9e50db3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bef4b010262ddb2ffb1acdca496076e92510d57f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1319233332854da31f95c5573c1983ee70aad2ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/869df3bb9df385eda6609064023181a2a6c7cacd.png[/img][/url]

[b]In addition to that, you’ll be able to use some real delicacies when fishing for the voracious African predators:[/b] Canned Meat, Buffalo Kidney, and Small Tilapia.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2d5f2e50a761c76a51d0a2b6fca7d74f9607124f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3282a63a00c0e46fab9fda76d57664744fa6db9a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2e28a4b8f0bfd68d5c5535a66bd3f15b5c4ebe56.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b8592c6f6a80452fa1c447efa13b367523e5e963.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a039382842b571920e671f62389159c5a31d423.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/53f3e7b0860128b22edec36f98fdd2b6795c0f06.png[/img][/url]

[b]So get your best gear ready, friends! After all, you’re about to have the opportunity to explore these amazing fishing grounds and test your skills on the African continent![/b]

notes.title: Welcome Halloween 2021: CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a35e82932ae55631758cda4e49e8d3397d841bde.png[/img]

Hey, Anglers! Get ready for Halloween’s horrifying fishing and frightful adventures!
[b]This awesome event is waiting for you on Steam, PS4 and Xbox![/b]
Complete dreadfully creepy missions to catch the abominable Frankenfish and get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward!
[list]
[*] Hunt for Ghost Pikes, Monster Gars and Skeleton Bluegills to complete cool Halloween challenges.
[*] Look for Tombstones and Vicious Pumpkins to get some awesome angling loot!
[*] Join the festive kayak race at Emerald, Falcon, Saint-Croix and San Joaquin.
[/list]
[i]The event will be  active until 6 a.m. UTC, November 3. [/i]
Behold the abominable Frankenfish - a scary and gruesome monster-fish boss that came to life as a result of a bizarre prank-gone-wrong! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed74bc701e541af474bb890348d61f72dc92a0b3.png[/img]
*This year you will have a chance to conquer Frankenfish again using new additions to our traditional Halloween potion!

[b]What a holiday without your favorite and terrifying missions![/b]

This frightful monster will devour anything alive, even humans! So it’s up to you to go on an epic adventure to summon and defeat the horrid beast:

[b][list]
[*]Retrieve the Book of Recipes from the Quanchkin Witch to brew the summoning potion!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aa5258702d9a0bb66a0e3205911390f13f3c02cb.png[/img][/url]

[*]Find the magic Witching Cauldron somewhere on the islands of San Joaquin and get all of the ingredients!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1569391312d29723e35f107fcd49578e72392753.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b96d9fb0e1c9e0f69217f51e430815614539935.png[/img][/url]

[*]Brew the Summoning Potion to summon and defeat the Frankenfish!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f5a264713d4f2df08f56ffff5676956fa4630477.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3213e10094e4183fa5b2722b45eda27fc886c321.png[/img][/url]

[*][b]Halloween 2021 will surprise you with a new kayak race which will make you  thrilled.[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b6cfa69a140ceab2326dfc47b92d01533dec059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18d1272d6fb6cb3c5aad5851211c06a80210826c.png[/img][/url]
[*] The winner will get the unique Vampire Glasses and Pond Passes to event ponds. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7a43f3398d93b6a0846fb4a2de4b739b5824ca85.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5554783249a27513bacd465a187f3c991719f3a.png[/img][/url]
This will be spook-tacular!
[/list][/b]
*It is the only few of a bunch of Halloween's missions you need to complete.

[b]Only you can put an end to its bloody rule once and for all! Conquer the monster to get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/976d5c2fe378130224c9b4328a9b799c927b0925.png[/img]

Also do not forget to Set out on a night hunt after the mysterious glowing Ghost Pike,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/54b2952c595ec24697a13c5343b0d1813faef72e.png[/img]
 catch terrifying Skeleton Bluegills,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f6b3f8d98a4fe4b491b9b558ffe7a76acfa55c.png[/img]

[b]and fierce Monster Gars:[/b]
 [list]
[*]Albino Yeti Gar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b561a98c571d8d1680e0d3e6677e9ab2773dcec.png[/img]
[*]Green Ogre Gar 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfe64b7360ae47c472bee57c0052a18c68aa9d2e.png[/img]
[*]Black Vampire Gar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d309ef7fa6a15791c0480396371efd050126cc19.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Be careful, because all fish monsters are going out for a hunt at night![/b]

Also do not forget about our cool tackle like the Ghost Reel™ 4000 spinning reel and the SpookySpin™ 260 spinning rod with a glow-in-the-dark tip, as well as creepy lures like the Bony Shad, Spider Spoon, and Slimy Crank and Halloween pumpkin jellies Candy bait and Veins Leader!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/48e324b7a3b281aae755d6cf14cb18ea5c751a51.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5542a0be5454963e57fa3d9c9c36dd3756bf645f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c0a8ffca9f35826d920d8edf3184e0020fe2a582.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37090a740a682f9c3fbc30c2be9b674be28e0d90.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2aef26e915cd542ac1966ffea7079cad4ba33ded.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/17f0136b97d121619fce638201ecaf1ec6435319.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/177dc7191eaed771f0447e1fde341d4962c0350f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/25a5d4df5849f50c907dead88712c0c8b094f2e8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0a3349eb5ea06173b99a888d4b1e6d861b9ccd62.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/cf4aabdf6cac13facf7301ce4d4fe10fdcf626e7.png[/img][/url]

[b]You can rent a special Coffin Kayak - available only for the duration of the Halloween event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/da410ecd3d0dd5880f23704b0cc6bb9d7ada3fa0.png[/img]

And make sure to find all the Jack-o-lanterns and graves hidden at various fishing destinations to claim your daily prizes!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/37dd95356d1872d305fe1e432aba00306c3a617d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9d9354ba0d92e46a227b1affdb7bf80053aa8017.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9f67e9aa169f9d1e7d2e8d8e347e5418c64d459d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/645ec42f6e8b472c5a6e0218e960b3e435d71882.png[/img][/url]

[b]Yep, this year’s [b]CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH[/b] Halloween promises to be a real adventure quest that’ll scare you out of your fishing wits!

Enjoy your chance to get a whole bundle of goods including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need!  

[b]Spooky Fishing Pack and Tricky Treats Pack will help conquer the Frankenfish and complete all Halloween missions!
[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/591985/Fishing_Planet_Spooky_Fishing_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c31e50c986af451dc02507a8366bafd3c3eb132f.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/730615/Fishing_Planet_Tricky_Treats_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/15225dfd52c03b8c6595e5090faaa8e4e8995d02.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Gars&Glory Cup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea610bcb6939690747cb24b6928c75ecfccbcba2.png[/img]

Looks like this October will see Halloween overshadowed by a far more exciting event! Forget Trick-or-Treating and better do some real monster fighting, cuz you’re in for the ultimate Gar tournament! But don’t let these powerful giants make you forget that you also have other opponents, represented by some of the best anglers walking our Planet! Make sure to register and head out on the most exciting competitive journey of your life as you travel through some of North America’s top Gar fishing destinations - from the luscious green wetlands of Florida’s Everglades, on to the banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River and finally to face the Top-20 Gar fighters in the swampy wilderness of Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake! Compete against the most ferocious opponents and make your glorious way through the 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Great Finale that’ll show who’s who on the monster fishing arena!
Gars&Glory Cup will be held October 13th through October 17th, with the Registration starting on October 12th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 12th of October - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 13th of October - Qualifier 1 on the Everglades.
[*] 14th of October - Qualifier 2 on Neherrin River. 
[*] 16th of October - Semifinal Round in the marshy wetland of Lake Quanchkin.
[*] 17st of October - the Grand Finale on Quanchkin Lake.
[/list]

Only for the duration of the tournament, you can get special tour pack

Hey anglers!
Many of you were asking about a new update, and we are happy to present you with our new feature!
[b]Twitch Drops are now available in Fishing Planet. [/b]
Now you can claim in-game rewards not only by playing Fishing Planet by watching your favorite streamers*!
Twitch Drops campaigns are a new and fun way to get in-game rewards! 
[b]To claim rewards you need to do a few steps:[/b]
[list]
[*] First of all, you should have a Fishing Planet account on Steam. 
[*] Connect your account Fishing Planet account with your Twitch account [url=https://twitch.fishingplanet.com/]HERE[/url] it will automatically recommend you to connect your Steam account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea2897708018d133aa4cac6410385434144f825f.jpg[/img]

[*] link your Twitch account.
[*] And do not forget to press “Link Account”
[/list]
Now you can find Fishing Planet Streamers and claim rewards after watching their streams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f0cc51c2f0a161738cf9daaf1fe1f9d039c3e46b.jpg[/img]

You will see a message at the top of the chat about the Drop campaign and how to earn rewards.

The campaign starts on 29.09.2021 at 15:00 UTC
End of the campaign on 03.10.2021 at 23:00 UTC

Please note that you will get a reward on your account only after restarting your game!
P.S.: We are happy to get feedback from you! Please share your ideas and experience with us.

Although somewhat undervalued in North America, this all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some of the world's most amazing fishing destinations - from the Italian charm of the Tiber River, the sunny magnificence of San Joaquin Delta in USA and hardcore reality of the Russian Akhtuba River in the first three Qualifiers, to the vast openness of German Sander Baggersee Lake for the Semifinal Round and finally, the enigmatic Weeping Willow Lakes fishery in Great Britain, where the ultimate Top-20 Carp catchers will have the chance to fight in the Grand Finale for the title of 

[i]Mighty Carp Master!  Mighty Carp Tour will be held September 14th through September 19th, with the Registration starting on September 13th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.[/i]

[b] The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 13th of September - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 14th of September - Qualifier 1 on the Tiber River in Italy. 
[*] 15th of September - Qualifier 2 on San Joaquin Delta in California, USA.
[*] 16th of September - Qualifier 3 on Akhtuba River in Russia.
[*] 18th of September - Semifinal Round on Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany.
[*] 19th of September - the Grand Finale on the Weeping Willow Lakes fisheries in the UK.
[/list]

Welcome to Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup - a special Sportfishing Tournament that we’re hosting to celebrate our yearly anniversary of the Game going live! Catch Salmon in various beautiful destinations like White Moose Lake, San Joaquin Delta and Lake Saint-Croix and prepare for an unforgettable Grand Finale in Alaska, on the mesmerizing Kaniq Creek, as you make your way from the Qualifiers to the Semifinal and Final rounds and become the Salmon fishing Champion!

notes.title: Independence Trout Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/781759f8474c4e3faf0a51bd474b6fb58cf94777.png[/img]

Hey, angling community! Join us this July 4th for an epic anglers’ celebration of Independence Day by taking part in the Independence Trout Open, the festive Trout sportfishing tournament hosted annually by Fishing Planet! Really, what could be better than spending a great all-American holiday in good company amidst thrilling competitive excitement?
So don’t hesitate to register and celebrate Independence Day by heading out on a fun and challenging competitive fishing journey that will take you through some of greatest Trout fishing locations in North America! First you’ll go from the Canadian snowy charm of White Moose Lake to the vastness of Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and the enigmatic banks of Colorado’s Rocky Lake in the three Qualifiers, then on to the picturesque shores of Oregon’s Falcon Lake for the Semifinal Round and the tournament’s Grand Finale, in which 20 best Trout anglers will fight their final battle for the title of Independence Trout Champion and many valuable prizes! 
Independence Trout Open will be held July 2th through July 7th, with the Registration starting on July 1rd, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 28th of June - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 29th of June - Qualifier 1 on Colorado’s Rocky Lake.
[*] 30th of June - Qualifier 2 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
[*] 1st of July - Qualifier 3 on Alberta’s White Moose Lake.
[*] 3rd of July - Semifinal Round on Falcon Lake in Oregon. 
[*] 4th of July - the Grand Finale on Oregon’s Falcon Lake.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome First Boat Tournament: Fishing Planet Boat Series
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4be0410aecc7595f6c021e7e9d61e2260260ae08.png[/img]

We welcome all anglers on this beautiful day and are happy to share some news with you! In June, Fishing Planet locations will host a boat predators tournament – Fishing Planet Boat Series. If a regular fishing trip feels boring to you, if you want to show off your honed skills, if you love the spirit of competition – this is for you! Don’t waste your time: go register for the Tournament. Prove to everyone that you are the best angler and earn not only recognition but also fantastic prizes, including Credits, BaitCoins and unique items. And three best Champions will become proud owners of new X-Series Bass Boats! Participants and spectators will have a whole week to enjoy the thrill of the fight. The tournament will take place at picturesque locations in the US, Germany and Russia. However, you will hardly have time to enjoy the view, since the clash is likely to turn fierce! You will be fishing for the toughest predators using a spinning or casting rod from your boat. The type of the qualifying fish depends on the location. The Tournament will take place from June 15rd through 20th. Over this period we’ll hold Qualifiers, Semi-Finals and Finals. 

You need to register 24 hours before Qualifiers start – don’t miss the deadline! The first registration begins on June 14nd.

[b]Dates of the Tournament:[/b]

[list]
[*] Qualifier 1 at the picturesque Saint-Croix Lake, Michigan 15.06
[*] Qualifier 2 amid the Bavarian views of Lake Sander Baggersee in Germany 16.06*
[*] Qualifier 3 on the vast expanses of the Russian Akhtuba River 17.06
[*] Semi-Finals at the magical Blue Crab Island, Mississippi 19.06
[*] Tournament Finals at the same place, Blue Crab Island, Mississippi 20.06
[/list]

[b]Show everyone who is the greatest angler in the whole of Fishing Planet![/b]

Make sure to grab everything you must have - [b]Fishing Planet Boat Series Pack[/b],
with all the tackle and exclusive equipment, you need to enhance your skills for the ultimate win!

notes.title: Welcome to Amazonian Maze in Brazil!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/06054496730c72e90dcc9b78d4507f9e76ef0dc3.png[/img]

Welcome to Brazil! 
You are in for an unforgettable tropical adventure in the maze of islands and canals of Amazonia!

You can find out more useful information about the new location in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/3058477185987351821]Dev's Diaries[/url].
New maximum level — 70

[b]9 different locations, each with distinct atmosphere:[/b]

[b]Stone Flower[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/05746d836e4f52e80d3a4813fee3b17fd144478a.png[/img]
If you travel further to the center of the maze of waterways and canals, you will find a rocky plateau. For thousands of years the river has been smoothing and polishing the stones, transforming the shore into a flat platform, ideal for swimming and fishing. Huge boulders protect the plateau from the wind and add to the pleasant atmosphere of seclusion. By the way, the water is deep, so enter with caution!

[b]Rio Grande Hotel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8860774d64f0d44192f8518460a7d1cb0d934b0d.png[/img]
It seems that this picturesque backwater area was specifically designed for watching beautiful sunrises and sunsets! The primordial beauty of this deep-water bay has certainly been instrumental in establishing a popular floating lux hotel. Take a look at the floating deck, where you can take pleasant walks, and the convenient landing pier. 

[b]Orchid Shore[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e1188bf6d5cee8e422a49461c744d9f4c51f602.png[/img]
If you’re looking for a perfect place for some solitude and contemplation, head straight to the wild orchid garden in the northern part of the river maze. The air here is heavy with the unique fragrance of tropical flowers. The orchids bloom right on the submerged trees peeking out of the water. This shallow bay is home to many fish species that prefer still waters.

[b]Abandoned Temple[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2ae0f50cbbaa2ebf46b5bd7f3f7d92a7b5056aec.jpg[/img]
Ruins of a small catholic temple are visible on the edge of the island in the eastern part of the Rio Negro maze. In the olden days churches were built to last forever, and this one is no exception – decades of desolation later, its walls still hold against the encroaching jungle. Even the locals can’t remember why the church was abandoned, but one has to agree that the ruins look very atmospheric.

[b]St. Sebastian Church[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/58b72c30445d9448c2ad80ecb33f3751e7cfe973.png[/img]
An example of modern-day Catholic architecture, St. Sebastian Church can be found in the very middle of the river maze. Most times it’s incredibly quiet and calm here. The church only becomes busy on Sundays, when boats bring local Catholic believers from all over the area for the mass. You can just about see a convenient landing pier nearby. 

[b]Mboya Village[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7eb97c44c1e1ff7052bd24324461c91264d634a4.png[/img]
This settlement is located on the long strip of land that very much resembles a snake tail. This might be why it is called “Snake Village” in the local language. Or maybe it’s because of the abundance of reptiles around? In addition to several fishing huts with thatched roofs, the village also has a church with a tall wooden cross in front of it to mark the gathering place for local celebrations and Catholic masses. The river is rather deep here, with tall palm trees growing along the banks.

[b]Acanga[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b5bf9d455b65c3353b287ab9472163b1ae7cf3f4.png[/img]
In the eastern part of the tributary, there is a remote islet with a wooden carved statue in the middle, that locals refer to as "Acanga". Most Brazilians are Catholics, but some people still practice shamanic cults in the midst of the rainforest. Peculiar carved stones, shrines, statuettes of gods and skulls of sacrificial animals clearly signify a place of religious worship. Entering such a place, try to be respectful and not disturb the local shamans and spirits!

[b]Stilt Hut[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2f6cd4c0534a5f57bf705fc1e1772e6e4432c91.png[/img]
This lonely wooden dwelling looks long abandoned. Alternatively, its owners really don’t have time for refurbishing it. Given the stilts it might be a fishing hut: the locals probably keep their tackle here, or even use it as a fishing spot, to hunt for species who inhabit shallow waters overgrown with reed.

[b]Giant Palm Tree Beach[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4097279dd68520f4338fe3976d70fb207dd5fedd.png[/img]
After exploring infinite jungles or rocky banks, how refreshing to see a beach with beautiful white sand! One can notice giant palm trees on the other side of the beach, which gave this place its name. Cozy summerhouses with palm leaf roofing are visible not far away from the shore. If you look at the water long enough, you might see a river dolphin or a small river cruiser. Local anglers say deep waters and peculiar riverbed have made this part of the river a favourite spot for large catfish.


[b]6 new unique Amazonian fish species[/b]

Take in a lungful of the thick humid air of the jungle and be ready for a fast-paced fishing adventure, because the fish is phenomenally feisty and large: 
the hefty [b]Orinoco Bass[/b], 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8f164177525e7729e9d2a31da9aeab4e6b57f56b.png[/img]
Orinoco Peacock Bass (Cichla Orinocensis) is a large species of Peacock Bass native to the Rio Negro and Orinoco River basins in South America that usually prefers to inhabit slow-moving blackwater rivers.
These fish are easily distinguished by their tropical coloration: golden shimmering bodies with large dark spots on the sides and a blueish dorsal fin. Orinoco Peacock Bass can reach up to about 2 ft. in length with a maximum recorded weight of around 11 lb.

the aggressive [b]Bicuda[/b], 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/545de76441b343b4aa9806ccddf0c4a75c2bc6b1.png[/img]
Bicuda (Boulengerella Cuvieri) is a South-American freshwater fish native to the Amazon region, inhabiting its many tributaries as well as other rivers throughout the countries of the continent. These fish tend to stay close to the surface in areas with rapids and strong currents, hiding behind debris, logs, and rocks.
Bicudas have long, gray pike-like bodies with elongated reddish tails and sharp, comb-like teeth. Fully grown specimen usually reach a maximum weight of 13 lb, and up to about 2.9 ft. in length.

the massive[b] Piraiba catfish[/b] weighing up to 330lb,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9a9f8bd88695d5280408335e21cf1a7333768f85.png[/img]
Piraiba (Brachyplatystoma Filamentosum) is the largest Catfish species found in South America. It inhabits the Amazon and Orinoco basins, where it thrives in both freshwater and brackish habitats.
Piraiba have elongated bulky silvery gray bodies with white bellies, which makes them look a little bit like sharks. They are easily distinguished by long barbels and red markings on the lips. But Piraiba’s key trait is their truly enormous size, with a maximum recorded length of 11.8 ft and a record weight of over 441 lb.

the incredible[b] Electric Eel[/b], 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ec9aea3deda97df20e5957c2f92d59627aa738a4.png[/img]
As you can figure from its name, this eel can generate a strong electrical charge. This helps it to not only attack its future prey but also successfully navigate its way in muddy waters. Thanks to an organ called the Weberian apparatus electric eels also have excellent hearing: you will have to try hard if you want to sneak up to this fish. 
[b]Banded Aracu[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eb44689fe524c97993397f4e5ddda495b3ee845e.png[/img]
is a fish species most often found in South American waters (the Amazon and Orinoco basins). These small and swift schooling fish prefer to inhabit fast-flowing rivers. During the wet season they also thrive in flooded forest areas.


the [b]Bull Shark[/b], which adapted to the freshwater environment and whose weight can reach up to 440lb! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f4e23940606e91805df8982700d2fee93dae2aec.png[/img]
These sharks prefer to hunt in muddy waters on their own, sneaking up to the prey and dashing suddenly before the attack. There have been attacks on humans, so be extremely cautious around its habitat! 

[b]Try thousand-year-old life hacks from local anglers: [/b]lures and baits like Blue-Winged Grasshopper or Giant Silk Moth Larva. Check out the varied coastline, the difference in depth and the unparalleled Amazonian nature.

[b]The unique form of the 6-feet-long of Arapaima added[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5a5948ee2f19961c11aed2784ddfb0b44dc68352.png[/img]
Arapaima are air-breathing fish that depend on access to surface air.
These fish have long, torpedo-shaped bodies covered in black-green scales with red markings. It’s dorsal and anal fins are situated closer to the tail. Arapaima are usually about 6.5 ft. in length, with some specimens growing up to 10 ft. in length and weighing as much as 440 lb!
The diet of the Arapaima mostly consists of fish and crustaceans, but these enormous creatures can sometimes devour land animals that happen to be near the shore.

[b]Fishing in Amazonian Maze you will have a chance to catch the biggest form of Speckled Bass in our game.[/b]

[b]New Tackles [/b]
[list]
[*]Rodster rod cases set
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f3319ac079a26b9b19e18d6ac0e3751fdf6d6a56.png[/img]
This Rodster rod case set is a capacious and reliable novelty from the creators of the best fishing gear at MagFin. With this rod case you’ll be sure that the tackle is safe and sound: sturdy nylon and a durable zip fastener guarantee safety while fishing and when transporting your gear. The cases come in several sizes, and what’s more important, they sport special pockets for your extra reels and lines!
[list]
[*] Whoa tackle box set
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/78b67a76d3849cfffd3d934cbaea25bbe5ef86c0.png[/img]
Anyone seeing this tackle box set is bound to go “Whoa”. And when you open it, you’ll definitely be surprised, because its capacity allows you to keep all the necessary fishing necessities in one place. The numerous sections and slots for your tackles, lines, reels and groundbaits are arranged in such a way as to help you quickly and easily find whatever you need this exact second. The experts at UL-CHUBER made this wonderful box capacious, sturdy and available in several sizes!
 
[list]
[*] Pocket Boss
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b678d96d08c321b6905d3df50767242c9d8b98d9.png[/img]
This Pocket Boss Vest by MagFin will keep you safe from the wind, and your tackle from any excess humidity! Thanks to its multiple pockets you will always have up to 50 pieces of tackle and 7 lines at the ready. And what’s more — with this vest you’ll be able to bring up to 3 groundbait components with you! This exclusive item is made of innovative nylon AquaStop® and comes in all sizes, XS to XXL.
 
[list]
[*] Vestern Pro
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/343939344f9a572fab31a5d709e44e5e45d7041b.png[/img]
This amazing waistcoat by MagFin is truly a great find for real pros. Rain or shine, this amazing garment will be of tremendous help to you, since it can comfortably hold 55 pieces of tackle, 5 lines and even 5 groundbait components! The material allows it to achieve optimal thermal control, keeping the warmth in when it’s cold and out when it’s hot. This is exactly what you need to have an enjoyable and fruitful fishing experience!
We also added new large keepnets and stringers that you have been waiting for.

[b]New Baits[/b]

[list]
[*] Blue-Winged Grasshopper
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7b9c293d8a04495129ebaed65f7e66cb840ec1d7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/016a99bd89a9fc75c7f9d4b9253bcde6fa6b6ccc.png[/img][/url]
The Blue-Winged Grasshopper is so huge that many mistake it for a locust. Its bright wings are great at attracting surface-dwelling fish, such as Apapa. At the same time it’s weighty enough to be used for distance casts.
 
[list]
[*] Giant Silk Moth Larva
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7f8566c5fab53f7d82ae048551ae010a2a3938db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/901df5cfb07a74b4ff85f26150cba1a4eadb9eb8.png[/img][/url]
This is a larva of a giant silk moth. It’s large, fleshy and bright, which makes it a delicacy of choice for the catfish and other omnivorous fish.
 
[list]
[*] Banded Aracu Minnow
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/86ac7ec240b3eed54231541df00f6ec533e9df97.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/30c75ed481263af59cb689225e6300251190463e.png[/img][/url]
The Banded Aracu is a small fish inhabiting Amazonian waterways. It’s the favorite delicacy of large predators like the huge Peacock Bass.
 
[list]
[*] Amazonian Sardine
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/07fadf61997e1d13ed422c1914f6c7189bfddc1c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/93fef09168f87cdedf7bcb74e6151dcc169702c4.png[/img][/url]
If you want to attract small Amazonian predators like Jacunda or Biara, the Amazonian Sardine is your best choice! This tiny elongated fish makes its carnivorous siblings bite as never before.


[b]Get your share of the real exotic fishing experience![/b]

notes.title: Happy St. Patrick's Day: Kick the Snake
notes.content:
Happy St. Patrick's Day: It’s time to deal with snakes!

St. Patrick's Day celebration often lasts a whole week! And this year is no exception. We promise that our anglers definitely won’t be bored from March 12th to 22nd.

We've got the celebration that is worth looking forward to!  St. Patrick became famous for many miracles! For example, once he drove out all the snakes from Ireland. The best way to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day for a real angler is to drive a Snakehead out of the ponds. This scoundrel spreads a real terror for the local fauna!

Drive out the vile Snakeheads from the ponds to get a special Leprechaun Frock Coat!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/676fac51376cb7ba35de76da3f6eb1415aa0c37e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/557ecb33ee0cca9f376daac01dc8d1da5ee3606d.png[/img][/url] 
 
Take part in the boat race following the rainbowto find some [b]pots of gold[/b].  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/90411a8e7051aa2852475bff3eabb1df6233ad2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91198c899f9bdff60442c0aaef1071a3dc9ab901.png[/img][/url]

Just keep an eye on the timer and make the most of your boat!

[b]The race starts on Emerald.[/b]

Catch the [b]Leprechaun Fish[/b] and the [b]Rowdy Bass[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/420809f5e21ccb79749fe92ee93e38d346f54c71.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fbffc03acb122594516a3c7e854dbcd326edf9fb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfeba676c15d64fd3c8b84c8608b0361a8effbe3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8391ad7084b720f68c25cb37cfaae622790eb793.png[/img][/url]

Get a Leprechauns’ favor for catches: be sure, they will pay you back with Clover Coins, the most popular currency of the Emerald Isle! With Clover Coins you can buy effective bait and cool green outfit, becoming the most fashionable angler at the Irish party!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/224c09353d8d662e0c9aedf842b4ce7052268d55.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/892eeb9efd526f1b05e981f7595fb6fa67f8473f.png[/img][/url]

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/300a487aba548abb8c458142bdced64d94d3a19b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/630e2ac69a27d6310def0605f1d6371bbe497843.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8225367473ee488ce402ac9205ee38c488202f7c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3b10e7c082e638f0d89877aedb85f03ae0f6e5dd.png[/img][/url]

[b]Check the next locations and may the leprechaun's luck be with you:[/b] Lesni Vila Fishery, Mudwater, Neherrin, Tiber,  Saint-Croix, Everglades, Quanchkin, Akhtuba and Blue Crab Island. 

[b]Northern Snakehead[/b]  — slick and agile thing, looking like a real snake! The homeland of Snakehead is the rivers of the Far Eastern region. However today this sly one made its way into many  waterways of Europe and America. And this is completely not good at all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0bf2b0690758e18c45dee0491c789738ed94c986.png[/img]

[b]We've heard the thieves have sneaked in these ponds:[/b] Lesni Vila, Mudwater, Neherrin, Everglades, Quanchkin, Akhtuba, Saint-Croix, Tiber or Blue Crab Island.

notes.title: Developer’s Diaries: Amazonian Maze in Brazil
notes.content:
Hi, anglers!
Many of you probably have been wondering what’s coming next in Fishing Planet. We are happy to tell you what we have been working on since the release of Marron River in Bolivia. [b]Right now we are finalizing a new waterway - the maze of islands and canals of Amazonian Maze in Brazil[/b], which we plan to release in 3-4 weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/58b72c30445d9448c2ad80ecb33f3751e7cfe973.png[/img]

A curious maze of islands, canals and bays has found its place a couple of hundreds kilometres from where the Rio Negro joins the Amazon. Tiny pockets of civilization spring out here and there among the impenetrable equatorial rainforests: Indian villages and oases of tourist life. The hot humid air is filled with the chirping of birds and the smell of wild orchids. This is the place we chose for you to explore the labyrinth of the wild Amazon and experience an unforgettable fishing adventure. 

Since our fishing location is situated near the equator, the weather is humid and hot here almost all year round. For your trip we have picked the end of the dry season. Although the rain frequency and intensity are increasing gradually, the water level remains low and there’s maximum fish activity. 
The waterway’s shoreline is incredibly varied: you can come across rich vegetation, rocky cliffs, sandy beaches and humbly equipped local piers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ebec24113d7a17d8ecdc5fb45154370d7b907e3.png[/img]

The location is almost as large as Blue Crab Island. It’s designed to be one of the most expansive in our game, and that’s why it has the biggest variation in depth: from 15 metres ( 50 feet) in the streambed to almost 2 metres (6 feet) in shallow bays. Not all areas are passable by a motor boat, so players should take care when choosing their navigation route, so that they wouldn’t run aground.

As for the waterbed structure, it also varies significantly. The river streambed and deep watercourses mainly have clay bottom with scatterings of sandy areas (in places with largest differences in depth and close to prominent sand banks). Shallow bays and backwaters might have a muddy bottom. In many places, especially in shallow areas, the bottom is covered with vegetation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f1ce0bbfe8ed1504f4a097c1e9174b8cf28e2643.png[/img]

The waters are of a pronounced brown color, but rather clear. Local anglers tell stories of a peculiar Amazon dolphin that can sometimes be seen around. They say whoever comes across it will have good luck, so keep an eye, maybe you will get a chance to meet this rare animal.

The waterway will house nine main locations, which is the largest number within our game. All locations are unique and will captivate even the most seasoned players: Flor de Pedra, the “Stone Flower”, Rio Grande Hotel, Orchid Shore, the Old Temple, St. Sebastian Church, Mboya Village, Acanga, the Stilt Hut, and Pindobusu Beach. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/adf0f44eccaf41affdd1846c21ecb22b817ee1f7.png[/img]

Let us transport you to the Acanga location for a moment. There is a far-off islet in the eastern part of the tributary, which is considered among locals to be a place of spiritual power. According to official data, most Brazilians are Catholics. But here, in the midst of the rainforest, some people still practice ancient shamanic cults as well as Christianity. Their traces can sometimes be found in similar hidden corners of the jungle near Indian villages. Peculiar carved stones, shrines designated for mystical rituals, statuettes of gods and skulls of sacrificial animals clearly signify a place of religious worship. Entering such a place, try to be respectful and not disturb the local shamans (and local spirits, of course)! 
Let us not forget about fishing! Watch the slick spines of Amazon fish swimming around under the reddish black water. The exact number of species inhabiting these waters is yet to be determined, but you can definitely come across the unique Arapaima, the giant Piraiba, and even the rare Electric Eel! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/54f894a9bbe4be2576de4a4f230e95f247374807.png[/img]

[b]You’ll be able to catch 24 fish species in total, six of which are unique and introduced to our game for the first time. [/b]

And if you’ve been dreaming of catching an actual shark, you’ll have that possibility now! Remember that [b]Bull Shark[/b] frequently visits the waters of the Amazon Maze to snack on some local delicacies. In order to catch such giants we have, of course, prepared new kits of excellent tackle to be purchased at our store at the waterway, or at our new Premium Store. 
[b]But take care and don’t leave your rods unattended: local monkeys are very curious and are always ready to steal a fun item just when you’re not looking. [/b]

[b]Also note that with the launch of this Brazil location, the maximum level for all players will be increased to 70. [/b]

Unfortunately, this waterway concludes our Amazon series. But don’t be sad, because there is still the vast and exciting world of Fishing Planet waiting to be explored in the future.

notes.title: Welcome Winter Pike Tour 2021!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1dde34a59ed7aaf02da4f46e8f2c58103b5b31cd.png[/img]
Hey guys! The month of January brings you a tournament that’ll make it feel like Christmas all over again! Just make sure to register in time and take part in the annual Winter Pike Tour - a competitive sportfishing event that’s all about landing some big fat Pike! Accept the challenge and set out to explore the specifics of Pike fishing in many amazing destinations, like the mesmerizingly remote and delightfully swampy Quanchkin Lake in the Pelican State of Louisiana, peaceful Mudwater River and breathtaking Lakes White Moose and Emerald as you heroically battle through the 3 Qualifiers, the Semifinal and move on to the Grand Finale on Michigan’s vast Lake Saint-Croix - all to prove yourself as the one and only Pike Fishing Champion, win valuable Prizes and most importantly have fun!
Winter Pike Tour promises to be a thrilling competitive battle full of drive, fun and fishing excitement! It will be held on will be held January 19th through 24st, with the Registration starting on January 18th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The full Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

18th of January - Registration for the WPT Tournament begins.
19th of January - Qualifier 1 on Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake. 
20th of January - Qualifier 2 on Mudwater River in Missouri
21th of January - Qualifier 3 on the snowy White Moose Lake in Alberta, Canada.
23th of January - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizing Emerald Lake in New York. 
24th of January - the Grand Finale on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.

notes.content:

Hello guys! This time we’d like to tell you the most sizable Tournament of the year - the Christmas Giant’s Tour! This event isn’t about any particular kind of fish, the key rule here is: the bigger the better...and not just big...but GIGANTIC! Yep, we’re talking super-huge Trophy-sized monsters: Trout, Pike, Salmon, Burbot, Catfish, Muskies, Bass, Gar, Snook, Dolly Varden...the list can go on and on! notes.title: Merry Fishmas: Krampus Hunt
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/88627b7bb0e9c9479e2303c5330bd2e37b39b9a6.png[/img]

Hey, angling folks! Have yourself a great Christmas and join in on the Merry Fishmas: Krampus Hunt adventures with Fishing Planet! 
 
[b]The Christmas event starts on December 17th and will be available through January 10th.[/b] 

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! To save Christmas from the havoc created by the old Krampuses, you will require a special set of treats and tackle! A whole team of  the best elf engineers has worked with their magic tools and homemade goods to come up with this top-notch kit for your Christmas fishing adventure. The right combination of rods and reels will help you to return the things stolen by the elderly villains back to Santa! 
 
[b]Now, only YOU can save Christmas:[/b]
The elderly Krampus fishes have stolen Santa's attributes — glasses, beard and hat — and set off wreaking havoc in nearby waters. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46e76d0e19a9c35459eb4a90849ae5726313c9bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/802faddabaae76af191c5ec76fbf99bbe9914d33.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ca2d8328381c66ed3f09531ed307eb2b5c79a0ac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d6680f2b81f369d46026e9195feb5bba15afce3b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/74d325f22ffb11716bcd6f3da60722357c004847.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46f4e8a111ee089ea04af12a9db7a7341fe5f0db.png[/img][/url]

You need to locate the old troublemakers, capture them and return the things they've stolen. 
You can find them by questioning their accomplices, who have decided to follow them and make mischief around. Because of their innate ability to lie, you'll have to catch a score of them. Get your rods ready!
 
[b]Magical Jukeboxes and new amazing baits will help you to attract the minions. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b178cdf4f8db8be7cbe8f41ecd580020fc2db65a.png[/img]

Activate Jukeboxes by using Christmas tokens**. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/123a2fa6d521514634d80f0d87ed684aa2bd9b5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/da1c404fefeda6cce7e305aeb5429d7b8ac40ce0.png[/img][/url]
*Settled on all event locations.
** Get Christmas tokens by completing the event missions. 
 
[b]What Christmas without snowballs. Collect snow and make snowballs.[/b] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6088174476f0f115df503960d85206fd6e26d4f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5c3bed08c5d159d2aa5240c78f9ed0bfbcb7071f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4a310218fee79d1d662c7ca858bb716d21c05b43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/490a9bab923159eb3fb99d29584a25c7a5f59a4d.png[/img][/url]
 
Do not forget about [b]Christmas gifts[/b], that you can find at every event location. Just check Gift Boxes and Christmas Stockings. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1f59ed87fbca65f1e4665e33422269394ab098cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b3ad9574eea7166b32eb8cc1fcf795863e132e68.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a761d688112f6cd835683361e311ec0875468358.png[/img]

[b]The White Moose will also please you with the good old Crystal Burbot, fantastic Antlered Salmon, and Furry Trout![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7ff34580bd87488436ecf6da18dd5e20f56c3851.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ab10f45cbf24a3f8ef5f3ac774f652e492ea79dd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/318fd55f2864a1b0e07fb4d3b1579cf9f536b3bb.png[/img]

If you take a couple of Ginger Cookies and join them with magic, the special power of Christmas pastry will create an ideal bait.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/003ad747bc89c963be790d0d700308531027618d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b9dd0c925b0dfd5d74445ec6eacf14923fbf7b26.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Grand Smallie's Cup 2020
notes.content:

As any Bass angler knows, Smallies are angrier and much more fierce opponents than their Largemouth relatives, which makes the Tournament even more of a fun challenge! So whether you’re a mastermind Bass angler or just getting started in Smallmouth fishing, don’t hesitate to go on this competitive fishing journey for an exciting trip through some breathtaking fishing destinations - from the deep blue waters of Oregon’s Falcon Lake and the the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California in the two Qualifiers, to for the Semifinal Round on Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and over to the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Smallmouth anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Smallmouth fishing Champion and many valuable prizes! 

Grand Smallie’s Cup will be held November 24th through November 29th, with the Registration starting on November 23rd. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]

[*] 28th of November - Semifinal Round on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix.

notes.title: Welcome Halloween 2020: CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a35e82932ae55631758cda4e49e8d3397d841bde.png[/img]

Hey, Anglers! Get ready for Halloween’s horrifying fishing and frightful adventures!
[b]This awesome event is waiting for you on Steam, PS4 and XB1![/b]
Complete dreadfully creepy missions to catch the abominable Frankenfish and get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward!
[list]
[*] Hunt for Ghost Pikes, Mutant Gars and Skeleton Bluegills to complete cool Halloween challenges.
[*] Look for Tombstones and Vicious Pumpkins to get some awesome angling loot!
[*] Join the festive kayak race at Emerald, Falcon, Saint-Croix and San Joaquin.
[/list]
[i]The event will be  active until 6 a.m. UTC, November 4. [/i]
Behold the abominable Frankenfish - a scary and gruesome monster-fish boss that came to life as a result of a bizarre prank-gone-wrong! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed74bc701e541af474bb890348d61f72dc92a0b3.png[/img]
*This year you will have a chance to conquer Frankenfish again using new additions to our traditional Halloween potion!

[b]What a holiday without your favorite and terrifying missions![/b]

This frightful monster will devour anything alive, even humans! So it’s up to you to go on an epic adventure to summon and defeat the horrid beast:

[b][list]
[*]Retrieve the Book of Recipes from the Quanchkin Witch to brew the summoning potion!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aa5258702d9a0bb66a0e3205911390f13f3c02cb.png[/img][/url]

[*]Find the magic Witching Cauldron somewhere on the islands of San Joaquin and get all of the ingredients!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1569391312d29723e35f107fcd49578e72392753.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b96d9fb0e1c9e0f69217f51e430815614539935.png[/img][/url]

[*]Brew the Summoning Potion to summon and defeat the Frankenfish!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f5a264713d4f2df08f56ffff5676956fa4630477.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3213e10094e4183fa5b2722b45eda27fc886c321.png[/img][/url]

[*][b]Halloween 2020 will surprise you with a new kayak race which will make you  thrilled.[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b6cfa69a140ceab2326dfc47b92d01533dec059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/18d1272d6fb6cb3c5aad5851211c06a80210826c.png[/img][/url]
[*] The winner will get the unique Vampire Glasses and Pond Passes to event ponds. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7a43f3398d93b6a0846fb4a2de4b739b5824ca85.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c5554783249a27513bacd465a187f3c991719f3a.png[/img][/url]
This will be spook-tacular!
[/list][/b]
*It is the only few of a bunch of Halloween's missions you need to complete.

[b]Only you can put an end to its bloody rule once and for all! Conquer the monster to get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/976d5c2fe378130224c9b4328a9b799c927b0925.png[/img]

Also do not forget to Set out on a night hunt after the mysterious glowing Ghost Pike,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/54b2952c595ec24697a13c5343b0d1813faef72e.png[/img]
 catch terrifying Skeleton Bluegills,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/33f6b3f8d98a4fe4b491b9b558ffe7a76acfa55c.png[/img]

[b]and fierce Monster Gars:[/b]
 [list]
[*]Albino Yeti Gar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b561a98c571d8d1680e0d3e6677e9ab2773dcec.png[/img]
[*]Green Ogre Gar 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfe64b7360ae47c472bee57c0052a18c68aa9d2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d309ef7fa6a15791c0480396371efd050126cc19.png[/img]

[b]Be careful, because all fish monsters are going out for a hunt at night![/b]

Also do not forget about our cool tackle like the Ghost Reel™ 4000 spinning reel and the SpookySpin™ 260 spinning rod with a glow-in-the-dark tip, as well as creepy lures like the Bony Shad, Spider Spoon, and Slimy Crank and Halloween pumpkin jellies Candy bait and Veins Leader!

notes.title: Welcome Mighty Carp Tour!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d28506db45c2154de5f923d1656e3418542a177e.png[/img]

Behold the mighty Carp! And welcome the opening Tournament of the fall season - this September’s bottom fishing excitement of Mighty Carp Tour! Although somewhat undervalued in North America, this all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. 
That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! 

Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some of the world's most amazing fishing destinations - from the Italian charm of the Tiber River, the sunny magnificence of San Joaquin Delta in USA and hardcore reality of the Russian Akhtuba River in the first three Qualifiers, to the vast openness of German Sander Baggersee Lake for the Semifinal Round and finally, the enigmatic Weeping Willow Lakes fishery in Great Britain, where the ultimate Top-20 Carp catchers will have the chance to fight in the Grand Finale for the title of Mighty Carp Master!  

Mighty Carp Tour will be held September 15th through September 20th, with the Registration starting on September 14th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 14th of September - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 15th of September - Qualifier 1 on the Tiber River in Italy. 
[*] 16th of September - Qualifier 2 on San Joaquin Delta in California, USA.
[*] 17th of September - Qualifier 3 on Akhtuba River in Russia.
[*] 19th of September - Semifinal Round on Sander Baggersee Lake in Germany.
[*] 20th of September - the Grand Finale on the Weeping Willow Lakes fisheries in the UK.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the River Marron, Bolivia!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/388357d5acb2c2d660457979c6f99027a0a1b19c.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to Bolivia’s Amazon tributaries full of rare and wonderful fish! [/b]
It’s not easy to get to the River Marron, and you can find out more useful information about the new location in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/2760097222793599103]Dev's Diaries[/url].

If you’ve found yourself in Beni Department holding a fishing rod – you surely know your exotic fishing! The further you are from civilization, the more chances you have to catch a rare fish, maybe even of an undiscovered species!

[b]A trip to the River Marron gives you a variety of fishing options in the most interesting places:[/b]
[list]
[*] Travel to the lone tree in the southern part of the river to hunt for a Red Peacock Bass straight from the grassy bank or the landing pier.
[*] Rent a Wooden Kayak from local residents at the old boathouse, where the sharp-toothed Payara is said to make an easy catch. Wooden Kayaks will be available for rent on all Amazonian locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/69c74db1117ed5f89aa8b57109edd5cabacec58d.png[/img]

[*] Visit the village in the north-east to enjoy the picturesque cableway and all the best spots to catch the golden-scaled Apapa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b631bbf98454b16411a8395305934a128e9dfc4a.png[/img]

[*]  Steer your boat to the western tributary to cast your rod into the quiet waters of a nearby small lake.
[*] Venture to a tiny island with low rocky shores to catch the Redtail Catfish hiding in shallow waters or bottom pits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e06dc633c84bd9b892bce2978b25eaa7e9198958.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Enjoy the most impressive view where a magnificent tree grows straight out of the water. [/b]

[b]New unique fish, such as:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tambaqui 
[/list](Colossoma Macropomum), also known as Giant Pacu or Black Pacu, is a large freshwater fish native to the Amazon and Orinoco basins in tropical South America.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/527ea2c74a9550047582869d1fda04905f035b2c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Trahira
[/list] (Hoplias Aimara), also known as Wolf Fish or Tiger Fish, is a predatory tropical fish species native to South America that lives in freshwater habitats of most river systems on the continent. 
Trahira can be found in both clear, fast flowing streams, as well as slow and still waters of canals and ponds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1b3cccf8afa4f9d6414588c6741e24adb5855427.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Apapa 
[/list](Pellona Сastelnaeana) is a South American species of predatory freshwater fish found mainly in the Amazon and Orinoco basins. These highly aggressive fish swim mainly in large schools, hunting their prey closer to the surface or in shallower areas. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1e602fa9065aa4432b9e64eba083176c1145aa19.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Redtail Catfish 
[/list](Phractocephalus Hemioliopterus), also known as Flat-nosed Catfish, is a large and very popular game fish found in the Amazon, Orinoco, and Essequibo river basins of South America that lives only in freshwater habitats, particularly large rivers, lakes and streams. It is the only known species of the genus Phractocephalus, that dates back to over 13.5 million years. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2c962b4cb089336be3ee7ad77d55558bc053abb8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Red Peacock Bass
[/list] (Cichla mirianae) is a tropical freshwater fish that tends to inhabit lagoons, waterways and flood plains of South American rivers. It prefers areas with slow currents and plenty of cover, such as sunken logs and submerged trees.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d80eebdf5a26f94781c1eb241081bf7163e521e9.png[/img]

[b]New tackle[/b]

We recommend top Amazon tackle for all your tropical fishing. 
Be sure to try out [b]the powerful bottom rod La Cazadora™ [/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8fc19157eb6039f4fcec8d261c551bc28750add0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/63c086787b2c8ae79fc0045d06559c9a4fd6c58f.png[/img][/url]
[b]the Torbellino™ reel by UL-CHUBER™[/b]. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/744ceaf7475c41a867b7ca99c166851e9703c9a1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/bb04e80b6be46d97339906ec0b7d97059ba46a83.png[/img][/url]
[b]Match Rod - SpellLauncher™[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/05f38e7db3b2b9f45e0fce915c8f5ef33c296584.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0e8aea59ded3fb3a239b3abfde604db1165ea441.png[/img][/url]
[b]Spin Reel - MatchCatch™[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/485f1c647c95c589d026c660cd44559a0d8db3bb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0a99384176d2c66ac0b0edfaf4f456d5fbd353df.png[/img][/url]

[b]Don’t forget about the new local baits:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dobsonfly, 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/74fc50f4dbb96e5634543f0b320a1b54ca814e50.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32a4aa1416dc98b9c47f96dda25c3ba78b320b13.png[/img][/url][*] Moriche Palm Fruit, 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b5f77ea968cf3d7fcfd8b5c229af97814604da4c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a1e3431923951fc6f6f9a55ec2be6f043ca33b37.png[/img][/url][*] Jauari Palm Fruit, 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c774034b7ac5ee3073d983790ebe37c1d3bf1cee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8ad4c0b3d7110c2d05d038f1e7a336fb33e3c09.png[/img][/url][*] Rubber Tree Seeds 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea04d774ef93c1dc90b9d300c76386ccfe04dd44.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95e7eea25e634567d4502fb38885c69afc7eb4fd.png[/img][/url]
[*]Freshwater Crab
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9074cca9d1a34516d1bad078b735af42cf611043.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8168bbd5ba47d8ba3831607fefa955209096105.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[b][list]
[*] Interesting missions and achievements.
[*] New max level for players – 65(unlocked at level 63).
[/list][/b]

[h3]You can find all the best stuff for local fishing in the Tropic Hunter Pack.[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200346/Fishing_Planet_Tropic_Hunter_Pack/?beta=0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/881a65689793212225ec37826de93004cde3e782.jpg[/img][/url]

Traveling to Bolivia to catch wondrous water monsters – sounds like a plan! And to bring it to life we have already gathered all the best stuff in [b]the Tropic Hunter Pack[/b]. The star of this set is the light and durable metal motor boat Lyra with a powerful engine and an innovative echo sounder Uniq, which can work without interference even at high speed!

notes.title: Release note 3.7.2: Summer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3a32fa678afdc12cc5c7a0e8ae16c73255ba74cd.png[/img]

Hello, anglers!
Welcome end of summer with our Summer update full of new useful improvements including:

[b]Polarized glasses[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6f5548a85b9fc4be61d6ea4938fd712ba3a65732.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/35647a08bca9cf8b4eb5f102065f95262775e15e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/312bc80718eea9c0adae9ca90f798ae62d07db07.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/723b9d320a8c08ad5a5cc0e7c22a2547120343d6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fc9158cab9e8cf4a8da72b8e5da6648806f785c6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/077bedf85bbba14417e5c4ed6873eaa4af9e168e.png[/img][/url]
More contrast and less eye strain when fishing! New Garry Scott sunglasses are specifically designed for anglers: in addition to ultraviolet protection, they also block most of glare from light reflecting off the water surface. The line offers several models for you to highlight your unique style!

[b]Sliders[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d15c3408e942ab52936c8efee2d60f97db10d869.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/2810b56ede776bcb5cae8ef0472b29a804681bd1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03368730106d4348b01c07b0d7208f5caafd48fc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f298c064abc4ba77849b9618da39779cf564f884.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/851abf35c63ceb53af4d4fbf243b76fccf1cde61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c1a47543fd3759ed0fc97b8d1ac9b3737445661.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/80a403b7844722a48f37cbed9be93b87bbe3ae12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9b5ff153958ef3f7a288d489641028ec30624ea1.png[/img][/url]
Slider floats are specially designed for sliding rigs. Sliders are able to fly further than common floats and are most often used for fishing at great depths.


[b]Wagglers [/b]
