notes.title: Developer’s Diaries: Marron River, Bolivia
notes.content:
Hi, anglers!
Many of you probably have been wondering what’s coming next in Fishing Planet. We are happy to tell you what we have been working on since the release of Maku-Maku Lake in Peru. Right now we are finalizing a new waterway - Marron River, which in Spanish means “The Brown River”. It comes next in our series of South American Amazon waterways that we are very proud to introduce to our players.

The river originates in the northern part of [b]Bolivia[/b], specifically in Beni Department, and is a tributary to the Beni River. Together with the Mamoré River they make up the Madeira, Amazon’s largest tributary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fa267f3002802064409eccec3e496b352ed79de6.png[/img]

September is the warmest month in this region. That’s why we’ve planned for you to visit these wonderful locations in late September. The heat starts to recede, and on some days it might even drizzle. It’s simply magnificent to fish or just walk along the picturesque banks of the Marron River during this time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6893c9d55e11e2ceb3c43d9bfd37ae6c50f2328f.png[/img]

The total length of the river with all its tributaries is over five kilometers (just over three miles), which makes it the [b]longest one in the Fishing Planet gaming world[/b]. That’s why owning a boat is virtually indispensable for a successful fishing trip. However, if you haven’t purchased a vessel yet, don’t be put out by this. 

[b]Go to the Viejo Vado Boat Station, where you can rent out affordable motor boats as well as an exclusive wooden kayak, skillfully crafted by local woodworkers.[/b] 

For those preferring to fish from the bank we have prepared [b]six basic locations with perfect fishing conditions[/b], and the Viejo Vado Boat Station is one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fc42de6cdc89e8d77a1fdd23dff079779bca9b33.png[/img]

The river’s mainstream has plenty of pits up to 10 m (33 ft) deep and is rather fast-flowing, so we recommend our anglers to use heavy lures and sinkers as part of their tackle.

[b]Large catfish and bottom predators will be waiting for you in the muddy waters of the Brown River. It is over 200 m (650 ft) wide at its mainstream.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d99c7298977e26e066b6abd8c49edaf1220e32c0.png[/img]

Meanwhile, the river’s many tributaries are not as fast or deep, so that’s where you can fully enjoy the gorgeous nature and take a short rest. 

Two small lakes, [b]Selva and Anku[/b], are also worth mentioning: they sit hidden among the river’s meandering tributaries and constitute two basic locations of the reservoir. These lakes are teeming with various fish species, including the [b]Fishing Planet’s largest piranha – Tambaqui[/b]. This is a giant of a fish, with its weight sometimes exceeding  over 40 kg (88 lb). Naturally, it’s not an easy task to catch a Unique Tambaqui and will require many hours, so be sure to have plenty of powerful tackle at hand if you come across this desirable trophy. You can find all your necessary tackle for fruitful fishing experience at [b]the local store – Marron Rio Mercado[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/270db91cde08b4a3a11850f1cd25c82b37715618.jpg[/img]

Our next basic location is situated near a lone hut on the southern bank of the river. Local residents have named this place [b]Sacha Kallpa[/b], which stands for “Mighty Tree”. Here, beside the hut, it seems the time has stopped thousands of years ago. The villagers know they can come across Peacock Bass in the southern areas of the Marron River, so they fish here sometimes.

Leaving the [b]Viejo Vado Boat Station[/b] and moving down the river you will find [b]the local village of Los Cardos[/b], which is similarly a basic location. Most dwellings are raised on stilts against the river flooding, and some of their thatched roofs peek out of the evergreen vegetation. The soil is sandy clay. The slope is rather steep occasionally, but in most areas you can freely reach the water to set up a fishing spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b631bbf98454b16411a8395305934a128e9dfc4a.png[/img]

Our final basic location of this waterway is situated on one of [b]the river’s isles, Chiri[/b]. This islet’s name means “cold” in the local language, which can be explained by frequent mists or cool air streams sweeping its shores. A small unkempt shelter adds to the feeling of abandonment, because nobody seems to live here today apart from rare visiting anglers from the village. The shore is clay, rocky and low-sloped, which makes for a most pleasant fishing experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e06dc633c84bd9b892bce2978b25eaa7e9198958.png[/img]

Speaking about the variety of fish, you will be able to catch 20 whole species at this location, some of which you previously fished for at Maku-Maku Lake. But you will still be treated to [b]five very new species, including the said Tambaqui![/b]

Marron River features one more very intriguing object – [b]a stranded old ship[/b]. It is still in great condition, and most importantly, hasn’t been salvaged by locals for tools or building materials. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/59ec298741ba864f7dc8186c3ef73a4db2cc409c.png[/img]

[b]Explore the location to find the ship: who knows what kind of surprises await you there![/b]

notes.title: Independence Trout Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/781759f8474c4e3faf0a51bd474b6fb58cf94777.png[/img]

Hey, angling community! Join us this July 4th for an epic anglers’ celebration of Independence Day by taking part in the Independence Trout Open, the festive Trout sportfishing tournament hosted annually by Fishing Planet! 

Really, what could be better than spending a great all-American holiday in good company amidst thrilling competitive excitement?
So don’t hesitate to register and celebrate Independence Day by heading out on a fun and challenging competitive fishing journey that will take you through some of the greatest Trout fishing locations in North America! First, you’ll go from the Canadian snowy charm of White Moose Lake to the vastness of Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and the enigmatic banks of Colorado’s Rocky Lake in the three Qualifiers, then on to the picturesque shores of Oregon’s Falcon Lake for the Semifinal Round and the tournament’s Grand Finale, in which 20 best Trout anglers will fight their final battle for the title of Independence Trout Champion and many valuable prizes! 

Independence Trout Open will be held June 30th through July 5th, with the Registration starting on June 29th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*]29th of June - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*]30th of June - Qualifier 1 on Colorado’s Rocky Lake.
[*]1st of July - Qualifier 2 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
[*]2nd of July - Qualifier 3 on Alberta’s White Moose Lake.
[*]3rd of July - Semifinal Round on Falcon Lake in Oregon. 
[*]5th of July - the Grand Finale on Oregon’s Falcon Lake.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4be0410aecc7595f6c021e7e9d61e2260260ae08.png[/img]

We welcome all anglers on this beautiful day and are happy to share some news with you!

In June, Fishing Planet locations will host [b]FIRST BOAT PREDATORS TOURNAMENT - FISHING PLANET BOAT SERIES[/b], where you get a [b]CHANCE TO WIN NEW X-SERIES BASSBOAT![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5b3cf7bdf502e76c0cc644ef11d3c527f606075a.png[/img]

If a regular fishing trip feels boring to you, if you want to show off your honed skills, if you love the spirit of competition – this is for you!

Don’t waste your time: go register for the Tournament. Prove to everyone that you are the best angler and earn not only recognition but also fantastic prizes, including Credits, BaitCoins and unique items. And three best Champions will become proud owners of new X-Series Bass Boats!

Participants and spectators will have a whole week to enjoy the thrill of the fight. The tournament will take place at picturesque locations in the US, Germany and Russia. However, you will hardly have time to enjoy the view, since the clash is likely to turn fierce!

You will be fishing for the toughest predators using a spinning or casting rod from your boat. The type of the qualifying fish depends on the location.

The Tournament will take place from June 16th through 21st. Over this period we’ll hold Qualifiers, Semi-Finals and Finals. You need to register 24 hours before Qualifiers start – don’t miss the deadline! The first registration begins on June 15th.

[b]Dates of the Tournament:[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to Amazonia, Peru, Maku-Maku Lake!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f175d327184e31690f9959d2e131093e065f4a6d.jpg[/img]

Well, anglers, are you ready to explore South America? 
Then enter the Amazonian jungles and follow to the waters of Maku-Maku Lake! This magical spot in north-western Peru, where the Amazon River begins, presents a rare opportunity to challenge yourself. Local waterways are famous for the variety of rare exotic fish species inhabiting them. 

[b]Here’s what the wild rainforest has in store for you:[/b]
[list][*] Our first Amazonian location in Peru — Maku-Maku Lake!
[*] 16  authentic fish species, from Redeye Piranha to the giant Arapaima!
[*] New spinning rods for heavy lure casts and large-spooled reels.
[*] Swimbait lures look almost indistinguishable from a live fish, and predators can’t resist it.
[*] Maximum level raised to 60.
[*] New Rainforest Journey Pack.
[/list]

[h1]Welcome Maku-Maku Lake in Peru![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1445252b4bc20da548f806950b392d4e264b725e.jpg[/img]


[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/2228662320417217409]Maku-Maku Lake[/url] embodies everything you can dream of in a tropical paradise fishing adventure! It’s just you, the primeval jungle and scores of rare Amazon fish! Do not be deceived by the seemingly peaceful water surface: it hides the sharp-toothed Payara, the gigantic Arapaima and the vulturous Piranha.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/233c468633f3881aff53f17ec9f2959f4901682d.jpg[/img]

When exploring the lake, visit the Oval Island. At the first glance there is nothing remarkable about it apart from a landing pier and a couple of tourist lodges. But you are here for the catch, and you won’t be disappointed. The lake’s muddy bottom near the island is full of deep pits, which make perfect hiding spots for Flatwhiskered Catfish, the enormous Gilded Catfish and other members of the Amazon catfish kind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b333529697fa71de2bad3021ad61d5511928d7f.jpg[/img]

Otorongo Village in the south-western part of the lake is where an Amazon indigenous tribe lives. The Maku-Maku people have surely chosen their residence wisely, since the local waterways are teeming with fish! The native residents have built a landing pier for their longboats. Take your boat from there to the north of the village to find a long gentle-flowing canal, a habitat of choice for the yellow-eyed Brycon and the elusive Payara. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/70ba2db17871c88a421a4e1af0b79397ae68f615.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer’s Diaries: Maku-Maku Lake, Peru
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/95ffeff250b71307f4ceb2c35267ef10f024bae7.jpg[/img]

Hi, anglers!
Many of you are interested in what we will release next.  Get ready to visit South America and experience a new fishing destination - The wild Maku-Maku Lake in the north-east of Peru.

The wild Maku-Maku Lake is located in the north-east of Peru, upstream the Amazon basin and in between the Marañón and the Ucayali Rivers, which come together to form the Amazon River.

This lake is a forgotten treasure of the immense and impassable Amazonian equatorial rainforest. Nothing even resembling industrial activity can be found within miles of the lake, with no signs of urban life nearby. Probably that’s why the flora and fauna of these places are so vehemently asserted in its rights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/21eaebc99b816db60066dbd4a14a3b2040d618e8.jpg[/img]

People still visit these places, but only as guests rather than masters. There is a small indigenous village at the lakeside, and its residents managed to preserve nature in its primordial state and become its organic part. And of course, the omnipresent tourists found their way here — they usually stay at a small tourist camping site near the lake in pursuit of amazing fishing trophies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c26895280d3871193e99c6aa75f91acc32686ee4.jpg[/img]

It’s constantly warm and humid in these parts of the world, and a year is roughly divided into a wet season and a dry season. Anglers start arriving here late May to early June when the wet season is nearing its end. The temperature and humidity start to drop, the sky lightens, precipitation level decreases (although it rains still), the water level begins to ebb, and the fish sets off to bite at anything it sees in the water! That’s why we chose the summer’s first month!

Our lake is rather deep, with many pits measuring some 33 ft (10 m) in depth. The deepest ones can reach up to 50 ft (15 m). After all, our biggest catfish do need somewhere to inhabit! But there are also vast shallow waters where small forage fish are eager to feed, inevitably falling prey to all sorts of predators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8a19ad1b3d6c8ec723fc00bdcbe1005d46ef64f8.jpg[/img]

The lake is best suited for boat fishing because the exuberant vegetation encroaches close onto the water body. There are only a few places where you can fish from the shore, but they are definitely there.

The three main lake locations deserve a special introduction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0b333529697fa71de2bad3021ad61d5511928d7f.jpg[/img]

The first one is a village of the local indigenous tribe on the western shore. Not far from it a narrow river flows out of Maku-Maku Lake and further feeds into one of the sources of the most magnificent river on the planet - the Amazon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/eeaa53ce50d9b1a75e48186d6fb69d609d8ac640.jpg[/img]

The second location is a fishing tourist site situated on a small hill on the southern shore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/233c468633f3881aff53f17ec9f2959f4901682d.jpg[/img]

The third one is a modest camping site in the northern part of the biggest island.

It’s necessary to mention a wondrous submerged forest, where you can steer your boat into and land a spectacular trophy. This is the first place of its kind to make an appearance in our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f3e9ff85443a879d7c54eda1d86d3d03afa5a02d.jpg[/img]

The reservoir naturally has its unique features. Its flora is uncanny, from palms and giant ferns to rubber trees and pistia the water cabbage, floating freely on the lake surface. A multitude of loud colorful birds and boisterous monkeys are keen on giving careless tourists the shivers.

Talking about species diversity, this lake will offer 18 fish species for you to catch, 16 of which are — unprecedentedly — introduced FOR THE FIRST TIME! Never before have we given to you so many exclusive species at one location!

And above all: the Amazonian region does not stop here, it only just begins. Expect even more unforgettable fishing experience in the future!

notes.title: Patch Note 3.5.9: 4 new Fish in Mississippi.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4db1fcf060761a4cb148da273e0fc39542b6eb3f.jpg[/img]

Hello, anglers!

Welcome, 4 new inhabitants of shoreless Blue Crab Island in Mississippi.

[list]
[*] The first one on our list is Shoal Bass, cousin of the Bigmouth and Smallmouth Bass. This indigenous freshwater inhabitant of the southern part of the USA, easily recognizable by its colorful body and aggressive behavior.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea5a964a9753318659cf14a658053ce43f40f649.png[/img]
[*] The second one is Bigmouth Buffalo. One of the biggest species in the Catostomidae family, native North American freshwater fish, mostly known for its giant size and its long lifespan. Despite being mostly planktivorous species, it easily could be caught on sports gear. So choose the right bait and good luck!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc140e379ba9958d132cad8dcd58b584f07dbe46.png[/img]
[*] The third one is American Gizzard Shad. This small-sized, extremely fecund and gluttonous member of the herring family serves as a feeding base for many freshwater predators. But due to the enabling environment of the Blue Crab Island, it has grown to a very impressive size and catching fish more than 1 kg is not so rare. Although American Gizzard Shad feeds mainly on plankton, here in the south it also willingly bites! Arm yourself with small hooks and the same small nozzle - and you are guaranteed success!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c78dc1d273f89b4f1a2312dfaca50b14c8202956.png[/img]
[*] Last but not the least interesting fish species is the Black Drum. This giant inhabitant of the sea depths, well known as the largest of all the drum family. Its behavior is very common to his close relative Red Drum, and you need to look for it in approximately the same places.
   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/32c0178df31d41a696f7ef22c37cba0a67e28bf4.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Tight Lines![/b]

notes.title: Happy St. Patrick's Day: Kick the Snake
notes.content:
Happy St. Patrick's Day: It’s time to deal with snakes!

[b]St. Patrick's Day celebration often lasts a whole week! And this year is no exception. We promise that our anglers definitely won’t be bored from March 16 to 22.[/b]

We've got the celebration that is worth looking forward to!
St. Patrick became famous for many miracles! For example, once he drove out all the snakes from Ireland.
The best way to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day for a real angler is to drive a Snakehead out of the ponds. This scoundrel spreads a real terror for the local fauna!

Drive out the vile Snakeheads from the ponds to get a special [b]Leprechaun Frock Coat, St. Patrick's Cap and special lurebox[/b]!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/676fac51376cb7ba35de76da3f6eb1415aa0c37e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/557ecb33ee0cca9f376daac01dc8d1da5ee3606d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c191f699032722c320b3903e566ada1fc6bfc988.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/83c3f8d844a0c87bd042d4c42611e35d414b0b81.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1db7e70e732d057439b627fcdd892f7b30ea98fe.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5cbb6e50e2b35081ee9d623247d4b275ba3aad39.png[/img][/url]
 
Take part in the boat race following the rainbow, collect parts of the[b] Golden Horseshoe Stringer[/b] and find some [b]pots of gold[/b].  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/edb6acc45f35a0aa711649de3122043cc9fb1dd3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7d6e4711df6ed2ddd6df62e84e998ee02227e17c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a39ffe9a1549fb8d2a2fe758d757011eb5e81a94.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/427277922462f6ecaf3551fdb2ea148b18c14b3d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/90411a8e7051aa2852475bff3eabb1df6233ad2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/91198c899f9bdff60442c0aaef1071a3dc9ab901.png[/img][/url]

Just keep an eye on the timer and make the most of your boat!

[b]The races start at the ponds:[/b] Emerald, San Joaquin, Saint-Croix, Tiber, Sander Baggersee, Akhtuba, Blue Crab.

Catch the [b]Leprechaun Fish[/b] and the [b]Rowdy Bass[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/420809f5e21ccb79749fe92ee93e38d346f54c71.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/fbffc03acb122594516a3c7e854dbcd326edf9fb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dfeba676c15d64fd3c8b84c8608b0361a8effbe3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8391ad7084b720f68c25cb37cfaae622790eb793.png[/img][/url]

Get a Leprechauns’ favor for catches: be sure, they will pay you back with Clover Coins, the most popular currency of the Emerald Isle!

These two  especially like our delicious [b]Drunken Worm[/b] and [b]Bully Grasshopper[/b].

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/300a487aba548abb8c458142bdced64d94d3a19b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/630e2ac69a27d6310def0605f1d6371bbe497843.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8225367473ee488ce402ac9205ee38c488202f7c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3b10e7c082e638f0d89877aedb85f03ae0f6e5dd.png[/img][/url]

[b]Check the next locations and may the leprechaun's luck be with you:[/b] Lesni Vila Fishery, Mudwater, Neherrin, Tiber,  Saint-Croix, Everglades, Quanchkin, Akhtuba and Blue Crab Island. 

[b]Northern Snakehead[/b]  — slick and agile thing, looking like a real snake! The homeland of Snakehead is the rivers of the Far Eastern region. However today this sly one made its way into many  waterways of Europe and America. And this is completely not good at all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0bf2b0690758e18c45dee0491c789738ed94c986.png[/img]

[b]We've heard the thieves have sneaked in these ponds:[/b] Lesni Vila, Mudwater, Neherrin, Everglades, Quanchkin, Akhtuba, Saint-Croix, Tiber or Blue Crab Island.

Don't forget to use special baits: Buffalo, Baby Catfish or Clown Frog.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/360fe707373a47037d21a8f2bf496071278412b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a8dfb49f783c779cbd50b01004ce4842a24e00f3.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/64a6239754f69812e5cf110832eeac1d46eecfbc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a044115c2ac1fc15ecd36b523983acbefffab64b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c0faf6e44ed882536d23af547d32efe755e0999e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a1e2375f6453e05440046355d0096c8f3253b8eb.png[/img][/url]

[b]But remember: this is not an easy quest![/b]

Search for [b]Lucky Horseshoes[/b] to exchange [b]Clover Coins[/b] for special items, such as bait, tackle box or fashionable and useful novelties. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f489be43de25fc54e68068313c85da0688c46b14.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e85fbe2aab3149c31b27796d0e9d324bf140ea0c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/224c09353d8d662e0c9aedf842b4ce7052268d55.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/892eeb9efd526f1b05e981f7595fb6fa67f8473f.png[/img][/url]

You can receive it for completing special tasks. With Clover Coins you can buy effective bait and cool green outfit, becoming the most fashionable angler at the Irish party!


[b]Get a festive St. Patrick Pack… and may Irish luck be with you![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/422473/Fishing_Planet_StPatricks_Pack/?curator_clanid=9666527][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/df5da38f67f0777cafcadef845ef977f5a77df46.jpg[/img]

This February you will witness history in the making, as Fishing Planet will be hosting Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour, the game’s first-ever feeder angling tournament!

Indeed, the competitive excitement of this new sportfishing event will overshadow everything else this month and stir up deeper emotions and feelings than the cheesy attributes of Valentine’s Day! You’ll have loads of fun angling in a thrilling competitive atmosphere, as you try to catching the biggest Bream imaginable! The heated fishing race of Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour will take you on an amazing adventure across Europe - from the Netherlands, to Germany and even Russia!

notes.title: Crappie Valentine Cup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e81581dc580fbaae67472649406860b014f558e3.png[/img]
Hello to all our beloved anglers!
Valentine's Day is coming and to make this holiday less about cheesy romantic nonsense and more about what you truly love, we’re hosting the annual Crappie Valentine Cup fishing tournament! 
This sportfishing event is meant to get everyone in the holiday mood this February 14th! 
Don’t hesitate to register and compete in a fun and challenging environment against the very best, as you test your skills in catching Black and White Crappie in a heated race taking you through five different states, from the picturesque banks of Missouri’s Mudwater River, to Louisiana’s swampy Quanchkin Lake! 
Fame, Glory and a prize pool that includes plenty of Credits, BaitCoins,unique fishing tackle and equipment and most importantly - the title of Crappie Valentine Champion await!

[b]Crappie Valentine Cup will be held February 11th through February 16th, with the Registration starting on February 10th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]

13th of February - Qualifier 3 on California’s San Joaquin Delta.
15th of February - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.

notes.title: Patch 3.4.0 New Waterway - Mississippi Blue Crab Island!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/877e2d647d4a86d1b28cd9a01aebfcde84b29175.png[/img]

Are you ready for fabulous fishing?
Welcome to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1702857555902048923]Mississippi Blue Crab Island[/url]! This picturesque place is a real paradise for anglers in the azure waters of the northern part of the Gulf of Mexico.

The trip to the Blue Crab Island is the dream of any experienced angler. Only the singing of birds and the buzzing of insects interrupt the local silence and solitude. Along the canals – thickets of sawgrass, the water here hides many large species. You can fish from a wooden pontoon near the boat station, or you can take a motor, go for a spin along the mangrove, and enjoy nature away from the coast and closer to the inhabitants of saltwater.

[b]You've got a big party to plan here:[/b]

[b]New level cap[/b]
Existing leveling system will be increased to 55 levels in maximum. The Mississippi Blue Crab Island will be available for all users who gained level 54. 

[b]Locations[/b]
Despite the waterway’s impressive size, there will be  two entry locations.
The first location  - [b]Mangrove Sunset[/b] - is situated next to a large stilt house, right in the center of the waterway and is a great spot to start exploring both fresh and saltwater areas by boat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc41344d72942af83acac6a46dae023350b6c419.png[/img]

The second location -  [b]The Bass Base[/b] - is on wooden docks in the middle of a freshwater bay, amidst natural wild scenery and black mangrove trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659bd07b4b81dcf3aa98090e4366a97fb2927c4e.png[/img]

Keep in mind that Mississippi is a waterway made specifically for boats and you can explore it in all possible ways.  You can also land anywhere along the coast.

[b]New fish species[/b]
Skilled anglers have a chance to catch new fish.

Bonefish, 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/75c273e0359d32bc370a10d42510e0704fbf3624.png[/img]
Speckled Peacock Bass,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/72042b5ad97f69e9f6b000b32b75dd1d70ba1617.png[/img]
Southern Flounder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/659ffea173315e1b66a40b4204c84f9ac3694acd.png[/img]
and Permit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6987ccc996892ec801352f0d464e6b2d4685455a.png[/img]

[b]New Trophy and Unique fish[/b]

Although at first glance the pond seems calm, it hides many fish, each of which is a welcome trophy: Tarpon, Red Drum, Snook, as well as a relic resident of the local waters – the Longnose Gar.

[b]New reinforced fishing rods and reels for catching really powerful species[/b]

[b]Spinning Rods  Thetis™[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7eb6d11ecd74a1b592480a06fead21677960226c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b4e83deb578ef8bad698ee756771b34651531e7.png[/img][/url]
Rivertex™ presents Thetis™ - the new and most powerful yet spinning rod that bears the name of a mighty sea goddess! An all-round superior choice for spin angling, this beauty is perfect for catching feisty beasts like trophy-sized bass, pike, salmon and muskies! Packed with Rivertex™ leading-edge technologies, like the ultra slim high modulus MaxCarbon™ alloy blank and the ResinFix™reinforcement method, this superb masterpiece of a rod features divine design to match its superior performance!

[b]Spin Reels    ExcelSpinner™[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d2ac7523c2fda3c0791f22d7dbf9ba626e5ad7a4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/8c38d822f5fdb6a80bc3443dc579aacdd6046d08.png[/img][/url]
ExcelSpinner™ is a new and even more powerful spinning reel from Rivertex™ with an elegant bronze TCP™ finish to match its might! The reel’s super large spool will make it much easier to land those trophies, while leading-edge technologies of ARTEX Slim™ reel body, HydroStop™ corrosion protected bearings and the exclusive StraighLine™ anti-backlash system ensure exceptional performance and superb durability!

[b]Match Rods    Majesty™ [/b]

Complete with FGS™ guide system and top-grade handles for improved grip, this exceptional rod is the perfect balance between power, precision and control.

notes.title: Developer Diary: Mississippi. The Blue Crab Island.
notes.content:
Today we’ll tell you about our latest and perhaps most fascinating of all Fishing Planet waterways - Mississippi: the Blue Crab Island in the Gulf of Mexico! Our team has been working on this new map for the past few months and we are happy to announce it should be released in a week or two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7f283ac00e99e8d6334108e3670054103fcdaa97.png[/img]

This idyllic and picturesque island is actually a part of Mississippi and is located off the state’s coast in the northern part of the Gulf of Mexico. From the angling perspective, the coolest thing about this place is perhaps that the island is surrounded by both fresh and saltwater areas! This means that you’ll have the opportunity to catch both freshwater and saltwater fish species within the same angling destination!
What’s more, Blue Crab Island is the largest Fishing Planet waterway up-to-date, with an overall area encompassing 4km2 (1.54mi2). This destination is perfect for boat fishing, as the island itself is small and most of the angling will be done offshore. At the same time, the depth is hardly over 1.5m (5ft) in most areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dc41344d72942af83acac6a46dae023350b6c419.png[/img]

Despite the waterway’s impressive size, there will be only two fishing locations available at this time. The first location is situated next to a large stilt house, right in the center of the waterway and is a great spot to start exploring both fresh and saltwater areas by boat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aa9febde4737b966aecaa96b9685e2e9125b5a18.png[/img]

The second location is on wooden docks in the middle of a freshwater bay, amidst natural wild scenery and black mangrove trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ed49bbd36891d214ed20c35f8534ffb158e99a6c.png[/img]

To recapture the atmosphere of this enchanting nature paradise as best we could, we added 2 types of mangrove trees: dwarf red mangroves in the saltwater area and tall black mangroves on the border of fresh and saltwater aquatorium. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6062343de61e3af0e3084b6ec49967287ac79b6a.png[/img]

You’ll also find dense thickets of sawgrass - abundantly covering the banks of many natural and man-made canals as well as countless little islets.
As far as weather and time of year are concerned, Blue Crab Island welcomes you with beautiful enchantment of early autumn, when the monsoon has already passed, and dry season hasn’t yet taken its reign. This gives us very interesting and diverse weather conditions: from heavy rains to scorching hot tropical sun. But more importantly, and much to any angler’s delight, practically all of the seawater fish species can be found in the northern part of the Mexican Gulf this time of year!

There’s a total of 20 fish species for you to catch in the waters of Blue Crab Island, with 4 of them appearing in the game for the first time! The ones particularly worth mentioning are probably every anlger’s dream: we’re talking about saltwater giants like Bonefish, Permit and the Southern Flounder!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c76da8836edcb1eb276c39b20ffc700c06a451d8.png[/img]

Whereas in the freshwater area, you can take your chances against the monstrous Speckled Peacock Bass, the largest member of its kind, weighing over 10kg (22lb).
From an angler’s point of view, the saltwater area of Blue Crab Island is probably the most interesting. Aside from the above mentioned species, you can also catch some Red Drum, Striped Bass, Gafftopsail Catfish and huge Tarpon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e6e39efa510ec15f0122be40eedaaf63003c4d5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0712428f6e273e08386f1cdace034076243da59c.png[/img]

To make your fishing experience even more realistic and add to the overall ambience of the place, we introduced a number of unique anthropogenic objects: 1) a huge house with docks and boat hangar in the center of the waterway; 2) an old and abandoned power line on wooden poles alongside one of the canals; 3) a new power line on huge metal supports seen on the distant horizon; 4) small and shabby little shacks with old windmills scattered around the waterway; 5) old docks and wharfs; 6) modern windmills in the saltwater area of the waterway; 7) hangar-style boat houses with gas barrels.

[b]Also, don't miss the opportunity to have fun watching plane flying around. 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/877e2d647d4a86d1b28cd9a01aebfcde84b29175.png[/img]
And to make your Blue Crab Island experience even more realistic, you can actually fish out unique objects and critters, like blue crabs themselves!:)
Have fun exploring and tight lines!

notes.title: Welcome Winter Pike Tour 2020!
notes.content:
Hey guys! The month of January brings you a tournament that’ll make it feel like Christmas all over again! Just make sure to register in time and take part in the annual [b]Winter Pike Tour[/b] - a competitive sportfishing event that’s all about landing some [b]big fat Pike![/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cf866731695fb3e453a67e455446d545e21d2d31.png[/img]

Accept the challenge and set out to explore the specifics of Pike fishing in many amazing destinations, like the mesmerizingly remote and delightfully swampy Quanchkin Lake in the Pelican State of Louisiana, peaceful Mudwater River and breathtaking Lakes White Moose and Emerald as you heroically battle through the 3 Qualifiers, the Semifinal and move on to the Grand Finale on Michigan’s vast Lake Saint-Croix - all to prove yourself as the one and only Pike Fishing Champion, win valuable Prizes and most importantly have fun!

notes.title: MERRY FISHMAS 2019!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/541355f9023f0aafb518081183215afa657456ce.jpg[/img]

Hey, angling folks! Have yourself a great Christmas and join in on the Merry Fishmas adventures in Fishing Planet! 
Christmas starts on December 19th and will be available through January 5th.

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! Santa’s sled was wrecked in a terrible snowstorm and crashed somewhere over Canada. Luckily, Santa is doing fine...but his reindeer went missing and all of the Christmas presents are now scattered around the world! 

[b]Now, only YOU can help Santa to Fix The Christmas:
[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/3380dc78345a1a1017c8644809a38791a62cd452.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a42c2886c354d3eee5b855a251ce337775efe8ab.png[/img][/url]

Santa's sleigh crashed somewhere over Canada. Gifts and Decorations are now scattered around the world.

Let's save this Christmas by filling Santa's Bag with lost gifts, decorating the Christmas tree and catching Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh. 

Christmas magic will summon Crystal Fish, that can be caught only during the holiday. So stock up on snow, toss snowballs at your friends and have lots of fun and adventures on White Moose Lake!

[b]Travel to White Moose lake and find Santa's sleigh. 
[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/444b3e8e11e0d3de7174f17662b9d62426bdfcef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/e2c365a8d9ac589259d8c668bf38f48cd10cdf18.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/337c3c726bd6a701c4331fb3f66142160124895a.png[/img]

Fill [b]Santa's Bag[/b] as you explore the waterways by boat in search of lost gifts.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/990f66be476f0e88ea46b1ee2a37bc797a6d87af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6b06351a807d76cebd6d0cdea6718d8c93644743.png[/img][/url]

Bring Christmas mood to the White Moose and [b]help Santa decorate the Christmas Tree[/b] with collected ornaments.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a5a0730e17ffea4ce9bc8c03a8dfaf20dafd962a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1c5c2896fef8e09a546f73b6c61f5e40c98dc26e.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200340/Fishing_Planet_Holiday_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/b07ee44ee3a02d1835eabbee9135398df98e68f7.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: New bite system and Sponsored Competitions
notes.content:
Hello, anglers!

We have news about new bite system on American waterways! In today’s update, we improve a new feature due to all your feedback and propositions. Also, we will try to make it better and more comfortable for everyone in the nearest future. 

And we’re finally rolling out the much awaited feature.  Now, you can create and customize [b]Sponsored Competitions[/b] based on your own preferences. 
Aside from standard [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1604898551799104999]User Competitions[/url], there will be easily recognized  by the distinctive golden design of the following elements:
[list][*] Logo frame
[*] Icon for the competition format 
[*] Competition name[/list]

[b]These competitions have some special characteristics:[/b]

[list][*] Only a Hosts appointed by the game devs may create Sponsored Competitions.
[*] Once created, such events get checked by the Administrator before publishing. 
[*] These competitions have unique names and are always shown at the top of the event list. 
[*] Devs may assign sponsor rewards for these competitions.[/list]

Sponsored Competitions will pose a particular interest for the more advanced sport anglers, being a perfect chance to compete against equally worthy opponents and win valuable prizes!

[b]If you're an influencer and want to create your own competition, please contact sc@fishingplanet.com  with information about your channel and they will provide you all the information needed. [/b]

That’s all for now! Stay tuned to keep track of what’s fishing;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/524bbb0dc70ef03f0e7c06cbc1e7008a13544dab.png[/img]

Now, you can create and customize competitive fishing events based on your own preferences, by fine-tuning and adjusting multiple event settings, including rules, locations, time schedules, participants and much more!

We designed a whole array of new tools to make it more comfortable for you to create and host just the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1661192277199329070]perfect angling competitions[/url] and set numerous parameters to your preferences:  [list]
[*] Use pre-existing templates or generate your fishing event from scratch!
[*] Select the competition formats (free for all/team/duel) and privacy settings.
[*] Set your own Entry Fee and Prize Pool.
[*] Choose from multiple settings, including location, number of participants, player LVLs, duration, time, weather conditions, tackle, qualifying fish, etc...!
[/list]

[b]We’ll tell you in more detail [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1608275615640152083]here [/url]how these new competitions are going to look like in the game.
[/b]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1608275615640152083][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d49df9703af7e21561a32e4bd34dbc8d5090ff8.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]A new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1608275615640152083]Custom Competitions menu[/url] will be added to the game interface that’ll feature a convenient list of all the user competitors both available and already played.[/b]

[h1]New Complex Rigs with new types of terminal tackle:[/h1]
Rigs. Yep, now you can use rigs with your spinning and casting rods: Texas Rig, California Rig. Three-way Rig and Flipping Rig- all to enhance your fishing experience!;)

[b]Three-Way Rig[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4f31bcd1da2975e96e99a427565b48ed9ef4caaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/82da6293fce63dd6349d6949c54d378bc9356761.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0c586419fb48efd2272bf26a643c83c8b320e25e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/31ca792c4d1ae9fbed449b17ecf624dcf150bfca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/088f5bceefb5d91bb87d0e9e2a72d5ad881177f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/886dea3225ecdf5fd3d3d82cd46ce99e76117429.png[/img][/url]
One of the most well-known and simplest rigs, the three way rig features a three-way swivel that has separate attachment points for the main line, sinker and the leader. Easy to set up, the three way rig provides smooth rotating and eliminates line twists. Particularly efficient for going after predators like Catfish, Trout, Pike or Bass.

[b]Texas Rig[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/607fa54dcb5ceae50bd7b13b37e07e8382be12fc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/383c8fdada27c94a5697d8703510c255b9735520.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ef83824fcdcd845e6af7f1863e58999a0490444e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/78408264aec59d93be2e37587fb8f1bfcc3908ce.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/46ca45e9d0bd67b400a141837dc6b46cd79cf95a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/aed606d16ac36da220074e3f215bc369fda5abaa.png[/img][/url]
The Texas rig is one of the easiest and most effective ways to use soft plastic baits for bass fishing. Just slide some weights on the line, tie on a hook, thread on a soft plastic bait, like a plastic worm, tube or craw and you’re ready to catch some big bad bass!

[b]Carolina Rig[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5de2ad3165f714d1088fa033604ced807c7e1b43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/de13b794b6e70f9c0ca463aa3ffe51d4bf6b0a90.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/537509055a54cccb3a7b05cf982a25459ae1ab43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6c98a84568c8227f4a84eca89ad090c5f4d325fd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/68d4b9f088245490c9543c904aa9d233d5f2f28a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/febbac6e9b21a87222c037620787f14c895482ed.png[/img][/url]
The Carolina rig is a super effective plastic bait rig that is especially perfect for going after bottom feeding fish and fish like bass. In this rig setup, the weight is fixed above the hook, and can be used with a number of soft plastic baits, like worms, craws or tubes. The Carolina rig is suitable for beginner anglers.

[b]Tear Drop and Bullet Sinkers[/b] 
[list]
[*] Tear Drop:
 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a19b88eb83bcc8a936e15955dc6a020b0772e076.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/84767fe6128a1a4da3a5673f9d75e724d16ffd43.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a3d7f5f9c7ecfc9d5d2e5e31a6e7383ada82e953.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d24336cc05364644ef12216b08607fc10a9fbdca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/dd23ef69daea58fdabc9b0c6e3531d6c81860598.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5627d666c9e5e0209acf1592e36ac889d2926b88.png[/img][/url]

[*] Bullet Sinkers:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/7f4feae50b841702cdfefc2bde41d878be650967.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/57aca8196b9786fac65ab2d38d83eb4b63897a98.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/65fa9f264fdc38f369287404c53fcb0691e2b06c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/a80928c2d7452f1b308dd6509823b9c88459e053.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/0581a2a1682178643f13dd1fa20f8fd6fea52f09.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/4ef4da59aba33bbbd5f0800f29d5645304826191.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

High-quality sinkers that are designed for use with jig rigs for spin fishing. These sinkers are one of the most popular choices among anglers.

[b]Tails[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/f0ca2fb45e19b62c102853d3ab0caea7efd1b4db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/03ab7ccbba7277a921c1839029761f16fc7483d9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/c7e2bb3a1dace8196faa3ecec14012099acd77d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/6f93664f8005551d96f1fe9089768121d67a1d9d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/9638c5233b551fc62da9d4885732968ae8ff73a2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/73bd07265217c301868da62feb4f4d573a84f703.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Grand Smallie's Cup 2019
notes.content:
Bass fishing is quite an art of its own! And since Fishing Planet wants to help you become a more versatile bass angler, we decided to host a very special Bass tournament, dedicated entirely to Smallmouth Bass! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/13d1c519ba164df9e14d690b0a6b861a19cb23a1.png[/img]

As any Bass angler knows, Smallies are angrier and much more fierce opponents than their Largemouth relatives, which makes the Tournament even more of a fun challenge! So whether you’re a mastermind Bass angler or just getting started in Smallmouth fishing, don’t hesitate to go on this competitive fishing journey for an exciting trip through some breathtaking fishing destinations - from the deep blue waters of Oregon’s Falcon Lake and the the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California in the two Qualifiers, to for the Semifinal Round on Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and over to the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Smallmouth anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Smallmouth fishing Champion and many valuable prizes! 

[b]Grand Smallie’s Cup will be held November 20th through November 24th, with the Registration starting on November 18th.
 The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list][*]18th of November - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*]20st of November - Qualifier 1 on Lake Falcon in Oregon.
[*]21nd of November - Qualifier 2 San Joaquin Delta in California.
[*]23th of November - Semifinal Round on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix.
[*]24th of November - the Grand Finale on Neherrin River in North Carolina.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Diaries: User Generated Competitions. Part 2
notes.content:
Hey friends! 
Today we’ll tell you in more detail how these new competitions are going to look like in the game.
A new Custom Competitions menu will be added to the game interface that’ll feature a convenient list of all the user competitors both available and already played:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/5d49df9703af7e21561a32e4bd34dbc8d5090ff8.png[/img]

To create a Custom Competition, simply push [b]CREATE [/b]and then either adjust all of the desired parameters in the competition settings menu or choose one of the preexisting competition templates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/68d91296baf36eee9065b6d48637bd1512f4a56a.png[/img]

Once you complete that step, you’ll find yourself in the [b]Lobby [/b]of your newly created Custom Competition, while the event itself will be published in the list of competitions to be seen and joined by other players.

Competition [b]Lobby [/b]is the place where players can look through the event details and chat with other participants. 
At the time of the event, there will be a count-down followed by the start of the competition. All players who confirmed their participation ([b]READY [/b]button) may then begin competing. Players that fail to confirm and are holding up the other participants, may be excluded from the competition by the Host. In case of pre-scheduled starts, all players who have not submitted their confirmation will be excluded automatically once the competition begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/1374efcd532155a18b0fba38411317e0e8b93def.png[/img]

The Lobby for Team Competitions will be somewhat different, featuring a list of players divided according to their teams. The competition Host may personally assign players to their teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/d1e54efee08a0492167c1d7ca96136c5f3d45015.png[/img] 

[i]The Host’s authority pretty much ends there. Once the competition begins, the Host will participate on the same grounds as all the other players, having no further advantages. [/i]

We can’t wait to share our work with you and present this new functionality. The release is planned for the next week. Hope you’ll enjoy it!

Tight lines!

notes.title: Developer Diaries: User Generated Competitions. Part 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/524bbb0dc70ef03f0e7c06cbc1e7008a13544dab.png[/img]

Hello, anglers! 

It’s been a while since we last shared with you what we are working on. Today we’d like to talk about new functionality that is waiting for you in the upcoming release in the first half of November. This time we prepared for you a new type of Fishing Planet’s competitive events called Custom Competitions.  

Unlike all regular (automated) competitions, Custom Competitions are User Generated Competitions and will be created by the anglers themselves. Players will also be able to fine-tune and adjust the multiple settings of these events, including rules, locations, time schedules, and participants.

We designed a whole array of new tools to make it more comfortable for you to create and host just the perfect angling competitions and set  numerous parameters to your preferences:[list][*] Templates - players can either choose from one of the preexisting competitive templates, or create a completely new competition. 
[*] Formats - there will be a number of formats for user competitions, depending on the type of competition:[list] [*] Free For All - players aim at getting the highest personal score. 
[*]  Team Competition - participants are divided into two teams, and each player aims at getting the highest total team score. 
[*]  Duel - a one-on-one competition format. 

[/list] [*] Privacy:
[list][*]  Open competition - the event is open to anyone. 
[*]  Private competition - the event is password protected.

[/list][*] Entry Fee - competition fee for those who wish to participate.
[*]Initial Prize Pool - the amount of reward that the competition Host sets for the prize. 
[*] Waterway for hosting the competition. 
[*] Player LVLs that are admissible for participation. 
[*] Maximum number of participants.
[*] Setting for Duration and Start of the competition.
 [list][*] Manual Start - competition begins after the Host starts it manually. 
[*]  Scheduled Start - competition begins automatically at a set time. 

[/list][*] Game Time/Weather tuning. 
[*] Qualifying Fish. 
[*] Count of score points - either total fish caught or fish in the Keepnet. 
[*] Set of score keeping Rule sets. 
[*] Tackle Types that are required to use in order to earn score.
[*] Choice of admissible equipment. 
[/list]

[b]Sponsored Competitions 
[/b]
Aside from standard User Generated Competitions, in the future there will also be Sponsored Competitions. These competitions have some special characteristics and might have unique sponsor rewards.

[b]That’s all for now! We’ll share more details on how this functionality would work in our next issue of DD this Friday. Stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Welcome Halloween 2019: CURSE OF THE FRANKENFISH
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/552e4b664d539523d6ee5393e98c3187f70efa9e.png[/img]

Hey, Anglers! Get ready for Halloween’s horrifying fishing and frightful adventures!

[list][*]Complete dreadfully creepy missions to catch the abominable Frankenfish and get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward! 

[*]Hunt for Ghost Pikes, Mutant Gars and Skeleton Bluegills to complete cool Halloween challenges.

[*]Look for Tombstones and Vicious Pumpkins to get some awesome angling loot!

[/list]

[b]The event will be active until 6 a.m. UTC, November 4.
[/b]
Behold the abominable Frankenfish - a scary and gruesome monster-fish boss that came to life as a result of a bizarre prank-gone-wrong! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ed74bc701e541af474bb890348d61f72dc92a0b3.png[/img]
This frightful monster will devour anything alive, even humans! So it’s up to you to go on an epic adventure to summon and defeat the horrid beast:
[b][list]
[*]Retrieve the Book of Recipes from the Quanchkin Witch to brew the summoning potion!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png[/img]

[*]Find the magic Witching Cauldron somewhere on the islands of San Joaquin and get all of the ingredients!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2d2deecf5ec36a5af26fcb12b2d4f7c7efc30bfb.png[/img]

[*]Brew the Summoning Potion to summon and defeat the Frankenfish!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/98559ca811ff38d06b80de8fd0461fccef15e77d.png[/img]
[/list][/b]
*It is only three of a bunch of Halloween's missions you need to complete.

[b]Only you can put an end to its bloody rule once and for all! Conquer the monster to get the unique Monstrosity Kayak as a reward![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/976d5c2fe378130224c9b4328a9b799c927b0925.png[/img]

Also do not forget to Set out on a night hunt after the mysterious glowing Ghost Pike,
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/54b2952c595ec24697a13c5343b0d1813faef72e.png[/img]
 catch terrifying Skeleton Bluegills,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/33f6b3f8d98a4fe4b491b9b558ffe7a76acfa55c.png[/img] 

[b]and fierce Monster Gars:[/b]
 [list][*]the Albino Yeti Gar

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5b561a98c571d8d1680e0d3e6677e9ab2773dcec.png[/img] 
[*]Green Ogre Gar 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/dfe64b7360ae47c472bee57c0052a18c68aa9d2e.png[/img] 
[*]Black Vampire Gar

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d309ef7fa6a15791c0480396371efd050126cc19.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Be careful, because all fish monsters are going out for a hunt at night![/b]

We also have plenty of cool tackle like the Ghost Reel™ 4000 spinning reel and the SpookySpin™ 260 spinning rod with a glow-in-the-dark tip, as well as creepy lures like the Bony Shad, Spider Spoon, and Slimy Crank and Halloween pumpkin jellies Candy bait! 

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/48e324b7a3b281aae755d6cf14cb18ea5c751a51.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5542a0be5454963e57fa3d9c9c36dd3756bf645f.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c0a8ffca9f35826d920d8edf3184e0020fe2a582.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/37090a740a682f9c3fbc30c2be9b674be28e0d90.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2aef26e915cd542ac1966ffea7079cad4ba33ded.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/17f0136b97d121619fce638201ecaf1ec6435319.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/177dc7191eaed771f0447e1fde341d4962c0350f.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/25a5d4df5849f50c907dead88712c0c8b094f2e8.png[/img][/url]

[b]You can rent a special Coffin Kayak - available only for the duration of the Halloween event![/b]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/37dd95356d1872d305fe1e432aba00306c3a617d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9d9354ba0d92e46a227b1affdb7bf80053aa8017.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9f67e9aa169f9d1e7d2e8d8e347e5418c64d459d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/645ec42f6e8b472c5a6e0218e960b3e435d71882.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Gars&Glory Cup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9666527/ea610bcb6939690747cb24b6928c75ecfccbcba2.png[/img]
Looks like this October will see Halloween overshadowed by a far more exciting event! Forget Trick-or-Treating and better do some real monster fighting, cuz you’re in for the ultimate Gar tournament! But don’t let these powerful giants make you forget that you also have other opponents, represented by some of the best anglers walking our Planet! Make sure to register and head out on the most exciting competitive journey of your life as you travel through some of North America’s top Gar fishing destinations - from the luscious green wetlands of Florida’s Everglades, on to the banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River and finally to face the Top-20 Gar fighters in the swampy wilderness of Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake! Compete against the most ferocious opponents and make your glorious way through the 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Great Finale that’ll show who’s who on the monster fishing arena!
Gars&Glory Cup will be held October 23th through October 27th, with the Registration starting on October 22th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The 

[b]Tournament’s timetable is as follows:
[/b]
22th of October - Registration for the Tournament begins.
23th of October - Qualifier 1 on the Everglades.
24th of October - Qualifier 2 on Neherrin River. 
26th of October - Semifinal Round in the marshy wetland of Lake Quanchkin.
27st of October - the Grand Finale on Quanchkin Lake.

Only for the duration of the tournament, you can get special tour pack
[b]Gars&Glory Pack at 30% OFF![/b]

Behold the mighty Carp! And welcome the opening Tournament of the fall season - this September’s bottom fishing excitement of Mighty Carp Tour! Although somewhat undervalued in North America, this all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. 
That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! 

Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some of the world's most amazing fishing destinations - from the Italian charm of the Tiber River, the sunny magnificence of San Joaquin Delta in USA and hardcore reality of the Russian Akhtuba River in the first three Qualifiers, to the vast openness of German Sander Baggersee Lake for the Semifinal Round and finally, the enigmatic Weeping Willow Lakes fishery in Great Britain, where the ultimate Top-20 Carp catchers will have the chance to fight in the Grand Finale for the title of Mighty Carp Master!  

Mighty Carp Tour will be held September 10th through September 15th, with the Registration starting on September 9th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

notes.title: Help needed!
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

We are all one big angling family in the Fishing Planet game world. But today, we turn to you for help within the biggest game of them all - a game called Life. 

Many of you remember Alex - Fishing Planet co-founder and key team member, who has been building our Fishing Planet universe from its very inception. Many of you were wondering why he has disappeared so suddenly. Well, here’s the truth. For the last 3 years, our dear Alex has been quietly fighting squamous cell lung cancer. Unfortunately, the odds are against him but as a real fighter he doesn't give up. There is one thing we can all do for him: we can help him get back home! 

All Alex wants right now, is to return to his homeland, to reunite with beloved friends and family and to continue his fight there. Given his immobilized condition, it's quite problematic and very expensive. The cost is far too high for a single person to afford. But TOGETHER we can all make Alex's dream come true! Our team would greatly appreciate your help - every donation and every share will matter greatly!

notes.title: Welcome Virtual Bass Open!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2604f579053877d8ee225710f3205676b55c5f2d.png[/img]

   Dear friends! Summer is here at long last...and for many of us that’s the “it” time of the year for fishing! And what better way to celebrate the start of summer angling season than to participate in our annual annual Bass sportfishing tournament, Virtual Bass Open! 

Taking place in June, this year it’s meant to honor the occasion of Father’s Day - the perfect holiday to spend celebrating the symbolic and deep meaning of the sacred father-and-son connection by doing some good ’ol fishing!

   Register to enter the Virtual Bass Open, a fun and challenging competitive fishing journey that will take you through some of North America’s best fishing destinations! 

First you’ll go from the blue aquatic vastness of Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake to the endless weedy wetlands of Florida’s Everglades and the curvy banks of Missouri’s Mudwater River in the three Qualifiers, then on to the wide shores of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Semifinal Round...and finally, if you’re lucky, you’ll head straight to Louisiana’s swampy Quanchkin Lake for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Bass anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of VBO Champion and many valuable prizes! 

Virtual Bass Open will be held June 11th through June 16th, with the Registration starting on June 10th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] 10th of June - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*] 11th of June - Qualifier 1 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
[*] 12th of June - Qualifier 2 on Florida’s Everglades.
[*] 13th of June - Qualifier 3 on Missouri’s Mudwater River. 
[*] 15th of June - Semifinal Round on Neherrin River in North Carolina. 
[*] 16th of June - the Grand Finale on Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Note 3.0.1: Motorboats Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e612b10dde7f74536d5d01f85342d1d7775df5b2.png[/img]

Hi, anglers!
We are excited to present you our new update! Here you can find detailed information about what are waiting for you. Explore and be ready for new adventures!

[b]1. Motorboats [/b]

Now you can enjoy three new types of motorboats that have unique speed, durability and vary in other params and features. 
[list]
[*] [b]Metal flat bottomed motorboats.[/b] 
Slow, cheap, but extremely durable boats. You can rent the basic metal boat. However, the other ones will be equipped with sonars and better engines
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3c10c29ebdbb08986d32ee670b6a1843b6a1e31c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/842fb818fce24ec45e6f3ef997aff8dfcca91bc2.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd5804685d137c3b2e402ecf40e96b03c7d77792.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3257486dc916b5c68ad463f85d3a6501e45f63f.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6f6e7e329631042d3803fbf712e6290d41922fa8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/69cd417cc95d5b2c81f85b8e5361603a0d44768a.png[/img][/url]


[*] [b]Rubber inflatable motorboats.[/b]
 These motorboats come with three various sonar options that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. There are also boats with different engine powers.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/31f7b7450194abfc3eaec0992cdb4331b87bab8f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c3fff106d05bbe47a23e007630436c791292d4a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/751044b0b8f9d948324ef65c4b63fcb7c1b9913a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/721f4685f7b3600dcbf2ed5d1d1e616ed18a05d0.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/03905164c520eb5fd2d94d945612580fabb80aff.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f42b5bd6588e7143cb8aef66e8a16c05264d918a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4efd0f576c5a17aa90f4645822e38f8c4c039ae2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf99c9ee974fa230c87bb4faf2dcc894198e97a3.png[/img][/url]


[*] [b]Bassboats[/b] are equipped with the best bassboat edition sonars and can develop the highest speed of all motorboats. Also, some bassboats feature, along with a trolling motor, an additional sonar installed in the front part, so that you could look for fish without having to get behind the steering wheel. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4c7686841fd29a34338b75137295988a418d4cc7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76b9c855520197b89a037f720cd9ca469890de43.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/36cf0d341e27f558cf1be87d4474565e155b3509.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81bc2ef822922b393799b0c25cbccc24bb27f1a3.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/617ac8a97d7b501ce316679082f38b8a627f364a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26989233b1c55c22e390295ffdbbaf5162934ba8.png[/img][/url]


You can purchase all types of motorboats in the in-game shop and enjoy them on the following waterways: 

[list]
[*] Emerald Lake
[*] Falcon Lake
[*] San Joaquin Delta
[*] Saint Croix Lake
[*] White Moose Lake
[*] Tiber River
[*] Sander Baggersee Lake
[*] Akhtuba River
[/list]

A basic edition of metal flat bottomed motorboat is also available for rent at all of these waterways. Please note that only one type of boat (metal boat or kayak) may be rented at a time!

[b]Types of Sonars[/b]
As mentioned before all motorboats purchased in the shop may be equipped with different types of sonars that vary by color themes, speed readings and fish tracking parameters. 

[list]
[*] [b]Basic[/b] - shows bottom shape and structure and works on slow speed. Color theme: monochrome.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3bc45823a4472c842a281e0705ed8995b9966fe.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b827984002e87de0b39e5fb67c707e5abe37bfe4.png[/img][/url]

[*] [b]Advanced[/b] - shows bottom shape and structure as well as fish. Works on slow and middle speed. Color theme: monochrome
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2e071d92033def8dbbafa1107e7c2e9c3f3a96d5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3e54767d2d29ef2e3780ded25d6ea37ab1fdcebf.png[/img][/url]


[*] [b]Pro[/b] - shows fish as well as bottom shape and structure in high resolution. Works on slow, middle and high speeds. Color theme: colorful.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3127007e8f87a81bfd2b30a9a6fdc43ae289f0a7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81cb306699e54bab05d9ba7e16dfdc4cc94a88f3.png[/img][/url]
 
 [*]Also there is a  [b]special edition sonar for the bassboat[/b] that corresponds to the Pro sonar characteristics but can work on higher speeds.
 [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9cf676f2895ac40dc78a18a6416e9091c8e29a1c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6ba271be055bfcb2836e50db281d63836f36a8e7.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[b]2. Missions[/b]

There have been added two new sets of missions: Exploration and Mastering for you to profound your angling skills and fully enjoy professional fishing. 
Explore every part of the proposed rivers, lakes and other bodies of water. Combining any fishing equipment and gear available to you, assemble a complete collection of fish species available for fishing and get the title of an explorer of each of the available places!
Use your skills to catch  Bass, Pikes, Trouts, Salmons, Catfish, Carps, and other ones that cause envy because of their size and power of opponents, and who often find themselves too tough for most anglers!

[b]Show off your expert angling skills by masterfully comply tasks!
[/b]

[b]3. New lures added:[/b] try fishing with Jerkbaits and three type of Minnows - Deep Runner, Hunched Runner and Triple Runner

[b]4. Changed access levels for Emerald and Rocky Lake.[/b] Now small mounting Rocky Lake unlocking on Level 5. Emerald Lake with rental motorboat unlocking on Level 8. Some tackles and lures also change access level.

[b]5. Fish Float biting behavior improved.[/b] Various unique portraits of behavior added for different fish species 

[b]6. UI improvements[/b]

[b]7. Added Traditional Chinese localization[/b]

[b]8. Сomplex bugfix[/b]

[b]9.Don’t miss the new Motorboat Packs: Metalhead Motorboat Pack and  Daredevil Motorboat Pack  with 15% OFF![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2751414337aae8f05f5368ac83e5464818b8f600.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000712/Fishing_Planet_Metalhead_Motorboat_Pack/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c4a368e246c5a45944889cfd4d7c63f3d2a6e392.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000713/Fishing_Planet_Daredevil_Motorboat_Pack/

notes.title: DevBlog: Motor Boats
notes.content:
Hello, angling friends! As always, Fishing Planet keeps growing and expanding its universe, along with the opportunities for fishing on different continents of the world! And as we strive to create spacious waterways with plenty of room for exploration and angling adventures, we are in turn faced by the question of better navigation. Before, you could explore new angling destinations either on foot or from a kayak. Now, we’re introducing motorboats!  

[b]Metal flatbottomed motorboats[/b] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3c10c29ebdbb08986d32ee670b6a1843b6a1e31c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/842fb818fce24ec45e6f3ef997aff8dfcca91bc2.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd5804685d137c3b2e402ecf40e96b03c7d77792.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b3257486dc916b5c68ad463f85d3a6501e45f63f.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6f6e7e329631042d3803fbf712e6290d41922fa8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/69cd417cc95d5b2c81f85b8e5361603a0d44768a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26dbce0b7d77aca0df79d94013e4f3dca5f21910.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4c71e0752f2525f1bc81b5b564f9b304a7b6097d.png[/img][/url]

[b]Rubber inflatable motorboats[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/31f7b7450194abfc3eaec0992cdb4331b87bab8f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c3fff106d05bbe47a23e007630436c791292d4a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/751044b0b8f9d948324ef65c4b63fcb7c1b9913a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/721f4685f7b3600dcbf2ed5d1d1e616ed18a05d0.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/03905164c520eb5fd2d94d945612580fabb80aff.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f42b5bd6588e7143cb8aef66e8a16c05264d918a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4efd0f576c5a17aa90f4645822e38f8c4c039ae2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf99c9ee974fa230c87bb4faf2dcc894198e97a3.png[/img][/url]

[b]Bass boats[/b]
[img][/img][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4c7686841fd29a34338b75137295988a418d4cc7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76b9c855520197b89a037f720cd9ca469890de43.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/36cf0d341e27f558cf1be87d4474565e155b3509.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/81bc2ef822922b393799b0c25cbccc24bb27f1a3.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/617ac8a97d7b501ce316679082f38b8a627f364a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26989233b1c55c22e390295ffdbbaf5162934ba8.png[/img][/url]

Each type has its own unique characteristics and parameters. For example, metal motorboats are more durable, while rubber motorboats have better maneuverability and bass boats allow to move at much faster speeds.
All motorboats that you can get from the game store are equipped with sonars. However, some bass boats feature, along with a trolling motor, an additional sonar installed in the front part, so that you could look for fish without having to get behind the steering wheel. 

Motorboats are similar to kayaks in use. The only difference is that these boats have a motor that you must operate. Just as you did with kayaks, to start using a motorboat, you must first rent or buy one. Then you must get on the boat and turn on the engine by using a pull starter, or in the case of a bass boat, by pushing the start button. To turn the engine off, simply repeat this step. 

Here’s a list of waterways, where you’ll soon be able to use motorboats: 
[list]
[*] Emerald Lake
[*] Falcon Lake
[*] San Joaquin Delta
[*] Saint Croix Lake
[*] White Moose Lake
[*] Tiber River
[*] Sander Baggersee Lake
[*] Akhtuba River
[/list]

This list is subject to change in the development process.

Keep track of the news to always be up to date about what’s happening in our big fishing world!;)

ity/public/images/clans/9666527/f6369ddb75845f748ba6b86a7c9e4ac8f9f6c7f7.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e0007a8ce1850b68947cd572bfe6d309a9135979.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/56c99dc1bf6db3d11339743162b82282f8cc99e1.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b0926a2f4168f1334f2e9e211ccf4694aa214707.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cb5353aea7c8dcf486cdfc8c879987499565bf9f.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f7d94f54b809a9946a2d83ae8188c6719bbf7696.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/412b090e078ba569f4b7029e597ad4062cafd233.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/16c4d82b198d61a7f14ca548e81d3744b71ab6f4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3a91936a256bed34591fde29000288532b86633f.png[/img][/url]
