Made out of highest grade ingredients, this pop-up bait is perfect for use in still waters with silty bottom and aquatic vegetation. Choose from a wide variety of flavors and colors!
Sinking Pellets - These new sinking pellets are made out of specially selected highest grade ingredients, making them unrivalled bait when it comes to going after fish like carp. Ideally suited for fishing in areas with solid or rocky bottom, these top quality pellets come in a variety of sizes, flavors and colors for you to choose from!


[b]Therefore, sinking and pop-up boilies and pellets work differently for different types of bottom. [/b]

[b]P. S.: [/b]Using boilies and pellets don’t forget to experiment with different flavours. Keep in mind weather conditions and water temperature, choosing boilies and pellets for your carp fishing.

notes.title: Carp Fishing: Flat feeder, PVA Bag/Mesh, Spod(Rocket)
notes.content:
Hey there, Carp anglers!
As you know we have released Carp Fishing with a lot of new tackle. In the next few posts we will give you some detailed information on the unique carp fishing tackle and how to maximize the benefits it.

[b]Flat feeder [/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/72c03bfbba7f5553c418bc8d518c876aa294e565.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/718024a85aa78af467736795e30e22e3d0f8cd2a.png[/img][/url]
Flat-feeder is a special feeder was intended for the carp fishing. This is a new type of feeder designed for use with the Carp Rod. As opposed to the usual feeder, in the flat feeder the hook with boilies balances on the top of the Flat feeder.
In the Flat-feeder can be charged only with special groundbait, made on the basis of sticky, paste-like texture called Method Mix, which takes a long time to dissolve in the water for better bait presentation.

[b]PVA Bag/Mesh[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/17279083f6f573ff77f148ff4a75c326defa1eeb.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ee22e64a1fce96317eb6bd62483f3444f2e93de5.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0273b080da8de349f578d3737ab9e2c9a11dfd80.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2abf0f39b7600a101c438d1f442039f847ae44a9.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b6e476ae0d9d357fcc8c0bf976b6b85cb5adf12f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9dd6a63aceb7ec2bef23782fcf3e2e6976c2334c.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/15419d24712fbee6e426b5602a078257349a05f6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4908a1b52d961b1891daf4e2fc21fff2be32c151.png[/img][/url]
Perfect for carp fishing all year round, these PVA stuff are one of the best ways to deliver your bait precisely where you want to! Just put your favorite groundbait and a carp rig in the PVA bag, tie it tightly, make your cast and wait for it to dissolve! Using PVA mesh, just fill it up, attach it to the leader above the hair rig, make your cast and wait for the mesh stick to dissolve!

[b]Spod(Rocket) [/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b857874e1314af6e73a870dcc32319a48da94dc5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4ba6dc93ffb4ac2ee3677d1f645b73f835cef935.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f9d605ff373359d8fe5e6d127eb81c1dbf5164f0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0ec08061868a80f92df12fc33addbc1e9e9e8c7a.png[/img][/url]
The spod is a special large-volume feeder for delivering baits to the desired point using the spod rod. The main feature of the Rockets, the fact that it is revealed when hitting the water and the whole bait drops out at a time. After that, the opened spod remains to float on the water surface and it needs to be pulled out of the water and you can refill the put out spod with the groundbait again.

[*] Spod rod (Power Launcher), Spin reel (Griffon Spod), New Mono Line (Light Green), Large Spod feeder, any groundbait (Boilies, Pellets/Spod Mix/ ets) 
[/list]
*Please note that type of few bottom rods has been changed to a carp type and you should use related tackles for it.

Also, for more bites, throw a Spod feeder with groundbait in one place 5 times at least. Then catch fish in this place using a rod stand. While waiting, throw a Spod to this place for additional feeding. Watch the surface of the water, maybe in places of fish activity you will be able to catch larger fish.


[h1]2. New groundbaits delivery method added.[/h1]
Together with the Carp Fishing we have added new groundbaits delivery method - hand feeding. Now you can place a groundbait that was mixed on the waterway in the special slot on paper doll and throw it in the water by hand while fishing.

[h1]3.	New waterway: Weeping Willow Fisheries.[/h1]

[b]Willow Lake, [/b]

Hey guys! Spring Cats Tour welcomes you at this spring’s first and most exciting competitive sportfishing event!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3ff22483e5b50ca92620c39595a25f28c73881e2.png[/img]

Catch all kinds and forms of Catfish and Bullhead as you travel to the most mesmerizing fishing destinations of North America: from Missouri’s Mudwater River, to the banks of Neherrin in North Carolina, then the open space of Michigan’s Saint-Croix Lake as well as the swampy wetlands of Quanchkin Lake in the pelican state of Louisiana. Fight your way through the Qualifiers and the Semifinal Round to make it to the Grand Finale and win the title of Catfishing Champion!  Fame, Glory and a prize pool that includes plenty of Credits, BaitCoins and unique fishing tackle and equipment!

12th of March - Qualifier 1 on Mudwater River in Missouri.

14th of March - Qualifier 3 on Michigan, Saint-Croix Lake.
16th of March - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.

notes.title: What’s next? New British waterway and Carp Fishing!
notes.content:
Hello dear anglers! 
Many of you are wondering what’s coming next in Fishing Planet. We are happy to tell you more what we have been working on since the release of feeder fishing and European waterways. Right now we are finalizing carp fishing and a new European waterway.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bc2b5fbb39541da60299f95afb19dc9321c81a82.jpg[/img]

The next one you will get an opportunity to explore is [b]Weeping Willow[/b] located in tin the Kent County of South East England. It is an artificial equatorial complex of five lakes based on the Grasswickshire River. It is a perfect place for the professional anglers made by anglers, where fish species were carefully stocked and cared. Weeping Willow is exceptionally sporty and friendly for anglers and fish water complex.
These lakes will welcome you with a lot of species like Catfish, Pike, Tench, Bream and many more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c341591aeaf77fea774986e0aba6d8b11335b809.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9d930eb3cefead8fef5e1d5781f2623bd4c8d068.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7c24cec3f91c36c6a0e45e8aad3948770717326e.jpg[/img]
 
You’ll be able to practice the iconic British carp fishing and nothing is more welcoming to catch a good carp as the nature of the British valleys.
 
[b]Carp Fishing[/b] is a completely exiting fishing with a specific carp tackles: carp and spod rods, reels, flat feeder, PVA bags, spod, hooks, leaders and sinkers. Carp baits - boilies and pellets will help you to attract fish of your dream.  You will get everything you need to experience uniqueness of carp fishing.

 [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7b5031b5cfdbe7328e6b560090555775e2c06a74.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/291d6f5654eaff9be110dcd65f2e92844c09832d.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5533a79aa09c610670dfcddd43c288e07bb522eb.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bcd6470e62ea2a18708a8089c6ff554f721ac364.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/85d9f5d348785774fbaf46a80d1b313fefdf6f65.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b1670e2386f19915df0aeac94339ff1ff4ae55f1.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/723f2e320784f07e3076e7349e090a0f304d745b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1f803991a74419070c6aa3db084539a3edf2c336.png[/img][/url]

Also, we will add Britain's most popular coarse fish species - [b]Hybrid F1[/b] Carp. A cross between crucian and common carp bred by more than 600 commercial fisheries in the UK. 

[b]We need few more weeks of development before releasing these new features for you and we promise the wait will be worth it![/b]

Akhtuba river is one of the most interesting angling destinations of the country. With its diverse structure, varying depths and currents, Akhtuba River attracts anglers, eager to explore this waterway’s countless fish species

[list][*][b]Сhaika Creek[/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/afb68b2f287076a32b095e33a392974f984ced06.jpg[/img]

-  Locals call Chaika, because of the name of an old abandoned camping site nearby, with shabby wooden houses standing since the days of USSR. Separated from the wide and moderately paced waterway by a small island, these narrow waters have a totally different dynamic with much faster current and a notably different fishing experience that comes with. 

Nevertheless, the little river armlet is swarming with a large variety of different fish:[b] from Caspian Roach and Common Bream to Zander, Asp and Wels Catfish.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9f9d67b4296f9a5ecccb2a733e47033b3714a77f.jpg[/img]

- Densely covered with lotuses and lily pads, it seems as if this still little lake is an aquatic pit-stop, where the hurrying current of Akhtuba River flows to fall into a tranquil slumber when tired from its incessant movement. 
The lake’s calm aquatic depth hides a plentiful array of underwater inhabitants for an angler to hunt on: [b]Blue Bream, Volga Pikeperch, Ide, European Carp, Chub and Northern Pike just to list a few. [/b]

- This beautiful fishing spot is situated on one of the vast and most spacious parts of the Akhtuba River. The broad open area surrounding this lovely riverside beach greets the traveler’s eyes with gradually sloping sandy shores overlooking a somewhat abrupt and cliffy opposite bank. 

 Enjoy this broad open space, as you indulge in catching [b]Asp, Caspian Roach, Tench, Zeige, Silver Bream, Zander and many other fish inhabiting.[/b] 

[*][b]All Hail the Pioneers[/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/23c523e4514bdb7097439a34935ac1ca878dc2a7.jpg[/img]

- Further upstream, in the higher reaches of Akhtuba River, you will discover a lovely steak of a long-forgotten desolate beach that once belonged to an old summer camp for young and daring Soviet pioneers. 

Ah, what an ambient place to spend the day out fishing for [b]Zander, Northern Pike, Asp, and Wels Catfish.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Merry Christmas and have a good carp!
notes.content:
Hello guys!
You know that new European fish have their own unique habits, so we have a few tips for you to catch a really good silver carp or bighead carp in Germany.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cce8e38e2d02d40b2b8acc15e3e4414f50c7eded.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b]Firstly[/b] you need to know that silver carp and bighead carp mostly feed on zoo and phytoplankton near the water surface. 
[b]Keep in mind[/b] that these huge carp fish almost never sink to the bottom. 
[*][b]Secondly[/b], you need to know that it’s large and strong fish! The angler, who decided to catch a few of these giants, should arm themselves with the most powerful match tackles.
[*]And [b]third and most importantly[/b] - the baited hook must be kept near the surface of the water! Even the largest species can be just in a few centimeters from the surface.
[/list]

notes.title: Making your own chum
notes.content:
We wanted all anglers to be able to create their own effective feeder mixes, and so we added a simple and a more advanced way of making your own chum.

[b]Simple chum making.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f7d9310806f0f9c8bbce1884b84a28420774d157.jpg[/img]
This method will work great for anglers who aren’t too sure about their fishing priorities and have no clear preference as to the fish they want to catch. In that case, all you need to do is purchase a basic groundbait mix from the game store and add some water to it. In just a few moments, you’ll get some effective, ready-to-use chum. 
[b]Here’s a step by step on what you need to do:[/b]
1. Buy a pack of basic groundbait mix
2. Go to the desired waterway
3. Drag the groundbait mix to the chum slot on your assembled feeder tackle (or simply double click on the pack)
4. Mix
All done!

[b]Advanced chum making.[/b]
This method is designed for anglers who like to experiment and make the most out of all chum components to have more effective results. This means, you can mix and add different components in the desired proportions:
1. Buy all the components you want
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/fd006ef5d0b3f0f610ac3c56f3607783cc44b26f.jpg[/img]
2. Go to the waterway of your choice
3. Open the chum mixing menu
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8564bd797b0b22e96efe9999e11338e91291c512.jpg[/img]
4. Select the desired proportions for all of the ingredients 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7e8696e4f3761549334b117bffab1704a2c05736.jpg[/img]
You can even save your recipe if you like. To do that, you simply have to enter a name for it. In the future, you’ll be able to get that same mix, as long as you have all of the ingredients in your inventory. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e46cf7015fa7ee845f58783cf78bfe07380ea0e0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9afc5221de30231eee87c22ea0ff6d73067852be.jpg[/img]
5. Mix
6. Get your own unique chum, put it into the chum slot, and go catch some of the biggest fish out there!

[b]Be careful when selecting the proportions for your chum ingredients[/b]. Use such concentrated components like liquid attractants with care: just because the possible proportion for an attractant is 10%, using the maximum amount won’t necessarily make it more effective!
Unbalanced chum mixes might actually distract fish from biting. Make sure to carefully read the description of your chum mix components to get a clear idea of what you want to mix and in what proportions.
[b]Keep in mind:[/b] the right chum, when used in the right places and conditions will not only increase your fish bites, but will attract more diverse and rare fish to the feeding spot! Experiment and explore!

[b]Tight lines and happy feeder fishing![/b]

notes.title: New Level Cap and XP requirements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4c2a84b9d45d6828cfe23a98227d83d57623d837.jpg[/img]

Hey, anglers! Hope you are enjoying the new update! While we are doing some bugfix we'll take our time to tell you in more detail about some features and changes. 

Today we'll discuss the new level cap and what happened to your rank points.

Due to the addition of the new waterways, XP requirements between levels have been changed and all waterways balance has been revised.

Level Cap has been raised from 40 to 50. Ranks XP requirements changed.
XP points have been divided into two parts: Level XP points and Rank XP points. 

All Rank XP points have been separated from Level XP and frozen together with the ranks.
 
You can continue earning them once you reach new level cap of level 50.
On the Leaderboard you can now see both Level and Rank, XP points are summarized to determine player's position on it. 

You can check your Rank XP in the updated Profile Tab.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/978a3570ddbca0080a8fa3adeb0062f6bc4c191a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5e6ec2058b4ed97a3671529c11fd916a7f29d9e7.png[/img][/url] Mirror Carp   and  [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3ee3049e9eb439a03951fe6efa8522279b7686ec.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9018c7ab5bdfa9ca8c92c5dfe7821705e367bb1d.png[/img][/url] Leather Carp  and dozens more!

[b]This update also includes few fish giants that will get on nerves of even hardcore anglers. No one can remain indifferent in the face of 60 kg Wels Catfish and Beluga. [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0af5f2976bc4914d327aa3041c4b5bb2145ce612.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6666fda82b0a0e5c4c741de2d5a48fd1b507e64c.png[/img]

[b]New fish generation system and AI [/b]
We have revised and reworked the fish generation system and AI to make it more realistic:
[list][*]Less specific fish distribution range.
[*]More flexible bite charts
[*]Codependency within the fish ecosystem in the waterway.
[*]Support of the movement of fish schools.
[*]Consideration of  interrelation between different species of coarse fish.
[*]More complex dependency of bites on the weather conditions.
[*]Water temperature indicator added
[*]Effect of chum on fish bites.[/list]
At the moment, this new system is functioning only on the newly added waterways, but will be implemented on all existing fishing destinations in the nearest future.

[b]Bottom fishing and Feeder fishing[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b8130f816f1fc0fdf46038d0aa47397a57423720.jpg[/img]
We have added bottom fishing, including feeder fishing, to the game to enrich your angling experience.

You can catch fish by holding the rod in hand or use special rod stands that will let you make multiple casts using a number of rods simultaneously. The rod’s flexible quiver tip swill show even a slight fish bite, while using an alarm bell is a sure way no to miss it.

Fishing with feeder tackle will work almost anywhere, but this method is most popular in Europe, where there the “white”, no-predatory fish are more abundant. Crucian Carp, Bream, Tench, Common Carp, Common Barbel and many other related species are you most likely catch when feeder fishing!


[b]Fish feeding and chum[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4d4f110ecf7ba21528bf15dd7c24da73e1708295.jpg[/img]

Another long awaited feature coming in this update is fish feeding and chums!

[b]How Feeding works:[/b] feeding implies “providing food” for a certain areas of a waterway to attract  fish and keep them in that area. You just load some chum into the feeder and cast it to the desired spots. Once in the water, the chum begins to spread from the feeder over time, creating feed areas that attract fish. To maintain the high density feed area it’s always a good idea to make repeated casts in the same spot once in a while.

Consider that various factors like the water temperature, flow direction and speed as well as the chum composition and many others affect feed area to create realistic feel of the process.

[b]Making your own chum[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8fd0640ab50d5f89a8dd32f19fa00c2949bb9f68.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/550f5a90f64f2239a4b9746239a0fd14fbf0982a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/aff2a3facc2f78ca1ffac3abc24989789bd7a8c6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a6383bb7ca3c7812f663193ffd3016e01ccd97d3.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6291828e2d625cdc478a42b7073a883eba68d858.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ab6b9bde9d1066ceb1cf0ac5a095daba60b138b4.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e145235e2d5ad93ea16dab419b4db56152fc5c50.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/66fad027dbb9faa6897a5365d8db09454358055c.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/26f8ffce7335f2fe50717c7f3bf98834671e22f6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7c819e1a31cf21eeb58a5c0b065ebc82466d1571.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1bb0bfc7da351aaad079e81621d934074a58fe2f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/78aa698b352a1b88a9a0c002c0828b86fb141450.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f986eb07e5c0ca07ec9469b5a8a5a7497f15cbf6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be48da3f9ab56ab770b44106402b991acc36f78d.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/144e7ef6e41569f3185833757c730f84d15726c4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5cc73369897dd777f5a9d5381b76e6e9fb38fd98.png[/img][/url]
[list][*]Basic Mixing: you just add water to a groundbait of your choice and literally create a basic mix with a single click
[*]Advanced Mixing: combine various ingredients (groundbait , different chum aromas and some particles)  in high precision proportions to create unique recipe that will fit your needs[/list]

[b]Keep in mind:[/b] the right chum, when used in the right places and conditions will not only increase your fish bites, but will attract more diverse and rare fish to the feed area.
There is a separate Chum slot in the inventory for all the chum ingredients: groundbaits, different chum aromas and some particles. Also you can save the recipe for all mixed chums.

[b]Multirods support[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d6ef0002717c7debe5b4e64adacf3f682da317ef.png[/img]
The coolest thing about bottom fishing is the possibility of using different rods simultaneously!
From now on, you’ll no longer need to constantly switch between rods and  baits, making the frustrating choice of what fish to catch first and what tackle to use. The multi-rod function will double your chances of a catch and let you enjoy a variety of fish hunting options!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/82e7f27ce74a80bc0d9aef8f6a986044d631ad84.jpg[/img]
We have added  new fishing equipment - the Rod Stands, that will let you catch fish using multiple rods at the same time! In this update we added 10+ different kinds of Rod Stands, that mostly differ by bite alarms and their rod capacity, being capable of holding from 1 to 4 rods each. Please note, you can take only one type of rod stands to  the waterway.

[b]Bottom Fishing Tackle[/b]
A lot of new tackle has been added to the game for you fully enjoy new types of fishing. This includes: bottom rods, feeder rods, new reels, line leaders, open and closed feeder, bells, sinkers and new small hooks, new strong lines (mono, fluoro and braid), new super heavy casting rods and reels.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5009160b6f06bd3ab79b88489e933237f2f1d25c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ad3c69161b7ac7c603103ddc7999600be8304cb6.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f772442a99d76b389b3be38fb634f92820d42234.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1de4c259e982c3ae9788754076ba1f953521f625.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/77efdb42c612f38f47a879c5c5dbbb9750e3b09b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5fa8924068112591d0dbaf37fc42070c8390de1a.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ef9ab9fede1bdf3f6459bc9ba17e8e36b81c3dbf.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/19ea2f14433eeed79fa3235383ca565a912a00d6.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/48d18d9109b9579f3212add20745b73abf5152b5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/da1c1c549ea0a3bf06cdc79e5259c1ec7430524d.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/33117d0915ecabc126e40705743dc182029899af.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be523eca9767eb08f73750a0bf76de28a697b1c1.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/110680d3e713cc4badc33b5a7c70831c6dec8ca2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/38b809b30a6af65d23e92035ebaa49a5fdc3afd8.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c6f6e3eaa9e7ba8a4d33024fbcc928e36af38dde.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d96c3ba5b5e5956967e62e67a2e7e77fc6f6b524.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/deb2904ac484496cb272b03c57094427daa8953e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d7101d102e88aa7759b46b2ae33fdb49ef2e4afb.png[/img][/url]

[b]Welcome new Feeder Dream Pack[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cb831642b009fd138e0a694a8a814c74ea804bc1.jpg[/img]

Feeder Dream Pack is every feeder angler’s must-have tackle set for an incredibly immersive feeder fishing experience! You get THREE powerful rod’n’reel combos, a full selection of all the terminal tackle, feeder baits, chum, attractants and other equipment along with weekly Pond Passes and Advanced Licenses for the top-3 European feeder fishing destinations!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/730619/

Make sure to complete the following new achievements on the new and existing waterways to get some cool rewards:

[/list]
[b]Level Cap changed[/b]
Level Cap has been raised from 40 to 50. Ranks XP requirements changed.
XP points have been divided into two parts: Level XP points and Rank XP points. All Rank XP points have been separated from Level XP and frozen together with the ranks. You can continue earning them once you reach new level cap of level 50.
On the Leaderboard you can now see both Level and Rank, XP points are summarized to determine player's position on it. You can check your Rank XP in the updated Profile Tab.


[b]New level XP requirements and waterways rebalance[/b]
Due to addition of the new waterways, XP requirements between levels have been changed and all waterways balance has been revised. Travel cost has been reduced for some of the existing waterways.

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list][*]Alaska has been nerfed - aligned with the new level system
[*]New HUD indicators (chum, bottom type, quiver tip)
[*]Water temperature indicator added
[*]Updated UI
[*]Inventory and local map optimization[/list]

notes.title: Feeding: Part 1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6c562d8524857e2285611711def935c2d40d2b58.png[/img]

[b]Hey, anglers! Today we’ll take a closer look at one of the key element of feeder fishing, namely, Feeding.[/b]

Feeding implies “providing food” for a certain areas of a waterway to attract bottom fish and keep them in that area. In this DevBlog entry we’ll tell you all about how the Feeding system functions as a feature within the game.

[b]How Feeding works.[/b]

The chum that you use to feed the selected feed area can have different properties depending on the components used to prepare it. In the game, you can use either basic groundbait mixes by simply adding some water or make your own unique chum by using different components and additives. Either way, the efficiency of your chum will directly depend on the components as well as the conditions in which you plan to use it.

You can prepare the chum mix only when you are already at a waterway, because it stays fresh only for a limited in-game period of time and should be used within the time limits shown on a special indicator in your inventory. Separate packed components and particle mixes, on the other hand, have no expiration date.

Besides, ready-made chum is very inconvenient in terms of transportation. That’s why once you leave the waterway, all the leftovers remaining from your prepared chum will be automatically disposed of.

To start Feeding the fish, you must place the chum into a feeder and cast it to the desired spot.

[b]You can find more info about feeders in this DevBlog entry:

Feeder Fishing: Part 1 https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1708449632711404564
Feeder Fishing: Part2  https://steamcommunity.com/games/380600/announcements/detail/1708450266990638581
[/b]
Once in the water, the chum begins to spread from the feeder, depending on its components, the type of the feeder you are using and the speed of flow. By seeping from the feeder, the chum creates so-called “Feeding spots” or “feed area” that attract bottom fish to the area.

Of course, many factors should be taken into account in order to make the Feeding most effective. You should consider the bottom terrain, time of day, weather conditions, temperature, speed of current, components used for making the chum and what fish they will attract and even the amount of chum you need to distribute in the given area.

It is important to keep in mind that even the most efficient and abundant Feeding won’t help you get many bites, if the feed area is initially devoid of fish. That’s why it’s always important to explore and study the waterway to select the areas with abundant fish activity.

At this stage, the only way of Feeding in the game will be with the help of feeders. In the future, however, we will most likely be adding other methods, like tossing the chum by hand. But it is too early to talk about at the moment.

notes.title: Feeder Fishing: Part 2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1206375552e6be0379f01f304c21fbf516308e01.jpg[/img]
The feeder is usually filled with a special feeder mix made out of many components to attract the fish. By casting the feeder repeatedly in the same spot, it creates a so-called “chum spot” that builds up the feed and attracts the fish, resulting in much more frequent bites and bigger catches!

Before you start feeding fish it’s important to study the bottom terrain and look for areas with higher fish activity and then prepare the feeder bait. Time after time, by filling up the feeder and recasting it to the same chosen spot, you’ll be able to attract a whole school of fish. The length of the hooklink can be adjusted by securing the line to stop it from running, but one must be careful not to lose the hookbait when making a powerful cast. 

You can feeder fish by holding the rod in hand or use special rod stands that will let you make multiple casts using a number of rods simultaneously. The rod’s flexible quiver tip swill shows even a slight fish bite while using an alarm bell is a sure way no to miss it. With some practice and proper effort, this method should definitely pay off, rewarding the angler with a hefty catch!

Сhum  will work almost anywhere, but this method is most popular in Europe, where there the “white”, no-predatory fish are more abundant. Crucian Carp, Bream, Tench, Common Carp, and many other related species are you most likely catch when feeder fishing!

[b]Enjoy your feeder experience with Fishing Planet and tight lines![/b]

notes.title: Feeder Fishing: Part 1
notes.content:
Hey, angling friends! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ea2b07f5834ab51450a3139f70bc78579f215ad7.png[/img]
Today we’ll give you a little insight into the captivating world of feeder fishing and tell you about this very popular technique, widely practiced and much loved by anglers worldwide!
Feeder fishing was originally invented in Great Britain - a nation with an immense history of fishing, and one that particularly enjoys this sporty pastime. 
Two things make feeder fishing different from all other methods: the use of feeders instead of simple traditional bait (that’s where it gets its name from) and the use of special fishing rods with a soft, sensitive quiver tip. 
The quiver tip’s sensitivity shows the rod’s “test”, usually measured in ounces or grams. The right “test” depends on the fishing conditions and target fish that you plan to catch. If properly chosen, this parameter should allow identifying even the slightest fish bites in any conditions. Enjoy your feeder experience with Fishing Planet and tight lines!

notes.title: Welcome Grand Smallie's Cup

Bass fishing is quite an art of its own! And since Fishing Planet wants to help you become a more versatile bass angler, we decided to host a very special Bass tournament, dedicated entirely to Smallmouth Bass! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/13d1c519ba164df9e14d690b0a6b861a19cb23a1.png[/img]

As any Bass angler knows, Smallies are angrier and much more fierce opponents than their Largemouth relatives, which makes the Tournament even more of a fun challenge! So whether you’re a mastermind Bass angler or just getting started in Smallmouth fishing, don’t hesitate to go on this competitive fishing journey for an exciting trip through some breathtaking fishing destinations - from the deep blue waters of Oregon’s Falcon Lake and the the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California in the two Qualifiers, to for the Semifinal Round on Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and over to the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Smallmouth anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Smallmouth fishing Champion and many valuable prizes!

notes.title: Italy. The Tiber. Part 2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a33ad44f189fb3b1db481b867da675c9ad2a2ccd.jpg[/img]
In its first iteration, our waterway will feature 3 locations. However, considering its large size, we have plans for doubling this number in the future. 

[b]Location 1. Twisty Tiber[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0e347af2798fcf658be97b1162c7d6e044c931ae.jpg[/img]
This is an amazing place for all types of fishing. This particular location is the spot where World Feeder Championship was held in 2011. Here, high earthen banks gradually descend into the river, with a only a few trees growing not far from the waterline and otherwise surrounded by vast farm fields and beautiful valleys. Target non-predatory fish: European Carp, Common Barbel and Crucian Carp. 
Target spinning fish: Asp.

[b]Location 2. Float & Feeder Heaven[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ebe4df40970b13d62b0432eaae58e22a90ae3cf3.jpg[/img]
The perfect spot for feeder and float fishing. This is the deepest of all locations, with slow moving water. A little dam makes Tiber flow wider in this area, forming a small water reservoir. The place is located right next to an old vineyard atop green hills. 
Target fish: European Carp and Wels Catfish. 

[b]Location 3. Tiber Rocks![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9031e0b604cf21b3b4daa1931dca29fbd6478135.jpg[/img]
Just a short way downstream from the dam, where Tiber’s streamflow is braided, is yet another fishing spot. Great place for catching Trout with a spinning. This is the most shallow location of all, with fast current and depth of about 3 m (10ft). Many small islands and rocky ridges come into view. 
Target fish: Brown Trout, Grayling and Riverine Brown Trout. 

This was probably the easiest pick of all. Tiber is such a famous river and this particular area is so well-known for hosting major fishing events, that choosing it as a Fishing Planet waterway was a no-brainer for us! 

 [b]Stay tuned and we’ll tell you lot’s more...[/b]

notes.title: Italy. The Tiber. Part 1
notes.content:
Hey, anglers! Today we’d like to give you a sneak peek at what’s coming and tell you about another new waterway from the European region that you’ll be fishing soon enough. We’re talking about la bella Italia! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8b111db8a4dd35fca7938c5c9dd10fb794001e1f.jpg[/img]

We chose the oldest and most well-known river in all of Italy - the Tiber (Tevere).
After all, the eternal city of Rome was founded right on its banks almost 3000 year ago. Tiber is also the third longest river in Italy with an abundance of fish species. 
Our waterway is a part of Tiber in its middle reaches, that passes through the region of Umbria. Here the river turns, meandering past a hilly rural area not far from the small town of Montemelino. The water is a bit turbid in this area, with moderate current. 

Well, first off, Tiber hosted World Championships of feeder, spinning and float fishing. The  particular spot that you’ll see in the game was the site of 2011 World Feeder Fishing Championship, when ukrainian angler Alexiy Strashniy got the championship title. Then there’s also the variety of beautiful landscapes in this area: beautiful meadows with farm fields, vineyards and forests atop tall hills, remnants of ancient structures, an old dam where the river flow separates amidst small islands and rocky ridges. All of this creates an unforgettable atmosphere of peace and tranquility in the very heart of Italy.

notes.title: Halloween's Missions!
notes.content:
[b]What is Halloween without magic and dreadful monsters?
 That is why we have a bunch of special missions for you.[/b]

The main one is  [b]”FrankenFish Hunt”.[/b] But you need to complete them all!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f17772477108922e7640294bbc33afd62bb8a40b.png[/img]
Rumor has it, there’s a abominable monster-fish that will devour anything alive, even humans! The only opportunity to summon and hunt it down is during this year’s Halloween festivities. Head over to San Joaquin, find the island with the Witching Cauldron and deal with the vile Frankenfish!

Second one is -[b]"Get the Book!" [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/85213f8639a50325948643f8d24aea0d6859c7a5.png[/img]
To complete this mission you need to find an ancient magic book and choose that one potion that will help you to summon the Frankenfish.
Head over to Quankchin Lake and catch all of the wicked witch’s pets Catfish at midnight using special Halloween baits to retrieve the magic book!

[b]“Potion of Summoning”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/98559ca811ff38d06b80de8fd0461fccef15e77d.png[/img]
You’re in for a real scavenger hunt and plenty of fishing adventures to collect all of the necessary items for brewing the Frankenfish Summoning potion! Find the Witching Cauldron on San Joaquin and put all of the magic ingredients according to the Witching Recipe Book at the Cauldron!

[b]In next missions you need to collect all the ingredients for the summon potion:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]“Bunch of Mandrake Roots”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2d2deecf5ec36a5af26fcb12b2d4f7c7efc30bfb.png[/img]
Wait for nightfall and head over to Falcon Lake in the mountainous region of Oregon to find these mythical plants that will glow in the dark!

[*][b]“Jar of Fish Eyes”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd75f315c783e8be33cc91caad9a0b575609139c.png[/img]
The second ingredient of the Summoning Potion are Fish Eyes taken from a Bowfin that was caught after midnight using Roaches as bait! This is Frankenfish’s favorite snack and will definitely get his attentions. 

[*][b]“Skeleton Tail”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a70d8404372fe2b5e4c9f46ef8aa11ba5944767b.png[/img]
Let’s start with the Skeleton Bluegill by getting its tail! Catch these fishy Skeletons only in special power places during night time, each corresponding a certain planet.

[*][b]“Ghost Essence”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/29fc6a337f283eeef3a7324d874f61f146541edd.png[/img]
You should put you soul into everything you do, particularly if you’re brewing a magic summoning potion! However, in this case, the Witching Book means literally adding some Ghost Pike essence! Catch enough of these fishy spooks during night time to gather a sufficient amount of their ethereal essence and attract the Frankenfish!

[*][b]“Green Ogre Scale”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/40652c09a8707195cf34e65fbc19a5d1051ba8c3.png[/img]
the summoning potion should be colored in a very sparkly shade of green. You’ll need to add plenty of green fish scales taken from the most fierce and hard-to-catch Gar in Neherrin River. 

[*][b]“Albino Yeti Gills”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b749c0b1f3d27b27a78a7cdbfa1c92089636d119.png[/img]
Catching a monster fish is quite a task. But catching an albino monster fish is even a bigger challenge! Head on over to Everglades night for your next magic ingredient and get some gills from Albino Yeti.

[*][b]“Black Vampire Fin”[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ace811a3e19292987a43186c2dd2d6ed255e1875.png[/img]
Now, the recipe says that you must add the fins of blood-sucking monsters! It’s a good thing that Black Vampire Gars were recently spotted in Louisiana. Of course you can only catch them during night time at Quanchkin.
[/list]

[b]Good Luck to all brave anglers who will try to catch the Frankenfish![/b]

notes.title: The drag systems
notes.content:
Hey, anglers! Today we’ll tell you a little about the basic purpose and functioning of the key feature of most fishing reels - the drag system.
The drag system is one of the most important mechanisms in any spinning or baitcasting reel. Basically, its purpose is to allow the line to slip instead of breaking under the excess pressure from playing a large fish. This prevents from losing your terminal tackle as well as minimizes damage to the rod and reel. 

[b]There are two types of drag systems:[/b]

[list][*]Front-drag in spinning reels

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/57100fce3987adedb4752859f308b541a6204373.png[/img][/list]

The front-drag system is much more sensitive and will react even to the slightest pressure exerted by the fish on the line. The drag system on spinning reels is located in front of the spool. In this case, drag adjustment is accomplished by turning a screw. While the front-drag system is basically a screw that secures the spool, in baitcasting reels, the drag can be adjusted by a single push of a button. 

[list][*]Rear-drag in spinning reels

The rear drag is less sensitive and is more commonly used when angling with heavier tackle to handle the bigger fish, particularly when feeder fishing, trolling or using super powerful spinning rods. It allows for quick and simple adjustment right while you’re reeling in the fish.

notes.title: Fishing in the Netherlands
notes.content:
Hey, anglers:) As you well know, Fishing Planet will soon be expanding its fishing premises onto the much awaited European regions! An so, today we’ll tell you about the Ghent–Terneuzen Canal in the Kingdom of the Netherlands - a place where you’ll be having some unforgettable fishing adventures! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d8a4ac8a1b6e2c90930ace201f1dc119da560f3e.jpg[/img]

Also known as Zeekanaal (or simply the Sea Canal), it links Ghent in Belgium to the port of Terneuzen on the Westerschelde estuary in the Netherlands. This deep canal (about 12m / 40 ft in depth) runs 200m (660 ft) wide and 32 km (20 mi) long, while serving as a navigable passage for large vessels almost all year round.
The in-game fishing locations are situated on the part of the canal near the small town of Westdorpe, just a few miles off the Belgium–Netherlands border. 
The shoreline is somewhat monotonous, which on the one hand makes this area seem a bit dull, but on the other - provides a perfect location for large-scale feeder and float fishing competitions. In fact, World Feeder Championships 2015 was held here as well as countless regional and local competitions. Among other things, this canal is so attractive to anglers because it is inhabited both by typical freshwater species (Ide, Common Bream and Common Roach) as well as sea fish (like the European Flounder, Thicklip Grey Mullet and the European Eel).  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b6516252bf21630082b7972ed1667ff5267ee076.jpg[/img]

Only the eastern bank (right side) of the canal in this location is available for fishing. The fishing area is about 1km in length. Since this waterway is a canal, the steady-sloping grassy bank is basically unchanging, lined with some reed thickets close to the shore. Beyond the fishing area, you’ll see a hilly tree-lined landscape with a highway and farm fields barely noticeable in the distance. 

Although the landscape and the shoreline are largely unchanged, the fishing area can be roughly divided into two parts, that is two fishing locations: 1) An urbanistic bank near a large highway span bridge, overlooking a large elevator and massive warehouses on the opposite side; 2)  A shoreline overlooking Dutch houses and farm fields with windmills.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/47b8c95a28cdb6983109d0e81afc3dc9307215c3.jpg[/img]

[b]Here are some interesting man-made objects that we added as part of the scenery: [/b]
1) a highway span-bridge across the canal; 2) huge cargo ships navigating the canal; 3) towboats and freight-laden barges navigating the canal; 4) an industrial area with a moore and an elevator across the canal; 5) modern and old-fashioned windmills atop the hills across the canal; 6) Dutch-style houses as part of the landscape.

[b]Here’s a quick overview to give you a general idea on how we created the new waterway:[/b]
First off, our game-designer (who is also an expert angler) did some in-depth R'n'D looking for the right waterway in the Netherlands. The key factor to consider was the waterway’s popularity particularly among feeder anglers in the region.  Since we were looking at the Netherlands, we wanted it to be a canal, to add some local coloring. Among other factors were the abundance of fish species, some interesting landscapes (we don’t want to repeat ourselves), etc. Once we found the perfect waterway, our angling game-designer drafted up a detailed plan with a map and all the necessary info that was further handed over to our 3D artists. It was up to them to create the scene, plant the trees and bushes, design and scale the industrial objects, etc. After that, it was up to our programmers to do some coding magic and make the towboats and cargo ships move, the windmills spin, the cars drive and the span-bridge turn. Finally, once all of that was completed, it was once again up to our angling game-designer to create the waterway’s bottom terrain and structure. And right now, we are working on fish setup for this waterway which is one of the final steps before waterway introduction into the Game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d00d34afa4eeef3d7f9ac0fc4375cc86d58435df.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Multi-Rod Fishing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7d13f824924199a45734f27b76f61043e2787e90.jpg[/img]
The coolest thing about bottom fishing is the possibility of using different rods simultaneously! That’s what makes so many anglers hyped about this way of fishing, and that’s exactly what we are currently working on!;) 

Once the whole Multi-rod feature is introduced to the game,  we’ll also be adding new fishing equipment, namely the Rod Holders, that will let you catch fish using multiple rods at the same time!

At first, we plan to add about 7 different kinds of Rod Holders, that will mostly differ by their rod capacity, being capable of holding from 1 to 4 rods each. This means that the player will get a chance to take one Rod Holder on a fishing trip and use it by setting up in any convenient location, as well as adjusting its direction and height. We also plan to add the possibility of taking multiple Rod Holders with a capacity for 1 rod, so that you could set them up in different locations. Certain rod holder models will even have a Bite Signal feature installed.

Aside from this, we’ll also be adding stationary rod holders on some of the waterways that will be available for all anglers to use. 

When all the functionalities related to bottom fishing and rod holders are introduced to the game, the players will be able to fish using various lures and baits simultaneously, which should drastically change everyone’s attitude to float and bottom-fishing rigs!

notes.title: Welcome Mighty Carp Tour Open!
notes.content:

Are you ready to catch the hardest freshwater fish? 
[b]Welcome the opening Tournament of the season - this September’s  Mighty Carp Tour![/b]
 Mighty Carp Tour -  is here to examine your fishers abilities! Are you ready to join the battle with the carp and will you have enough  strength to conquer this freshwater king?
 
Tournament is held on Neherrin River in North Carolina, Lake Quanchkin in Louisiana and San Joaquin Delta in California. 

[b]Target fish – Common Carp and  Buffalo.
Dates: 12/09 - 16/09, Registration begins 11/09/2018.
Schedule details available in-game![/b]

This all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! 

Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some amazing fishing destinations - from the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River and the swampy wetland of Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake in the two Qualifiers, to the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California for the Semifinal Round and the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Carp anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Mighty Carp Master and valuable prizes!

Mighty Carp Tour will be held September 13th through September 16th, with the Registration starting on September 11th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

[b]The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*]11th of September - Registration for the Tournament begins.

[*]13th of September - Qualifier 2 in the swampy wilderness of Lake Quanchkin.
[*]15th of September - Semifinal Round on San Joaquin Delta.
[*]16th of September - the Grand Finale on San Joaquin Delta in California.
[/list]

Do not lose your chance to use the best tackle possible to enjoy your Carp fishing experience to the maximum and get the Mighty Carp Pack with awesome tackle tackle for the Tournament or any angling occasion!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.3.3: Missions Update bugfix
Patch Note 1.3.2: The Missions update.
notes.content:
Hey dear anglers,

if you’re keeping track of the posts in our Dev Diaries, you might already know that aside from introducing bottom fishing and new European waterways, our team is working hard on adding Missions to your Fishing Planet experience!

In this release we are happy to present you the 1st iteration of the Missions update - Tutorial Missions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/eb97b7067dfc7a7ce688548491340401dce996cd.jpg[/img]

These missions are available to all players, and while they were specifically created to enrich and make the learning process more efficient for the less experienced folks, many of them will be quite useful even for the more proficient anglers. After all, Tutorial Missions are based on tasks that help you get a deeper understanding of the game as well as apply logic to choosing the best and most appropriate tackle and baits. This means, no matter how good you think you are, there still might be some cool features you overlooked!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5ae42ce947cd0076709acd8178255b7bb2b72512.jpg[/img]

Tutorial Mission are comprised of a number of tasks accompanied by hints and will be available as you progress all throughout the game.
There is a special Missions tab, where you can see the list of completed missions as well as the description and progress status of the current one. If you choose to track your current mission, all related hints and tasks will be showing up as you play the game. Or you can simply untrack your Mission to turn off the hints and mission widget.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b52f34e350f5a75159e4b85f824c5978cdf4aeda.jpg[/img]

Missions are a new addition to your overall gaming experience that can be both fun and useful, but they are optional, and whether to complete them or not is entirely up to you! However, we do hope that you’ll use this opportunity to sharpen your perspective, learn cool new things and get a better understanding of the game as you explore the Fishing Planet world with Missions and, of course, get rewards for completing them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0885fe694d8d5618c09523fd056e8bee2183ab1d.jpg[/img]

Like we already said, this is only the 1st iteration of Missions update. The next iteration will include more complex missions for more experienced players of average or high proficiency levels and will be aimed at exploring the waterways and mastering your fishing skills. These tasks will require a lot of effort and skill on your part, but with greater rewards to match the sweat and tears you put in! Also, the next iteration of mission will allow you to catch a new special fish that is not available in ordinary gameplay!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cd6d922ed3f7044659b95212dcfe91b2c0aaef2e.jpg[/img]

[b]Besides missions, Patch 1.3.2. will bring you:[/b]
[list]

[*]new challenge: the Barbless Master
[*]Level XP requirements changed to be in sync with new and upcoming missions.
[*]updated local and global map UI
[*]updated game UI
[*]controller improvements
[*]new sound effects
[*]more menu music
[/list]

And so, with the Missions finally out, you can substantially improve your progress, discover cool new fishing spots, tackle and features or simply test yourself to see if there was some stuff you might’ve been missing all along?

notes.title: The Developers Diaries: New Fish and Waterways!
notes.content:
Filled with inspiration and driven by our passion for fishing, we’ve been working on a global update of our game for quite a long time now. Sparing no efforts, we’re dead set to give you a renewed Fishing Planet experience of the highest quality! And since our game is celebrating it’s third anniversary this August, we decided to share some developer inside scoop and give you guys an idea of the great wonders ahead: like the completely new European waterways, even more kinds of fish species, and a few other features you’re sure to love!;) So read on… 

[b]Waterways: [/b]

We’re finally adding a completely new region of the world to Fishing Planet - Europe! Now you’ll be able to enjoy fishing the many european waterways, complete with their own unique vibe, scenic surroundings, beautiful nature and all the realistic details inherent to the region!  

The global map will be represented as a 3D globe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/352783648032095c2980f345fee36bb0c8998a4a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/387d05fb69e0b68bec9e100535d92a34490d5e9a.jpg[/img]

We’ll be adding 10 new waterways in total, all scattered around different european countries. Now you can go on a real fishing adventure and travel to countries like [b]the Czech Republic, Great Britain, Italy, Russia, the Netherlands[/b], and a few other places that we’re keeping a secret for now!;) The first iteration of the new waterways will include 5 new rivers and lakes of the European region. 

[b]At this stage, we’ll be introducing waterways of: [/b]

[b]The Czech Republic:[/b]

You’ll get the chance to indulge in meditative fishing on a delightfully serene little pond, amidst the charming Czech woods, or land a trophy fishing the wide canals in the Netherlands, surrounded by a mesmerizingly urbanistic landscape, or even fill up your keepnet on the boisterous Carp ponds of Great Britain. And that’s not even mentioning the inimitable dolce vita vibe of captivating Italian scenery, that you can enjoy along with fantastic sunsets and the fishing rod in hand! 

[b]Fish: [/b]

Along with the European waterways, we’re introducing over 20 new fish species! Read on to find out more about some of the fish that’ll be added in the first iteration... 

[b]The Czech Republic will be the place to go if you’re up to catching some savoury Tench, Prussian Carp and plenty of Common Roach. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/984c6b628f5b13c5bb0ec3f061278839407f8cba.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b6a41ffc8db16d512977c42c24305c0dfc562c9f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/06d36c33be20e76254d67e7f0d646c25d8a2df27.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0e74ee8dc8d8029268640a581b5f6c686f32f9fc.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a7c3a038c13bbc9a91d66357eea82173da44cb27.jpg[/img]


Aside from all of the above, you guys are in for many more new kinds of fish, that will be quite a challenge to catch and will call for your best fishing skills!;) 

[b]But the introduction of new waterways means not only more species of fish, but also more opportunities! [/b]


Alongside the European region, we’re introducing …. [b]feeder fishing[/b], ta-da!  Now you can enjoy [b]bottom fishing[/b] with the aid of feeders to constantly attract more fish to your spot! Why are so many anglers hyped about feeder fishing, you might ask. Well, thing is, while the fish consumes some of the bait in the feeder, the rest of the bait gets spread around the bottom of that area, which efficiently attracts other fish, thus multiplying your chances of a good catch! This function is literally a gateway to new possibilities, substantially increasing the quantity and quality of your catches!

[b]But even that’s not all. [/b]

[b]Multi-Rod Fishing:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7d13f824924199a45734f27b76f61043e2787e90.jpg[/img]

For now on, you’ll no longer need to constantly switch between rods and lures, making the frustrating choice of what fish to catch first and what tackle to use. The multi-rod function will double your chances of a catch and let you enjoy a variety of fish hunting options! No more tough choices. From now on you can just set up a bunch of rods simultaneously and enjoy waiting for the bites. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c0f8a48bec6f370a50b7140f008e8b7d396d683d.jpg[/img]

Soon enough you’ll get a chance to experience all these updates firsthand and try them out yourself! However, such a massive update calls for great responsibility on our part. We want to make sure that everything functions like clockwork and give our full attention to even the smallest details. This means that we still have a big chunk of work ahead of us. And it’ll require at least a few months to do everything right. But trust us, it’s definitely worth the wait!;)

[b]In the meantime, stay with us to keep track of the updates and… tight lines!;) [/b]

   Dear friends! Summer is here at long last...and for many of us that’s the “it” time of the year for fishing! And what better way to celebrate the start of summer angling season than to participate in our annual annual Bass sportfishing tournament, Virtual Bass Open!

First you’ll go from the blue aquatic vastness of Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake to the endless weedy wetlands of Florida’s Everglades and the curvy banks of Missouri’s Mudwater River in the three Qualifiers, then on to the wide shores of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Semifinal Round...and finally, if you’re lucky, you’ll head straight to Louisiana’s swampy Quanchkin Lake for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Bass anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of VBO Champion and many valuable prizes! 

Virtual Bass Open will be held June 12th through June 17th, with the Registration starting on June 11th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

notes.title: The Dev Diaries: Missions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4b6996e2f6291565d5447c3d45d8e0a9b53bca0f.png[/img]

With regard to our community’s multiple requests for more information about the coming update, this time we’ll be telling you about the new Missions system that we’ve been working on for months straight! Underwater items are actually a part of this functionality that already saw the light of day in the previous update. But now we’re actively finalizing this full feature’s first iteration. One thing’s for sure - whatever your game level, you guys will love this update!;) So if you happen to catch an old boot - don’t get disappointed too quickly - it just might be the mission key to finding a real treasure! 

When you first started playing Fishing Planet, the one thing you had to go through was the game tutorial. But learning new stuff and improving existing skills is something one should be doing all the time, right? And that’s exactly why we’re introducing Missions - to make sure you’re always up to speed when it comes to the game’s newest features and secrets! 
Worry not, angler! We haven’t forsaken the FP’s expansion, and the core part of our team is diligently creating new waterways and introducing more fish species! But in the meantime - why not test your skills by completing our fun new Missions? 

[b]So what are Missions?[/b] Well, basically Missions are a system of objectives to help the player master new mechanics by introducing him to game content through engagement in various activities. This is a rather complex feature, and therefore we divided it into a number of iterations. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/aeab4ff4fe6ece4ff0fe6918ca3b82e1ba2a4cfb.png[/img]

[b]Missions of the first iteration[/b] are tutorial in nature, based entirely upon the learning process to help the less experienced players get a better understanding of the game, like how to choose the best tackle and baits. 
But at the same time, there’s quite a lot to be gained here even by the more experienced anglers.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/98f90d43be703bb8e385c647a8045bc7324dd3ec.png[/img]

[b]Missions are available to all players.[/b] Perhaps there’s a certain feature you overlooked or great fishings spots you were missing all along - you might be surprised by the cool thing you can discover while completing Missions! 
All Missions include a number of tasks for the player to complete and will be available all throughout the game, depending on your progress, waterway, fish  and object you catch. In short, it’s a great way to go over some stuff you might have missed!;) 

We should also point out, that Missions are [b]not mandatory[/b] - meaning, you can decide for yourself whether you want to participate or not. But we do hope that you’ll see more incentive in getting various rewards, that will depend on the Mission’s difficulty level. And of course, Missions are a great way to explore the beautiful nature surrounding the waterways, when you want to take a break from fishing. 

These first tutorial Missions will feature hints to help understand what’s required of the player to complete them.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e06232f52787d6d2c4b0e73078968a1f477d5c7b.png[/img]

Now, the second iteration of Missions will focus on engaging the most experienced players of higher levels. These Missions are designed for pro-anglers and those who never take the easy way out!;) The implied tasks will require a lot of effort and skill on your part, but with great rewards to match the sweat and tears you put in! These Missions will be introduced a bit later - because there’ll be hundreds of them! And we wish to present you with a finished, high quality output, which in turn requires much time for development and testing.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ba43c9435dfd92fae185d290e21e9a07f144d349.png[/img]

Once the Missions are released, you can test yourself and find out just how well you know the game, as well as learn some cool things! So brace yourself for new adventures!;) 

[b]Speaking of Missions, maybe you have some interesting thoughts and ideas on the tasks you'd find interesting and would like to see in the game?[/b] 

[b]We will show you more screenshots next week. Stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.2.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Dear Anglers! [/b]
[h1]Patch Note  1.2.4  is a minor update that includes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]optimization of the inventory - now it works 2 times faster.
[*]underwater items (details below).
[*]snagging and bouncing lure and curving rod issue fix.
[*]complex bugfix.
[/olist]
   While we are working on the new European waterways and lots of new fish, here is a fun update for you in the meanwhile. As Fishing Planet is aimed to give you a fully realistic fishing experience now you can catch some underwater items and creatures, just like IRL.
   Also underwater items are a part of a new complex feature - Mission System which will be released with the next update. In the future you will be able to use them to complete different tasks. 
   Underwater items do not influence the probability to catch fish in any way, you might get them only after the snag. Do not miss the chance to use them to explore the underwater world of the waterways.

notes.title: Game crash issue
notes.content:
Hey anglers,

we have received numerous crash reports after Patch 1.2.0. Please note that the Windows x32 and DirectX 9 are not supported anymore. Also please attention to minimum requirements that your computer should meet for game to perform correctly.

For ATI Radeon card owners if you experience game crashes please disable Dynamic Water in Video Settings. We are aware about this issue and are working on it, in the meanwhile disabling dynamic water should help.

Tight Lines!

notes.title: Major Spring Update. Patch note 1.2.0.
notes.content:
Hey guys! Happy to announce that a [b]Major Update[/b] has arrived with cool new features and improvements, some of which you’ve been waiting a very long time for! So here’s a full overview of this update’s essential points, covering the new features as well as the redesign of some existing functions and giving insight on how it all works:

[*][b]Navigation: depth map and markers.[/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/97918805bbd3888390c9f1786d9847103a0e099e.png[/img]
We added a [b]navigation tablet[/b] showing a waterway map that you can use without leaving your fishing spot by simply pressing the [М] button! This map will show [b]detailed info on the bottom shape and depth[/b] of the initial waterway (Lone Star) as well as provide a general description for the bottom terrain of other rivers and lakes. Players will be able to explore a detailed depth map for other waterways as well as get information about underwater structures and fish using fish finders that will be added to the game in the nearest future. Not only does this map make navigation easier, but it also allows you to [b]leave Marks to highlight your latest fishing spots[/b] and add a corresponding description, as well as randomly mark places on the water surface with special [b]Marker Buoys[/b]. But what’s even cooler is that you can [b]share your Markers with friends[/b]!

[*][b]Photo Mode[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c9096621e7662b7a01f5a154ef6775e06db47b48.jpg[/img]
Now you can capture and share your moments of triumph with others by [b]taking beautiful photos of yourself[/b] holding that trophy catch from different angles! Just press the [P] button while you are still holding the fish and adjust the screen angle to your liking. You can also choose whether or not you want the fish stats to be displayed on your photo. You can make such screenshot of your catch within the Steam interface, by simply pressing F12. 
At this moment, Photo Mode is available only for bank fishing, but we’ll be adding this function for boat fishing a bit later as well.

[*][b]Tackle Templates and Setups[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e9a57179eeca4cfd07824f3bcb592e5fa5563c3f.png[/img]
Templates for your favorite tackle combos are finally here! Simply select a free slot in the Templates Menu to save the your current tackle set-up and reassemble it whenever you need with just one click! And you can even [b]share your set-up Templates with friends[/b]!

[*][b]Limited Home Storage and Inventory Expansion[/b]
Yep, guys. Now that we’re introducing a true-to-life limited Home Storage, you’re gonna have to manage your space by getting rid of excess junk that you’re used to carrying around! But for those who still insist on more storage space, we’re adding a new option of [b]Storage Boxes[/b] for inventory expansion that you can get as part of DLCs or from the in-game Store under the new SERVICES tab. Later on, you’ll also be able to [b]get Storage Boxes as prizes[/b] for various in-game activities.

[*][b]Lure Buoyancy Fixed[/b]
Let’s look at the two main problems regarding lure buoyancy that existed up until now, and how we fixed them, in this simple BEFORE/AFTER overview:
[b]PROBLEM 1[/b]: The time it took lures to sink to the bottom.
BEFORE: All lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same.
AFTER: Now, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it'll take more time for a light lure to go down than for a heavier one.
[b]PROBLEM 2[/b]: How the lures parted from the bottom on slow retrieves.
BEFORE: Some lures would hardly take off the bottom when you made a retrieve using the first or second reeling speed. This would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
AFTER: Now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?

[*][b]New Physics[/b]
Namely:
1) fishing line made more rigid 
2) lure hydrodynamics improved
3) improved collision rendering 
4) line tension and rod tip action improved upon lure hitting the bottom 
5) effect of wind on the lure
6) wind direction indicators and Cardinal Directions added
Now you know where True North is and which way the wind is blowing

[*][b]New sounds[/b]
An extensive reworking of background sounds and the sound of wind added.

[*][b]New Challenge for exploring added at every waterway[/b]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/affd0b4b3e2528f251fcf16fbb806fb795014fc1.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1c46f6b8f2bc4c7c52530cce1c569ea56ac97133.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d11a6bf0bc752d23d5dabd001555e33dfa4db028.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2a63a2f5dcc083d13a734048b382d995a9eafc5c.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9cc2b842281aade671fd71dde1558cd7cf9428b2.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0c0b4ea155cb043942fbb46b2457362ee0049916.png[/img][/url]
Enjoy exploring the game's waterways and their picturesque premises for a certain number of days in a row to complete all three stages of each challenge.

[*][b]Changes to rule settings of competitions[/b]
We fine-tuned the rules for all competitions based on the maximum total fish weight in your Keepnet: Cheesy Cat, Yellow Perch Goldrush, Fly like a Butterfly Swim like a Bass, Sturgeon in the Dark, Big Red Fish. As of now, the [b]size of your Keepnet no longer affects the result[/b] and all fish count, including the ones you let go.

[*][b]Convenient Support Form[/b]
We added info on how to reach us, as well as a convenient support contact form [b]directly from the game[/b]! You can access this new function from the Support tab in the Settings menu. 
In the future, we’ll make it possible to attach a screenshot to your support message. 
Please keep in mind, that the Support team’s reply will be sent to the email address you used upon registration. You can verify it in the Profile tab of the Settings menu.

[*][b]We have added the ability to turn Flashlights on and off[/b] using "J". However, you can connect this function to any other hotkey in the game settings.

[*][b]Chinese Language added![/b] 
Ni hao and welcome, our dear Chinese-speaking friends![/list]

As you can see, this is one extensive update! We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements...and tight lines

notes.title: Spring Cats Tour
notes.content:
Hey guys! Spring Cats Tour welcomes you at this spring’s first and most exciting competitive sportfishing event!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f73cc1b4cafc4a152d67f7cecb5bd60491c3956f.png[/img]

Catch all kinds and forms of Catfish and Bullhead as you travel to the most mesmerizing fishing destinations of North America: from Missouri’s Mudwater River, to the banks of Neherrin in North Carolina, then the open space of Michigan’s Saint-Croix Lake as well as the swampy wetlands of Quanchkin Lake in the pelican state of Louisiana. Fight your way through the Qualifiers and the Semifinal Round to make it to the Grand Finale and win the title of Catfishing Champion!  Fame, Glory and a prize pool that includes plenty of Credits, BaitCoins and unique fishing tackle and equipment!

Spring Cats Tour will be held March 13th through March 18th, with the Registration starting on March 12th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

13th of March - Qualifier 1 on Mudwater River in Missouri.
14th of March - Qualifier 2 on Neherrin River in the fine state of North Carolina.
15th of March - Qualifier 3 on Michigan, Saint-Croix Lake.
17th of March - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
18th of March - the Grand Finale on Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.


Only for the duration of the tournament you can get special tour pack Spring Cats Pack  at 30% OFF!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/591970/Fishing_Planet_Spring_Cats_Pack/

notes.content:
Hello to all our beloved anglers!
Valentine's Day is coming and to make this holiday less about cheesy romantic nonsense and more about what you truly love, we’re hosting the annual Crappie Valentine Cup fishing tournament! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c0e891779ec8569257a701ebbd555f38662b1991.png[/img]

Only for the duration of the tournament you can get special tour pack Crappie Valentine Pack at 25% OFF!
