notes.title: The Dev Diaries: What’s coming in the new update?
notes.content:
Hey guys! We get a lot of questions from you regarding our future plans for the game and what we’re currently working on. Well...we’re happy to tell you that our team is already getting bigger, which means that now we can introduce even more cool features and improvements in the nearest time. So today we’ll give you some inside scoop on the newest features that are being added to the game in test mode as we speak! 

It only seems right to mention that we often draw our inspiration for the new features from your letters, guys. 
Many of you kept asking for a [b]Navigation functionality [/b] to be added - and voila, here it is!
Ever since kayaks were introduced, you can catch fish all over the waterway. This, however, made it a bit difficult to remember the places for best biting. And that’s why we’re adding a couple of features to ease your navigation and let you keep track of all your favorite fishing spots!

-Depth Map. Every location in the game will now have its own unique depth map, so that you can know the bottom terrain and decide where to look or the fish you’re after. 

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603828725/8CF898BAD105FF45463D84EBEDC8F4AF6364769A/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A573&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A573&background-color=black [/img]
-Markers. Now you can mark your favorite fishing spots right on the map! But that’s not all. This function allows you to add a description for every Marker, noting what kinds of fish you caught there, what tackle you used and most importantly  you will share your Markers with Friends in the future! 

[b]Buoyancy improvements.[/b]
 
Yep, we made quite a few changes here!
Up until now, all lures regardless of their weight would sink at identical speed. Be it a 4-gram spinner or a 56 gram bass jig, they’d go down the same. Not anymore!
From now on, just like in real life, a lure’s WEIGHT directly affects how fast it sinks. So now, it’ll take almost 20 seconds for a 4-gram spinner to go down to a depth of 5 meters, whereas a bass jig of 56 grams will plummet in just 5 seconds! 

Remember how frustrating it was when you couldn’t even get some lures off the bottom when making a retrieve at first or second speed? And this would happen regardless of the lure’s weight. Heavy or light - they all behaved the same when you were making a retrieve, which of course wasn’t very realistic.
But now, most of the lures will be showing some action even at the slowest retrieve speed, with the lighter lures lifting off the bottom and having more buoyancy than the heavier ones. Awesome, right?:)

[b]Tackle Setup Templates[/b]
We’re introducing the setup templates to make it easier for you to organise all the different tackle you use depending on the waterway, the fish or a certain competitive event. Those of you who collected copious amounts of different objects overtime will find this feature particularly useful! Now you can use personalized templates to restore and assemble the needed tackle setup with just one click of a button, without having to filter through your inventory in tedious attempts to find the necessary objects, and so - spend more time actually FISHING!;) 
 
Oh yeah, there’s one more feature we’d like to highlight: [b]the Photomode![/b]


[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923671396603846185/D34263BF4E6067FF871F257B033C973220DC009B/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A576&composite-to=*,*%7C1024%3A576&background-color=black[/img]

How often did you find yourself wishing you could save your triumphant catch moments - after all the hard planning, timing, and preparations you put into it? But there was no way to capture it!
Well, that’s about to change! Now you can take beautiful photographs of yourself holding up that Trophy catch at different angles. And then - you can send the pictures to your Friends!  Share your joys and triumphs with the world! 

Well, that’s a quick overview of the new patch that’s coming your way;)
All these cool new features will be added real soon...so keep track of our updates!

And yes, we are always eager to hear your thoughts on how to make the Fishing Planet experience more comfortable and fun! 
So if you have more ideas about improving the boat navigation functionality or making the shore fishing more convenient - let us know!

notes.title: Questions & Answers #4
notes.content:
[b]1. Will there ever be a feature to catch your own bait?[/b]
Yes, definitely. We’ve had it in our minds for quite a while to implement the possibility of making your own bait using small fish or anything you might catch.  

[b]2. Any plans to separate fish by species in the leaderboard? Currently many different species are put together into one group[/b]
Yes, we are planning to make improvements to our Leaderboards in terms of the sorting and sports ranking algorithms. 

[b]3. Will there be more events for all different skill groups? Some of the higher level players are lacking competitions.[/b]
Right now we are actively working on adding the Missions functionality to our game. Once this system is implemented, players of all levels will be able to participate and complete various Missions and tasks within the game. 

[b]4. What kind of alternate types of fishing are you planning to add in the future? (e.g fly fishing, ice fishing, feeder fishing etc)[/b]
Well, first off, we’re planning to add feeder fishing. Actually, we’ve been working on a whole variety of feeder tackle and European waterways since the end of last year.  

[b]5. Console players are interested in controller vibration feedback during catching fish, when the lure hits the fish and similar. Anything planned?[/b]
While we are porting the game to Xbox, we are planning to enhance colntroller settings for all consoles. 

[b]6. Will we ever be able to have more than one person on the kayak?[/b]
No. Kayaks will remain one-person fishing boats. However, we will be adding other kinds of boats, i.e. motorboats and bass boats. Now, these vessels will let the players enjoy their co-angling experience with friends. 

[b]7. When will Club Competitions be introduced?[/b]
Only when the Clubs themselves are created:) Unfortunately, our team will be focusing on other more pressing issues during the next few months. But of course, we do have plans for creating special Club competitions and tournaments in the future.


[b]8. Do you plan on adding more gear and game content in general for max level players?[/b]
Yes, most definitely. This year we will be adding new feeder tackle and various jig rigs, i.e. drop-shot, carolina, texas rigs.

[b]9. What is the ETA for the next big update?[/b]
End of February / beginning of March we are planning to release some new features. 
 
[b]10. Is there technical possibility for implementing a function that would allow to watch another player (a friend) fishing? Many games (e.g. Dota2 or Heartstone) let you to watch another player if the player either allows it or the competition is held publically. Have you considered such a possibility? [/b]

Yes, we’re considering the possibility of adding such a function. However, it’s not in development at this time, as we have more pressing issues to work on, like creating a more convenient sports ranking system. 

[b]11. Are you planning to increase the max level in the game? [/b]
No, we aren’t.

notes.title: Winter Pike Tour
notes.content:
Hey guys! The month of January brings you a tournament that’ll make it feel like Christmas all over again! Just make sure to register in time and take part in the annual Winter Pike Tour - a competitive sportfishing event that’s all about landing some big fat Pike! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/cf866731695fb3e453a67e455446d545e21d2d31.png[/img]

Accept the challenge and set out to explore the specifics of Pike fishing in many amazing destinations, like the mesmerizingly remote and delightfully swampy Quanchkin Lake in the Pelican State of Louisiana, peaceful Mudwater River and breathtaking Lakes White Moose and Emerald as you heroically battle through the 3 Qualifiers, the Semifinal and move on to the Grand Finale on Michigan’s vast Lake Saint-Croix - all to prove yourself as the one and only Pike Fishing Champion, win valuable Prizes and most importantly have fun!

Winter Pike Tour promises to be a thrilling competitive battle full of drive, fun and fishing excitement! It will be held on will be held January 16th through 21st, with the Registration starting on January 15th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The full Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

15th of January - Registration for the WPT Tournament begins.
16th of January - Qualifier 1 on Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake. 
17th of January - Qualifier 2 on Mudwater River in Missouri
18th of January - Qualifier 3 on the snowy White Moose Lake in Alberta, Canada.
20th of January - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizing Emerald Lake in New York. 
21th of January - the Grand Finale on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.

Only for the duration of the tournament you can get special tour pack Winter Pike Pack at 30% OFF!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/496438/Fishing_Planet_Winter_Pike_Pack/
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e0e70c154662f344cb0282a2f74ed4dbb3ac87d3.png[/img]

notes.title: A letter to Santa
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6d4fa6967c6d5520de883fbea131bf75a3dc22d5.jpg[/img]
Hey there, angling friends! 
Believe it or not, but every now and then Santa Claus himself enjoys a day out fishing in the company of his magic elves. That’s why he particularly enjoys reading any mail coming from a fellow angler!

So how about writing a letter to Santa and his elves to tell them about some of the fishing adventures you had this year? Let them know which places you’ve been, what tricks you’ve learned, and don’t forget to mention what kind of present you’d like to get in the Fishing Planet game for Christmas!

We’ll make sure to pass the letter on to Santa and will see to it that the writers of the most creative, interesting and original stories get their rewards!

[b]Contest Rules:[/b]
1. Write an interesting story about your fishing experience, mentioning what kind of present you’d like to receive in the game and explain why.
2. Send us the letter to olga.k@fishingplanet.com
3. All letters must be written and sent before Dec 24th, of course;)

[i]Winners will be announced on Dec 25th and get some presents and perhaps, if they are persuasive enough, even the present they asked for in their letter to Santa;) [/i]

The more interesting, funny, sincere or original your letter will be, the more chances of touching Santa’s heart and getting what you want! :)

[b]Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5974da55fda578ffa937b1ce2716f5e64a339d55.png[/img]
Then of course, do not forget about Christmas Giant’s Tour - the final fishing Tournament of 2017.

For a full joy of this special event we  compiled the limited Christmas Magic Pack with unique collectible holiday-themed rods and reels!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ac6629392799d2a494699247f357382ef3b809c4.jpg[/img]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/730612/

notes.title: Christmas Giant’s Tour
notes.content:
Hello guys! This time we’d like to tell you the most sizable Tournament of the year - the Christmas Giant’s Tour! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/76bdcb9e269cf2a9e48e710a2fd6f5f454d44a97.png[/img]
This event isn’t about any particular kind of fish, the key rule here is: the bigger the better...and not just big...but GIGANTIC! Yep, we’re talking super-huge Trophy-sized monsters: Trout, Pike, Salmon, Burbot, Catfish, Muskies, Bass, Gar, Snook, Dolly Varden...the list can go on and on! It’s not the name, it's the size that matters. Yep, this is the big league, boys and girls and we’re doing some heavyweight fishing! Tight lines!

Christmas Giant’s Tour will be held December 19th through December 24th, with the Registration starting on December 18th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The CGT Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

18th of December - Registration for the Tournament begins.
19th of December - Qualifier 1 on on the snowy White Moose Lake way out in Canada.
20th of December - Qualifier 2 on on Michigan’s Saint-Croix Lake.
21st of December - Qualifier 3 on Florida’s Everglades.
23rd of December - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizingly beautiful Kaniq Creek in Alaska.
24th of December - the Grand Finale on California’s San Joaquin Delta.

And for all the big league boys and girls out there who are up to enjoying this supersized challenge, Santa’s got another present: the new Christmas Giant’s Pack! This exclusive Pack features a full selection of CGT Tournament-edition tackle with enormous potential to match the size of the occasion!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/730611/

notes.title: Patch note 1.1.11.
notes.content:
Hey dear anglers,

the main highlight of this patch is that [b]kayaks are now available in the in-game store![/b]

We have added 4 kayaks to the in-game store for you to to choose from so you can fully enjoy the variety and thrill of kayak fishing:
[list]

notes.title: Grand Smallie's Cup: Final Results
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/13d1c519ba164df9e14d690b0a6b861a19cb23a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Questions & Answers #3
notes.content:
[b]Do you have plans for future feature for kayaks? Like stand-up position?[/b]
We have only just began our work on the kayak feature, so you guys are definitely in for cool updates. Overall we plan to implement rod holders and trolling as well as an option to use multiple rods simultaneously.

[b]Will we ever get a topographical map of the waterways showing bottom features and structures with a waypoint / note pad added to it?[/b]
Yes, the next big feature that we are currently working on and will eventually add to the game are the new topographical maps with indication of bottom relief, depth and fish habitats as well as the option of leaving your own personal marks on the map. So keep track of the news and prepare for cool new updates;)

[b]What are some fish species that are coming to Fishing Planet in the future?[/b]
New fish will be added to the european waterways. And we’re talking about over 30 new and unique species that are typical for the european region. 

[b]Can you implement a compass on the screen to know which direction you are facing?[/b]
Soon enough we’ll add a compass, indicators of wind and current, water temperature and other meteorological data. But that’s gonna happen once we implement the new waterway maps, right after adding sonars and fishfinders. 

[b]What are your plans for players who have reached level 40? Raise the level cap maybe? The game needs longevity.[/b]
At this moment, players who’ve reached level 40 can keep getting more experience and ranking. But of course we understand that these players want more and so, we’re thinking about adding new high-end content. 

[b]Do you plan to expand the character customization functionality? Obviously, it’s not that important in a fishing game, but still… [/b]
Yes, we definitely plan to enhance the character customization and add more variety for the clothing option. At the moment, however, our team is mostly focused on matters that have to do directly with the fishing process. 

[b]Are there going to be any discounts for DLCs on Black Friday or Cyber Monday?[/b]
Definitely yes. Quite soon we’ll be launching our Autumn Sale, which means you’ll be able to get our exclusive tackle packs with a huge discount! So keep track of the news and don’t miss this unique chance:) 

[b]How about some cool polarized sunglasses to see into the water a little better? Might be a thought for the 40+ level guys to earn somehow![/b]
Sunglasses were a part of the game’s initial plan, right from day one. This feature will be added eventually, however not in the nearest time. 

[b]Are you planning to expand the possibilities for interaction between players in the game?[/b]
Once we add the Team functionality to the game and the option of creating Clubs becomes available, players will gain access to new social interactions that will include group travel, fishing together from one boat (co-angling) and other possibilities. 

[b]Do you plan to add locations that are accessible only from a boat? It would be cool to have a fishing spot somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean with sailboats and some tuna fish![/b] 
In the nearest future we will be adding only freshwater fishing destinations. We do however plan to substantially increase their size so that you can have more space to explore and look around for perfect fishing spots.

notes.title: Grand Smallie's Cup Announcement
notes.content:
Bass fishing is quite an art of its own! And since Fishing Planet wants to help you become a more versatile bass angler, we decided to host a very special Bass tournament, dedicated entirely to Smallmouth Bass! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/13d1c519ba164df9e14d690b0a6b861a19cb23a1.png[/img]

As any Bass angler knows, Smallies are angrier and much more fierce opponents than their Largemouth relatives, which makes the Tournament even more of a fun challenge! 

So whether you’re a mastermind Bass angler or just getting started in Smallmouth fishing, don’t hesitate to go on this competitive fishing journey for an exciting trip through some breathtaking fishing destinations - from the deep blue waters of Oregon’s Falcon Lake and the the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California in the two Qualifiers, to for the Semifinal Round on Michigan’s beautiful Saint-Croix Lake and over to the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River for the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Smallmouth anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Smallmouth fishing Champion and many valuable prizes!

Grand Smallie’s Cup will be held November 21st through November 26th, with the Registration starting on November 20th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:

20th of November - Registration for the Tournament begins.
21st of November - Qualifier 1 on Lake Falcon in Oregon.
22nd of November - Qualifier 2 San Joaquin Delta in California.
25th of November - Semifinal Round on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix.
26th of November - the Grand Finale on on Neherrin River in North Carolina.

Grand Smallie's Pack is a limited edition exclusive Pack created with the subtle art of Smallmouth Bass fishing in mind, to give you all top notch combat-mode tackle that’ll help you achieve a Champion performance!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/91fe4306ad7f39abb78b73f58772ea47257e437e.jpg[/img]

Complete with exclusive Tournament-level tackle, Grand Smallie's Pack includes powerful Smallmouth combating weapons, like the GSC BassFinder™ pro casting rods and the super muscular GSC DynaSwirl™ casting reels, along with the limited collectible goodies like the super tough GSC OmniCase™ rod case, the handy GSC GoodyBox™ lure box and of course the lucky-streak GSC Buffer™ fishing jacket! You also get a whole bundle of goodies including all the terminal tackle, equipment and licenses you need to enjoy your Smallie fights.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/591987

notes.title: Developer diaries. Boats
notes.content:
Hey anglers!

What’s up?! My name’s Yuriy and I’m a lucky guy - happy to be a game designer at Fishing Planet!  
Being only a casual amature angler, I nevertheless totally get the thrills when my line becomes tense, promising that big catch. Actually, there was one extremely emotional moment that I experienced while boat fishing for pike last fall. And yesterday while playing Fishing Planet I literally had a deja vu and experienced that same sensation, that exact tremor….as I took a kayak into some reed thickets and cast my bait...and felt the line go tight with tension. But you guys know that feeling as well as I do. 

Right from day one, we designed Fishing Planet as a fishing simulator with boats. All this time, you’ve probably been wondering why we created such huge waterways like Emerald or San Joaquin, with great open spaces that you couldn’t reach anyway. And now, finally, all that great potential is going to make sense! In order to do that we approached the matter with utmost seriousness! 

Part of the team went out and rented actual kayaks (luckily, our office is located right by the riverside;) to see and feel for ourselves what it’s like to go boat fishing from a kayak. You see, while it may be quite widespread in the USA, for us here kayak fishing was a completely new experience. Many of us were actually riding a kayak for the first time in our life. 

[img] https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/856107890649354831/270A11C313C8716260116CA3DC5207CF9E5F51B9/[/img]

Those few of our team members who were quite experienced, instructed the rest, and were only making meticulous notes to ensure that the in-game kayaks would behave just like the real thing and that kayak fishing dynamics and mechanics are true to life. 

[img] https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/856107890649358156/5D5EF8096882D3CF52D8CAD4141E0BB69ADEB55A/[/img]

As it is often the case, the creation process of one boat type alone turned out to be way more difficult than we expected. This was mostly because our programmers wanted to go the whole way and recreate fully true to life physics of the kayak’s behavior, rather than make a primitive model that would be a very distant imitation.

The kayak is propelled through the player’s rowing movements and depends on technique to not turn over or get stuck on shallow shoals. This means that it’s rather challenging to control it and that was precisely what we were after. 
In the future we plan to improve the rowing system to make kayak controls even more realistic, but even now I hope you’ll enjoy the opportunity to explore the vast open spaces of our rivers and lakes and do some boat fishing, of course! 

Here’s an insider tip for you guys: hurry up and enjoy your kayak fishing the way it is right now, because in all probability our future updates will feature new improvements to make the catch way more challenging and probably put limitations on the tackle you can use for kayak fishing. After all, it’s not so easy to make a cast with that long telescopic rod while balancing a kayak, right? 

[b]So what’s next?[/b]

Why, motorboats, of course! So I hope you’re already looking forward to some dynamic boat speeding action!

After that will come new waterway maps and fish finders, of course! 
We also plan to broaden the scope of possible interactions with some of the boats’ separate elements. And you can definitely expect some boat fishing competitions in the future!

Believe it or not, but I’ve been waiting for all this for the last few years! 

[b]So, what would you like to find out about in our next entry?[/b] Ask away, give us topic ideas...and we’ll make sure to give you the hottest inside scoop on what’s cookin’ in our gamedev kitchen!;)

notes.title: Questions & Answers #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/f4b15d439d8bfc590e12f18002726ec95933b7be.jpg[/img]

[b]1. Will boats come to all maps?[/b]
Yes, to almost all maps, except for small lakes like Lone Star or Rocky Lake and speedy Kaniq Creek. But you’ll be able to enjoy boats and kayaks on the rest of the waterways.  

[b]2. Are we going to get motorboats and be able to fish with multiple rods at any time?[/b]
Motorboats are currently in development, we are actively working on their creation and implementation - so keep track of our news. As for fishing with multiple rods, this feature is next in the line. 

[b]3. Are you planning to add seafishing? What about new locations in general?[/b]
The game’s waterways that we plan to add next will still be freshwater ponds, located predominantly in Europe and Great Britain. We do plan to add sea fishing eventually, however not in the nearest future. 

[b]4. At this stage of the game, catching small fish (Crappie, Perch etc) is useless for higher level players because of the lack of money and it makes players only fish for the big guys. Will it ever be reworked to make all fish worth catching?[/b]
At this point, higher level players can use their skills at catching smaller fish to win tournaments and competitions. Once we add Missions and Quests to the game, fish of all sizes will become equally worthwhile catching for all the players. 

[b]5. What are your plans with baitCoins? There aren't many ways of collecting them at the moment.[/b]
In the nearest future we plan to add new competitions that will feature BaitCoins as part of the prize pool. Also, don’t miss the chance to complete our Halloween (and later, Christmas) challenges and get your reward! 
 
[b]6. When is PS4 getting all the updates PC has? Why does it take so long?[/b]
In November we are planning a PS4 update that will feature topwater, night and boat fishing. We fully understand how much you guys want to enjoy the latest version of Fishing Planet on your favorite console. But the update approval cycle takes up to a month, not to mention extra time is required to port the new content to console. But we will do our best to satisfy your expectations as soon as we can.

[b]7. When will characters be worked on? They currently look all the same with minor differences.[/b]
At this point, we are focused on boats and don’t plan any expansion of options regarding the in-game characters and their outfits in the nearest time.
  
[b]8. When is the Xbox version of Fishing Planet coming?[/b]
We are currently working on porting the game to Xbox. The release is planned for the first or second quarter of 2018. 

[b]9. Are you planning on working on the weather system and making it more dynamic?[/b]
Definitely. We are gradually expanding the in-game weather functionality and are currently working on improvements to cloud and wind behavior. 

[b]10. How do you plan on making the game more interesting for those who have reached Level 40? Better ranking system, achievements etc.[/b]
That’s right, we plan to completely change and improve the competitive ranking system to make things more interesting. This will motivate players of various skill levels to participate in competitions and grow to become pro players and pro anglers.

notes.content:
Forget Trick-or-Treating and better do some real monster fighting, cuz you’re in for the ultimate Gar tournament!

But don’t let these powerful giants make you forget that you also have other opponents, represented by some of the best anglers walking our Planet! Compete against the most ferocious opponents and make your glorious way through the 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Great Finale that’ll show who’s who on the monster fishing arena!

notes.title: Developer Diaries. Part 1. Overview
notes.content:
Hey folks!:)

From this post on, we’ll be sharing with you how things are on our side of the screen! We’ll let you in on our thoughts and secrets as well as make sure to keep you updated on what we’re currently working on. Follow the bold and daring plans of our programmers, daydream together with our designers and graphic artists and get the overall vibe of Fishing Planet’s dev team!

But first, let us thank you guys for supporting us from the start! We know and remember all those who were with us right from day one and feel that we’ve truly bonded after all these years. We couldn’t have done it without you! 

And now that we’re officially released it’s almost impossible to believe in the long road that’s been leading us up to this point for the past few years! We’re officially out on Steam as well as PlayStation®4. [b] For those of you who asked about Xbox… [/b] Yes, we definitely plan to port the game to this platform and are already working on that!

[b]BOATS[/b]

But the main focus atm is the new big update we’re working on right now! Those of you who were most attentive already noticed the Garage icon we added a while back and guessed correctly in thinking that we’ll be adding Boats soon!;) Not much longer to wait! We’re already preparing a teaser video to give you a sneak peek! This awesome update will come out on Steam first, and after a month or two will become available on PS4.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/862a3a185547ce7d72eeb3b9b39a571664da82c9.jpg[/img]

The first update with boats will feature kayaks that you can use for boat fishing on 5 waterways.  After a while we plan to add zodiac boats, bass boats and other motorboats as well as extend our boat fishing waterways for more exploration opportunities.   

[b]NEW LOCATIONS[/b]

Way back in the beginning of our journey, the Fishing Planet dev team was just a handful of people with countless dreams and numerous plans! We wanted to add waterways and fishing destinations from all around the globe. And it was extremely difficult to narrow our point of focus and choose something specific to put our efforts into.   

But that choice was made. And as you all know - we began our journey with North America. The variety of fish species in this region played a significant part in this decision. The territory of USA alone is home to over 1000 different kinds of freshwater fish! There are as many as six types of Bass here, that’s not including the hybrid forms. 
Another reason was that one of our game designers is an avid angler who spent a lot of time traveling this region and was mesmerized with American waterways, knowing exactly which fish species are found there and what their behavior patterns are.   

But the game is growing and our plans are too! As much as we love these locations, we already started creating European and British fishing destinations. Actually, one British waterway is finished - Weeping Willow Lake and we’ll show you more screenshots soon enough! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/3c6900beb64a8f604d81c7999521fc3d59aaea94.jpg[/img]

[b]BOTTOM FISHING[/b]

But that’s not all. We’re also busy working on 50+ new European fish species, that will be added to the game together with the new ponds. 

As we already told you in our Q&A, we plan to release the new waterways and fish species together with bottom fishing in one big update. We had plans to add bottom fishing for quite a long time and now finally began working on this cool feature! Right after we release the boat fishing update, we plan to put all our focus into bottom fishing development.  

[i]Well, that’s probably enough info for now:) We’ll make sure to keep you informed about our plans and overall day-to-day life. It’s hard to decide what to talk about, so how about you help us out and tell us yourselves what you’re interested in and what you’d like to know more about? Please, comment below and let us know![/i]

notes.title: Questions&Answers
notes.content:
1."What is the garage icon for at the bottom of the Inventory page? Will this be for boat access and when can we expect boats to be launched?"

That’s right - the Garage will soon be the place from where you can access Boats. That’s exactly what we are currently working hard on and we plan to release this feature in the nearest future. Actually, we’ll share a video with you guys next week! Make sure to keep track of our news - it’ll be fun!  

2. "Will we see traditional carp fishing features such as bite alarms, bottom bait fishing .E.G boilies. Also in combination with some British waters?. Thanks"

Right now, we are actively working on bottom fishing, feeders,  as well as British and European waterways.  We already finished a new aquatic complex in Great Britain called the Weeping Willow Lakes and are currently working on Dutch and German waterways.  We’ll soon show you a sneak peak of the new location and + 40 European fish species. However, we plan to release all of these features (European ponds and Bottom fishing) together, as one complex update. 

3."Are there any plans to do a port for Xbox one?"

We definitely have Xbox in plan and are currently busy with porting the game to this platform. At this time we can’t say anything about release dates, so keep track of our news and updates - we’ll be sure to let you know!

4.Would u consider legendary fish ? even bigger then the unique versions
Yes, we’re thinking about introducing Legendary Fish as a part of Quests or Game Missions.  

5."Will you be adding quests and missions and more achievements(that are not related to tournaments) because at the moment if you're not interested in competitive fishing there's nothing to do other than just fish and after a while it's hard to stay enthusiastic about fishing when you have no goals"

We are thinking about adding Quests and Missions to the game, but at this point our key focus is centered on new core features, such as Boats and Bottom Fishing. 

6." My main question is why baitcoins are now required for unlimited licences on all locations? Would much prefer if it was back to just credits/cash like how it used to be."

Unlimited Licenses are a premium feature. Skilled and experienced players can earn enough BaitCoins to buy an Unlimited License for their favorite location.

7. "Do you guys plan on adding new fishing locations on PS4 to catch fish like amberjacks , grouper, marlin? And also when will there be night fishing available on the PS4 version?"

We plan to add night and topwater fishing on PS4 by the end of this year. But we do not plan to release saltwater fishing in the near future.


8."When developing the bite behavior for the fish, food preferences, and general fight characteristics, which species did you guys find hardest to portray?"

At this point we had the most difficulties with behaviour tuning for all fish of the Salmon family, Trout in particular. 

9. "Will there ever be a way to create your own lures? How many times I've wished I had a 3ft 5/0 lemon yellow crankbait or a 1.oz 3/0 rainbow spinner etc."

We have a Craft System in plan, that will allow you to create your own custom lures and baits. We plan to release an early version of this feature together with Bottom Fishing.

10. "Will ducks, deer, wildlife etc. ever be introduced into the game. It would help drastically with emersion and overall game experience."

We definitely plan to introduce wildlife to our waterways! Actually, we already added animals as a test feature a few times. For instance, there was a bear on Kaniq Creek last year...but he probably had enough salmon to eat and is currently sleeping in off in his lair;)
As a matter of fact, you can bump into an alligator while fishing right now! Have you met one?;)

notes.title: Mighty Carp Tour
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/11bafbad1ae6b098cd63d7612cdf4294eb163e37.png[/img]

Behold the mighty Carp! And welcome the opening Tournament of the season - this September’s first ever [b]Mighty Carp Tour[/b]! 
[list]
[*]Tournament is held on Neherrin River in North Carolina, Lake Quanchkin in Louisiana and San Joaquin Delta in California. 
[*]Target fish – Common Carp and Smallmouth Buffalo.
[*]Dates: 13/09 - 17/09, Registration begins 12/09/2017.
[*]Schedule details available in-game!
[/list]
Although somewhat undervalued in North America, this all-time European favorite game fish is quite a fun challenge to catch. That’s why we’re eager to bring this competitive Carp fishing experience your way and see you work that angling magic on the hardest freshwater fish to fool into biting! 

Those of you who embark on this competitive fishing journey are in for an unforgettable trip through some amazing fishing destinations - from the wide banks of North Carolina’s Neherrin River and the swampy wetland of Louisiana’s Quanchkin Lake in the two Qualifiers, to the mesmerizingly picturesque San Joaquin Delta in the sunny state of California for the Semifinal Round and the Grand Finale, in which 20 toughest and most skilled Carp anglers will face each other in an epic showdown for the title of Mighty Carp Master and valuable prizes!

[b]Mighty Carp Tour will be held September 13th through September 17th[/b], with the Registration starting on September 12th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:
[list]
[*]12th of September - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*]13th of September - Qualifier 1 on Neherrin River in North Carolina. 
[*]14th of September - Qualifier 2 in the swampy wilderness of Lake Quanchkin.
[*]16th of September - Semifinal Round on San Joaquin Delta.
[*]17th of September - the Grand Finale on San Joaquin Delta in California.
[/list]

New exclusive [b]Mighty Carp Pack[/b] with new match rods and reels and awesome tackle for the Tournament or any angling occasion!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/591980/

notes.title: Topwater & Nightfishing Update (v.1.0.0 Patch note)
notes.content:
Hey there, angling community!

We prepared an awesome update with amazing new features, including TOPWATER and  NIGHTFISHING, as well as new line and lure physics!

[b]Main highlights[/b]

[h1]Topwater :[/h1] [list]
[*]We created new topwater fishing lures: Walkers, Poppers and Frogs.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ec0249835ef0124dbb4cc0ebd4291669b1aa765a.png[/img]
[*]Two new retrieves added: Popping and Walking.
[*]Substantial changes to line and lure physics.[/list]

[h1]Night Fishing:[/h1][list]
[*]Changes to fishing Licenses: Night Fishing is permitted only with Advanced Licenses.
[*]Changes made to the shift between fishing days: your catch in the fishkeeper is sold at 5 a.m. every next morning. This means you can keep fishing all night long!
[*]New fish activity charts for nighttime added.
[*]New tackle for fishing in the dark: rods with fluorescent tips, that let you see the fish bite even in total darkness!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/de422432472359b24b7d08f5ba76da4cfac27b98.png[/img]
[*]We also added holographic lures of different weights snd sizes: luminescent Cranks and glow in the dark soft lures: Craws, Worms and Shads.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4088fb5f5fc80dce547339746f0fcf9c377710e7.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2b96760221d6231fe42d55b345e8b6a150136050.png[/img]
[*]A wider selection of glow-in-the-dark floats: now slim and pear-shaped floats added.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c93b992a5a7702791360bfaebb3702053a7a23f6.png[/img]
[*]New unique fishing cap with flashlight that you can get for completing the new "Night Shift" challenge.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ce19e5250e024a73f18e4225b48b16d4c6595381.png[/img]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][list]
[*]New animation for underwater lure indicator. 
[*]New Ardix match rod and LineGlider spinning reel added.
[*]Level requirement changes made for Brutus rods as well as reels of Hornet Swarm and Espira DoublePunch series.
[*]Retrieves system has been reworked.
[*]Last selected rod now is saved.
[*]Pitching flag for each floating rod will be saved during pond session as well.
[*] Last selected in inventory rod will be automatically taken in game when you leave inventory
[*]Auto selecting first equipped rod when last used was disassembled[/list]

[h1]Topwater Midnight Pack[/h1]
No fishfight is more visual and powerful than a proper topwater battle! And nothing compares in its atmosphere to a night hunt! Both spectacular and challenging in their beauty, topwater and night fishing are a complex art that equally requires sharp skill and the right tools! That’s why we created the TOPWATER MIDNIGHT PACK - for all anglers who can handle the eye-popping action and raw emotion of confronting your scaly enemy face-to-face and bring in the catch in the darkest hours!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/591981/

notes.title: FISHING PLANET GOES FROM BETA TO FULL RELEASE!
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

It’s been 2 long years full of fun and exciting adventures within our Fishing Planet world...and now we are happy to announce that we're going from Early Access to our official STEAM RELEASE! You’ve seen us grow, you’ve supported us and it's fair to say that you played a huge part in creation of the whole virtual fishing ecosystem! 

We’re happy that our fishing community keeps growing and cherish every one of our players, working hard to make you guy happy and introduce as many new and interesting features as our small team can, at this stage.  

And so, we prepared an awesome new update with amazing new features, including NIGHT and TOPWATER fishing, which will be available in a few days!

notes.title: Fishing Planet coming to PS4
notes.content:
Hey dear anglers,

As many of you know, we have been working on porting the Fishing Planet game to the consoles. And now we are happy to announce August 29th as the official release date on PlayStation®4.

Fishing Planet is the 1st F2P fishing simulator available on consoles. If you are an owner of one, prepare to indulge in the fantastic world of fishing without having to leave your couch, playing your favorite console!

Moreover, we have also implemented PlayStation®4 Pro support, which allows to fully enjoy the super realistic graphics, erasing the line between reality and the virtual fishing world. 

Fishing Planet hits both American and European PlayStation®4 stores on August 29th.

Those, who do not have PlayStation®4, do not feel blue, as we have prepared interesting updates with new functionality that are coming pretty soon! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Fishing Planet Anniversary
notes.content:
Hey, dear angling community!

Guess what? It’s our Birthday soon! Yep. Fishing Planet is celebrating its 2nd Anniversary of coming into this world and uniting anglers from all around the globe in their favorite pastime! This surely calls for a celebration and treats. So we prepared an amazing gift and a special Anniversary Tournament for you to enjoy!

[b]Special Gift: 3 DAYS of Premium Account for FREE[/b] to every angler showing active participation in the game as of August 4th!
So starting August 4th, make sure to join in on all the angling fun and excitement and participate in our fishing adventures with utmost enthusiasm to get your free Premium days (August 11th - 13th). More treats to come closer to Anniversary Day - August 11th, stay tuned!

Oh yeah, and prepare for the Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup that starts on the 8th of August!
Tight Lines and...let the fun begin!

[b]Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/93b1825959cf378e626208d528c088caf3a0e97a.png[/img]

[list] [*] Tournament is held on Alberta’s White Moose Lake, Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan, San Joaquin Delta in California and Kaniq Creek River in Alaska. 
[*] Target fish - Salmon.
[*] Dates: 8/08 - 13/08, Registration begins 7/08/2017.
[*] Schedule details available in-game!
[/list]
Welcome to Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup - a dear-to-our-heart Sportfishing Tournament that we’re hosting to celebrate our second year anniversary of coming out on Steam!
The Salmon you catch might be virtual, but the Tournament and the Championship status are as real as they get!

Register for the Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup, pass the Qualifiers, get to the Final Round and compet against the very best to ultimately become the Salmon fishing Champion! 

First-place winner and the two honorable runner-ups get the fame, the glory and valuable prizes! But making it to the Top-10 is quite an achievement too!

This is the one sportfishing event you don’t want to miss!

Fishing Planet Anniversary Cup will be held August 8th through August 13th, with the Registration starting on August 7th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:
[list] [*]7th of August - Registration for the FPAC Tournament begins.
[*]8th of August - Qualifier 1 on the snowy White Moose Lake in Alberta, Canada.
[*]9th of August - Qualifier 2 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan. 
[*]10th of August - Qualifier 3 on San Joaquin Delta in sunny California.
[*]12th of August - Semifinal Round on the mesmerizing Kaniq Creek in Alaska. 
[*]13th of August - the Grand Finale on Alaskan Kaniq Creek.
[/list]

[b] Fishing Planet Anniversary Pack[/b]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/496431/

notes.title: Patch note 0.8.4
notes.content:
Hey dear anglers,

Here is patch note for 0.8.4

[b] Main highlights [/b]

[b]"Fourth of July" event in honor of Independence day [/b], that includes various gameplay activities:
[list]
[*]Ability to catch historical tagged fish and to get achievements and rewards for it (new historical fish has been added).
[*]Ability to get tackle rewards and fireworks for everyday flag-raising on the event locations.
[*]Ability to launch fireworks on all event locations.
[/list]
The event takes place from 6/27/2017 till 7/10/2017.
The annual Trout sportfishing tournament  - Independence Trout Open will be held as part of the event.

[b] New Tournament -  Independence Trout Open [/b]
[list]
[*]Tournament held on Colorado’s Rocky Lake, Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan, Alberta’s White Moose Lake, Falcon Lake in Oregon.
[*]Target fish - Trout.
[*]Dates: 7/04 - 7/09, Registration begins 7/03/2017.
[*]Schedule details available in-game!
[/list]
Welcome to Independence Trout Open, the annual Trout sportfishing tournament hosted by Fishing Planet in the wake of July 4th, Independence Day! This is what we’ve all been waiting for!

The Trout you catch might be virtual, but the Tournament and the Championship status are as real as they get!

Register for the Independence Trout Open, pass the Qualifiers, get to the Final Round and compete against the very best to become the Independence Trout Open Champion!

First-place winner and two runner-ups get the fame, the glory and, of course, valuable prizes! But making it to the Top-10 is quite an achievement too!

This is the one sportfishing event you don’t want to miss!

[b] Independence Trout Open will be held July 4th through July 9th [/b], with the Registration starting on July 3rd, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:
[list]
[*]3rd of July - Registration for the Tournament begins.
[*]4th of July - Qualifier 1 on Colorado’s Rocky Lake.
[*]5th of July - Qualifier 2 on Lake Saint-Croix in Michigan.
[*]6th of July - Qualifier 3 on Alberta’s White Moose Lake.
[*]8th of July - Semifinal Round on Falcon Lake in Oregon. 
[*]9th of July - the Grand Finale on Oregon’s Falcon Lake.
[/list]

[b] DLC [/b]
[list]
[*]Happy 4-th of July Pack! store.steampowered.com/app/423369/

notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.0
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]We introduced special hot keys for selecting lures/baits and rods when fishing! Use the hotkeys to bring up a floating menu of lures/baits and rods available in your backpack and quickly make your switch. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/05958367d572651f10a060c8db760bf39c26eab9.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bf0382770d8ce3cc05a92e97bb1bc07b77b7fec7.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d3cf64e52ea93569bce08a45fc35cdc9fee845a3.jpg[/img]


This will make the process much faster and easier without distracting the player from the game.
The bait change panel is opened by pressing "Z" key(as default), while holding "Z" key you can set a new bait by scrolling the mouse wheel.
The rod change panel is opened by pressing "Q" key(as default), while holding "Q" key you can set a new rod by scrolling the mouse wheel.[/*][*]New mechanism and animation for predatory fish striking a float rig. Now a predator’s strike looks more aggressive and intense, making it easy to distinguish from a non-predatory fish and get prepared for a real fight![/*][*]New tutorial slides added.[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*]Some localization bugs fixed.[/*][*]Quanchkin Lake, Kaniq Creek and Saint-Croix optimized.[/*][*]New faces for 3D characters added.[/*][*]More sounds added and lobby music changed.[/*][*]Models and textures of some fish fixed.[/*][*]New models and animation of fish jumping from the water during the daytime activity[/*][*]Fixed bobber size display for different modes[/*][/list]
[b]New Tournament - [b]Char Charger's Open[/b][/b]
[list][*]Tournament held on Kaniq Kreek, Saint-Croix Lake and White-Moose Lake[/*][*]Target fish - Chars
[/*][*]Dates: 17.05 - 21.05, Registration begins 16.05.2017
[/*][*]Schedule details available in-game![/*][/list]
Ah, the merry month of May! With spring in full bloom and summer closing in, recharge yourself by taking part in the unforgettable Char Charger’s Open! This sportfishing Tournament is all about catching the many fish pertaining to the Char genus, which means all your favorite kinds of Trout! Held on the North America’s top Trout fishing destinations - from the cold and beautiful banks of Alaska’s Kaniq Creek, to the breathtaking Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan and the snowy Canadian White Moose Lake, this exciting event will have you competing with fellow anglers in 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Final Round that’ll settle the dispute of who’s the Char Champion once and for all!


17th of May - Qualifier 1 on Kaniq-Kreek River in Alaska.
18th of May - Qualifier 2 on Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan.
20th of May - Semifinal Round on the White-Moose Lake in Alberta state in Canada.
21st of May - Grand Finale on the White-Moose Lake in Alberta state in Canada.

[b]DLC[/b]
[list][*]Char Charger's Pack [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/591971]http://store.steampowered.com/app/591971[/url]
[/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.7.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]3D Preview[/h1]

Now you can enjoy a 3D preview of rods, reels, and terminal tackle before making a purchase in the Game Store.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/fda3559c7782c5458b7771033d66f08f88e00b0e.jpg[/img]
Examine your Trophy catches in a satisfying 3D preview from the Player Profile menu.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8bcb7c28d3ab5ef1ccb9f17975b697611ef9e7fc.jpg[/img]


[h1]Referral Program[/h1]
Enjoy the benefits of the newly introduced Referral Program by getting rewards for the friends you invite!
Special reward for inviting a friend who actually starts playing the game - 50 BaitCoins for you and 300 BaitCoins for your friend!  
Another reward upon your friend reaching Level 7 - 250 BaitCoins and a special X-Series Casting Spoon 21 g, #3/0 for you!

[h1]Interface[/h1]
“No Fishing License” notification window added if you choose to "Go Fishing" without a license. License expiration notification changed to 5 min before actual expiration.
The first iteration of new Hint slides introduced. This system will be undergoing further change, so only a limited selection of hints will be available for now.
Bug fix of the cooldown timer showing a negative value.
Fixed scroll in the info window upon exiting a Tournament qualifier.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Drag speed reduction fixed when pressing the Shift key.
Bug fix of immediate tackle withdrawal when trying to hookset the fish using a float rig.
Minor balance fixes for the Everglades.
Bug fix of players “falling” under bridges.
Fixed FPS drops when players are joining locations

[h1]Fish[/h1]
Three new species introduced in the Everglades:[list]
[*]Common Snook
[*]Red Drum
[*]Gafftopsail Catfish
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ccdf90e34f85794374b830932c8705bbcf412bff.jpg[/img]

Unique form of Blue Catfish added to Saint-Croix Lake.
Two new event fish temporarily introduced:  [list]
[*]Rowdy Bass
[*]Leprechaun Fish
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
Game graphics optimized
Minor bugfixes
Obscene words filtration is now more efficient in all languages.
Language support introduced on a basic level for Portuguese and Dutch. These localizations are still being polished, so bugs are possible.  
Bug fix - now there will be a fine for keeping Spotted Bass on Lone Star Lake without having an Advanced License.
New fish species added to competitions.
Game physics optimized

[h1]Prices[/h1]
Pricing changes introduced for 12 countries with weak economies.

[h1]New Tournament - Spring Cats Tour[/h1]
Tournament held on Mudwater, Neherrin, Saint-Croix, and Quanchkin Lake
Target Fish - Catfish and Bullheads that inhabit these waterways.
Dates: 14.03 - 19.03, Registration begins 13.03.2017
Schedule details available in-game!
The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:[list]
[*]13 of March - Registration
[*]14 of March - Qualifier 1 on Mudwater River in Missouri.
[*]15 of March - Qualifier 2 on Neherrin River in the fine state of North Carolina.
[*]16 of March - Qualifier 3 on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix. 
[*]18 of March - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[*]19 of March - the Grand Finale on Lake Quanchkin.[/list]

[h1]13-20 of March - Holiday Event: St.Patrick's Gold Hunt! [/h1]

Event waterways:[list]
[*]Mudwater River
[*]Neherrin River
[*]Saint-Croix Lake
[/list]For the duration of event these waterways will be colored green!
Event fish introduced[list]
[*]Rowdy Bass
[*]Leprechaun Fish
[/list]

[h1]Earn BaitCoins for catching event fish![/h1]
Collect special pots with Gold and Silver on different locations!

[h1]DLC[/h1][list]
[*] Spring Cats Pack
[*] St.Patrick's Pack
[/list]

notes.title: Q&A with developers
notes.content:
1. What are developers currently working on and what is the ETA?

Working on:
- Night fishing - ETA 1 month
- Quests and missions - ETA 2-3 month
- Big lakes and boats (with sonars)  - ETA 3-5 month
- Feeder rods, chums, bottom fishing lakes and fish - ETA 3-4 month
- Clubs, teams and player created tournaments - ETA - 4-6 month

2. Are we gonna see an expansion into saltwater fishing and/or open-sea fishing? I'd love to be able to go fishing for big-game such as sailfish, tuna, dorado, sharks etc.

Yes, but freshwater boats first. ETA for saltwater - 8-10 month

3. Will you bring some Features which allow us to enjoy fishing (no grind) without being scared of losing money?

Yes - mission, quests, cooperative gameplay. More different terminal tackles and setups. Explore the huge open world lakes on boats.

4. Will we ever get an FLW or BASS style tournament format with customizable and sponsored clothing, boats, trucks, etc? Leaderboard MMO tournaments?

After introduction of boats the tournaments will be changed to support "boat" style tournaments too.

5. Will you bring an "aquarium" option where you can see your biggest one of each fish? Would love to see my uniques swimming around. You coud sell cosmetic things for this aquarium in the shop to get money. Or at least a moving animation next to the statistic.

Yes, and the first part of such "aquarium" will be ready in the next update within a week. (See attached screenshots - fish 3D view)

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c6f6a2206b796b9a8b70bf90dca6b90384dbeb78.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d0fc1ca364eab9bb3fc93250c6728125d37f3e34.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/fda3559c7782c5458b7771033d66f08f88e00b0e.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/45a57f54f28988601e1095fb4b52894881cfad65.jpg[/img][/url]

6. How many developers are workin to improve the game

We are a small team, about 10-25 people.

7. Are you going to add boats, canoes, or kayaks at any point?

Yes, we think soon enough we will have a beta test.
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/565ebc9e03250dd4e40cfdea929257f33ed08c37.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4d48b617dfe8263d03f1cb5251e6d0f683d99e68.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c30715931bffdfd6b9ee55cfd70ba828541fd832.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8a700d9ce056de09b28955bf9fa97609cd5da8d6.jpg[/img][/url]

8. When feeder rods and more European tehnique will be added to the game ?

If we will be lucky, the first phase will be ready at the end of spring.

9. What are your inspirations? Do you fish in real life? Do you have any pro anglers consulting? Do you have any plans to add real tackle sponsors, advertisements and clinics?

Inpiration - a lot of fishing and outdoor experience, we have pro anglers in our team, and a lot of help from the community. 
Real tackle and sponsors will be announced soon. 

10. What about night fishing?
 
Night fishing will be ready very soon - with topwater tackle, glowing bobbers and flashlights.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5 Release Note. Prepare for Double XP Weekend & Crappie Valentine Сup
notes.content:
Hello, dear angling community!

We have some hot news for you, cuz this weekend will be sizzling with action!
Prepare for the Double XP Weekend - your ultimate opportunity to go up a few Levels faster than ever! But that’s not all…
We are also disabling the CoolDown function for Time Fwd feature until Monday, which means that you can fish at any convenient time without waiting or limitations!

We’d like to tell you more about this coming VALENTINE'S DAY Update! We wanted to make this Valentine’s Day very special even for the toughest and most skeptical members of our angling community
- your ultimate opportunity to go up a few Levels faster than ever! But that’s not all…

Here are the main highlights:
First off, we’re hosting [b]Crappie Valentine Cup[/b], a sportfishing event to get everyone in the holiday mood this February 14th! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c0e891779ec8569257a701ebbd555f38662b1991.png[/img]

Secondly, you’re in for a completely new and different location [b]"Salty Delta"[/b]  on Florida’s vast [b]Everglades[/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a546a9c31fde003bca00a953b5bb82ebed8f3e44.jpg[/img]
This is beautiful delta with brackish water, where you can finally catch [b] Atlantic Tarpon![/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8a211445aaf95e43dec31f88f1e4f409ddd09758.png[/img]

And last, but not least is a bunch of other cool things like the new Crappie Valentine Pack with exclusive tackle and outfit.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/496439

But let’s take another moment and look closely at the upcoming Crappie Valentine Cup. 
Now you don’t have to worry about missing your Qualifier time window and can take part in the Qualifiers at your convenience within the 20 hours given for passing that particular stage.
Current Tournament results will be calculated and published every 24 hours.
Now the goal is to make it to the Top 20 players in every round, with 60 players competing in the Semifinal and 20 players battling in the Final Round.
Crappie Valentine Cup will be held Feb 14th, through Feb 19th.
[b]Registration[/b] starting on [b]February 13th[/b], 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier. 

The Tournament’s timetable is as follows:
[list]
[*]14th of February - Qualifier 1 on Mudwater River in Missouri.
[*]15th of February - Qualifier 2 on the beautiful Lake Rocky in the state of Colorado.
[*]16th of February - Qualifier 3 on California’s San Joaquin Delta.
[*]18th of February - Semifinal Round on the swampy Quanchkin Lake in Louisiana.
[*]19th of February - the Grand Finale on Neherrin River in the fine state of North Carolina.
[/list]
This Tournament’s Prize Pool:
[list]
[*]200.000 Credits and 5.000 BaitCoins - First place
[*]100.000 Credits and 3.000 BaitCoins - Second place
[*]50.000 Credits and 1.000 BaitCoins - Third place
[*]And unique equipment 

[b]Telescopic Rod X-Series Javelin™ 700[/b]  
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/1a7807402fbbf2fba4a8429f86c7537b57b03969.png[/img]
[b]Rivertex™ CVC Victor Cap[/b] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a8d3efd20350babdb5cb31448673c58298f1f36c.png[/img]
[/list]

Additional prizes in game currencies for Winners of every Round of the Tournament.

And now a list of other changes:
[list]
[*]New feature added - now you can use a Lip Grip - to conveniently hold and display your catch!
[*]Different fixes including improved fishing license notifications and changes made to fishing fines
[*]Added hints on the controller in the settings window, and local maps, inventory window
[*]Now you can buy unlimited license with negative credits balance
[*]Fixed wrong message about money balance
[*]Fixed the descriptions of all the competition in Spanish
[*]Some changes in Shiner settings
[*]Fixed wrong place assigned in competition
[/list]

This pretty much gives you an idea what to expect
Good luck to you and Happy Valentine’s Day!

notes.title: Winter Pike Tournament Review
notes.content:
Hey!
Due to concerns from other players, we re-checked the results and player behavior for the WPT 2017. As a result, we have changed the winners of the Winter Pike Tournament 2017. 

Old thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/380600/discussions/0/143387886728862008/
NEW THREAD:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/380600/discussions/0/135507548125700054/

NEW WINNERS ARE: 
1. ServileLupus
2. Ganz73
3. XAtheisticX

It was our mistake and we apologize for letting advanced players participate in low-level competitions and take advantage of this bug.

P.S. As long as part of the fault was on our side and winners didn't read or know English, we will pay the prize money to old and new winners to avoid discussions about "unfair" changes in decision making. However, it will be the first and last time we are doing this.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.0 PATCH NOTES & MIGRATION MAP
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]Leveling[/b]
[list][*]Introduced Level cap 40
[*]Players can subsequently reach max level unlimited number of times.
[*]Ranking system introduced: each time Level cap is subsequently reached, player’s rank grows by 1 and a reward is given for reaching max level.
[*]Level XP requirements completely changed.
[*]Level requirements for unlocking new waterways changed as follows:  
[*][list][*]Lone Star Lake - Level 1
[*]Mudwater River - Level 3
[*]Emerald Lake - Level 5
[*]Rocky Lake - Level 8
[*]Neherrin River - Level 10
[*]Falcon Lake - Level 14
[*]Everglades - Level 18
[*]White Moose Lake - Level 22
[*]Quanchkin Lake - Level 26
[*]Saint-Croix - Level 30
[*]San Joaquin - Level 34
[*]Kaniq Creek - Level 38[/list]
[*]Fish XP calculation formula changed.
[*]Now fish XP formula includes tackle params. When catching heavy fish with light tackle you get more and vice versa.
[*]XP reduction for subsequently catching same kinds of fish removed.
[*]Fish XP alterations on all waterways.
[*]No more ХР reward for Achievements.
[*]No more XP reward for gaining new Level.
[*]Level requirements changed for most in-game Tackle and Equipment.[/list]

[h1]Game Economy[/h1]
[b]In-game currency changes[/b]
Credits: Standard in-game currency.
BaitCoins: New Premium Currency introduced instead of Gold. You can either buy it from the Game Store, earn for completing achievements, getting higher ranking or next Level or winning competitive events.
Gold: Completely removed from the game. All players with accumulated Gold will receive BaitCoins instead, as foreseen by the conversion procedure.

[h1]Licenses[/h1]
Licensing system simplified:
Now there are only 2 kinds of Licenses - Basic and Advanced.
Basic:
[list][*]Catch any fish in the pond
[*]Must release all Trophy and Unique forms of target fish
[*]Must keep rough (coarse) fish[/list]
Advanced:
[list][*]Catch, keep or release all kinds of fish[/list]
Permanent licenses can now be acquired only with Premium currency (BaitCoins)
Penalty rules changed: inspection only takes place once, no additional inspection at the end of the day.

[h1]Traveling[/h1]
[list][*]Home waterway entity removed. Now all fishing trips cost the same for all players.
[*]Cost of tackle and equipment
[*]Price changes in the Game Store[/list]

[h1]Money for fish[/h1]
[list][*]No more Gold for catching fish 
[*]Changes to amount of money for catching all fish
[*]BaitCoins will be given along with Credits for catching rare fish[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list][*]A few BaitCoins are given as reward for completing some Achievements
[*]New items added for completing certain Achievements that cannot be obtained in any other way
[*]Other rewards for Achievements removed[/list]

[h1]Level gaining[/h1]
[list][*]Upоn gaining nеxt level, player gets a fixed amount of BaitCoins
[*]Level gain accompanied by a showcase of newly Unlocked[/list]

[h1]Graphics and Surrounding[/h1]
[list][*]Dragonflies added
[*]Lighting algorithm changed
[*]Visual hints added to water surface - hatchlings, air bubbles, etc
[*]Most waterways optimized[/list]

[h1]Fish[/h1]
Fish and tackle physics moved to a separate thread
Fish migration within a waterway added
Tackle load calculation changed
Unique forms introduced for almost all fish species
New menu that shows all forms and species of fish within a certain waterway
[list][*]New fish: Tiger Muskie
[*]New fish: Tiger Trout
[*]New fish: Splake
[*]New fish: Golden Trout
[*]New fish: Redband Trout[/list]

[h1]Game characters[/h1]
[list][*]3D game characters added
[*]You can see 3D characters of other players
[*]Modify your 3D character’s appearance
[*]Chat messages above the 3D characters introduced
[*]DLC items added - most items like jackets or caps can be seen on the Characters[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
Game interface completely renewed
Controller support added
Manage your fishnet in the catch overview window
Cooldown period for the Forward Time function introduced. Cooldown time depends how far the time was forwarded
New menu that shows all forms and species of fish within a certain waterway as well as some hints as to catching these fish
Premium features
Now you can purchase a Pond Pass to one of the 6 most popular fishing destinations, that also includes an advanced license
Now DLCs include Pond Passes along with the corresponding advanced licenses
Currency conversion from BaitCoins into Credits added
FF Time cooldown period reduction
Unlock game waterways and remove level requirements for corresponding tackle
Buy permanent fishing licenses
Buy Premium Account
Premium Account gives +50% to XP and money for fish caught
Register in Competitions for free

[h1]DLC[/h1]
4 new DLC Packs added, each focusing on certain target fish and containing passes to 2 waterways with corresponding licenses as well as tackle sets for target fish.  
[list][*]Bass DLC: Saint Croix, Everglades
[*]Trout DLC: Falcon Lake, White Moose Lake
[*]Salmon DLC: Kaniq Creek, San Joaquin Delta
[*]Catfish DLC: Quanchkin, Neherrrin[/list]

What else:
[list][*]New Starter DLC - Lucky Start Pack
[*]Tournament DLC - WPT Pack
[/list]
All other standard DLCs will be removed from store in future, but items will stay in your inventory.

[h1]Waterways[/h1]
New waterway added: Quanchkin Lake, Louisiana. Level 26 required.
Kaniq Creek (Alaska) rebalanced

[h1]Competition features[/h1]
2 new Competitions added on Kaniq Creek
[list][*]Salmon Clash
[*]The Battle of Kaniq
[/list]
2 new Competitions added on Quanchkin Lake
[list][*]Lucky 7 Spots
[*]Catfish Trial
[/list]New Tournaments added, 1 per month
Some of the competition now have alagos with max level limitations. They are marked as Amateurs
Minimum level requirements changed for all Competitions according to new Leveling system.
New prize tackle added that can only be won (in Competitions, Tournaments or by getting Achievements)

[h1]Events[/h1]
In the wake of Christmas holidays, a new Pike fishing tournament introduced:  Winter Pike Tour
Get Presents on White Moose Lake, launch fireworks and catch Furry Trout!


[h1]New Progression Migration Guide[/h1]

[b]What happens to the Player[/b]
[list]
[*]All players will be taken to the Global Map
[*]All active fishing trips will automatically terminated
[*]All tackle and equipment on the Character will unequip and go to Home Storage
[/list]

Home State
[list]
[*]Change Home State function will be removed from the game
[*]Now all players will have equal opportunities for travel
[*]Players that already changed their Home State will get a compensation in Credits
[/list]

XP and Levelling
[list]
[*]Level cap will be introduced at Lvl 40. After reaching it, players will continue growing in ranks.
[*]All XP earned within the previous levelling system will be transferred to the new one
[*]All players with more XP than required to reach Lvl 40, will receive corresponding ranking
[/list]
Gold and Credits
[list]
[*]Due to changes in game economy, all accumulated Credits will be transferred at a rate of x10
i.e. 100 credits will be 1000 credits
[*]All accumulated Gold will be converted into the new premium currency - BaitCoins - at a rate of 10 to 1 

[/list]
In-game Items
[list]
[*]All inventory items that were in players’ possession will still remain, except the ones removed from the game completely
[*]Items removed from the game will be compensated with Credits
[*]Keepnets and Stringers were modified and adapted to the new realia
[/list]
Licenses
[list]
[*]All active licenses will be valid, exceps Specialized Licenses
[*]Specialized Licenses will be removed from the game. The remaining validity of these licenses will be converted into Advanced Licenses of corresponding States.
[/list]
Requirements for unlocking ponds and game items
[list]
[*]In the process of rebalancing, we changed the level requirements for unlocking items and waterways. These entities might become unavailable to the players who don’t meet the new Level requirements.
[/list]

Leaderboards and ranking
[list]
[*]Due to a great amount of changes in the gaming algorithm, all leaderboards and ranking will be reset to ensure equal growth opportunities for all players.  
[/list]
Premium content
[list]
[*]All transactions carried out in Beta will be transferred to the main server at a rate of x2
[*]All who took part in the Test and reached Level 7 will be given a 7-Day Premium Account on the main server!
[*]Essential Predator Pack will be replaced with the more versatile Lucky Start Pack. All players who already purchased Essential Predator Pack, will be given items from the Lucky Start Pack.
[/list]

P.S. We would like to give all our customers a gift of 100 baitCoins!

notes.title: Upcoming Open Beta Patch Notes (64-bit Windows only)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]

[h1]Leveling[/h1]
[list][*]Level cap 40 introduced
[*]Players can subsequently reach max level unlimited number of times.
[*]Ranking system introduced: each time Level cap is subsequently reached, player’s rank grows by 1 and a reward is given for reaching max level.
[*]Level XP requirements completely changed.
[*]Level requirements for unlocking new waterways changed as follows:  
[list]
[*]Lone Star Lake - Level 1
[*]Mudwater River - Level 3
[*]Emerald Lake - Level 5
[*]Rocky Lake - Level 8
[*]Neherrin River - Level 10
[*]Falcon Lake - Level 14
[*]Everglades - Level 18
[*]White Moose Lake - Level 22
[*]Quanchkin Lake - Level 26
[*]Saint-Croix - Level 30
[*]San Joaquin - Level 34
[*]Kaniq Creek - Level 38
[/list]
[*]Fish XP calculation formula changed.
[*]Fish XP formula now includes tackle params. Catching large fish with light tackle gives more XP and vice versa. 
[*]XP reduction for subsequently catching same kinds of fish removed.
[*]Fish XP alterations on all waterways.
[*]No more ХР reward for Achievements.
[*]No more XP reward for reaching new Level.
[*]Level requirements changed for most in-game Tackle and Equipment.
[/list]

[h1]Game Economy[/h1]

[h1]In-game currency changes[/h1]

Credits: Standard in-game currency.
How to get:[list][*]Sell fish
[*]Get to next level
[*]Sell items
[*]Sell BaitCoins
[*]Buy DLC
[*]Win competitions
[/list]
How you can spend it:[list][*]Pay for fishing trips
[*]Buy items
[*]Repair items
[*]Repair premium items
[*]Pay for staying on waterways
[*]Buy fishing licenses
[*]Pay for Competition registrations
[/list]
Gold was removed from the game. Migration mechanics yet undecided.

[h1]Premium Currency[/h1]
BaitCoins introduced.
How to get:[list][*]Purchase for real money
[*]Get some for reaching next Level 
[*]Get some for completing Achievements
[*]Win competitions and tournaments
[*]In the future - get for catching rare fish
[/list]
How you can spend it:[list][*]Buy Premium items
[*]Buy permanent fishing Licenses
[*]Instant unlock waterways
[*]Reduce or skip cooldown period of Forward Time function
[/list]

[h1]Licenses[/h1]

Licensing system simplified:
Now there are only 2 kinds of Licenses - Basic and Advanced.
Basic:[list]
[*]Catch any fish in the pond
[*]Must release all Trophy and Unique forms of target fish
[*]Must keep coarse fish
[*]Permanent licenses can now be acquired only with BaitCoins
[/list]
Advanced:[list]
[*]Catch, keep or release all kinds of fish
[*]Permanent licenses can now be acquired only with BaitCoins
[*]Penalty rules changed: inspection only takes place once, no additional inspection at the end of the day.
[/list]

[h1]Traveling[/h1]
Home state entity removed. Now all fishing trips cost the same for all players, since they'll be traveling from one point. 

[h1]Cost of tackle and equipment[/h1]
Prices changed in the Game Store

[h1]Money for fish[/h1][list][*]No more Gold for catching fish
[*]Amount of money for successful catch changed for all fish
[*]BaitCoins will be given along with Credits for catching rare fish 
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1][list][*]A few BaitCoins are given as reward for completing some Achievements
[*]Other rewards for Achievements removed 
[*]Special tackle that you can get only for completing Achievements. 
[/list]

[h1]Level gaining[/h1][list][*]Upоn gaining nеxt level, player gets a fixed amount of BaitCoins
[*]Level gain accompanied by a showcase of newly Unlocked[/list]

[h1]Graphics and surrounding[/h1][list] 
[*]Dragonflies added
[*]Lighting calculations changed
[*]More hints added to water surface: bubbles, baby fish, etc.[/list]

[h1]Fish[/h1][list]
[*]4 new kinds of fish - Splake, Tarpon, Colorado Golden Trout, Rainbow Trout Lake Form
[*]Fish and tackle calculation physics transfered to a separate stream 
[*]Fish migration within a waterway added 
[*]Tackle load calculation changed 
[*]Unique forms added for most of the fish species 
[*]Info window with all fish species and forms in a waterway [/list]

[h1]Game characters[/h1][list]
[*]3D game characters added
[*]You can see 3D characters of other players
[*]Modify your 3D character’s appearance
[*]Chat bubbles added above 3D characters
[*]Players count in the room will be different - from 5 to 10
[*]DLC items added - apparel like jackets and caps can be seen on the character[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1][list]
[*]Game interface completely renewed
[*]Controller support added
[*]Manage your fishnet in the catch overview window[/list]

[h1]Premium features[/h1][list]
[*]Now you can buy a Pond Pass (which includes advanced license) to one of the 6 most popular fishing destinations
[*]DLCs now include Pond Passes to fishing destinations along with Advanced licenses
[*]Currency conversion
[*]Skip FF Time cooldown
[*]Unlock game waterways and remove level requirements for corresponding tackle
[*]Buy permanent fishing licenses
[*]Buy Premium Account:[list]
[*]Premium Account gives +50% to XP and money for fish caught
[*]Register in Competitions for free
[*]Lets you create Private rooms and Friend Only rooms (don't mistake it with playing with a friends - you can play with friends in the same room for free)
[*]50% less coldown time [/list]
[/list]

[h1]DLC[/h1][list]
[*]4 new DLC Packs added, each focusing on certain target fish and containing passes to 2 waterways with corresponding licenses as well as tackle sets for target fish.  
[*]Bass DLC: Saint Croix, Everglades
[*]Trout DLC: Falcon Lake, White Moose Lake
[*]Salmon DLC: Kaniq Creek, San Joaquin Delta
[*]Catfish DLC: Quanchkin, Neherrrin 
[*]All other DLCs will be eventually removed. 
[/list]

[h1]Waterways[/h1][list]
[*]New waterway added: Quanchkin Lake, Louisiana. Level 26 required.
[*]Alaska nerfed
[/list]

[h1]Competition features[/h1][list]
[*]2 new Competitions added on Kaniq Creek[list]
[*]Salmon Clash
[*]The Battle of Kaniq[/list]
[*]2 new Competitions added on Quanchkin Lake[list]
[*]Lucky 7 Spots
[*]Catfish Trial
[/list]
[*]New Tournaments will be added, 1 per month.
[*]Competition copies added to the first 8 waterways with maximum level limit.
[*]All Competitions require Min Level 10.
[*]Minimum level requirements changed for all Competitions according to new Leveling system.
[*]New Top Series tackle added that can only be won in Competitions, Tournaments or gained for Achievements. 
[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1][list]
[*]In the wake of Christmas holidays, a new Pike fishing tournament introduced:  Winter Pike Tour
[*]Launch fireworks, get New Year gifts and catch Furry Trout on White Moose Lake!
[/list]
