notes.title: Gar-o-Ween Resurrection
notes.content:
[h1]Freaky Halloween Fishing[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0f20a10ea6e38cb17da9b1bcba6974cddc9d2fac.png[/img]

Hey, angling community!
Looks like this Halloween you're in for some terrifyingly exciting fishing! Are you up for it? Then get ready for GAR-O-WEEN: RESURRECTION! 

[h1]ACCEPT THE CHALLENGE IF YOU DARE[/h1]
Scary and huge monster-mutant gars have been once again spotted in Missouri, North Carolina and Florida! 

If you have the courage, try catching them at night time (9 p.m. - 5 a.m.) using special freaky baits and glowing bobbers! 

Catch a certain number of each kind of Gar to earn a new and more complex 3rd level unique halloween-style achievement, especially if you didn’t get one last year! For passing all three stages of each Achievement you'll be awarded an exclusive new item which only the monster-gar-hunters will have in Fishing Planet! Make sure to be one of the few. 


Hurry! The time is ticking and this event will last for a limited time only, ending on the spooky Midnight of Nov 7th! 


[h1]DISCOUNTS IN PREMIUM SHOP INTRODUCED[/h1]
You’ve been asking for it, so yes, there will be discounts! 30-Day and 7-Day Premium accounts at 30% OFF and an additional 13% OFF all other Premiums and Money Packs! 

[h1][url=store.steampowered.com/app/496433]MONSTER NIGHT PACK Available[/url][/h1]

Get the best possible tackle for conquering Mutant Gars with our EXCLUSIVE Halloween edition fishing goodies like the freaky Purple Bat™ Telescopic Rod and the bony SkeleHand™ Match Rod, plus the new Ghost Reel™ with  unmatched monster fighting potential. Combined with creepy Halloween baits, night fishing Glow Bobbers and the capacious Iron Maiden Stringer, this super scary tackle is sure to help you land the horrendous mutant Gars this Gar-O-Ween and earn freaky new Achievements to win creepy prizes! 

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/496433][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/be969970dbb14c550e318730263cf9954957add2.jpg[/img][/url]

[H1][url=store.steampowered.com/app/496433]BUY IT NOW![/url][/H1]

[h1]YOUR FAVORITE MONSTER FISH ARE BACK! (MUTANT GARS):[/h1]
- Albino Ghost Gar (FLORIDA) 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/dc94f7d78a496c03eba7729d356c96e67ba0ea72.png[/img]
- Green Ogre Gar (NORTH CAROLINA) 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/67522c7cd2ac19f8566abb2bf876f0e083e2dff8.png[/img]
- Black Vampire Gar (MISSOURI) 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/97dd7070bbd5cd030b65f165328009cd4e7a37af.png[/img]

[h1]FEATURES ADDED[/h1]
New exclusive rods added, available in the Monster Night Pack Only 
Your favorite freaky baits are back! Look for them in Local Shops!
Three Halloween-style Achievements upgraded and complicated!
Exclusive Halloween-edition tackle and equipment!
Sinister evil eyes glowing in the darkness will creep you out at night! 
Look up at the night sky to see the sneaky evil moon!
Turn up the volume for scary night sounds!
Gather all your courage and GO NIGHT FISHING! 


[h1]GAR-O-WEEN ACHIEVEMENT DETAILS[/h1]
We’ve changed last year’s three cumulative Halloween Achievements based on catching Halloween Monster Gars (one Achievement for each kind of Gar). If you missed out on last year’s Halloween event, you’ll love getting these awesome creepy prizes for getting to the final stage of each Gar-O-Ween Achievement! 

[b]SILVER BULLET ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Black Vampire Gars REWARD - SCARECROW HAT [/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/9527443e6d940fedd6485092681f0cbc990b3e6a.png[/img]

[b]GRAB YOUR TORCH AND PITCHFORKS! ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Green Ogre Gars REWARD - PSYCHO KILLER VEST 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/690e470f23994854bd94941fb67ce9c749feb954.png[/img]

GHOST SUMMONER ACHIEVEMENT FOR CATCHING Albino Ghost Gars REWARD - PANDORA’S BOX [/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/39c3ea4a1fdc359513c9ac3b5ed062c5e1a1e0ba.png[/img]

[h1]SCARY FISHING TIPS[/h1]
Keep in mind that even superb tackle alone won’t get the job done. Only your skills and knowledge will land those huge Monster Gars! Here’s a few tips: 
Halloween Baits for Halloween Gars! But don’t forget about the classic Gar yummies. 

Mutant Gars are feisty and muscular fish, so make sure to use the most powerful tackle available! 

For big Gars use big Hooks. These fellows have huge snouts! 

There are many spots where Gars feed at each location, search them if you are not afraid! 

...Scary Halloween Fishing!

notes.content:
Fellow anglers, in 5 minutes we shall need to reboot servers for maintenance purposes. 

During the reboot we shall as well apply a small fix that shall fix the premium shop issues that prevented some of you from making purchases.

notes.title: BUGFIX AND OPTIMIZATION UPDATE COMING IN 10 MINUTES
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers!

During the Alaska Anniversary update we have received a significant amount of feedback from you regarding the issues that previously stayed out of our scope.

Here goes:

[list]
[*]We have researched the differences between the expected fish activity and the actual fish activity reported by some players based on player statistics and applied a fix to Fish AI in terms of lure and bait attractivity. The players that have previously experienced awkwardly low fish activity should see increase after the patch.
[*]Starting, ending and canceling Competitions sometimes resulted in bugs, we have researched and fixed reported issues.
[*]Sometimes the automated maintenance server reboot coincided with Competitions, we have ensured this would never occur again and tuned the Competitions schedule accordingly.
[*]The great Compost Pile on the Home waterway sometimes experienced worm outages. We ensured that the pile is the land of plenty for worms.
[*]We have applied deep optimization towards server performance which should result in higher overall sustainability of the game.

We continue our work and will share the news soon.

Tight lines!

notes.title: Alaska Update Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We want to thank you for the feedback on our recently added Kaniq Creek, Alaska.

The team worked hard on evaluating and tuning the fish activity and balance, creating truly realistic, dynamic and challenging fishing environment on this great northern creek and now it is time to set it live!

We have as well performed several optimisation sessions and the overall Alaska experience should be a lot better now.

The fish population is now significantly increased! Enjoy the salmon fishing!

P.S.

THE CLIENT VERSION WILL REMAIN THE SAME, THIS IS A SERVER UPDATE


Tight lines!

notes.title: Alaska update
notes.content:
Hey there guys!

After releasing Alaska we have received a considerable ammount of feedback about the issues with the waterway. After researching the matter we need to acknowledge that Alaska has severe issues and bugs in terms of Fish AI and physics which may cause performance issues too.

We are sorry for the inconvenience you have experienced and we assure you that in the vey idea of making an Alaskan area waterway we had a wish to deliver the celebration of fishing with plenty of fish during spawning season.

Soon we shall release fixes and address the issues with Alaska, we shall reimburse the credits you lost due to the trips with no catch and issue additional courtesy perks to you.

Thank you for being with us and sorry for letting you down.

notes.title: A year later...
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers!

They say time flies... Is there a word that can describe how fast the past year has passed? It has been almost too fast.

A year and one day ago we have released Fishing Planet to the open world and let everyone play the game and leave a review. Right upon release we had issues with inventory which appeared only during massive usage of our servers by real players. I remember the days really good. As Killerwhale likes to joke "We were replying in support emails 24/7 with a 30-minute break to put face on the keyboard and cry". 

But the most memorable thing for me was the immense support from you guys despite the bugs, the inconsistencies we had. It helped us work better, move faster and cry less.


Some things stay with you until the end and it this community has given us moments we will never forget. In particular, the story of our dear and beloved Mod Flaguitars. We love you Fla, you take a lot of negative but you are one awesome guy. Thank you.

Posts like the one I am about to paste here will keep us moving no matter what.

"I love fishing planet is for the following reasons.

I have a high-level disability and have a great love for fishing but never really get the opportunity to do it much anymore! I have been searching for many years now looking for a game that has the realisms of fishing as you would in real life. But most of the arcade games are totally ridiculous. 

Fishing Planet is a game that I can play unaided all by myself. As I cannot use my hands, I use a mouth operated mouse called the Quadjoy and just by using the sipping and puffing for left and right mouse functions. I can compete on a level playing field with everybody else in the game which is the most important thing for me.

I have made my way up to level 20 now has been a blast, with much appreciated assistance through some pretty awesome people along the way giving pointers and hints nudging in the right direction. Not forgetting numerous friends made from all over the world from within the game

Looking forward to the future upgrades of the game and it's unlimited potential for going global for all types of species. Especially barramundi from down under

But most importantly because of my disability and being stuck in bed for long periods of time. Fishing Planet has been a great out for me, being able to immerse myself in to very graphically pleasing environment catching fish leaving the real world behind

Cheers Ilovesunshine a.k.a. Richard"

Richard, all of you guys. Thank you for being with us, thank you for supporting us, thank you fro criticizing us and helping us in any possible way. 

We do this for you, we do this to show how immense the world of sportfishing is, how beautiful the nature.

We frequently say that we have a small team, but that is not true, our team is huge and all of you are a part of this team (the grumpy ones too).

P.S.
The Anniversary patch is true, it will feature Alaska, a special tournament, lots of fixing and nice perks you will definitely enjoy. E.T.A. later this month.


Tight Lines!

notes.title: Fishing Planet iCast Odyssey (teaser included)
notes.content:
Hello fellow anglers! As promised it is time for us to tell the story of our journey to the iCast 2016 show and how we explored the fishing America.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8a8a7875191f693e1b6ab3a9be149f42e9cbef84.jpg[/img]

I would like to start with saying that the scale of iCast show is just immense, its incredibly big in terms of space and crowded in terms of people visiting it. 

In a matter hours we witnessed how hundreds of showcase platforms and booths were put together, how thousands of people worked to transform an empty hangar into the celebration of fishing. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/20cdc3822643e434e1d6ff6ac2617c490ef101a1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bc587fdf7968cfa7ace214143dbbd3479644b94e.jpg[/img]

So did we...
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bfb6958490f7953f42902d412933070d57783390.jpg[/img]

Hundreds of tackle companies gather each year at one place to showcase new products. But new on iCast is now new in the regular meaning you'd expect. A lot of companies from the industry deliver close to no innovation and only the very few struggle to move the fishing industry ahead. As you may assume - Fishing Planet is one of the brave few. The thing is, several years in a row the fishing industry experts notice that the sales of fishing licenses to the underaged have decreased by 30% and there is no one in the industry with the solution to the problem. But us... =)

When we were heading to the show we aimed to get the real tackle companies work with Fishing Planet and add their produce to the game. We as well wanted to get the feedback from the real Pro anglers if they feel the game is as real as we say it is.

So we started slow with no hustle, after we set up the booth with three huge 4k screens and a VR showcase people started coming.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4fab587eef25924adcb8b4f1d25396e0ac81a648.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b9ac204877cd5449bf0a51ee7ea257efe97c1ecc.jpg[/img]

The rumor had it - odd guys from Easter Europe had an awesome thing one should try. And it was not long that we had people pouring to our booth from all over iCast and tackle producers started passing by our booth.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/db0328f2c5246c58bc94fb97559d5ce3f5557bd6.jpg[/img]

Then we had a first Pro-angler say his word - Remington Barkley, the future champion was just blown away with what he saw.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d13f951c44ac417165f84195616d780c5c2503ce.jpg[/img]

More and more media reps were coming, bloggers, youtubers but it was not until the kids started playing our game that the big tackle guys showed up.

Some of the children playing the game at our booth were the kids of tackle company executives. It turned out that after they found our game they were playing it same whole night. The proof that Fishing Planet is the best tool to appeal to the younger generation was in our hands.

And the younger generation made it's choice
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c72c2de4834bd8c4b564aaa7708cd054275e6efd.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d021b6aeb2fad2e6559dc5dc2151933104e8a8ab.jpg[/img]

As we are now in the middle of negotiations I won't tell you who the big guys are, but you have surely used their tackle.

In short words, we had huge media coverage, a lot of visitors, unbelievably positive response and quite a lot of opportunities have emerged that could help Fishing Planet grow.

Oh, I almsot forgot to post a team picture =)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0b212177f5a17e256986e737b684450288c802ab.jpg[/img]

Now, when we finished with iCast we went to explore fishing itself. Frankly speaking, we weren't as good as you guys may be, but we've caught some fish and enjoyed the beauty of American nature, we discover the Everglades, researched the San Joaquin Delta and caught fish.

Meet Ivan (the Artist)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/074df5bcc3b980fefa1e3a93f452c7e8c844a60f.jpg[/img]

Meet Ivan (the Engineer)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/360c27620c792665823fd3cd341716a660b70223.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5be9fc941c283d57dc2b09b1ac6d9be5dfbe02f2.jpg[/img]

But even this was not the end of our journey. After iCast and the expedition part of our trip we went to San Francisco to participate in Casual Connect award ceremony for the Independent developers. But that's a completely different story...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d4110fdc23695b1207dff3dabe9493b2b34c8d76.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8afadb842b09823dce411407fbb6af5725d18067.jpg[/img]

P.S.

I promised you a teaser, didn't I?

Behold, the pure and wild natural beauty of Alaska (reminds you of the Revenant movie, doesn't it?).

But even more is coming! 

New tackle, lots of new fish species, anniversary tournament, lots of bug fixing and nice perks like ability to walk while fishing) You'll love it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a8a43e4a79025a9e7ce6b394aa568733474058ea.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5ba100af27147aad4c5484dcc04f3073352fe715.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/60a517cc835a16abf20f0c311ab91d7657626496.jpg[/img]

P.P.S.
I WOULD LIKE TO SAY SPECIAL THANKS TO ACHILLES FOR HIS HELP AND SUPPORT, HE'S BEEN A GREAT PART OF OUR TEAM DURING ICAST, WE HAD A LOT OF FUN AND DID SOME GREAT STUFF TOGETHER!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bc587fdf7968cfa7ace214143dbbd3479644b94e.jpg[/img]

So did we...
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/bfb6958490f7953f42902d412933070d57783390.jpg[/img]

Hundreds of tackle companies gather each year at one place to showcase new products. But new on iCast is now new in the regular meaning you'd expect. A lot of companies from the industry deliver close to no innovation and only the very few struggle to move the fishing industry ahead. As you may assume - Fishing Planet is one of the brave few. The thing is, several years in a row the fishing industry experts notice that the sales of fishing licenses to the underaged have decreased by 30% and there is no one in the industry with the solution to the problem. But us... =)

When we were heading to the show we aimed to get the real tackle companies work with Fishing Planet and add their produce to the game. We as well wanted to get the feedback from the real Pro anglers if they feel the game is as real as we say it is.

So we started slow with no hustle, after we set up the booth with three huge 4k screens and a VR showcase people started coming.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/4fab587eef25924adcb8b4f1d25396e0ac81a648.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b9ac204877cd5449bf0a51ee7ea257efe97c1ecc.jpg[/img]

The rumor had it - odd guys from Easter Europe had an awesome thing one should try. And it was not long that we had people pouring to our booth from all over iCast and tackle producers started passing by our booth.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/db0328f2c5246c58bc94fb97559d5ce3f5557bd6.jpg[/img]

Then we had a first Pro-angler say his word - Remington Barkley, the future champion was just blown away with what he saw.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d13f951c44ac417165f84195616d780c5c2503ce.jpg[/img]

More and more media reps were coming, bloggers, youtubers but it was not until the kids started playing our game that the big tackle guys showed up.

Some of the children playing the game at our booth were the kids of tackle company executives. It turned out that after they found our game they were playing it same whole night. The proof that Fishing Planet is the best tool to appeal to the younger generation was in our hands.

And the younger generation made it's choice
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c72c2de4834bd8c4b564aaa7708cd054275e6efd.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d021b6aeb2fad2e6559dc5dc2151933104e8a8ab.jpg[/img]

As we are now in the middle of negotiations I won't tell you who the big guys are, but you have surely used their tackle.

In short words, we had huge media coverage, a lot of visitors, unbelievably positive response and quite a lot of opportunities have emerged that could help Fishing Planet grow.

Oh, I almsot forgot to post a team picture =)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/0b212177f5a17e256986e737b684450288c802ab.jpg[/img]

Now, when we finished with iCast we went to explore fishing itself. Frankly speaking, we weren't as good as you guys may be, but we've caught some fish and enjoyed the beauty of American nature, we discover the Everglades, researched the San Joaquin Delta and caught fish.

Meet Ivan (the Artist)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/074df5bcc3b980fefa1e3a93f452c7e8c844a60f.jpg[/img]

Meet Ivan (the Engineer)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/360c27620c792665823fd3cd341716a660b70223.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5be9fc941c283d57dc2b09b1ac6d9be5dfbe02f2.jpg[/img]

But even this was not the end of our journey. After iCast and the expedition part of our trip we went to San Francisco to participate in Casual Connect award ceremony for the Independent developers. But that's a completely different story...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/d4110fdc23695b1207dff3dabe9493b2b34c8d76.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/8afadb842b09823dce411407fbb6af5725d18067.jpg[/img]

P.S.

I promised you a teaser, didn't I?

Behold, the pure and wild natural beauty of Alaska (reminds you of the Revenant movie, doesn't it?).

But even more is coming! 

New tackle, lots of new fish species, anniversary tournament, lots of bug fixing and nice perks like ability to walk while fishing) You'll love it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a8a43e4a79025a9e7ce6b394aa568733474058ea.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/5ba100af27147aad4c5484dcc04f3073352fe715.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/60a517cc835a16abf20f0c311ab91d7657626496.jpg[/img]

P.P.S.
I WOULD LIKE TO SAY SPECIAL THANKS TO ACHILLES FOR HIS HELP AND SUPPORT, HE'S BEEN A GREAT PART OF OUR TEAM DURING ICAST, WE HAD A LOT OF FUN AND DID SOME GREAT STUFF TOGETHER!

1) Run Steam in the desktop client without the -vr option

3) Bring up properties on SteamVR and opt-in to the "Beta Update" beta. Let the update download.
4) Quit the Steam Client again and start it with -vr

notes.title: PREPARE FOR VIRTUAL BASS OPEN! UPDATE AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Now that we are sure that tournaments work just fine and we have fine-tuned the anti-cheat systems it is time to announce the Virtual Bass Open.

This is the Bass tournament many of you have been anxiously waiting for so long. But that's not all, folks, a mint classy DLC, UI improvements and fixes will make fishing even better.

Don't lose your chance to get some cash playing Fishing Planet!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b54d00f621e2e635b7eae98bdff887c8fda1971d.png[/img]

[h1][b]Virtual Bass Open[/b][/h1]

Enter the Virtual Bass Open, pass the Qualifiers, get to the Final Round and compete against the very best to become the Virtual Bass Open Champion!

First-place winner gets the fame, the glory and $1000 First Prize!
Don’t miss the most real sportfishing tournament of the virtual realm!

[b]REGISTRATION OPENS - JULY 10th - 1 P.M. EST[/b]

[h1]Tournament Conditions:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Everyone is eligible to register and participate in the Tournament. 

[*]All player level restrictions for visiting waterways in Tournament-related States will be temporarily lifted for all players registered in the Tournament.

[*]Tournament registration fee covers all necessary Licenses for all the fish in the waterways of Tournament-related States. Licenses will be valid only for the duration of the Tournament for all participants regardless of their performance.
 
[*]Tournament Rounds include: 3 Qualifiers, Semifinal and Final Round. In order to advance to the next Round, a player must make it to the Top 10 of the previous Round. 

[*]Every round of the Tournament is held in real time, simultaneously for all players.

[*]There are 3 Qualifying Rounds. To get to the Semifinal Round a player must make it to the Top 10 in either one of the three Qualifiers. This means you get 3 chances to make it to the Semifinal. 

[*]If you make it to the Top 10 players in the first  Qualifier, you automatically become a participant of the Semifinal and cannot participate in the 2 remaining Qualifiers. 

[*]All players who make it to the Top 10 of the Semifinal get to take part in the Final Round.

[*]The three winning places of the Tournament will each get their share of the $1500 total prize money.

[*]Tournaments are available only for individuals of age 18+
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON - A MUST-HAVE DLC that will make you look like a Pro. Fake it till you make it, right?[/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496430
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/496430]

[h1]PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[*]A whole new tournament with real-money reward
[*]Visual UI improvements - finally the interface gets a better look. These are just first steps and gradually Fishing Planet is going to look better and better
[*]Gamepad inversion option added to settings menu
[*]Force-feedback for gamepad option added to settings menu
[*]Tournament weather functionality tweaks
[*]Small anti-cheat enhancements


[h1]BASS TAILORED LURES AND SOFTBAITS ADDED[/h1]
[b]SPINNERBAITS[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.0 IS AVAILABLE - PREPARE FOR TOURNAMENTS
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Anglers!

Today is the Day! We proudly present you the Patch 0.5.0 with some greatly anticipated features as well as 4th of July celebrations!  Let's see what we got here for you:

[h1][b]Independence Trout Open[/b][/h1]

This is a brand new sport event with real money prize pool $1500. There are some key points every participant should know:

[list]
[*]Tournament will be held July 1st - July 5th, with a day off on July 4th between the Semifinal and Final rounds.
[*]Tournament will have following stages: registration, qualifiers, semifinal, final. (After each round we shall hold a result verification session)
[*]Registration begins 24 hours prior to the Qualifiers.
[*]Top 10 players of each Qualifier go to the next stage. You may participate in all three Qualifiers until you either Qualify or the Qualification period is over.
[*]Top 10 players of Semifinal will go the Grand Finale.
[*]The Top 3 players will get their share of the prize money in the Grand Finale.
[*]Tournament will be held on lakes White Moose, Saint-Croix, Rocky and Falcon. All these lakes will be decorated with Tournament banners accordingly.
[*]This Trout fishing Tournament implies Catch&Release fishing. Only 10 fish from your Keepnet qualify. You must release extra fish once over the limit.
[*]All players who register in the Tournament will get the necessary Licenses and have player level restrictions lifted for the waterways in Tournament-related States. Even after the player is out, he can visit these States until the Tournament ends.
[*]Tournaments will be available only for individuals of age 18+

Good luck and have a great fun!

[/list]

[h1][b]4th OF JULY EVENT[/b][/h1]

ON JULY 4TH ALL LEVEL LOCKS WILL BE REMOVED FOR ONE WHOLE DAY!


[b]Tagged Fish[/b]
This Independence Day try your luck at catching truly historic fish that are over 200 years old! The story has it, that on 4th of July 1796 many young fish were released into the lakes and rivers throughout North America to honor the 20th Anniversary of USA Independence. All these fish had a special anchor tag clipped onto their fins, marked with the year and President’s George Washington’s signature! So good luck at catching these living pieces of History!

[b]Collect them all and add your name to the event leaderboards.[/b]

And get new Independence Day achievement - win George Washington's Hat!
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e5e2ba4de0cab0f8beeee3a16c1d3dd8d81a12a7.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e48daa22779914a9517a61ab77163c378b5ea6a5.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Lone Star Lake - Historic Spotted Bass
[*]Mudwater - Historic White Crappie
[*]Emerald - Historic Chain Pickerel
[*]Rocky - Historic Cutthroat Trout
[*]Neherrin - Historic Smallmouth Bass
[*]Falcon - Historic Rainbow Trout
[*]Everglades - Historic Largemouth Bass
[*]San Joaquin - Historic Chinook Salmon
[*]Saint-Croix - Historic Muskie[/list]

[b]Raise the Flags![/b]
In honor of great date the flags are raised above our waterways. Join the celebration - ignite the fireworks, interact with flags and claim some sweet random presents!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/17405df69b33e0cf7cb70444b994f3da3e857067.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/c431bcaae2453f0852e9be27fa24aca8f48746ef.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/6579f6a293f420c59c0f15ef0510745628529353.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/7e96b579810dc31673124f54d2cc44b08a089a65.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/b805d45db84ced96118750089c5ae0eba4d944ee.png]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/718094aebe152166053a8339f0ea76b724645729.png[/img][/url]

[b]The flagpoles are located on every waterway present on American soil!
To interact press - [E] [/b]

notes.title: STATUS REPORT #3
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers!

Fishing Planet Dev Team here!

You might have noticed that we've been pretty busy lately and sacrificed our communication to the speed of developing new stuff. But today we will try to restore the good old tendency with Status Report posts and Dev Blog posts.

P.S.
We have enabled the What's New window in the game to let you guys find the awesome Pro Angler Bundle and help newbies get to know about Competitions.

Here's a short list of things we've been busy doing last week


[h1]Competitions: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Dynamic scheduling system (a tailored solution that will allow all of you (in the majority of time zones) enjoy each and every competition 
[*]Additional Competitions[/list]

E.T.A – NEXT WEEK

[h1]Small perks and bugfixes: [/h1]	
[list][*]Ability to cut the line in any given moment of time introduced
[*]Additional notifications on the right time to strike the fish added (not visible for players LVL5 and up)
[*]Fish bite issues addressed and fixed (including fish bite issues on float tackle)
[*]Localization bugs fixed (mistakes and UI issues)
[*]DLC descriptions corrected and proofread
[*]Further competition scoring and rating improvement
[*]Messaging issues addresed
[*]Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

E.T.A. – NEXT WEEK

[h1]Tournaments: [/h1]
Only several weeks separate us from the tournament madness – prepare for the new age of virtual sportfishing and train to win the real prizes. In the end of this month we shall announce a Closed Beta test of tournaments so stay tuned if you want to be among the first virtual sportanglers.
Next week we shall share a Dev Blog post on Tournaments, what is going to be amazing about them and why you should be really excited!

E.T.A. – END OF MONTH 


[h1]4th of July Event: [/h1]
A small but great event that will let you have fun in the midst of intense tournament action and struggle for the real-money prize
E.T.A. – 4th of July

[H1][B]FEATURES IN INTENSE PRODUCTION COMING IN 2-3 MONTH PERSPECTIVE[/B][/H1]

[h1]New waterways: [/h1]
[list][*]Lake Fork – we are looking forward to releasing a separate part of Lake Fork at first, a cove that will let you get used to the scale of the lake as we finish the rest of the Lake.
We shall start sharing details next week

E.T.A – to be announced

[*]Alaska River – a Michigan sized walkable Alaskan river with more than 5 new fish species is in production as we speak.
We will share details in two weeks
[/list]
E.T.A – to be announced

[h1]3d Avatars: [/h1]
A feature that will change Fishing Planet forever and enable real multiplayer. 

No E.T.A. yet, but in July we shall start sharing more details, but believe us – when you start fishing with a visible friend of yours and you his movements, theretrieves he or she makes… things are just never going to be the same.

notes.title: HOTFIX AND IMPROVEMENT UPDATE ON THE WAY!
notes.content:
Fellow anglers!
No need to say that we constantly improve each and every part of our game. Competitions are no exclusion and are subject to thorough and swift improvements. Today’s patch will make things even better and the struggle for glory ever more challenging!

[h1][b]NOTABLE FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h1][olist]
[*] Scoring system adjusted to exclude odd participants from ratings (for instance, sometimes players with overall average performance and scoring points occupied top places due to scoring update issue). Some of you may now notice your ranking in previous competitions changed to a lower rating -  achieving fair play may be painful and thank you for your understanding.   

[*] Further fish weight distribution improvement to exclude similar results in competitions.

[*] Competition dynamic scoring UI improved. Feel the action and see your performance in perspective – from now on during competitions you see the Top 3 overall players, as well as your results and three players ahead and behind you.

[*] Server functionality for additional conditions for Competitions implemented – several more steps left to implement conditions limiting participation by level of tackle (rods, reels, lines, baits and lures). Get ready to prove your skill among equals!

[/olist]

notes.title: GO COMPETITIVE! COMPETITION UPDATE 0.4.0 AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers!

The time has come for a long-awaited Competition update! The servers will be down for one hour and after that...


The fishing Competitions are finally here (in Beta mode)!

Fishing Planet team is proud to present Competitions as an entirely new multiplayer gaming mode. This much awaited feature will let you put your fishing skills to the test and compete against other anglers! Not to mention that it’s a great opportunity to earn some extra money! Here are some details about the Fishing Planet Competitions to answer any questions you might have:
[list][*] In-game Competitions are held on a daily basis, so everyone will get a chance to participate.

[*] Competitions are NOT to be confused with Tournaments. You may find the rules of some Competitions to be a bit unusual or even weird, but rest assured, we’ve put a lot of thought into every rule to ensure a fun and competitive experience! Let’s say you’re bored and tired of fishing for Bass… Well, then you could try your luck at catching the smallest Shiner!

[*] Along with the Competitions mode, the so-called PSR - Personal Skill Rating will be introduced to the game. PSR - is a dynamic rating of your Competition performance. Depending on your results it will either get higher or lower. That way you’ll be able to keep track of your performance on the improved Leaderboard with the newly introduced PSR rating. Tight lines!

[*] Everyone will get a chance to be an active Competitor! Even if your rating is low, don’t worry. There are special Competitions for low-level players.

[*] Right from the start we are launching 12 different and unique Competitions for you to enjoy that will encompass all waterways in all the States, except Lone Star Lake (since it is the starting Home waterway and is not meant for hosting any competitions)

[*] We plan on expanding the variety of Competitions by adding new ones, that’ll be even more fun and diverse! Make sure to keep track of the updates.
[/list]

[b][h1]COMPETITION GUIDELINES: HOW TO PLAY?[/h1][/b]
Here’s an overview to highlight key points of Competition mode and explain how it works.
The much anticipated Competitions button on the upper UI panel is finally unlocked!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/a1090ab242e9fba373eaefec65c42883d647a485.jpg[/img]

Upon clicking this button, the Competitive Dashboard menu will open up. Here you can conveniently select and register in any Competition that is currently available to you (if such exists atm), read the Competition overview/rules and apply as a participant.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/09e0cf588fc35c5e4320973eded83907752fd008.png[/img]

The rules can be somewhat tricky, so make sure to read them attentively!

[b]ALL PREMIUM ACCOUNT HOLDERS MAY TAKE PART IN ANY COMPETITION FREE OF CHARGE WITHOUT PAYING REGISTRATION FEE.[/b]

You may also plan ahead your events by checking out the full timetable of all current Competitions in the Competitions Schedule menu.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/e7059a4c2a1a02e507f9dedc0569fae951b9209d.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ec2d44ed75d536d212d75e1b0836a41c708f9d5c.png[/img]

Once you’ve read the rules and registered, wait for the Competition to start and head over to the corresponding location.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/687bfde3efa87e0931ac989f409cd7ff5fdb279e.jpg[/img]

Make sure that your equipment and tackle fit the corresponding Competition rules! Otherwise you will not be admitted to participate in the Competition.
Now all you have to do is FISH like there's no tomorrow!

Keep track of the Competition results.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/ef5a154df57e5796a15f5c1fb03ad07200ac496c.jpg[/img]

DOMINATE FISHING PLANET!

[b][h1]PATCH NOTES:[/h1][/b][list]
[*] Competitions multiplayer mode now added!

[*] New competitive Achievements added.

[*] Barbless hooks and fish-friendly lures added to the in-game Store.
 
[*] Ultralight rods and reels now available at in-game Store.

[*] A new DLC with unique sports edition outfits and equipment: cap, jacket, rod case and backpack.

[*] All tackle that was or still is available for sale in DLCs now features the SE logo (Special Edition)

[*] 2 new Crankbaits added.

[*] A new fish stringer available.

[*] Flying fish bug fixed.

[*] Fish AI improved - fishing will never be the same.

[*] New tab with player’s competition results and Personal Skill Rating added to Statistics menu.

[*] New atmospheric pressure indicator added to the game screen.

[*] Competition leaderboard added.

[*] Application’s performance considerably improved.

[*] All Credit Packs now at 30% OFF!

[*] 30% off on 7 and 30 Day Premium Accounts.

notes.content:
[H1]TODAY WE ARE PROUD TO ANNOUNCE BETA STEAM VR SUPPORT. 
AN OUTDOOR EXPERIENCE THAT SHALL BLOW YOU AWAY! 

AVAILABLE TO ALL STEAM VR (HTC VIVE) OWNERS[/H1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MEXGAQb.png[/img]
currently, we support HTC Vive only, VR support is experimental.

[h1]HOW TO LAUNCH FISHING PLANET IN VR MODE[/h1]
EASY STEPS TO GET HOLD OF TOP-NOTCH VR EXPERIENCE
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HOdw1if.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/k1ypLpS.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jqCuTeh.png[/img]

[h1]HOW TO ENABLE STEAM VR ON FIRST LAUNCH[/h1]
The first time you run STEAM VR you may need to do the following:
1) Run Steam in the desktop client without the -vr option
2) Find "SteamVR" under "Tools" in your library. (If you don't have it installed, install it.)
3) Bring up properties on SteamVR and opt-in to the "Beta Update" beta. Let the update download.
4) Quit the Steam Client again and start it with -vr



P.S.
Alex here, guys, the experience is very impressive. To be honest we ourselves did not expect it to be so immersive.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0 COMING IN 30 MINUTES! BRACE YOURSELVES!
notes.content:
Hey there!

The game-changing Update is almost here! We have put a lot of effort in delivering it and you should know - fishing is now addictive as never before. Things shall be tuned but we are sure that current update will change the way you fish!

Read the updates with attention!

[h1]Additional tackle parameters[/h1]
 [list][*]New parameters influencing casting mechanic
1) Rod Casting Test
2) Lure Weight 
3) Lure Windage
4) Line Thickness – visibility factor in Fish AI increased
5) Reel Type (cast reel or spin reel)
6) Line  Type (braid or mono/flur)
7) Min Cast Weight (of lure) for cast reels
[*]New bobber params enabling unique sensitivity and lifting capacity for each bobber type[/list]

BALANCE YOUR SETUP WISELY! THE SETUP IS ALWAYS A BALANCE NOW!

HEAVY LURES CAN BREAK THIN LINE AND IF THE LINE IS STRONG ENOUGH AND YOU CAST A STONE-HEAVY LURE YOU MAY DAMAGE A LIGHT ROD.

STRONG LINE REQUIRES A STRONG REEL AND MAY SAFE YOU FROM THE INITIAL STRIKE OF A FISH BUT BREAK YOUR REEL IN THE LEAST APPROPRIATE MOMENT.

IDEAL CASTING DISTANCE DEPENDS ON PUTTING THE RIGHT LINE, LURE, ROD AND REEL. IT ALL MATTERS!

BOBBERS NOW SINK IF YOU USE A TOO HEAVY BAIT. READ BOBBER MAXFLOATWEIGHT PARAMETER.
 
[h1]Fish AI[/h1]
[list][*]Introduction of fish fatigue - the more tired the fish is the lower its power is and the lesser load it can create. Each species now gets tired differently, some create only several bursts of energy and then get shocked, some like smallies will fight until the very end.
[*]Introduction of hiding spots for fish - now Fish AI can determine the underwater objects (snags, stones, holes with plants) where it can hide. If the fish determines an underwater object close to itself it shall try to escape to that place. When a fish enters such a place you can get snagged due to plants and other trash.
[*]Detailed tuning of fish physical body parameters to simulate its movement in water when you reel it in and it resists, how the body turns in the water and how the trajectory of fish movement changes.
[*]Fish escape due to ultra-high line tension or low line tension tuned. Do not leave your line slack - the fish may get rid of the hook.
[*]Fish sizes/weights now vary significantly. The hook size is still a factor you need to keep in mind but the overall impact on the size of the fish you can hook and catch is now a lot less strict. You can now catch a unique using a small hook, if you manage to fight it somehow =) So don't relax it is getting a lot less predictable
[*]Improving distribution AI and diminishing hot spots
[/list]

[h1]Item durability system[/h1]
[list][*]Items are now separated in two groups - items that wear out due to daily use (clothing, rod cases, etc) and items that gradually wear out per each use (tackle).
[*]The more load you put on tackle the faster it will wear out and if you exceed max loads it can break instantly.
[/list]

[list][*][b]Casual angler Indicator[/b] now demonstrates which specific part of your set up is under load, letting you react and lower your rod thus projecting load on reel and not line or rod. [img]https://i.imgur.com/9jvCQWp.gif[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ueY0Df8.png[/img]
[/list]

Now that the loads work properly you will very well consider that using UL tackle is a great option.
UNIQUELY AVAILABLE IN THE DLC
A thin almost transparent but immensley stron line, beautiful rod and reel featured in different sizes and MicroSpinner along with MicroSpoons 
http://store.steampowered.com//app/423361

[h1]Drag[/h1]
[list][*]Reels will now have 6, 8 or 12 drag positions thus giving you more control.
[*]Drag setting are now distributed equally per each position, no more exponential growth
[*]When drag works it light up on the UI
[/list]

[h1]Similar fish/hook weight/size issue fix[/h1]
[b] a game-changer [/b] – MONSTER WILL OCCASIONALLY BITE

[h1]Ability to sell items[/h1]

[h1]Line cutting window added when equipping line[/h1]
Now when you equip line we give you option to choose how much line you'd like to equip. Line is now stockable anymore, equipping line means creating new piece of it.

[h1]Chat overhaul and improvement[/h1]
[list][*][b]Private chat now functional[/b]
[*][b]Chat overall redesign, addition of chat settings and much more[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pb3QuCC.gif[/img]

[*][b]Minimized chat now available - because but sometimes you just want to enjoy the beauty of nature in Fishing Planet staying connected with your friends[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6gA9KkM.gif[/img]

[list][*]Two types of private rooms introduced - solitude private room and a room visible to you and your friends only. (friends of your friends will not see the room, no)[/list]

A very cool feature letting you feel that a waterway is a single seamless place

Roam free!

[list]
[*]American Shad
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yhsHrWS.png[/img]
[*]Freshwater Drum
[img]http://i.imgur.com/60V7GKm.png[/img]

notes.title: ROAD MAP. PHASE 2. STATUS REPORT #2
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers!

As promised (with a slight delay) today we are going to share some details of things we currently have in development.

After launch we have been gradually transforming Fishing Planet into a high-quality product and were battling basic issues each indie game faces during the OBT.

Before new year our team scaled and we have managed to deliver series of event-driven updates to add fun to the game and freshen your fishing routine.

At the same time it came to our mind that iterative and event-driven updates do not let us concentrate on our dream - building a vast world with a ton of options for challenge and exploration. Sharing and competing would be the cornerstones of this world.

Therefore, we have decided that implementation of multiplayer mechanics is our TOP priority and we should sacrifice events for some time to boost the development of multiplayer mechanics. Ironically, without proper challenge no competition gameplay can be ever possible - this is why to make a leap ahead we had to make several steps back.

Probably the most important thing about fishing in real life is the constant challenge you face - "Will your regular techniques work? Did you read the environmental changes correct? Will you have enough time to explore and discover the spots, where should you go first?"
A great mix of known and unknown an eternal rivalry of human rational spirit (the feeling of control) and nature's unpredictability and power. 

All of that meant we need to tune and improve the very heart of Fishing Planet:

[h1]Fish AI[/h1]
[list][*]Introduction of fish fatigue - the more tired the fish is the lower its power is and the lesser load it can create. Each species now gets tired differently, some create only several bursts of energy and then get shocked, some like smallies will fight until the very end.
[*]Introduction of hiding spots for fish - now Fish AI can determine the underwater objects (snags, stones, holes with plants) where it can hide. If the fish determines an underwater object close to itself it shall try to escape to that place. When a fish enters such a place you can get snagged due to plants and other trash.
[*]Detailed tuning of fish physical body parameters to simulate its movement in water when you reel it in and it resists, how the body turns in the water and how the trajectory of fish movement changes.
[*]Fish escape due to ultra-high line tension or low line tension tuned. Do not leave your line slack - the fish may get rid of the hook.
[*]Fish sizes/weights now vary significantly. The hook size is still a factor you need to keep in mind but the overall impact on the size of the fish you can hook and catch is now a lot less strict. You can now catch a unique using a small hook, if you manage to fight it somehow =) So don't relax it is getting a lot less predictable
[*]Improving distribution AI and diminishing hot spots
[/list]

[h1]Item durability system[/h1]
[list][*]Items are now separated in two groups - items that wear out due to daily use (clothing, rod cases, etc) and items that gradually wear out per each use (tackle).
[*]The more load you put on tackle the faster it will wear out and if you exceed max loads it can break instantly.
[/list]

[h1]New Load Indication[/h1]
[list][*][b]Casual angler Indicator[/b] now demonstrates which specific part of your set up is under load, letting you react and lower your rod thus projecting load on reel and not line or rod. This way you shall need to use the tackle wisely and move around with the rod with attention during the fish fight.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/thu2jCc.gif[/img]

[*][b]Pro angler Indicators[/b] a more detailed indicator for pros that fight monsters and when seconds to reaction matter (and they will, they will)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9jvCQWp.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Drag[/h1]
[list][*]Reels will now have 6, 8 or 12 drag positions thus giving you more control.
[*]Drag setting are now distributed equally per each position, no more exponential growth
[*]When drag works it light up on the UI
[/list]

[h1]Chat overhaul and improvement[/h1]
[list][*][b]Private chat now functional[/b]
[*][b]Chat overall redesign, addition of chat settings and much more[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pb3QuCC.gif[/img]

[*][b]Minimized chat now available - because but sometimes you just want to enjoy the beauty of nature in Fishing Planet staying connected with your friends[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6gA9KkM.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Addition of Private rooms[/h1]
[list][*]Two types of private rooms introduced - solitude private room and a room visible to you and your friends only. (friends of your friends will not see the room, no)[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SeOl5yo.jpg[/img]

And the last but not the least - we are making the game more user-friendly day after day.
[h1]Settings menu overhaul and controller support[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JJw8zXO.jpg[/img]

All of the things we have mentioned above and mentioned in Status Report #1 (and some more) are going to be introduced in an update scheduled for early March.

Simultaneously we are implementing the multiplayer infrastructure - and will have the things in closed beta in Mid-Late March.

We shall gradually update this post and make edits, so feel free to ask questions in the comments and share your thoughts.

Tight lines!

notes.content:
Hey there Fellow Anglers!

The Holiday Season has been a real hit. More than 500.000 fireworks have been launched and about 501.000 furry trouts caught. In rough numbers that would make enough fur to produce some 14.000 Fur coats and Jackets! Wow, that's a lot! But there's even more to that - you guys have spent about 1000 in-game years having fun on the White Moose Lake.

Now, it is high time to move forward and tell you what we have been cooking while you enjoyed Canadian Vacation. And we have to tell you that we've been working hard. The list of features we shall be posting below is what we currently have under development (some features are already done).

It is too early to share any ETA's but it is going to take not less than a month to enter CBT phase for the mentioned features.

This is going to be a big leap for Fishing Planet, we are going to re-balance some things from scratch and in a good way this is going to be a different and more interesting, open and diversified game with teams and clubs letting you compete in a fair game and win some valuable prizes becoming famous worldwide as virtual pro-anglers! =)

notes.content:
Fellow Anglers!

Recently we started receiving your reports about blocked accounts.

This is NOT because you were banned or we don’t want to see you fishing with us!

When you see a login/password window on startup, please, restart Steam. This should fix the problem. 

If the issue persists, please, contact us at support@fishingplanet.com and we’ll unblock your account asap.

 Tips Up and Tight Lines!;)

notes.title: Dev Blog #4: All you need to know about Licensing
notes.content:
If you started playing Fishing Planet, you already know that different States and certain fish species require obtaining a fishing license. In this article we’ll tell you all you need to know about how the licenses work, understanding the risks of getting fined, and the changes we plan to introduce to the licensing system in the near future.    

Firstly, you should ALWAYS get a license. Period. If you’re going on a fishing trip you should get at least a Basic fishing license (just like you would IRL). Some fish will inevitably die after getting hooked even if you let them go. This is the main reason why fishing without a license is prohibited! 

If you have no license, you’ll get fined. Of course, there’s always a slight chance that you may not. But that depend entirely on whether you’re lucky enough not to get caught. You are free to take the risk, but the chances of getting fined are rather high. Fines differ from state to state and depend on the fish in question.

It’s also important to understand your license. Some players tend to go fishing without taking a look at the license description first, not knowing which fish they shouldn’t catch. Always read the license description to know your restrictions and limitations!   

To check your licenses just go to your Inventory and click on the Licenses tab. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000656101/60C1916D4F13C17817D00CD375BFDCB0A1DFE361/[/img]

Another way is to look at the color of the License icons when selecting your travel destination. Red means that you have no license for catching that fish; yellow implies that the fish must be released if caught; whereas a green License icon means there are no restrictions whatsoever. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000661356/1D0F28B45FB25EE4F3249489831B19761B52166D/[/img]

If you disregard this and decide to go fishing without a license anyway, you’ll get a warning as shown in the picture below. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000665750/65FA4D3C67161FB6E4ADACF9136A41FEA9878433/[/img]

After traveling to a certain State, you can check which licenses you have before going fishing to a particular location. Your licenses and their expiration dates/times are displayed on the bottom left of the State’s map screen.  

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000670233/26C7FE61D06BD6A4DAC2405550D048EC639BD3C0/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside|1024:599&composite-to=*,*|1024:599&background-color=black[/img]


If after all these warnings you choose to proceed fishing without a license, upon catching a prohibited fish you’ll get another warning as reminder that you may get fined. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000672861/0416A8D9027B5237C2EE78905E71631F03E558EA/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside|1024:597&composite-to=*,*|1024:597&background-color=black[/img]

If you don’t want to take your chances, you should go straight to the Local Shop and obtain a fishing license. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/357275257000676219/06250415E7F2CE6F7DB1442525A687D1A800F0AF/[/img]

As you can see, the licensing system is quite simple and logical. Nevertheless, we plan on introducing certain changes, based on your requests. 

In the near future we will introduce an additional warning that will pop up 5-10 mins prior to the License expiry, so that you will have time to prolong it. We also plan on clarifying certain text messages to make it easier for you to understand which fish exactly you can get fined for.  

If you have any ideas or suggestions, we’ll be happy to hear them out. Just write your thoughts in the comments below! 

Tight lines and timely licenses! ;)

notes.title: Dev Blog #3: Friends functionality
notes.content:
As we have already told you before, one of the features we are currently working on and are very close to completing is the Friends functionality. So today we’ll tell you what it’s all about and how it is going to work.

On Global Menu you’ll see a new active [b]Friends icon[/b].  To let you easily find your friends and contact them we made a whole new Friends section. More than that, all your Steam friends who play Fishing Planet will be added to your friends list automatically.

In case, you want to add a new friend, you can use the Search function in the Friends section and send them a friend request. Once that person accepts your request, you’ll be added to each other’s friend lists. 


[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/393300969327629122/3001BFB40835C48D89031874A59F771C8B583A6F/[/img]


In the Friends section you can see all info about your friends (online status, level, what location they are currently fishing on) and also send them a gift. And not just any gift..! But we’ll tell you about that a bit later;) For now, let’s just say that you’ll be able to make some of your friends very happy:)

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/393300969327627802/83E8B29B30D6981D0D6D432397C6A8531EA11B7C/[/img]

In case you don’t want to accept someone’s friend request or you want to remove someone from your friends list, you can always unfriend or ignore that person. 

Another cool new thing is that now you can select which Chatroom to enter within a certain location. It means that now you can browse for your Friends on the vast shores of Fishing Planet! If you simply click Go Fishing right after selecting the fishing location, you automatically go to a chatroom where most of your friends are.

But if you want to find a specific person (like your best friend) you can left click on the chosen location to get a dropdown menu with a list of your friends and the different chatrooms they are in, letting you choose which one to join!

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/393300969327626727/7E6CC8D8E0AFDBF10FD6CA820594CF647F26145C/[/img]

At this point, the Friends feature doesn’t have all the desired functions, but this is just the beginning! Here’s what we plan on adding in the nearest future:
[list]
 [*]Invite a friend to a group
 [*]Invite your friend on a Fishing duel
[/list]
We are currently testing these new functions and are hoping that you’ll be able to try them out for yourself next week!:)

notes.title: The Flare Path: Like A Fish Out Of Water
notes.content: Traditionally, autumn is the time for virtual hunting in the Stone household. This year, for a change, I’ve decided to leave my high-velocity deer dispatcher in the gun cabinet and rely on eight feet of simulated carbon fibre for my indoors outdoors fun. Fishing Planet and Euro Fishing have six hours each in which to (A) hook me, (B) reel me in, and (C) exhaust my meagre supply of hackneyed angling metaphors. At the end of these brief but intense auditions one of the games will be granted indefinite leave to remain, the other will be tossed back into the seething Steam stew pond. … [visit site to read more]

Everything at hand for your basic routine - one after another you cast [b]CRANKBAITS[/b], different lures - the medium spoons, favorite color worms, grubs and shads - you’ve got plenty. The retrieving techniques count. And finally your prey is hooked. A Muskie… Who’s hunting who now?

Pike and Walleye Hunter Pack ensured you are ready to face any monster you may hook in Fishing Planet. The sturdy rods and reels for different fishing styles and long casts, durable tools and equipment along with a huge MagFin FishHut Keepnet G and Lucky Seven Rod Case guarantee your progress is streamlined and nothing stands on your way to fun and challenging fishing.

[b]Here are some tips for Predator Hunters: [/b]

[b]Northern Pike[/b]
[list][*]Remember they are typical ambush predators; they lie in wait for prey, holding perfectly still for long periods, and then exhibit remarkable acceleration as they strike. 
[*]Look for your trophies near the waterplants, dead tree groups and snags.
[*]Don’t forget about the retrieves
[*]… Profit![/list]

[b]Walleye[/b]
[list][*]They dwell in darkly stained or turbid waters and tend to feed throughout the day. 
[*]In the spring and fall walleye are located near the shallower areas due to the spawning grounds
[*]Plastic worms and other softbait work well
[*]… Profit[/list]

[b]Muskellunge [/b]
[list][*]The fish of ten thousand casts. Catching even four Muskies in one day is a success.
[*]They prefer clear waters where they lurk along weed edges, rock outcrops, or other structures that Northerns like too but may as well go to shallow ranges for hunting.
[*]Large plastic worms and cranks will do their job
[*]… Profit[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #2 Road Map
notes.content:
Hey there fellow anglers! Time has come for us to share the road map and the vision we have for the future of Fishing Planet.

From day one our team had a detailed vision of how an ideal fishing game should look and how it should feel.

Since the launch of Early Access we were trying to listen to all of you and take into account what you’d like to see and what would be interesting to you. To our surprise and joy both the community’s and our own Vision practically coincided. This is great as it proves that we are all on the same page.

Surely we made some changes to prioritization of features and perks that we’ll be introducing, but the overall image of the game will stay as planned from the very beginning. This only goes to prove once again that all anglers from all over the world think alike and essentially want the same things.

But we are not only good at planning and feeling what you may want, we really do what we say and throughout last three month since we've launched Fishing Planet we have proven that. Just take a look at a shortened list of things we've done:
[list]
[*]New big lake added
[*]Big Halloween event 
[*]Support for 2 new platforms added MacOsX, Linux
[*]Intense optimization
[*]45 features and functionality items added
[*]12 Fish species added
[*]3 reels added
[*]4 rods added
[*]New tackle type added - Crank-baits
[*]43 lures added
[*]About 26 known bug issues fixed
[*]Multiple achievements added
and a lot more...
[/list]

Now, we shall share what we plan on doing in future and the following list of features is divided into phases according to the time-frame of delivery.

This is only a less than a year perspective. We have a lot more in our heads =)

[h1]PHASE 1 FUNCTIONALITY CURRENTLY UNDER DEVELOPMENT[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Friends functionality (first iteration)[/b]
* Ability to choose and join a common chat room with your friends on the waterway 
* Ability to invite friends to the game and get rewards for that
* Chat improvements for the “Friends” feature
* Ability to send a gift to a friend

[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]
* Competitions
* Challenges
* Sportfishing Tournaments
* Tournament Series
* Tournament Ranks
* Tournament items and tackle

[*][b]Quests with NPCs[/b]
* Bulletin/Announcement board on waterways with quests, news and many more interactions
* Quest items – unique items and tackle available only upon quest completion
* Catch-able water plants, trash and other stuff from the lakes’ bottom (boots, weird and scary stuff)

[*][b]Free roaming across entire shorelines for the majority of current waterways[/b]
* Additional location on Michigan next week and a bigger shoreline available for walking near the Lighthouse

[*][b]Further improvement of visual and physical tackle behavior to enhance realism[/b]

[*][b]Introduction of new animations when landing the fish (no more teleport)[/b]

[*][b]Fish AI improvements[/b]
* Fish AI in terms of  physical behavior

[*][b]Additional bobber size tuning[/b]

[*][b]Christmas Event[/b]
* New trout specialized waterway that’ll stay after the event
* New clothing items (with corresponding visualization. and yes, you’ll have the opportunity to dry-clean your flannel shirt;)
* Additional fun features to make the holidays a bit brighter
* New achievements
* New tackle
* New fish species
[/list]

[h1]PHASE 2 FUNCTIONALITY PLANNED FOR NEAR FUTURE (3 MONTHS PERSPECTIVE)[/h1]
[*][b]Additional Events[/b]

[*][b]Introduction of Bottom fishing[/b]

[*][b]Additional fish species, including European fish species[/b]
* 80 real-life simulation fish species
* Additional rare occasional hybrids or mutant fish for quests

notes.title: Developer's journal: Achievements
notes.content:
Today we’ll talk a bit about Achievements in Fishing Planet. 
Some of them are very simple to understand and some could be a bit tricky.

The simplest ones are fish farming achievements. Like Trout Master. Catch a certain number of trouts and you get it. Such achievements target specific fish species (Pikes, Basses, etc.) or a certain fish class (Trophy or Unique). Simple and clear.

Another simple set of achievements can be obtained within a limited timeframe. You are required to do something within one calendar day. A calendar day should not be confused with an in-game day that you spend on a location. Achievement counter is reset at midnight. 
This currently means server time, which is UTC-5.

Some achievements require to do something “in a row”. So you are required to do a series of successful actions. Any unsuccessful action will break the sequence and you will be required to start from the beginning. This could be much harder to do. And for many of these achievements you will also require some luck aside of your fishing skills. 

For example, with Lucky Bobber you should perform a series of successful strikes in a row. If you miss a fish bite - start from the beginning. Another example could be the Angling Machine achievement. This requires you to catch every fish on every bite. 

You may do everything perfectly: you strike in time, your choice of hook size is correct, your bait is wisely selected, etc., but the fish might escape regardless. Because it’s a fish. 

Patience and luck put together will lead you to success!

It’s also worth pointing out that there are some hidden achievements in the game. You will not see them, until you actually unlock the first stage. 
Search and you will find them. 

Good luck!

notes.title: Developer's journal: Indicators
notes.content:
Dear Community,

With this post we’ll start explaining the different aspects of Fishing Planet. 

And the first topic is about the indicators in our game.

Fishing Planet has vast and deep mechanics within the fishing engine. We heard a lot of feedback about our game and found that many of you don’t understand what all the indicators are about. They speak out to you, but you don’t always understand the language.

First, I’ll tell you about the very concept of indicators. In real-life fishing an experienced angler receives a lot of information from the rod itself. Feeling the force applied to rod, controlling the line tension by gently touching it, looking closely at the rod tip to understand what’s going on with the lure in the water, feeling the fish attacks and strikes and instantly reacting on them. If forced impulse is applied to the rod, a fisherman will instantly react and will try to damper it. 

Now, in the game it’s impossible for the player to feel the tension that way. However, in order to make a good fishing simulator we had to give a similar impression and inform the players. The in-Game indicator is telling you about the force. It can also alert you about some unwanted conditions you are about to encounter. A quick reaction can save your tackle from breaking or prevent a fish escape.

You should also know about some good and bad things that can happen to the line. Imagine you hooked a fish and started fighting it. While the hook is in the fish’s mouth, you should maintain the line tension to avoid losing the fish off the hook. On the other hand, if you apply too much force, you can just tear the fish’s lip and it will escape. Obviously, the fish does not enjoy being hooked. It will try to break loose by swimming towards you or jumping out of the water. It’ll pull, shake its head, and thrust in all directions to escape.

The picture below illustrates the key states of the indicator that all players should understand. The idea is simple: indicator stays empty when no force is applied to tackle. This can happen when line is slacked or there is no hooked fish. This is shown in picture 1 and can be seen most of the time.  

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387667044015152641/700C9E150FCB8E9D7EB992C1CCD43DE92F440220/[/img]

The second picture is showing a partially filled indicator. When indicator looks like this - you are in the safe zone. You will not lose your fish and you will not break or damage you tackle. This is ideal and most desirable state.

Picture 3 shows an empty indicator with its bottom glowing yellow. This can be regarded as “first warning”. Line tension is too low. Start reeling in and/or pulling the rod up to create some tension. If you do not create line tension, after some time the indicator’s bottom will start glowing red like in picture 4. If this will happens - there is a risk of fish escape.

The same goes for the tension created by the fish itself. Indicator warns you about the force of your fish fight when its top starts glowing yellow (5). You should try to avoid creating excessive tension by pointing your rod down, discontinue reeling in, decreasing the drag force, etc. If your fight continues to be excessively fierce, the indicator top starts glowing red (6). That means you are under the risk of a fish escape because you’re pulling on the fish too hard.

If the indicator is fully filled like in picture 7 - then some of the tackle is overloaded. You need to decrease the tension to avoid tackle damage. In the game you can break your line, reel or rod. When this happens, you’ll lose your lure or hook along with some line. You will also lose the item that gets broken. So it is strongly advised to make sure the weakest part of all your tackle is the fishing line. This will protect you from breaking your reel or rod, which would be far worse and more costly. Typically, the tackle with the lowest load params is under the highest risk of breaking. The indicator is fully filled when any part of your tackle becomes overloaded.

The load can be decreased by changing the angle between the rod and the line and by decreasing the drag force. This should be done quickly enough, as your reaction time is limited and overload can easily result in breakage. 
There are also secondary indicators showing you which part of tackle is overloaded.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387667044015161335/E877F7BE47C5D2C55817774C11A357062A87F081/[/img]

As you can see, secondary indicators are highlighted when the rod or reel are overloaded. If only line is overloaded, no secondary indicator will be highlighted.

Each secondary indicator has two states. State 1 means that the Rod was overloaded during the current fish fight. Durability of this rod will be decreased. Indicator number 2 means that the Rod is critically overloaded and it will be broken unless relieved of the load quickly enough.
Secondary indicators number 3 and 4 have the same meaning for reel.

This pretty much covers everything we wanted to tell you guys about the indicators, tackle overload and breakage. I hope it’ll be useful for your fishing experience.
Let me know if you have any other questions. And stay tuned for more posts about other cool things in Fishing Planet.

notes.title: Developer's journal: Indicators
notes.content:
Dear Community,

With this post we’ll start explaining the different aspects of Fishing Planet. 

And the first topic is about the indicators in our game.

Fishing Planet has vast and deep mechanics within the fishing engine. We heard a lot of feedback about our game and found that many of you don’t understand what all the indicators are about. They speak out to you, but you don’t always understand the language.

First, I’ll tell you about the very concept of indicators. In real-life fishing an experienced angler receives a lot of information from the rod itself. Feeling the force applied to rod, controlling the line tension by gently touching it, looking closely at the rod tip to understand what’s going on with the lure in the water, feeling the fish attacks and strikes and instantly reacting on them. If forced impulse is applied to the rod, a fisherman will instantly react and will try to damper it. 

Now, in the game it’s impossible for the player to feel the tension that way. However, in order to make a good fishing simulator we had to give a similar impression and inform the players. The in-Game indicator is telling you about the force. It can also alert you about some unwanted conditions you are about to encounter. A quick reaction can save your tackle from breaking or prevent a fish escape.

You should also know about some good and bad things that can happen to the line. Imagine you hooked a fish and started fighting it. While the hook is in the fish’s mouth, you should maintain the line tension to avoid losing the fish off the hook. On the other hand, if you apply too much force, you can just tear the fish’s lip and it will escape. Obviously, the fish does not enjoy being hooked. It will try to break loose by swimming towards you or jumping out of the water. It’ll pull, shake its head, and thrust in all directions to escape.

The picture below illustrates the key states of the indicator that all players should understand. The idea is simple: indicator stays empty when no force is applied to tackle. This can happen when line is slacked or there is no hooked fish. This is shown in picture 1 and can be seen most of the time.  

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387667044015152641/700C9E150FCB8E9D7EB992C1CCD43DE92F440220/[/img]

The second picture is showing a partially filled indicator. When indicator looks like this - you are in the safe zone. You will not lose your fish and you will not break or damage you tackle. This is ideal and most desirable state.

Picture 3 shows an empty indicator with its bottom glowing yellow. This can be regarded as “first warning”. Line tension is too low. Start reeling in and/or pulling the rod up to create some tension. If you do not create line tension, after some time the indicator’s bottom will start glowing red like in picture 4. If this will happens - there is a risk of fish escape.

The same goes for the tension created by the fish itself. Indicator warns you about the force of your fish fight when its top starts glowing yellow (5). You should try to avoid creating excessive tension by pointing your rod down, discontinue reeling in, decreasing the drag force, etc. If your fight continues to be excessively fierce, the indicator top starts glowing red (6). That means you are under the risk of a fish escape because you’re pulling on the fish too hard.

If the indicator is fully filled like in picture 7 - then some of the tackle is overloaded. You need to decrease the tension to avoid tackle damage. In the game you can break your line, reel or rod. When this happens, you’ll lose your lure or hook along with some line. You will also lose the item that gets broken. So it is strongly advised to make sure the weakest part of all your tackle is the fishing line. This will protect you from breaking your reel or rod, which would be far worse and more costly. Typically, the tackle with the lowest load params is under the highest risk of breaking. The indicator is fully filled when any part of your tackle becomes overloaded.

The load can be decreased by changing the angle between the rod and the line and by decreasing the drag force. This should be done quickly enough, as your reaction time is limited and overload can easily result in breakage. 
There are also secondary indicators showing you which part of tackle is overloaded.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387667044015161335/E877F7BE47C5D2C55817774C11A357062A87F081/[/img]

As you can see, secondary indicators are highlighted when the rod or reel are overloaded. If only line is overloaded, no secondary indicator will be highlighted.

Each secondary indicator has two states. State 1 means that the Rod was overloaded during the current fish fight. Durability of this rod will be decreased. Indicator number 2 means that the Rod is critically overloaded and it will be broken unless relieved of the load quickly enough.
Secondary indicators number 3 and 4 have the same meaning for reel.

This pretty much covers everything we wanted to tell you guys about the indicators, tackle overload and breakage. I hope it’ll be useful for your fishing experience.
Let me know if you have any other questions. And stay tuned for more posts about other cool things in Fishing Planet.
