notes.title: Developer's journal: Michigan
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387666306416512014/E4EE73181F004FD866261615FD9E5D50D3410562/[/img]

Why did we choose Michigan as the new fishing destination?

If that's not obvious to you, it means that you've never been to Michigan nor enjoyed the splendid Great Lakes. But that's ok! Together we'll soon fill this gap in your personal history:)  In the meantime, check out this game screenshot or these photos  that help grasp the magnificent natural beauty of the Great Lakes and the mysteries hidden it these depths... 
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/589b1a96dd3388e4fe8d31881dc7aecc.jpg[/img]


Local waters are filled with every fisherman's dream Trophies and just the catches everyone is both anxious and a bit afraid to hook.  
[img]https://thebigtaxi.files.wordpress.com/2013/10/dsc_3550_a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387666306416603063/6977C26787B5FF759CF72BEC4B6F8A948ECFB535/[/img]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387666306416604064/795B1B315BCF4448FCC2B9673A3904C8ECD9DC98/[/img]


So, lets start with the mesmerizing beauty of the landscapes around the in-game's lake Saint- Croix.
Whoever has been there before, should guess the lake's real-life prototype: Lake Сharlevoix.
[img]http://www.harborsir.com/resources/v_3_9_1_89/siteresources/my%20folder/static_pages/charlevoix.jpg[/img]



 Once French-owned territory, the lake and its surroundings please the eye with picturesquely pastoral views. Even Hemingway himself could not resist the local beauty and loved to fish here. Adorable fairytale houses, gorgeous yachts, even an old lighthouse - we recreated everything from real life. But what's more important is the fish diversity and good chances of landing a huge Trophy. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387666306416664343/02B9CF276BA54832F796B770E224321EC5B8B912/[/img]

Muskie is the king of Michigan. The gigantic pike is every trophy-catcher's dream. 
But this one's not an easy catch. For one thing, this fish is quite rare. And that was wise on nature's part, because if a monster like this would roam plentifully, there would be no other fish left...along with birds and small mammals. And secondly, this fish has a very feisty and aggressive attitude, which combined with its size is enough to make any angler feel uneasy... 
So make sure to use the most powerful rod and reel you can get your hands on, when going after this guy.


The lake also boasts a plentitude of Trout, Trophy Yellow Perch and, for all the float fishing enthusiasts, Blue Catfish.
If you're lucky, you can even land a Sturgeon. 

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/387666306416620219/98ABDB8BFDCF22ACE20767809ADA9CB4B497B23B/[/img]

What's important, is that we are already testing our new lake, and if all goes as expected, you'll get a chance to enjoy awesome fishing in Michigan already early next week!

notes.title: Welcome the mighty Sturgeon!
notes.content:
[img] https://pp.vk.me/c629330/v629330878/11704/HU7-owJlweY.jpg[/img]
Sturgeon is one of the most ancient fish species on Earth, that existed for over 250 million years. Now wonder it outlived the dinosaurs and all natural catastrophes that followed.

Sturgeon predominantly try to keep to deeper waters, closer to the bottom. It feed primarily on fish, mollusks, worms and the like. Sturgeon can leap out of the water for as high as 2 meters (6.5 feet). They can grow to 2.4 meters (7.5 feet) in length, weighing almost 90 kg (200 lbs). That’s one impressive fish!

Have you ever caught a sturgeon? Soon you’ll have that chance in Fishing Planet!

notes.title: 0.2.12 PATCH WITH GAMEPLAY AND BALANCE UPDATE ARRIVED
notes.content:
Hey there!

Today’s update is worth getting excited over! After all, we considerably improved the balance, tuned the optimization and fixed certain gameplay issues. 

With that off our hands, we can finally return to working on the following patch - a big update with some brand new content. We hope it won’t take long and just within a few weeks you’ll have many new things to enjoy in Fishing Planet!

But that’s coming a bit later, and now we’ll tell you about the current patch:

First off, to add dynamics and challenge to the fishing process we put more power into the fish fights, letting you feel the thrill of a predator’s desperate struggle for life and freedom.

California and Florida, as well as all associated tackle and licenses are now accessible to players on earlier levels. Along with more experience for catching Common Fish, Uniques added and more intense fish fights we battle the grind and add more fun.

More Gold, really more - You get more gold for reaching higher levels and you get even more gold for earning the third stages of Achievements.

Fish population distribution changed on all waterway along with slight tuning of lure attractivity for different fish species. You'll need additional time to hunt em all down.
Please, note that Florida and California fish population distribution is subject to further tuning. You will be able to enjoy fishing there to the fullest in the following update.

Trophy Perch has been modified and now looks different from a Common Perch. Who will be the first to post a screenshot?;)

Introducing considerable optimization to the 32-bit version and an experimental Fishing Planet build for Mac. The game is running really faster now. We did a lot to optimize the game’s overall performance and reduce possible crashes. 

And, the last but not the least - a lot of options added to the settings menu. Yeah, invert mouse folk - rejoice!

Have fun fishing! Let us know what you think!:)

P.S.
All testers get a Week-long Premium for all of their help!

Here are the patch notes!

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fish AI tuning (Fish AI tuning to intensify the fish fights and add the skill value to it (tackle tuned, fish AI tuned to ensure maximum fun)
[*]Distribution of fish population on waterways tuned and changed, some species migrated to different areas on the lakes and rivers (this includes uniques being present at all lakes and rivers).
[*]Experience reward overhaul throughout all fish diversity, game progress streamlined
[*]Florida and California now available earlier – Everglades lvl 16 and San Joaquin lvl 18
[*]Licenses pricing changed 
[*]Home State relocation pricing changed
[*]Travelling balance changed with the consideration of players current Home State
[*]Achievements tuned and rewards changed
[/list]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fishnet capacity status now on HUD (Right under the weather conditions data)
[*]Feedback on reel and hands when you reel in (You start reeling in slower when there's weight or fish fighting on the other end).
[*]Trophy Yellow Perch body form added
[*]Anti-cheat system enabled and tuned
[*]Permanent breakdown of items introduced
[*]Outfit damage system tuned and fixed
[/list]

[h1]Physics:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tackle physical behavior tuning and fix
[*]Tackle physics performance optimization
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixing:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tutorial fish biting issues fixed
[*]Chat ban fixing (players get unbanned automatically when the penalty terms ends)
[*]Licenses fines fix (Fines are charged immediately) 
Duration of licenses bug fixed (licenses shall last a day more)
[*]Connectivity issues significantly reduced
[*]Inventory fixes and performance optimization
[*] No need to unplug your controllers anymore!
[/list]

[h1]Options added to settings menu:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Environment sound volume controls added to settings (birds, rain, etc.)
[*]VSync added to settings menu
[*]Mouse inversion option added to settings menu
[*]Mouse sensitivity option added to settings menu
[/list]

[h1]Optimization:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Loading time dramatically reduced
[*]Overall FPS increased at about 10+%
[*]Fastest graphics setting is toggled automatically for low end PCs
[*]Scenes, fish models and shaders have been heavily optimized
[*]Fog effects tuning and optimization
[/list]

[h1]Art add-ons:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Splashes diversified
[*]Water ripples intensified
[/list]

[h1]Crashes and stability:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Win 32 bit version stability significantly enhanced
[*]Win 64 bit with 4gb RAM or less stability increased
[*]Warning message added for users with low memory
[/list]

[h1]DLC and Premium changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]360 premium now accumulates all licenses
[*]Crappie and Catfish DLC licenses duration increased to 7 days
[*]Bass Fighter Pack and Trout Pioneer Pack licenses duration increased to 30 days
[/list]

[h1]Other platform support[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mac platform support added and in test[/list]

notes.title: CLOSED BETA TEST FAQ!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

As you already know, we launched a Closed Beta Test of the big gameplay update you have all been passionately waiting for.

We gradually keep sending emails with Closed Beta invites to different groups of players. Each group is selected based on behaviour metrics and playing style. This will let us get the necessary feedback to build an even better balance.

If you have not received an invitation to the CBT you can apply for the Closed Beta test access. 

To do that, you need to send us an email at support@fishingplanet.com with "Closed Beta Test Application" in the subject line, stating your fishing or gaming experience and three things you like about the Fishing Planet game as well as three things you think need improvement. 

Please, keep in mind that CBT access is limited and we can accept ONLY 500 applications. First 500 applicants will be granted access to the CBT.


[h1]! IMPORTANT ! [/h1]

[list]
[*]THE CLOSED BETA TEST WILL BE HELD APPROXIMATELY UNTIL WEDNESDAY SEPTEMBER 16TH (WITH POSSIBLE PROLONGATION)

[*]DURING THE CLOSED BETA TEST YOU’LL NEED TO CREATE A NEW ACCOUNT

[*]YOUR PROGRESS IN THE CLOSED BETA TEST SHALL BE ERASED WHEN THE CBT ENDS

[*]YOUR OLD ACCOUNT IS STILL THERE AND YOU MAY RETURN TO IT ANYTIME YOU WANT. TO DO THAT, FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS GIVEN IN THE INVITATION EMAIL. ADDITIONAL EMAIL SHALL BE SENT WITH GUIDELINES.
[/list]

ALL THE DISCUSSIONS ABOUT CBT ARE MOVED TO CORRESPONDING SUBFORUM
http://steamcommunity.com/app/380600/discussions/9/

Hey there guys!

We are working hard on fixing and tuning a lot of stuff as well as creating new lakes and fish species.

notes.title: LEVELING AND XP
notes.content:
Hey there guys!

Time to break the silence we’ve kept since Friday.

The last couple of weeks were very intense. It’s been a time of hard work and great effort. 
 
There have been a lot of questions and discussions regarding the grind, leveling and XP. Here are our thoughts on the topic:

We too feel that current leveling and XP system is a more grindy and casual that it should have been. This is not because the game devs are greedy or unwise.

There are several reasons why the current gameplay feels so grindy in terms of leveling and XP: 

[list]
    [*]Easy fish fights
    [*]Low XP rewards for common fish
    [*]Lack of fish species to gain XP effectively
    [*]XP gaps in leveling for future game mechanics (tournaments, duels, quests)
    [*]Huge XP gaps on levels 15+ to slow down of ultra hardcore players gap from the majority
[/list]

This was because we believed we could deliver additional gameplay mechanics earlier, but in fact more time was needed to implement them. Therefore, we have decided to address the grind situation with current mechanics to make your gameplay progress comfortable and fishing-oriented.

We are also aware of the leaderboard spread issue and will be addressing it soon. The competitive spirit is the cornerstone of fishing.


[b][h1]OUR NEXT STEPS TO REDUCE GRIND (E.T.A NEXT WEEK)[/h1][/b]
 
FISH FIGHT SYSTEM TUNING – WE ARE ALREADY TESTING A CHALLENGING FISH FIGHTS SYSTEM WITH FIXED FISH AI.
 
ADDITIONAL XP FOR COMMON
 
ADDITIONAL XP FOR TROPHY 
 
SMALLER XP GAP BETWEEN COMMON, TROPHY AND UNIQUE
 
INTRODUCING UNIQUES BACK AND ADDING MORE 
 
FLORIDA AND CALIFORNIA WILL BECOME AVAILABLE EARLIER
 
INTRODUCTION OF NEW XP LEADERBOARD SORTING UPDATED ON A WEEKLY BASIS
 
ADDING XP CAP AT LEVEL 23 THAT WOULD INCLUDE CREDITS AND GOLD

notes.title: SOME TROUBLESHOOTING SOLUTIONS
notes.content:
Dear Friends! We know that some of you are experiencing certain problems with the game. Here are the most common issues and the solutions that have helped in most of the cases:

Problem: You get stuck on “loading” screen during the first start of the game.
Reason: Incompatibility with your antivirus.
Solution: Turn off your antivirus. This fixed the issue for most users. 

Problem: Camera view is jerking up and down.
Reason:  Your system requirements are lower than recommended. 
Solution: Go to Settings and change your graphic resolution to minimum. 

Problem: Game doesn’t run on computers with 32-bit systems.
Reason: The 32-bit build is still under development.
Solution: Be patient and wait for the 32-bit build to come out soon!

Please, if you have another bugs write it here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/380600/discussions/5/

Dear Friends! We know that some of you are experiencing certain problems with the game. Here are the most common issues and the solutions that have helped in most of the cases:

Problem: You get stuck on “loading” screen during the first start of the game.
Reason: Incompatibility with your antivirus.
Solution: Turn off your antivirus. This fixed the issue for most users. 

Problem: Camera view is jerking up and down.
Reason:  Your system requirements are lower than recommended. 
Solution: Go to Settings and change your graphic resolution to minimum. 

Problem: Game doesn’t run on computers with 32-bit systems.
Reason: The 32-bit build is still under development.
Solution: Be patient and wait for the 32-bit build to come out soon!
